automation.fail_safe: Exclusive locks; partial failure preserves the previous valid deployment artifact.

text.zh: 每条经验同时保存支持条件、最小反例和弃权区域。
text.en: Store support conditions, minimal counterexamples, and abstention regions with every lesson.

text.zh: 带边界经验应保持正迁移，同时减少跨任务错误调用。
text.en: Bounded lessons should preserve positive transfer while reducing erroneous cross-task invocation.

text.zh: 自然语言经验被过度泛化到表面相似但约束不同的状态。
text.en: Natural-language lessons are overgeneralized to superficially similar states with different constraints.

text.zh: 学习一个小型元控制器，根据边际收益、分歧、回退和成本选择继续、回滚或停止。
text.en: Learn a small meta-controller that chooses continue, roll back, or stop from marginal gain, disagreement, regression, and cost.

text.zh: 控制器应在等效性能下减少至少 30% 调用，并能跨任务族迁移。
text.en: The controller should save at least 30% of calls at matched utility and transfer across task families.

text.zh: 固定反思和更新轮数会在简单任务浪费调用，在困难任务过早停止。
text.en: Fixed evolution rounds waste calls on easy tasks and stop too early on difficult ones.

text.zh: 每条 lesson 固定只允许 6 个 sentinel。scope router 根据触发条件、检索位置、tool/API 类型和任务结构，分配 2 个预计受影响、2 个边界、2 个预计不受影响任务；做 paired before/after 后才准入。A-3 使用完全相同 6 个 Probe 与真值作为 parent control。
text.en: Each lesson receives exactly six sentinels. A scope router uses trigger conditions, retrieval position, tool/API type, and task structure to allocate two predicted-affected, two boundary, and two predicted-unaffected tasks; admission follows paired before/after testing. A-3 receives the exact same six-probe budget and truth as the parent control.

text.zh: 同样 replay 预算下，记忆特有的影响范围应比源任务因果门控、语义相似度或通用回归 Probe 更少放入有害经验。
text.en: At the same replay budget, memory-specific impact scope should admit fewer harmful lessons than source-only causal gating, semantic similarity, or generic regression probes.

text.zh: generic pre-commit gate 已经有直接工作；memory-specific 方向只剩一个更窄问题：在完全固定的 Probe 数量下，能否利用 lesson 的触发条件与适用范围，把有限 sentinel 预算更准确地分给真正可能受影响的任务。
text.en: Generic pre-commit gates now have direct prior work. The memory-specific question that remains is whether lesson triggers and applicability scope can route a strictly fixed sentinel budget toward tasks actually likely to be affected.

text.zh: 对冻结的异构更新对做 A→B、B→A、A-only、B-only 四格干预，抽取 typed interaction clause（兼容、优先序、互斥、局部 restoration）。把反复出现的 clause 编译成小型修复程序，在未见三元组合上直接决定排序或插入 restoration，而不是重新搜索。
text.en: Run A→B, B→A, A-only, and B-only interventions on frozen heterogeneous update pairs to extract typed interaction clauses (compatible, precedence, exclusion, local restoration). Compile recurring clauses into a small repair program that orders or restores unseen triples without re-searching.

text.zh: 交互图应预测未见组合回退并找到更优提交顺序。
text.en: The interaction graph should predict unseen composition regressions and identify better commit orders.

text.zh: Prompt、Memory、Tool、Workflow 等更新单独有效，并不代表顺序组合后仍兼容；已有 compositional model editing 已覆盖同类知识编辑的组合，因此需要研究异构 Agent 更新表面之间可复用的交互规则。
text.en: Prompt, memory, tool, and workflow updates may each work alone yet fail when composed in sequence. Compositional model editing already covers same-family knowledge edits, leaving heterogeneous agent-update surfaces as the relevant problem.

text.zh: 原始 episodes 永不被 consolidation 覆盖。每条规则维护 support set 与 contradiction core；通过删除干预寻找‘去掉后会改变规则结论/适用边界’的最小证据集合。只有在固定 context/storage 预算下，规则+证据 core 比 episodic-only 更好，才持久发布 consolidated memory。
text.en: Raw episodes are never overwritten. Each rule maintains a support set and contradiction core; deletion interventions identify the minimal evidence whose removal changes the rule conclusion or applicability. Publish consolidated memory only if rule-plus-evidence-core beats episodic-only memory under fixed context/storage budget.

text.zh: 保留反证应减少过度概括和后续负迁移。
text.en: Preserving counterevidence should reduce overgeneralization and later negative transfer.

text.zh: 最新结果表明 LLM 持续 consolidation 本身可能把有用轨迹压坏；因此不能默认‘摘要更好’，必须让每条 consolidated rule 始终可追溯到原始支持与反证，并证明压缩后的规则优于保留原始 episode。
text.en: Recent evidence shows LLM consolidation itself can corrupt useful trajectories. Summarization cannot be assumed beneficial; every consolidated rule must remain traceable to raw support and counterevidence, and consolidation must beat retaining raw episodes.

text.zh: 对检查、重采样、工具调用和局部重写做局部反事实信用分配。
text.en: Assign local counterfactual credit to checking, resampling, tool use, and local rewrite actions.

text.zh: 动作级信用应减少无效纠正调用而保持修复率。
text.en: Action-level credit should remove ineffective correction calls while preserving repair.

text.zh: 多轮纠正中无法判断哪次 critique 或修复动作真正带来提升。
text.en: Multi-round correction does not reveal which critique or repair action caused improvement.

text.zh: P0 中强模型 proposer 完全冻结，不参与任何迭代更新；它只在固定调用预算内提出候选边界任务，程序/环境 verifier 独立判真。对验证反例逐约束 delta-debug，直到任何进一步删除都会使任务失效或不再反驳当前规则；只把 1-minimal 反例送入小模型的固定 token Prompt/LoRA/skill 更新。这样把‘反例质量’与‘教师自己越来越强’严格分开。
text.en: In P0 the stronger proposer is fully frozen and never iteratively updated. It only proposes candidate boundary tasks under a fixed call budget, while a program/environment verifier independently supplies truth. Delta-debug each verified counterexample until any further constraint removal makes it invalid or no longer refutes the current rule; only 1-minimal counterexamples enter the smaller model's fixed-token prompt/LoRA/skill update. This separates counterexample quality from a teacher that itself improves over time.

text.zh: 在相同生成、验证和训练 token 下，1-minimal 反例应比失败重放、随机扰动和 verifier 过滤但不做最小化的任务产生更强的未见边界泛化。
text.en: At matched generation, verification, and training tokens, verified 1-minimal counterexamples should improve unseen boundary generalization more than failure replay, random perturbations, or verifier-filtered but non-minimized tasks.

text.zh: counterexample-guided learning、formal counterexample generation 和 CEDAR 已经证明 verifier 反例能驱动学习；剩下的问题只是在完全相同 verifier/训练预算下，1-minimality 本身是否让课程更高信息、更少 shortcut。
text.en: Counterexample-guided learning, formal counterexample generation, and CEDAR already show verifier counterexamples can drive learning. The remaining question is whether 1-minimality itself creates a more informative, less shortcut-prone curriculum under identical verifier/training budget.

text.zh: 用固定锚点和行为分布距离监测漂移，并触发 replay、减小更新或停止。
text.en: Monitor drift with frozen anchors and behavioral distance, triggering replay, smaller updates, or stopping.

text.zh: 漂移信号应在锚点退化前预测回退。
text.en: Drift signals should predict regression before anchor degradation.

text.zh: 在线课程改变策略分布，旧 Reward 和任务生成器随迭代失配。
text.en: Online curricula shift policy distributions, making rewards and task generators stale.

text.zh: 保存 actor/evaluator 版本矩阵。对固定 anchor trajectories 做跨版本交叉评分，先用 actor-fixed/evaluator-changed 的 delta 定位 evaluator drift；再对可疑 rubric 维度做 neutral/counterfactual rubric intervention，只允许小型 rubric/calibrator patch，且该 evidence batch 上 actor 保持冻结。
text.en: Maintain an actor/evaluator version matrix. Cross-score fixed anchor trajectories across versions and localize evaluator drift using actor-fixed/evaluator-changed deltas; then apply neutral/counterfactual rubric interventions to suspicious rubric dimensions, allowing only small rubric/calibrator patches while the actor remains frozen on that evidence batch.

text.zh: 跨版本门控应降低外部 Judge 和人工小样本上的 reward hacking。
text.en: Cross-version gating should reduce reward hacking under external judges and small human audits.

text.zh: policy 与 internal reward 共进化已经有直接方法；真正难的是 reward 上升时判断究竟是 actor 变好，还是 evaluator/rubric 自己漂向 actor 的捷径。
text.en: Direct methods already co-evolve policy and internal reward. The unresolved problem is attribution: when reward rises, did the actor improve or did the evaluator/rubric drift toward the actor's shortcut?

text.zh: 只保留位于当前成功—失败边界附近且能区分相邻 checkpoint 的任务。
text.en: Keep only tasks near the success-failure boundary that discriminate adjacent checkpoints.

text.zh: 前沿任务应以更少样本获得更高圈外提升。
text.en: Frontier tasks should yield more out-of-loop gain per sample.

text.zh: 失败生成课程容易重复旧失败或制造超出当前学习能力的无效难题。
text.en: Failure-generated curricula duplicate old failures or create tasks beyond the useful learning frontier.

text.zh: 先用最小观察/计划/工具/动作替换定位失败模块，再只允许对应模块生成更新。
text.en: Localize the failing module with minimal observation, plan, tool, or action replacements before generating an update.

text.zh: 模块定位正确时，模块专属更新应优于全局反思。
text.en: Correct localization should make module-specific updates outperform global reflection.

text.zh: 整条轨迹反思混合感知、规划、工具和执行错误，生成的经验难以验证。
text.en: Whole-trajectory reflection mixes perception, planning, tool, and execution errors, making lessons hard to verify.

text.zh: 只把可由环境或工具真值裁决的跨架构 Critic 分歧用于更新。
text.en: Use cross-architecture critic disagreement for learning only when environment or tool ground truth can resolve it.

text.zh: 可裁决分歧应比全量 critique 具有更高监督精度。
text.en: Resolvable disagreements should provide higher supervision precision than all critiques.

text.zh: Actor 与同架构 Critic 容易共享盲点，表面一致不能证明正确。
text.en: Actors and same-family critics share blind spots, so agreement is not correctness.

text.zh: 接受纠正前执行最小步骤/观察/工具干预，验证方向一致的因果效应。
text.en: Before accepting a correction, execute a minimal step, observation, or tool intervention and test directional causal consistency.

text.zh: 通过干预验证的纠正应具有更高修复率和迁移性。
text.en: Intervention-validated corrections should repair more reliably and transfer better.

text.zh: Critique 可能只是事后合理化，修复其声称的变量并不会按预期改变答案。
text.en: A critique may be post-hoc rationalization: fixing the claimed variable may not change the answer as predicted.

text.zh: 只在有 simulator/程序规则可验证的环境生成未执行 action counterfactual。若某动作跨越预定义的不可逆 state-equivalence boundary（例如资源永久耗尽、关键对象销毁、权限不可恢复改变），把最小 precondition + action + verified effect 编译成 typed risk clause。后续 episode 先查 clause，再决定是否需要 planner。
text.en: Generate unexecuted-action counterfactuals only where a simulator/program rule can verify them. If an action crosses a predefined irreversible state-equivalence boundary (permanent resource depletion, destruction of a key object, non-recoverable permission change), compile the minimal precondition + action + verified effect into a typed risk clause. Later episodes consult clauses before invoking a planner.

text.zh: 验证后的反事实记忆应减少不可逆错误且不导致过度保守。
text.en: Verified counterfactual memory should reduce irreversible errors without excessive conservatism.

text.zh: test-time counterfactual planning、act/refuse safety 和 recovery 已经有大量工作；真正可能形成持续学习的是把少量可验证的‘状态条件 + 动作 → 不可逆效应’编译成跨 episode 复用的条款，从而后续无需重复模拟就能提前排除风险动作。
text.en: Test-time counterfactual planning, act/refuse safety, and recovery already have substantial prior work. A plausible persistent-learning problem is compiling a small set of verified 'state condition + action → irreversible effect' clauses that can be reused across episodes to prune risky actions without repeated simulation.

text.zh: 定期把顺序更新链压成 checkpoint + dependency/restoration clauses。压缩目标不是重构参数相似度，而是对一组冻结 rollback query 保持行为等价：撤销任意授权更新子集后，压缩历史应恢复与 full-history replay 相同的任务行为。
text.en: Periodically compress sequential update history into checkpoints plus dependency/restoration clauses. The objective is not parameter similarity but behavioral rollback equivalence: for frozen rollback queries, undoing authorized update subsets should match full-history replay behavior.

text.zh: 局部回滚应比恢复最近 checkpoint 保留更多累积收益。
text.en: Local rollback should preserve more accumulated gain than reverting to the latest checkpoint.

text.zh: 版本化 rollback 已出现更直接的 Agent memory 系统，OS 层也已有高效增量 checkpoint/rollback；当前版本不再具备直接进入 P0 的新颖性边界。只有证明跨异构更新表面的固定存储预算行为等价压缩不能被 snapshot/delta checkpoint 解决，才值得复活。
text.en: Direct agent-memory version control and efficient incremental checkpoint/rollback now exist. The current version is no longer P0-ready and is revivable only if cross-surface behavioral-equivalent compaction under a fixed storage budget cannot be solved by snapshot/delta checkpointing.

text.zh: 冻结 skill body 和预定义 predicate vocabulary。每个验证反例只允许向 external gate 增加最小 distinguishing predicate，使该反例被排除；gate 不得重新扩张，且每次收缩都必须通过旧正例保持测试。
text.en: Freeze the skill body and a predefined predicate vocabulary. Each verified counterexample may only add the minimal distinguishing predicate to an external gate that excludes that counterexample; the gate cannot re-expand, and every shrink must preserve old positives.

text.zh: 局部修复应同时提高反例修复率和旧正例保持率。
text.en: Local repair should improve both counterexample repair and old-positive retention.

text.zh: 遇到反例时整条删除或重写 procedural memory 会损失仍然有效的主体；但 counterexample-driven skill refinement 已有工作，因此新变量必须是‘skill body 完全冻结，只允许 external applicability gate 最小且单调地收缩’。
text.en: Deleting or rewriting a procedural memory after a counterexample destroys still-valid content. Because counterexample-driven skill refinement already exists, the new variable must be a fully frozen skill body with only a minimally and monotonically shrinking external applicability gate.

text.zh: 采用两阶段触发。第一阶段完全廉价：memory 每次被激活就打标，只用最近使用时间、激活频率、复用间隔和局部 API/schema 变化给所有 memory 排审计优先级；很久没用、局部环境变化大或复用模式异常的 memory 先进入候选。第二阶段才消耗真实预算：只对固定比例候选做 memory-on/off paired replay，用真实边际效用决定继续保留、缩短复验间隔或隔离。历史干预效用只学习‘下一次该审谁’，不替代最终真值。
text.en: Use a two-stage trigger. Stage one is cheap: mark every activation and rank memories for audit using recency, activation frequency, reuse interval, and local API/schema change; long-unused memories, strong local changes, or unusual reuse patterns become candidates. Stage two spends real budget only on a fixed fraction of candidates via paired memory-on/off replay, whose true marginal utility decides retain, shorten the next audit interval, or quarantine. Historical intervention utility learns only whom to audit next and never replaces final truth.

text.zh: 基于激活局部效用的复验应在相同审计预算下比 LRU、LFU、固定 TTL 和定期复验更早发现真正失效的记忆，同时少误删长期有效记忆。
text.en: Activation-local utility revalidation should detect truly stale memories earlier than LRU, LFU, fixed TTL, and periodic revalidation at the same audit budget while deleting fewer durable memories.

text.zh: stale memory、utility refinement 和 shift recovery 都已有直接工作；剩下的问题不是‘会不会过期’，而是在固定审计预算下，何时值得重新做一次 memory-on/off 干预来确认局部效用已经漂移。
text.en: Stale memory, utility refinement, and shift recovery now have direct prior work. The remaining problem is not whether memory becomes stale, but when a fixed audit budget should trigger a new memory-on/off intervention because local utility has drifted.

text.zh: 冻结同一任务、同一成功终点的多种 process family。一个冻结 extractor 从每条成功轨迹提 candidate lesson；随后对 lesson 做 memory-OFF / memory-ON matched intervention，并采用 leave-one-process-family-out 验证。只有平均效用为正、worst-process 不为负且跨 process 方差低的 lesson 才持久写入。
text.en: Freeze multiple process families for the same task and same successful outcome. A frozen extractor proposes candidate lessons from each success; each lesson then receives matched memory-OFF/memory-ON interventions with leave-one-process-family-out validation. Persist only lessons with positive mean utility, non-negative worst-process effect, and low cross-process variance.

text.zh: 跨成功过程稳定的经验应比单轨迹反思具有更强圈外迁移。
text.en: Lessons stable across successful processes should transfer better than single-trajectory reflections.

text.zh: 多条成功轨迹做交集、共识或 contrast 已经不足以形成新方法；真正的问题是：同一成功结果可由不同有效过程获得时，哪条经验在改变未来行为后仍跨过程稳定有益。
text.en: Intersection, consensus, or contrast over multiple successful trajectories is no longer enough. The real problem is identifying lessons whose behavioral intervention remains beneficial across distinct valid processes that reach the same successful outcome.

text.zh: 先做 P0a 现象门：同起点配对正常成功与扰动后成功轨迹，读取 exact program state，计算对象位置、持有物、开关/权限/资源等 residual vector Δs，并审计 baseline writer 是否正向写入。只有发生率足够才做 P0b：用未来 matched reuse harm 监督 residual-effect admission score，决定 write/summarize/quarantine。
text.en: First run a P0a phenomenon gate: pair normal and perturbed-success trajectories from the same start, read exact program state, compute a residual vector Δs over object locations, inventory, switches/permissions/resources, and audit whether a baseline writer stores them positively. Only if prevalence is sufficient run P0b: supervise a residual-effect admission score with future matched-reuse harm to choose write/summarize/quarantine.

text.zh: 若残余状态真的影响未来复用，基于 Δs 学到的准入应在相同记忆容量和 replay 预算下，比 success-only、终点相同和手工恢复阈值更少产生负迁移。
text.en: If residual state truly matters for future reuse, Δs-based learned admission should reduce negative transfer versus success-only, endpoint-equality, and hand-coded recovery thresholds under the same memory and replay budgets.

text.zh: 最终任务成功是一个很粗的标签：它会把‘干净完成’和‘勉强补救后完成’都记成 success。长期自进化却会把成功轨迹写成可复用经验；如果补救轨迹虽然完成目标，却仍留下抽屉未复位、工具被占用、权限/资源状态异常等残余状态，反复学习就可能把这些异常行为固化。真正要验证的问题是：这类 success+残余状态是否会被误写成正经验，并在未来复用时造成伤害。
text.en: Final task success is a coarse label: it treats clean completion and barely recovered completion as the same success. Long-term self-evolution may persist successful trajectories as reusable experience; if a recovered trajectory completes the goal but leaves residual state such as an unrestored drawer, occupied tool, or abnormal permission/resource state, repeated learning may entrench that behavior. The concrete question is whether success-with-residual-state is admitted as positive experience and later causes harm when reused.

text.zh: 维护固定 K 的 core/reserve Probe 面板。用历史已提交/拒绝更新在独立隐藏原任务上的真实 before/after 回退，学习每个 Probe 的预测价值和冗余度；每个 epoch 只允许少量 reserve 替换低价值 core Probe，并用序贯停止决定何时已经收集到足够证据。
text.en: Maintain a fixed-K core/reserve probe panel. Use true before/after regression on independent hidden original tasks from past accepted/rejected updates to learn each probe's predictive value and redundancy; at each epoch only a few reserve probes may replace low-value core probes, with sequential stopping when enough evidence is collected.

text.zh: 固定预算下，回归门控应提高未来任务收益并显著降低最坏回退率。
text.en: Under fixed budgets, regression gating should improve future-task utility and reduce worst-case regression.

text.zh: 预提交 gate 已经成为自进化 Agent 的直接研究对象；剩下的问题不是再叠一个 critic，而是在固定很小的 Probe 预算下，哪些 Probe 真能预测隐藏原任务回退，以及它们何时应该退役。
text.en: Pre-commit gating is now a direct research topic in self-evolving agents. The remaining problem is not adding another critic, but learning which probes actually predict hidden original-task regression under a fixed small budget and when those probes should retire.

text.zh: 先用 per-item causal selector 得到候选集，再只对高频共检索 pair 做 2×2 intervention：none、A、B、A+B。把‘有害’操作化为：A+B 的真实任务效用相对 none、A 或 B 出现可重复的额外负边际效应；把‘隔离’操作化为：保留原 memory，但写入 exclusion / precedence edge，使该触发条件下不再共同检索或强制先后顺序。最终形成持久 co-retrieval graph，测试时不再额外 replay。
text.en: Start from a per-item causal selector, then run 2×2 interventions only for frequent co-retrieval pairs: none, A, B, A+B. Define harmful operationally as a reproducible extra negative marginal effect of A+B on true task utility relative to none/A/B. Define quarantine as preserving the original memories while storing an exclusion/precedence edge that blocks joint retrieval or enforces order under the trigger. Persist the resulting co-retrieval graph and use it at test time without extra replay.

text.zh: 隔离识别出的有害条目后，应恢复圈外任务且保留主要收益。
text.en: Quarantining harmful entries should recover out-of-loop tasks without erasing main gains.

text.zh: 单条 memory 的 causal usefulness 已有直接方法；剩下的真实失败是两条单独无害/有益的 memory 同时被检索后相互误导，而 per-item score 看不见这种 interaction。
text.en: Direct methods already estimate causal usefulness of individual memories. The remaining failure is interaction: two memories may each be harmless or useful alone yet become harmful when co-retrieved, which per-item scores cannot detect.

text.zh: 用语义保持、语义改变正对照和捷径探针三类 matched interventions 测选择性不变性。
text.en: Use matched semantics-preserving, semantics-changing positive controls, and shortcut probes to measure selective invariance.

text.zh: 可靠 Reward 应对无关变化稳定、对语义改变敏感，并预测真实选择错误。
text.en: Reliable rewards should be invariant to irrelevant changes, sensitive to semantic changes, and predictive of real selection errors.

text.zh: Reward 对语义无关格式、背景或表述敏感时，Agent 会优化捷径。
text.en: Agents exploit shortcuts when rewards respond to semantically irrelevant format, background, or phrasing.

text.zh: 用正确答案保持、错误答案修复和反事实敏感性三轴定义纠正坍塌。
text.en: Define correction collapse using correct-answer preservation, error repair, and counterfactual sensitivity.

text.zh: 真实纠正应同时提高修复并保持正确答案和无关稳定性。
text.en: Real correction should improve repair while preserving correct answers and irrelevant invariance.

text.zh: 模型可能学会频繁改答案、偏好格式或迎合 Reward，而不是真正纠错。
text.en: A model may learn to change answers, prefer a format, or please a reward without genuinely correcting errors.

text.zh: 为 label-event 建 provenance DAG，记录 generation、producer/evaluator family、parent label 和 update lineage；用少量冻结独立 anchors 估计来源可靠度与 lineage covariance，把共享祖先/同源后代折算成 effective evidence count，再决定 Prompt/Memory/Rubric 更新是否准入。
text.en: Build a provenance DAG for label events with generation, producer/evaluator family, parent labels, and update lineage. Use a small frozen independent anchor set to estimate source reliability and lineage covariance, convert correlated descendants into an effective evidence count, then gate persistent prompt/memory/rubric updates.

text.zh: 如果错误主要沿同源谱系传播，谱系去相关后的准入应比当前轮置信度、简单一致性和不看祖先的加权平均更早阻断坏更新，同时保留独立来源支持的好更新。
text.en: If errors propagate mainly along same-source lineages, lineage-decorrelated admission should block bad updates earlier than current-round confidence, simple consistency, or ancestry-blind weighting while retaining updates supported by independent sources.

text.zh: multi-agent agreement、pairwise validator 和 uncertainty-aware self-labeling 已经能提高单轮伪标签质量；剩下的问题是跨轮自进化时，同一个早期错误经同源 evaluator/父标签反复派生后被当成多份独立证据。
text.en: Multi-agent agreement, pairwise validators, and uncertainty-aware labeling can improve one-round pseudo-label quality. The remaining problem is cross-round dependence: one early error can spawn many descendant labels through the same evaluator lineage and be mistakenly counted as independent evidence.

text.zh: 根据失败证据学习成本感知路由器，选择最小且最稳定的更新表面。
text.en: Learn a cost-aware router that selects the smallest and most stable update surface from failure evidence.

text.zh: 路由器应以明显低于穷举的成本接近 oracle 修复收益。
text.en: The router should approach oracle repair at substantially lower cost than exhaustive evaluation.

text.zh: 同一失败可通过改 Prompt、记忆、工作流或小模块修复，但系统通常固定更新一种表面。
text.en: The same failure may be fixed by prompt, memory, workflow, or small-module updates, yet systems hard-code one surface.

text.zh: 用轨迹 KL、动作编辑距离、工具路由和记忆检索变化定义离散 Agent 更新信赖域。
text.en: Define a trust region for discrete agent updates using trajectory KL, action-edit distance, tool routing, and memory-retrieval shift.

text.zh: 行为偏移应比文本编辑距离或当前任务收益更好预测回退。
text.en: Behavioral shift should predict regressions better than textual edit distance or current-task gain.

text.zh: 平均收益相似的更新可能引发完全不同的行为分布漂移。
text.en: Updates with similar average gains can induce very different behavioral distribution shifts.

text.zh: 先用单轨迹执行图/surrogate 给节点边分组，再对少量 group 做 disable/replace intervention，自适应下钻到最小 causal subgraph。把多次验证得到的 (failure motif, local graph context)→typed rewrite 编译成 grammar；hidden workflow 只允许 grammar 直接重写一次。
text.en: Use single-trajectory execution graphs/surrogates to group nodes/edges, then apply disable/replace interventions to a few groups and adaptively descend to a minimal causal subgraph. Compile repeatedly validated (failure motif, local graph context)→typed rewrite rules into a grammar; hidden workflows allow only one direct grammar rewrite.

text.zh: 结构信用应减少达到同等性能所需的搜索评估，并跨任务复用。
text.en: Structural credit should reduce search evaluations required for the same performance and transfer across tasks.

text.zh: CE-Graph 已经会从 failure distribution 定位 recurring mode 并 propose-and-verify graph edit，因此单纯 branch credit 不足。剩余问题是：能否用少量 group intervention 找到真正致因子图，并把跨 workflow 重复的 cause→rewrite 编译成冻结 grammar，后续不再搜索。
text.en: CE-Graph already identifies recurring failure modes and propose-and-verifies graph edits, so branch credit alone is insufficient. The remaining problem is whether sparse group interventions can identify causal subgraphs and compile recurring cause→rewrite mappings into a frozen grammar reusable without search.

text.zh: 冻结 typed edit library 与 workflow 局部上下文表示。Source workflow 只做单编辑 paired before/after 干预得到 ΔU；学习同一 workflow 内 edit_i 与 edit_j 的 pairwise 排序或 normalized regret，而不是‘edit 是否有正收益’二分类。冻结后在未见 workflow 上禁止候选试跑，只允许直接选择并持久提交一个 edit。
text.en: Freeze a typed edit library and local workflow-context representation. Source workflows provide paired single-edit before/after interventions yielding ΔU. Learn pairwise edit ranking or normalized regret within each workflow rather than binary positive-effect classification. Freeze before unseen workflows, forbid candidate trials, and allow exactly one edit selection and persistent commit.

text.zh: 通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。
text.en: Certified workflows should transfer better to unseen tools and task graphs.

text.zh: WorkflowPerturb、Agentic Predictor、FLORA 已覆盖 workflow 扰动/性能预测，CE-Graph 也已根据 failure distribution 做 targeted graph edits；因此不能再做 certificate。剩下的问题是：能否从历史 before/after 编辑试验中学出一个冻结后可跨 workflow 直接选 edit 的持久 update policy。
text.en: WorkflowPerturb, Agentic Predictor, and FLORA cover workflow perturbation/performance prediction, while CE-Graph already applies failure-driven targeted graph edits. A certificate is no longer enough. The remaining question is whether paired before/after edit interventions can train a persistent update policy that directly chooses edits on unseen workflows after freezing.

text.zh: 对每条真实 transition 先计算当前 world model 的预测；再做 counterfactual decision test：把该 transition 的预测替换成真实 next state/关键属性，重新求一次当前 policy 的 action/risk/recovery decision。只有 correction 会导致 action switch、risk threshold crossing 或 recovery choice 改变的 transition 才进入固定容量的持久 transition memory/adapter 更新。
text.en: For each real transition, compare the current world-model prediction with truth, then run a counterfactual decision test: replace only that prediction with the true next state/critical attributes and recompute the current policy's action/risk/recovery decision. Admit the transition to fixed-capacity persistent memory/adapter training only if the correction causes an action switch, risk-threshold crossing, or recovery-choice change.

text.zh: 决策价值门控应以更少更新获得同等或更高任务收益。
text.en: Decision-value gating should match or improve utility with fewer updates.

text.zh: AAWM 已经把 world-model supervision 改成 policy decision needs，因此不能再主张‘decision-aware world model target’。剩下的问题是更新预算：真实 transition 很多时，哪些 transition 值得被持久写入/训练，才能以更少更新改变后续决策。
text.en: AAWM already makes world-model supervision decision-oriented, so 'decision-aware world-model targets' are no longer enough. The remaining problem is update budgeting: among many real transitions, which ones deserve persistent storage/training because correcting them would change later decisions?

separate scientific search, evidence gathering, and answer synthesis while preserving grounded citations and metadata
co-design agent subqueries and retriever choice; a stronger retriever is not automatically better when the query generator emits keyword-like queries

capabilities.purpose: Find a specific target paper or narrow evidence chain through iterative query refinement.
Collect a broad set of papers satisfying an explicit inclusion contract.
Recover supporting, conflicting, and lineage relationships rather than only similar papers.
Fetch and verify the authoritative paper/project/repository behind a claim.
Run the cheapest deterministic or offline test that can change a scientific decision.
Execute an authorized scientific experiment under a frozen protocol.
Analyze frozen experiment artifacts without changing the execution protocol.
Red-team hypotheses, protocols, and interpretations with independent reviewers.
Publish validated structured state without mutating scientific history.

routing_contract.fallback: block and surface the missing capability; never silently replace a missing scientific tool with a more permissive generic interface

retrieval_router_contract.rule: route query formulation and retriever jointly rather than selecting a retriever in isolation
retrieval_router_contract.simple_first: BM25/lexical retrieval remains a mandatory matched baseline before a reasoning-heavy retriever is promoted
retrieval_router_contract.promotion_gate: a complex retriever must improve the frozen literature benchmark under the same query generator, corpus, cutoff, and budget
retrieval_router_contract.domain_mismatch: if a retriever loses under domain-matched evaluation, retain the simpler retriever and record the mismatch as a failure asset

references.adopted: evaluate target-paper Deep Research and open-ended Wide Research as separate literature capabilities
evaluate ego-, pair-, and path-level scientific relations rather than only content similarity
separate paper search, evidence gathering, and answer generation with citation/metadata provenance

verifier_contract.rule: A model/judge verdict is an instrument reading, not ground truth. Calibrate the instrument against human or deterministic gold before using its flags as a publication gate.

retrieval + evidence gathering + cited synthesis with literature-specific evaluation

nearest_work: Reward-Free Evolving Agents via Pairwise Validator

nodes.finding: The strongest low-resource ICLR thesis is constrained policy improvement with disjoint regression tests, matched costs, and auditable commit/rollback.
nodes.required_action: Report persistent capability gain and regression after every evolution round under equal interaction, token, model-call, and training budgets.

title.zh: 证据保真的矛盾核心巩固

nearest_work: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs

nodes.finding: The general memory-consolidation space is crowded, and recent systems already revisit discarded evidence, compress memories, or retrieve counterevidence. Nevertheless, a standalone thesis survives after narrowing: under an identical storage and retrieval budget, memory value is defined causally by whether retaining or removing an item changes a downstream conclusion. Optimizing a minimal conclusion-changing set is more specific than coverage, similarity, contradiction detection, or full-history revisitation.
nodes.required_action: Replace the broad three-domain pilot with a fixed-capacity benchmark containing oracle-verifiable conclusion-changing evidence and compare against recent consolidation systems at identical stored and retrieved token budgets.

title.zh: 异构更新交互修复编译器

nodes.finding: A narrow standalone thesis survives: predicting order-sensitive regressions among persistent agent updates is not covered by workflow search or module-composition work. The claim must be limited to unseen combinations of individually beneficial, versioned updates and distinguished from generic graph-performance prediction; a pairwise interaction graph alone is insufficient unless it also predicts held-out orders and higher-order compositions.
nodes.required_action: Freeze the update surface to versioned prompt, memory, or workflow commits and preregister held-out pair-order and three-update composition tests against a task-conditioned graph predictor at identical execution and testing budgets.

nodes.finding: A narrowed standalone thesis survives. TeamTR establishes trust-region control for sequential parameter updates in multi-agent LLMs, MAPRO invokes small prompt mutations as a heuristic trust region, and GRASP admits skill edits through a balanced held-out regression gate. None of the located work defines and validates an occupancy-level trust region for persistent nonparametric agent updates using trajectory, action, tool-routing, and retrieval distributions, then tests whether that distance predicts future regression better than textual edit size or current-task gain. ([arXiv][4])
nodes.required_action: Pre-register one nonparametric update surface and one independently sampled occupancy-divergence estimator before claiming a unified trust region across prompts, memories, and workflows.

nodes.finding: The memory-harm phenomenon, held-out continual-learning evaluation, NullMemory counterfactuals, and contamination-aware routing are already established. Novelty survives only as replicated entry-level causal credit followed by a persistent quarantine policy; the current auditor framing does not yet specify an identifiable learning rule or multi-round stability test.
nodes.required_action: Define an entry-level admission/quarantine policy whose only update signal is a replicated effect estimate from retrieved, shuffled, and no-memory replay, then test the frozen policy on a chronological held-out stream.

title.zh: 可验证不可逆效应条款记忆

nodes.finding: World-model lookahead, episodic safety memory, and memory-guided counterfactual planning already cover most ingredients. A viable novelty boundary remains only if verified unexecuted consequences become persistent risk memories that improve later tasks after the simulator and extra lookahead calls are removed; the current formulation does not isolate that learning effect.
nodes.required_action: Narrow to one environment with an exact independent transition verifier and demonstrate a discovery-then-freeze protocol in which counterfactual risk memories are learned under a fixed simulator-call budget and evaluated with the simulator disabled.

title.zh: 谱系去相关的自标注准入

nearest_work: Reward-Free Evolving Agents via Pairwise Validator

nodes.finding: Cross-generation error amplification is important, but CREAM already addresses noisy, overconfident preference labels through cross-iteration reward consistency, while recursive-training work studies collapse prevention through self-verification. The surviving contribution is not generic confidence weighting; it must be an explicit parent-label dependency model whose propagated uncertainty predicts independently audited errors and improves persistent reward-model updates under identical label, call, token, and training budgets.
nodes.required_action: Produce a preregistered multi-round pilot that compares a formally specified lineage-confidence model against current-round confidence, CREAM-style consistency, and independent-judge calibration using exactly the same generated examples and evaluator calls.

title.zh: 跨版本 Rubric 干预修复

nodes.finding: Frozen anchors, heterogeneous reward ensembles, and policy-feedback reward evolution already cover the proposal's principal components. A cross-version evaluation matrix is useful, but as written it is a hand-designed audit protocol rather than an identifiable learning contribution. The thesis becomes defensible only if actor-by-evaluator interaction residuals predict future external-quality failures and train a persistent gate that generalizes to unseen rounds or actors.
nodes.required_action: Implement a learned actor-version-by-evaluator-version interaction-residual gate and evaluate it on held-out future rounds against frozen rewards, latest-version pairing, and matched-call reward ensembles.

title.zh: 残余状态效应驱动的经验准入

nodes.finding: The residual-recovery hypothesis may be novel, but the current mechanism is primarily a hand-built admission gate and leaves the persistent update surface unspecified. Dejavu already continually admits and retrieves successful embodied experiences, PEAM learns whether and when experience should be internalized, and ACE-Brain-0.5 combines progress and recovery monitoring with rollout-derived failure-recovery memory. The contribution must therefore be the prospective relationship between incomplete recovery and harmful future reuse, not the existence of another experience filter.
nodes.required_action: Fix the update surface to a bounded external experience memory and learn a recovery-completeness score from independently measured future reuse harm rather than hard-coding endpoint, rejoin, and residual checks.

nearest_work: Counterexample Guided Learning in the Large

nodes.finding: The broad curriculum claim is crowded. WebRL generates new tasks from unsuccessful attempts, DreamGym generates tasks that challenge the current policy, ATGen adversarially evolves automatically scored test cases, and formal counterexample work generates verifier-checked instances by deleting hypotheses. A thesis survives only around minimal single-constraint counterexamples to explicit agent rules and demonstrable boundary generalization rather than generic difficulty generation, failure replay, or adversarial task synthesis.
nodes.required_action: Restrict the pilot to one verifier-rich environment and define counterexample minimality operationally through constraint deletion or delta debugging against an explicit extracted policy rule.

title.zh: 条件编辑排序工作流策略

nodes.finding: The proposed perturbations are not themselves novel: WorFBench evaluates held-out workflow generalization, RobustFlow trains workflow invariance to semantically equivalent instructions, and WorkflowPerturb applies controlled structural and description perturbations. A viable thesis remains only if the contribution is a calibrated pre-commit admission rule whose certificate predicts locked out-of-loop transfer better than ordinary validation, rather than another robustness test suite. ([OpenReview][1])
nodes.required_action: Define and calibrate a pre-commit acceptance statistic on independently generated workflow candidates, then validate it against future performance on unseen tool APIs and task-graph motifs under a matched total evaluation budget.

nodes.finding: Adaptive stopping and budget-conditioned control are already active mechanisms: TacoMAS permits a meta-controller to stop test-time co-evolution, BAGEN learns budget-aware early stopping, and VRR-Stop chooses repair versus commitment from estimated marginal gain under verifier and repair noise. The surviving novelty must therefore be explicitly about persistent cross-episode updates, rollback, and frozen transfer of a learned controller across evolution processes—not generic stop-or-continue control. ([arXiv][2])
nodes.required_action: Construct a counterfactually evaluable replay dataset for one persistent update surface in which continue, commit, rollback, and stop decisions can be compared from the same evolution state without regenerating different candidate sequences.

title.zh: 回滚等价的更新历史压缩

nodes.finding: Versioned resources, lineage, rollback, inactive branches, and whole-memory semantic rollback already exist. The potentially surviving contribution is narrower: estimating a causally sufficient minimal subset of interacting commits whose removal repairs a regression while preserving unrelated accumulated gains.
nodes.required_action: Reformulate the work around causal minimal-set rollback with explicit dependency identification, interaction handling, and a ground-truth rollback benchmark rather than around lineage storage.

nodes.finding: Selecting tasks near the learner's success boundary is established curriculum learning, while WebRL and Socratic-SWE already generate tasks from current failures and adapt them to the solver's evolving capability frontier. The surviving opportunity is specifically to test adjacent-checkpoint discriminativeness as a cheaper, gradient-free estimator of future out-of-loop learning value.
nodes.required_action: Replace the generic frontier claim with a formally defined adjacent-checkpoint discrimination score and directly test whether it predicts held-out improvement better than success probability, failure replay, and validation-gradient alignment.

title.zh: 影响范围路由的经验准入

nodes.finding: The proposal recombines same-state counterfactual rule editing, replay-gated retention of candidate skill patches, and explicit memory admission control. Requiring stability to irrelevant changes is an additional acceptance test, not a sufficiently new problem-mechanism pair for a standalone ICLR thesis.
nodes.required_action: Replace source-task causal admission with a mechanistically distinct cross-task transportability certificate that predicts whether a lesson's effect survives task-family shift, and compare it directly against SCORE, SkillCAT, and A-MAC.

nodes.finding: Selective invariance to neutral changes, sensitivity to causal changes, shortcut probes, and downstream selection validation are directly covered by recent reward-model robustness work. As written, this is a training-free diagnostic suite rather than an identifiable persistent-learning contribution.
nodes.required_action: Do not advance the audit as the thesis; pivot to a learned reward-update mechanism that uses independently certified causal and neutral interventions and demonstrates improved downstream policy selection over CROME and PRISM.

title.zh: 最小单调适用边界修复

nodes.finding: Targeted repair of a failing skill component while preserving valid substructures is already explicit in SkillTracer and SkillAdaptor; counterexample provenance plus regression preservation is also explicit in counterexample-supplemented sketches. The proposal does not define a new representation or update operator beyond this recent combination.
nodes.required_action: Only revive the idea by formalizing a monotone applicability-set specialization operator with executable exception lineage and proving that it preserves unaffected positives better than SkillTracer and SkillAdaptor under matched edits.

nodes.finding: The proposal is directly covered as an audit rather than a learning mechanism. Correction and Corruption formalizes self-correction through separate error-repair and correct-answer-corruption rates, CorrectBench evaluates repeated correction across reasoning and code settings, and SCoRe already studies behavioral collapse during self-correction training. Adding counterfactual sensitivity is an incremental diagnostic unless it controls a new persistent update and demonstrates predictive value beyond these existing interfaces.
nodes.required_action: Terminate the standalone detector thesis and incorporate counterfactual sensitivity only as an ablation or gating signal inside a distinct persistent self-correction learning method.

nodes.finding: The problem-mechanism pair is substantially covered by work available before the cutoff. InT identifies an erroneous step, proposes a single-step intervention, verifies successful counterfactual continuations, and persists the intervention through training. REFLECT performs diagnosis-specific, prefix-preserving replay and treats a verified outcome flip as evidence for error attribution. Minimal intervention plus directional outcome validation is therefore not a surviving standalone mechanism, and extending it across text, tools, and multimodal tasks is primarily an experimental expansion.
nodes.required_action: Reframe the work as a failure-analysis benchmark that identifies settings where InT and REFLECT-style controlled replay produce invalid correction credit under matched intervention and rollout budgets.

title.zh: 故障模式因果重写语法

nodes.finding: The standalone problem-mechanism pair is substantially covered. JudgeFlow assigns responsibility scores to problematic workflow blocks and uses them to target subsequent edits; Learning to Compose estimates counterfactual marginal contributions of workflow capabilities; and Sherlock uses counterfactual workflow analysis to identify failure-prone nodes. Replacing these estimators with matched local ablations is a measurement refinement, not a distinct learning thesis.
nodes.required_action: Merge branch credit into compositional-update-compatibility as its attribution and evaluation subsystem and stop advancing it as a standalone paper.

title.zh: 决策翻转驱动的转移准入

nodes.finding: This is a direct restatement of decision-, value-, and policy-aware model learning. Prior work explicitly argues that globally accurate transition prediction is unnecessary and optimizes model updates toward value-relevant or policy-relevant transitions; recent work also studies calibration of such objectives. Adding action-selection, risk, and recovery decisions to web or GUI agents is a domain application unless it introduces a formally distinct objective or identifiability result.
nodes.required_action: Stop the standalone idea and reframe it only if a formally distinct, calibrated action-rank-change objective for LLM world models can be defined and evaluated with independent intervention ground truth.

title.zh: 复用机会驱动的记忆效用复验

nodes.finding: The problem-mechanism pair is directly occupied. MemoryBank already implements importance- and time-dependent forgetting and reinforcement; later work studies selective deletion under task-distribution shift; SF-AMS replaces heuristic decay with utility-driven survival; and Forget to Improve explicitly scores memory by value minus harm under stale-memory and task-drift conditions. Reparameterizing these signals as a half-life is not an identifiable new learning contribution. ([arXiv][3])
nodes.required_action: Stop standalone method development and merge the idea into a controlled benchmark of memory-staleness hazard estimation with intervention-derived ground truth.

nodes.finding: The stated collision boundary is obsolete by the review cutoff. SCoRe trains a multi-turn correction policy; InT localizes faulty reasoning and inserts targeted corrective interventions; reset-based policy optimization resamples counterfactual continuations from localized states to assign credit; and VerlTool assigns learning signals across multi-turn tool interactions. Typed correction actions and cost pruning are useful experimental factors, but they do not rescue the generic claim of local counterfactual correction credit as a new mechanism. ([OpenReview][5])
nodes.required_action: Stop standalone method development and reframe the contribution as a benchmark of typed correction-action attribution with executable leave-one-action-out intervention ground truth.

nodes.finding: The proposal combines mechanisms already demonstrated separately and jointly: WebRL explicitly controls policy-distribution drift with adaptive updates and replay, Library Drift supplies pre-regression diagnostics and lifecycle interventions, and PACE supplies a statistically controlled stop-or-commit gate. A unified drift score is not, by itself, an identifiable new learning contribution.
nodes.required_action: Stop this as a standalone thesis and retain it only as an evaluation or governance component inside an idea with a genuinely new update mechanism.

nodes.finding: CLEAR and MemCollab already contrast multiple trajectories for the same task to distill reusable context or task-level invariants while suppressing trajectory-specific artifacts. Restricting the pool to trajectories with the same endpoint does not create a new credit signal, because endpoint equivalence neither establishes process validity nor identifies which shared behavior caused success.
nodes.required_action: Stop the proposal as stated and only reopen it after replacing outcome matching with independently verified counterfactual process interventions that yield identifiable invariance evidence.

title.zh: 带适用边界的经验学习

nodes.finding: Assay directly addresses lessons or skills that help some tasks and harm superficially related ones: it measures per-skill causal heterogeneity, splits skills into conditional variants with explicit triggers, and suppresses predicted-harmful skills per task. RaMem independently stores contextual validity conditions and performs validity-aware retrieval. Adding support text, counterexamples, and abstention fields is therefore a representation change rather than a distinct learning mechanism.
nodes.required_action: Stop this standalone idea and merge its counterexample or abstention representation into an Assay-class causal skill-selection baseline unless a formal calibrated support-set learner can be specified.

paper_first_workflow.rule: A local pilot tests a frozen paper-motivated method. If the core method changes, return to novelty/method design and invalidate any full-experiment authorization.

problem_revision.reason: HarnessFix already performs harness-layer diagnosis plus scoped repair, and Diagnosis Is Not Prescription directly shows that causal responsibility need not identify the best patch locus. A direct cross-surface router would therefore be combination novelty.

rows.paper_problem: Given a failed agent trace and pre-intervention evidence, is the minimal causally sufficient persistent repair surface identifiable at all; if not, what reversible cross-surface evidence is required before a system may commit rather than abstain?
rows.irreducible_boundary: The paper is about partial identification of the repair locus, not fault attribution, scoped patch generation, or direct surface prediction. Multiple persistent surfaces may remain observationally compatible with the same failure and responsibility diagnosis while implying different repair/collateral outcomes. The method must certify IDENTIFIED(surface) only when the compatible model/effect set agrees on one minimal sufficient surface, otherwise return UNIDENTIFIABLE or PROBE_MORE.
rows.current_method_problem: A one-shot learned router or hidden-time best-surface trial is too close to HarnessFix/WML plus generic classification/CATE. The revised method must expose non-identifiability and abstain instead of always predicting a surface.
method_design_requirements: Formalize a finite registered set of persistent repair surfaces with explicit persistence, reversibility, scope, and collateral-effect assumptions.
Define a compatibility set of causal repair models/effect intervals consistent with pre-intervention trace evidence and any already-observed reversible probes.
Define minimal causal sufficiency under frozen task-success, persistence, collateral, and scope constraints; allow multiple incomparable minimal surfaces.
Provide a repair-surface non-identifiability construction: identical pre-intervention evidence/responsibility can be compatible with different minimal sufficient repair loci.
Emit IDENTIFIED(surface) only when every compatible model/effect interval agrees on the same minimal sufficient surface; otherwise abstain.
PROBE_MORE may propose only reversible diagnostic interventions that reduce the compatible surface set; exhaustive persistent repair trials at hidden time remain forbidden.
Separate the certificate from any active probe policy so generic active diagnosis is a same-information baseline rather than hidden novelty.

generic active diagnosis / information-gain probe selection over the same surface hypotheses

HarnessFix harness-layer attribution plus scoped repair operators
WML smallest-valid-edit localization inside structured skills
CausalFlow/CAR counterfactual step attribution and minimal trace repair
MOSS source-level repair as a broad repair-surface ceiling

fault localization or scoped patch generation itself is novel
a direct multiclass surface router is the contribution
generic causal identifiability or information-gain probing is novel merely because variables are agent surfaces

rows.irreducible_boundary: Generic future plasticity is already a continual-learning problem. rows.current_method_problem: A sealed future-adaptation AUC gate is a direct look-ahead evaluation and is reducible to CPE-style preservation plus a standard plasticity measurement unless the causal quantity is redefined around a fixed agent evolution operator.

Freeze the future evolution operator, its data/call/update budget, and adaptation rule before the candidate update is evaluated.
Require the phenomenon on at least one non-weight persistent surface; otherwise the contribution collapses toward continual-RL plasticity.
Separate current capability, old-task retention, and future evolution-operator response as three different potential outcomes.

assumptions.statement: Observable local state contains information about the marginal value and risk of another update.

contract.mechanism: When update value diminishes or regression risk rises, an adaptive controller can stop before unnecessary or harmful updates and preserve useful earlier changes.

predictions.statement: Frozen update sequences contain distinct optimal stopping points and nontrivial future-benefit variation.
predictions.observable: stop/continue/rollback target entropy and oracle headroom

predictions.statement: Given qualified sequences, state-dependent stopping saves update calls at matched success versus the strongest fixed/simple stopping rule.
predictions.observable: held-out call saving at bounded success loss plus policy disagreement

operationalization.validity_check: same sequence access and matched-information baselines

falsification.contradiction_rule: Reject only the state-dependent stopping sub-principle after a qualified nondegenerate update stream and valid controller target fail the preregistered matched hidden test.

failure_update_rules.design-nonidentifiable: repair sequence construction/target variation; no principle negative
failure_update_rules.assumption-violation: revise scope/assumption and derive a new prediction
failure_update_rules.matched-simplification: weaken/merge the learned-controller realization, not the adaptive-stopping phenomenon

checks.evidence: Hidden confirmatory update sequences are outside controller fitting, threshold selection, and sequence generation.
Hidden optimal-round labels and final sequence outcomes are not exposed to the controller during fitting.
Round utility and regression are computed from executed ALFWorld outcomes rather than controller self-evaluation.
Static and learned stopping policies receive the same frozen sequences, state features, and call accounting.
Confirmatory metrics directly test call saving at bounded success loss with regression control.
Sequence generator, feature extraction, evaluator, config, and source hashes are frozen before execution.
Protocol forbids future-round truth leakage, hidden-label reuse, evaluator introspection, and post-hoc sequence replacement.

references.adopted: treat experimental-protocol mismatch, evidence mismatch, and missing scientific core as distinct end-to-end research failures
audit exposure, agent use of the exposure, and score inflation before treating benchmark performance as intended capability
evaluation artifacts themselves can create false negatives and require versioned verification
sequential policies must be assessed under the observation distribution they induce rather than only the pre-update data distribution
multi-turn supervision quality depends on alignment with the learner's current decision context and on-policy prefix distribution
a persistent skill may be content-valid yet silently bypassed at runtime, so deployment-time invocation is a separate validity condition

updater_competence_prerequisite.reason: Adaptive stopping phenomenon exists, but the updater stream has only 19.4% nonzero target-effect rounds, below the 25% prerequisite.
updater_competence_prerequisite.scientific_role: hard prerequisite before Gate 1; failure blocks controller fitting without rejecting the stopping phenomenon

research_execution_plan.objective: Generate decision-relevant evidence for the registered principle predictions under the frozen protocol.

fallback_conditions.action: repair execution only; preserve scientific contract
invalidate scientific interpretation and repair protocol
repair substrate/variation before method interpretation
repair measurement bridge before principle update
classify as protocol/operationalization mismatch before method or principle failure; do not rescue by changing scientific thresholds
route to principle adjudicator and human scientific review

research_execution_plan.rule: This plan makes objectives, dependencies, tools, artifacts, checkpoints, and fallback conditions explicit; it never authorizes execution by itself.

evidence.basis: Keep the competent ALFWorld interaction horizon at 50 steps.
Twenty-four fit sequences and twenty-four hidden sequences provide a confirmatory controller split while preserving frozen hidden evaluation.
Four update rounds expose early/late stopping and over-update harm without unbounded search.
At least one quarter of hidden sequences must contain a successful candidate round before call-saving can be scientifically identified.
A 25% call reduction at matched utility is the preregistered minimum effect worth a formal P0 claim.
Twenty-four hidden sequences have 1/24 = 4.17pp binary success resolution; a 5pp tolerance is observable whereas 2pp is not.
Qualified Qwen react-family throughput predicts about 7.45 worst-case GPU-hours; cap includes a safety margin.

summary.scientific_role: base-agent competence evidence measured on server60; imported unchanged for cross-server Pre-Experiment compilation

checks.question: Does the training objective directly optimize the quantity required by the paper claim?
Does the target have enough entropy/variance to expose the claimed decision boundary?
checks.evidence: Canonical Round-1 produced no optimal-stop label variation.

checks.question: Can the proposed method and strongest simplification make different decisions on the frozen discovery pool?
checks.evidence: Without early/late/rollback-optimal sequence archetypes, controller policies cannot expose a meaningful decision disagreement.

checks.question: Can the chosen representation/model express the hypothesized mechanism on a synthetic realizability test?
Can the learner fit a tiny real discovery subset before a scientific run is allowed?
Is the base agent neither degenerate-easy nor degenerate-hard, with both successes and failures?
Do candidate interventions produce both useful and harmful/non-useful effects?
Are unique inference count, measured throughput, expected wall time, and hard cap frozen before execution?
Are streaming traces, checkpoints, output locking, commit/source hashes, and resume rules specified?
Is every important observable outcome mapped in advance to scientific/experimental diagnosis and allowed next action?

retrospective_pre_p0.claim: A persistent update controller can save update calls by learning when to continue, stop, or rollback.
retrospective_pre_p0.objective: Predict whether one more persistent update is worth applying.
retrospective_pre_p0.primary_metric: Calls saved at matched final task utility and regression.
retrospective_pre_p0.required_next: A2-R1 must prove sequence-archetype target entropy and controller/baseline disagreement offline before training.

detail.reference: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct react-family on server 60 RTX3090, 24 ID environments, 50-step cap

detail.restart_policy: Preserve complete sequence artifacts for diagnosis; restart a fresh confirmatory run under the same frozen contract after any runtime stop.
detail.partial_artifact_policy: Partial sequences never enter the Pilot Registry or formal controller comparison.

title.zh: 带适用边界的经验学习

idea_title.zh: 预算校准的预测性回归面板

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 预算校准的预测性回归面板

setup.zh: 冻结 30–40 个历史轻量更新和 8-Probe 预算，比较固定面板、随机轮换、历史敏感度面板与学习面板；最终只在从未用于面板学习的隐藏原任务上统计 harmful-commit rate。
setup.en: Freeze 30–40 historical lightweight updates and an 8-probe budget; compare fixed panels, random rotation, historical-sensitivity panels, and the learned panel; harmful-commit rate is measured only on hidden original tasks never used to learn the panel.

gate.zh: 固定预算下，回归门控应提高未来任务收益并显著降低最坏回退率。
gate.en: Under fixed budgets, regression gating should improve future-task utility and reduce worst-case regression.

idea_title.zh: 预算校准的预测性回归面板

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若固定 VaG-style gate 或简单历史敏感度排序在同 K 预算内匹配 learned panel，或面板只在同一更新表面有效，则停止独立方法主张。
gate.en: Stop if a fixed VaG-style gate or simple historical-sensitivity ranking matches the learned panel at the same K budget, or if the panel does not transfer across update surfaces.

idea_title.zh: 证据保真的矛盾核心巩固

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 证据保真的矛盾核心巩固

setup.zh: 固定 40–60 条 raw episodes 和 8–12 个候选 rule；比较 forced summary、utility refinement、episodic-only、rule+contradiction-core。hidden tasks 从未参与 consolidation。
setup.en: Freeze 40–60 raw episodes and 8–12 candidate rules; compare forced summaries, utility refinement, episodic-only, and rule+contradiction-core. Hidden tasks never participate in consolidation.

gate.zh: 保留反证应减少过度概括和后续负迁移。
gate.en: Preserving counterevidence should reduce overgeneralization and later negative transfer.

idea_title.zh: 证据保真的矛盾核心巩固

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若 episodic-only 在同 context/storage 预算下匹配或优于 rule+core，或 deletion core 对 hidden behavior 无预测力，则停止 consolidation 主张。
gate.en: Stop the consolidation claim if episodic-only matches or beats rule+core at equal context/storage budget, or if deletion cores do not predict hidden behavior.

idea_title.zh: 异构更新交互修复编译器

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 异构更新交互修复编译器

setup.zh: 选 Prompt×Memory×Tool 三类各 6–8 个冻结更新；用 pair 数据训练 clause compiler，测试从未一起出现过的 triples。四格容量、调用和 hidden-task truth 全匹配。
setup.en: Use 6–8 frozen updates from each of prompt, memory, and tool surfaces; train the clause compiler on pairs and test never-before-seen triples, with matched 2×2 capacity, calls, and hidden-task truth.

gate.zh: 交互图应预测未见组合回退并找到更优提交顺序。
gate.en: The interaction graph should predict unseen composition regressions and identify better commit orders.

idea_title.zh: 异构更新交互修复编译器

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若简单 pairwise conflict score、最近更新优先或穷举顺序在匹配预算下等效，或 clause 不能跨 update surface 迁移，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if simple pairwise conflict scores, recency ordering, or exhaustive ordering match at equal budget, or if clauses fail to transfer across update surfaces.

idea_title.zh: Agent 更新信赖域

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: Agent 更新信赖域

setup.zh: 在 ALFWorld、AgentBench 上，以 1 GPU、20 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。
setup.en: Run P0/P1/P2 on ALFWorld, AgentBench with two open models and at least two domains within 1 GPUs and 20 GPU-hours.

gate.zh: 行为偏移应比文本编辑距离或当前任务收益更好预测回退。
gate.en: Behavioral shift should predict regressions better than textual edit distance or current-task gain.

idea_title.zh: Agent 更新信赖域

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若“行为偏移应比文本编辑距离或当前任务收益更好预测回退。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Behavioral shift should predict regressions better than textual edit distance or current-task gain.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

idea_title.zh: 共检索交互排斥图

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 共检索交互排斥图

setup.zh: 固定 20–30 个 memory 和 top co-retrieval pairs；在相同 replay 总数下比较 per-item causal、随机 pair、共现阈值、interaction graph。hidden tasks 不参与 edge 学习。
setup.en: Freeze 20–30 memories and top co-retrieval pairs; compare per-item causal selection, random pairs, co-occurrence thresholds, and the interaction graph under the same replay count. Hidden tasks never train edges.

gate.zh: 隔离识别出的有害条目后，应恢复圈外任务且保留主要收益。
gate.en: Quarantining harmful entries should recover out-of-loop tasks without erasing main gains.

idea_title.zh: 共检索交互排斥图

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若 CMI/per-item selector 或简单共现互斥在同 replay 预算下等效，或 pair edge 不能跨任务复用，则并入普通 memory selection，不单独成方法。
gate.en: If CMI/per-item selection or simple co-occurrence exclusion matches at equal replay budget, or pair edges do not transfer across tasks, merge into ordinary memory selection.

idea_title.zh: 可验证不可逆效应条款记忆

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 可验证不可逆效应条款记忆

setup.zh: 在 exact-state simulator 中学习 10–20 条 verified clauses；hidden tasks 比较 no-memory、hand rules、test-time counterfactual planner、persistent clauses，累计 simulator calls 严格匹配。
setup.en: Learn 10–20 verified clauses in an exact-state simulator; on hidden tasks compare no memory, hand rules, test-time counterfactual planning, and persistent clauses with strictly matched cumulative simulator calls.

gate.zh: 验证后的反事实记忆应减少不可逆错误且不导致过度保守。
gate.en: Verified counterfactual memory should reduce irreversible errors without excessive conservatism.

idea_title.zh: 可验证不可逆效应条款记忆

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若 hand rules 或同总 simulator-call 的 test-time planner 在 hidden success/风险上等效，或 clause 只能记住具体对象名，停止独立方法。
gate.en: Stop if hand rules or a test-time planner with the same total simulator calls matches hidden success/risk, or if clauses only memorize concrete object names.

idea_title.zh: 谱系去相关的自标注准入

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 谱系去相关的自标注准入

setup.zh: 先用公开/真实 4–6 轮自标注日志做 reality check；若 lineage error enrichment 存在，再构造 ancestry-blind、source-count、anchor-threshold、lineage-decorrelated 四臂，最后两轮冻结测试。
setup.en: First run a reality check on public/real 4–6 round self-label logs. If lineage error enrichment exists, compare ancestry-blind, source-count, anchor-threshold, and lineage-decorrelated arms with the final two rounds frozen for testing.

gate.zh: 如果错误主要沿同源谱系传播，谱系去相关后的准入应比当前轮置信度、简单一致性和不看祖先的加权平均更早阻断坏更新，同时保留独立来源支持的好更新。
gate.en: If errors propagate mainly along same-source lineages, lineage-decorrelated admission should block bad updates earlier than current-round confidence, simple consistency, or ancestry-blind weighting while retaining updates supported by independent sources.

idea_title.zh: 谱系去相关的自标注准入

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若真实日志几乎没有跨轮继承/同源复用，或简单 anchor 阈值/source-count 在同预算下等效，则停止独立方法。
gate.en: Stop if real logs show little cross-round inheritance/source reuse, or if simple anchor thresholds/source counts match at equal budget.

idea_title.zh: 跨版本 Rubric 干预修复

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 跨版本 Rubric 干预修复

setup.zh: 4 个 actor×4 个 evaluator 版本，固定 100–200 anchor trajectories；注入或自然产生 2–3 类 shortcut drift，比较 frozen reward、scalar calibration、multi-judge、cross-version rubric repair。
setup.en: Use four actor by four evaluator versions and 100–200 fixed anchor trajectories; induce or observe 2–3 shortcut-drift types and compare frozen reward, scalar calibration, multi-judge, and cross-version rubric repair.

gate.zh: 跨版本门控应降低外部 Judge 和人工小样本上的 reward hacking。
gate.en: Cross-version gating should reduce reward hacking under external judges and small human audits.

idea_title.zh: 跨版本 Rubric 干预修复

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若简单独立 anchor calibration 或 frozen reward 在同预算下等效，或 cross-version matrix 无法可靠区分 actor/evaluator drift，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if simple independent-anchor calibration or a frozen reward matches at equal budget, or if the cross-version matrix cannot reliably distinguish actor from evaluator drift.

idea_title.zh: 残余状态效应驱动的经验准入

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 残余状态效应驱动的经验准入

setup.zh: P0a 至少 100 对 normal/perturbed successes；只有 success+Δs 非零且被 writer 正向写入达到预注册 prevalence 才启动 P0b。P0b 固定相同 future replay 数比较 success-only、endpoint equality、hand threshold、learned residual-effect。
setup.en: P0a uses at least 100 normal/perturbed-success pairs; P0b starts only if success+nonzero-Δs positive writes exceed a preregistered prevalence. P0b fixes the same future replay count across success-only, endpoint equality, hand threshold, and learned residual-effect arms.

gate.zh: 若残余状态真的影响未来复用，基于 Δs 学到的准入应在相同记忆容量和 replay 预算下，比 success-only、终点相同和手工恢复阈值更少产生负迁移。
gate.en: If residual state truly matters for future reuse, Δs-based learned admission should reduce negative transfer versus success-only, endpoint-equality, and hand-coded recovery thresholds under the same memory and replay budgets.

idea_title.zh: 残余状态效应驱动的经验准入

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若 success+nonzero Δs 的正向写入很少、Δs 对 future harm 无预测力、或手工 threshold 等效，则停止，不把 recovery 当论文贡献。
gate.en: Stop if positive writes of success+nonzero Δs are rare, Δs does not predict future harm, or the hand threshold matches; do not claim recovery as a contribution.

idea_title.zh: 1-Minimal 边界反例课程

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 1-Minimal 边界反例课程

setup.zh: 每轮冻结 20–30 个 verified counterexamples，一半做 delta-debug 到 1-minimal；最终两臂训练 token 完全相同。P0 只看一轮更新后的独立 boundary set。
setup.en: Freeze 20–30 verified counterexamples per round, delta-debug half to 1-minimality, and match final training tokens exactly across arms. P0 evaluates only one update on an independent boundary set.

gate.zh: 在相同生成、验证和训练 token 下，1-minimal 反例应比失败重放、随机扰动和 verifier 过滤但不做最小化的任务产生更强的未见边界泛化。
gate.en: At matched generation, verification, and training tokens, verified 1-minimal counterexamples should improve unseen boundary generalization more than failure replay, random perturbations, or verifier-filtered but non-minimized tasks.

idea_title.zh: 1-Minimal 边界反例课程

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若 non-minimal baseline 在相同 proposer/verifier/训练预算下等效，或只有更新强 proposer 才能看到收益，或 minimality 只减少 token 而不改善独立边界泛化，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if the non-minimal baseline matches under identical proposer/verifier/training budget, if gains appear only when the stronger proposer itself is updated, or if minimality only reduces tokens without improving independent-boundary generalization.

idea_title.zh: 条件编辑排序工作流策略

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 条件编辑排序工作流策略

setup.zh: 先只做 offline calibration：按 workflow 留出，pairwise/listwise ranker 的 top-1 best-edit accuracy 必须比 global-best 高至少 25pp；未过门不得打开 fresh hidden。过门后才在 fresh hidden workflow 上一次 commit。
setup.en: Start with offline workflow-held-out calibration only. Pairwise/listwise ranking must exceed global-best top-1 best-edit accuracy by at least 25 points; fresh hidden workflows stay sealed until this gate passes. Only then allow one persistent commit on fresh hidden workflows.

gate.zh: 通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。
gate.en: Certified workflows should transfer better to unseen tools and task graphs.

idea_title.zh: 条件编辑排序工作流策略

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若 Agentic Predictor、nearest-neighbor edit reuse 或 failure-signature heuristic 在相同 source/hidden execution 预算下等效，则停止 update-policy 主张。
gate.en: Stop if Agentic Predictor, nearest-neighbor edit reuse, or a failure-signature heuristic matches under the same source/hidden execution budget.

idea_title.zh: 预算感知进化控制器

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。

idea_title.zh: 预算感知进化控制器

setup.zh: 在 ALFWorld、WebArena-Lite、AgentBench 上，以 1 GPU、18 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。
setup.en: Run P0/P1/P2 on ALFWorld, WebArena-Lite, AgentBench with two open models and at least two domains within 1 GPUs and 18 GPU-hours.

gate.zh: 控制器应在等效性能下减少至少 30% 调用，并能跨任务族迁移。
gate.en: The controller should save at least 30% of calls at matched utility and transfer across task families.

idea_title.zh: 预算感知进化控制器

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。

gate.zh: 若“控制器应在等效性能下减少至少 30% 调用，并能跨任务族迁移。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—The controller should save at least 30% of calls at matched utility and transfer across task families.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

idea_title.zh: 回滚等价的更新历史压缩

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

idea_title.zh: 回滚等价的更新历史压缩

setup.zh: 构造 30–50 个顺序轻量更新、12 个冻结 rollback query；比较 full-history oracle、周期 checkpoint、文本摘要和 clause compactor，存储字节与 replay 调用严格匹配。
setup.en: Create 30–50 sequential lightweight updates and 12 frozen rollback queries; compare full-history oracle, periodic checkpoints, textual summaries, and the clause compactor with matched storage bytes and replay calls.

gate.zh: 局部回滚应比恢复最近 checkpoint 保留更多累积收益。
gate.en: Local rollback should preserve more accumulated gain than reverting to the latest checkpoint.

idea_title.zh: 回滚等价的更新历史压缩

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若简单周期 checkpoint 在同存储预算下达到相同 rollback fidelity，或必须保存接近完整历史才能正确恢复，则降级为工程组件。
gate.en: Stop or demote to an engineering component if simple periodic checkpoints match rollback fidelity at equal storage, or if correctness requires nearly full history.

idea_title.zh: 失败前沿课程

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。

gate.zh: 前沿任务应以更少样本获得更高圈外提升。
gate.en: Frontier tasks should yield more out-of-loop gain per sample.

gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Frontier tasks should yield more out-of-loop gain per sample.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。

idea_title.zh: 影响范围路由的经验准入

setup.zh: 20–30 个冻结 lesson，6-sentinel 硬预算；比较随机、全局历史敏感度、A-3 learned panel、scope-routed panel。hidden task family 在 router 和阈值冻结后才打开。
setup.en: Use 20–30 frozen lessons with a hard six-sentinel budget; compare random, global historical sensitivity, the A-3 learned panel, and scope-routed selection. Hidden task families open only after router/threshold freeze.

gate.zh: 同样 replay 预算下，记忆特有的影响范围应比源任务因果门控、语义相似度或通用回归 Probe 更少放入有害经验。
gate.en: At the same replay budget, memory-specific impact scope should admit fewer harmful lessons than source-only causal gating, semantic similarity, or generic regression probes.

idea_title.zh: 影响范围路由的经验准入

setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若 A-3 通用面板在同 6-Probe 预算下等效，立即并入 A-3；若 scope 只有通过更多 replay 才获胜，也停止。
gate.en: Immediately merge into A-3 if the generic panel matches at the same six-probe budget; also stop if scope wins only through extra replay.

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。

idea_title.zh: 最小单调适用边界修复

setup.en: Freeze 10–15 procedural skills with 2–4 verifiable boundary counterexamples each; compare delete, full rewrite, free classifier, and minimal monotone gates on paired old-positive and new-counterexample tests.

gate.zh: 局部修复应同时提高反例修复率和旧正例保持率。
gate.en: Local repair should improve both counterexample repair and old-positive retention.

idea_title.zh: 最小单调适用边界修复

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若 free classifier/full rewrite 在同容量下同时达到相同修复率和旧正例保持，或最小单调约束导致明显欠拟合，则降级为实现选择。
gate.en: Demote to an implementation choice if a free classifier/full rewrite matches repair and old-positive preservation at equal capacity, or if monotone minimality materially underfits.

gate.zh: 真实纠正应同时提高修复并保持正确答案和无关稳定性。
gate.en: Real correction should improve repair while preserving correct answers and irrelevant invariance.

gate.zh: 通过干预验证的纠正应具有更高修复率和迁移性。
gate.en: Intervention-validated corrections should repair more reliably and transfer better.

gate.zh: 若“通过干预验证的纠正应具有更高修复率和迁移性。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
