external_reviews.finding_zh: 将纠错信用转化为持久的可执行语法属于实质性复活，但该组合与已有工作高度接近。ASI 和 NSI 已归纳可复用的程序化或逻辑化技能，SkillGen 通过有技能与无技能的受控干预验证技能效果，REFLECT 则通过受控重放验证错误归因。类型化失败槽可能退化为人工标签，最近邻修复程序检索也可能在无需语法归纳的情况下复现恢复效果。剩余的独立命题必须证明语法产生式能够在未见失败组合上重新组合，而不是为每条训练轨迹存储一个修复。
external_reviews.required_action: Demonstrate automatically induced failure slots and grammar-level compositional generalization against ASI, NSI, flat skill induction, and intervention-verified nearest-repair retrieval under identical trajectories and inference budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 在相同轨迹数据和推理预算下，与 ASI、NSI、扁平技能归纳及经干预验证的最近修复检索比较，证明失败槽能够自动归纳且语法具有组合泛化能力。

closest_work.title: Lifting Traces to Logic: Programmatic Skill Induction with Neuro-Symbolic Learning for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
SkillGen: Verified Inference-Time Agent Skill Synthesis
REFLECT: Intervention-Supported Error Attribution for Silent Failures in LLM Agent Traces

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A correction-specific grammar whose productions are credited to necessary actions and systematically recombine across unseen failure compositions, tool domains, and backbone models.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: NSI or ASI program induction combined with intervention-verified nearest-repair retrieval
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train on primitive correction types and only a strict subset of their pairwise compositions across two tool domains. Test held-out compositions and a second frozen model under matched traces, calls, and executable-skill capacity, comparing the full method with ASI, NSI, nearest-repair retrieval, flat natural-language skills, and an ablation without action-necessity interventions.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the grammar claim if it does not outperform retrieval or flat programmatic skills on unseen compositions, if failure slots require manual annotation, or if the number of productions grows approximately one-for-one with training traces.
unknowns: No independent automatic ground truth is specified for observation, plan, tool, and action failure slots.
It is unclear whether module-replacement interventions are executable and semantically comparable across both proposed domains and the second model.
The proposed environments may not provide unique or verifiably minimal correction-action sequences.

removable_atoms: typed failure slots
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Intervention-verified nearest repair-program retrieval using ASI- or NSI-style program induction without grammar productions
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Controlled replacements provide a plausible sensing and credit path, and the grammar is an exact persistent update. However, slot identifiability and production-level credit are unresolved, so future recovery may be attributable to case retrieval rather than grammar composition.

real_problem.zh: 整段反思混合观察、规划、工具和执行错误，成功纠正也无法说明哪类动作必要。
real_problem.en: Whole-trajectory reflection mixes observation, planning, tool, and execution errors, so success does not identify necessary correction actions.

composition_logic.zh: 把纠错拆成观察、计划、工具和动作替换，通过最小干预估计必要性，再把有效组合编译为带适用条件的纠错程序。
composition_logic.en: Decompose correction into observation, plan, tool, and action replacements, estimate necessity via minimal interventions, and compile effective combinations into applicability-bounded programs.

learning_signal.zh: 模块替换结果、错误类型和独立任务成功。
learning_signal.en: Module-replacement outcomes, failure types, and independent task success.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见失败组合上的成功率、必要性和误用率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Success, necessity, and misuse on unseen failure combinations.

strongest_baseline.zh: 整轨迹反思、REFLECT/InT、成功轨迹 SFT 和 leave-one-step-out。
strongest_baseline.en: Whole-trajectory reflection, REFLECT/InT, success-trace SFT, and leave-one-step-out attribution.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 verifier-rich 工具环境中构造四类错误与组合错误，冻结后迁移到第二域。
decisive_pilot.en: Create four error types and compositions in a verifier-rich tool environment, then freeze and transfer to a second domain.

stop_condition.zh: 若类型化程序不能比模块级反思更好迁移，或真值不独立，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if typed programs do not transfer better than module-level reflection or ground truth is not independent.

external_reviews.finding: The deployment failure is real, and the proposal survives narrowly as a standalone method thesis. DoVer, CausalFlow, and REFLECT already use controlled interventions to validate failure attributions, while ANNEAL persistently commits typed repairs. The surviving contribution is not causal repair itself, but learning minimal conjunctions of typed correction actions and compiling them into applicability-bounded programs that remain useful on unseen mixed failures after freezing. A retrieved library of individually validated repairs is the main threat, so compositional transfer rather than in-domain recovery must carry the paper.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该部署失效是真实的，且该方案可以较窄地作为独立方法论文成立。DoVer、CausalFlow 和 REFLECT 已使用受控干预验证失败归因，ANNEAL 也会持久提交类型化修复。因此，剩余贡献不能只是因果修复本身，而应是学习类型化纠正动作的最小组合，并将其编译为具有适用范围的程序，使其冻结后仍能处理未见过的混合故障。最大的威胁是检索已有验证修复的简单程序库，因此论文必须由组合泛化而非域内恢复结果支撑。
external_reviews.required_action: Run a matched-budget factorial pilot with disjoint failure-composition and domain splits, comparing the compiler against intervention-based repair plus retrieval of validated corrections.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 开展预算匹配的析因实验，严格划分故障组合与领域，并将编译器和“干预式修复加已验证纠正检索”基线直接比较。

closest_work.title: DoVer: Intervention-Driven Auto Debugging for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
CausalFlow: Causal Attribution and Counterfactual Repair for LLM Agent Failures
ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Minimal-set learning over typed correction-action combinations, followed by compilation into applicability-bounded reusable programs for held-out mixed failures, rather than per-trace attribution, repair supervision, or direct process-graph patching.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: CausalFlow with module-type tags and retrieval of previously validated minimal repairs under the same intervention and model-call budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct four independently verifiable observation, planning, tool, and execution faults plus pair and triple compositions. Train on all singleton faults and a subset of pairs, freeze the library, and evaluate unseen compositions and a second environment with identical correction-call budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Falsify the thesis if the 95% confidence interval for success improvement over CausalFlow plus repair retrieval includes zero on held-out compositions, or if compiled-program misuse exceeds 5% on clean and nonmatching failures.
unknowns: The correction-program grammar and the method for learning applicability predicates are not specified.
It is unclear how leave-one-action-out interventions distinguish necessary conjunctions when correction actions interact non-additively.

combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: CausalFlow- or DoVer-style intervention followed by nearest-neighbor retrieval of validated module corrections.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The loop is coherent: typed replacement interventions provide sensing and causal credit, compiled programs persist as the update, and frozen tests on unseen compositions measure future utility and misuse. The applicability learner still requires an exact specification.

title.zh: 记忆交互兼容子句学习

real_problem.zh: 单条记忆各自有益，但共同检索时可能产生冲突、覆盖或错误组合。
real_problem.en: Individually useful memories can conflict, overwrite, or compose incorrectly when retrieved together.

composition_logic.zh: 通过成对和三元共同检索干预学习带置信度的兼容、互斥和优先级子句；这些子句成为持久检索约束，而不是一次性冲突检测。
composition_logic.en: Use pairwise and triple co-retrieval interventions to learn confidence-bearing compatibility, exclusion, and precedence clauses that persist as retrieval constraints.

learning_signal.zh: 共同检索组合、独立任务结果和冲突解释标签。
learning_signal.en: Co-retrieval combinations, independent task outcomes, and conflict-explanation labels.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见任务与未见记忆组合上的共同检索成功率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Co-retrieval success on unseen tasks and unseen memory combinations.

strongest_baseline.zh: 相似度去重、矛盾保留、全部检索、图聚类和直接风险门控。
strongest_baseline.en: Similarity deduplication, contradiction preservation, retrieve-all, graph clustering, and direct risk gating.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造 20–40 条可独立验证记忆，训练在部分组合上，冻结后评测未见二元和三元组合。
decisive_pilot.en: Use 20–40 independently verifiable memories, train on a subset of combinations, and freeze for unseen pair and triple compositions.

stop_condition.zh: 若兼容子句不能跨组合泛化，或简单相似度／冲突检测同样有效，则作为记忆管理组件保留。
stop_condition.en: Retain only as a memory-management component if clauses fail to generalize or simple similarity/conflict checks match performance.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is deployment-relevant, and the proposal identifies a behavior-changing persistent object that is not directly covered by current memory systems. ActMem reasons over causal memory graphs, RSCB-MC gates risky memory use, and HGMem represents higher-order memory relations, but none of these official descriptions learns reusable compatibility, exclusion, and precedence clauses from controlled co-retrieval interventions and tests them on unseen memory combinations. The thesis survives only at the type-level compositional boundary: if clauses merely memorize memory identities, a contextual gate or association-rule learner erases the contribution.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该失效具有真实部署意义，而且方案提出了一个能够持续改变行为、尚未被现有记忆系统直接覆盖的更新对象。ActMem 在因果记忆图上推理，RSCB-MC 对高风险记忆使用进行门控，HGMem 表示高阶记忆关系，但这些官方方法描述均未通过受控共同检索干预，学习可复用的兼容、排斥与优先级条款，并在未见过的记忆组合上测试。该论文只能依靠类型层面的组合泛化成立；如果条款只是记住具体记忆身份，情境门控器或关联规则学习器就会消除其贡献。
external_reviews.required_action: Use disjoint memory-identity and composition splits to demonstrate that typed clauses outperform a capacity-matched pairwise or contextual risk gate on unseen pairs and triples.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 使用记忆身份与组合均不重叠的数据划分，证明类型化条款在未见过的二元和三元组合上优于容量匹配的成对或情境风险门控器。

closest_work.title: ActMem: Bridging the Gap Between Memory Retrieval and Reasoning in LLM Agents
Learning When to Remember: Risk-Sensitive Contextual Bandits for Abstention-Aware Memory Retrieval in LLM-Based Coding Agents
Improving Multi-step RAG with Hypergraph-based Memory for Long-Context Complex Relational Modeling

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Persistent induction and enforcement of typed compatibility, exclusion, and precedence clauses from controlled co-retrieval outcomes, with generalization to unseen memory identities and higher-order combinations.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A risk-sensitive contextual bandit or pairwise compatibility classifier using the same retrieval features, outcome labels, token budget, and abstention actions.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Create 20–40 independently verifiable memories with designed compatible, conflicting, and precedence-sensitive relations. Train on disjoint memory identities and selected pairs, freeze all policies, and test unseen identities, pairs, and triples under identical retrieval and context budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Falsify the clause-learning claim if the matched contextual gate is within two percentage points on unseen-combination success and misuse, or if clause performance collapses when all test memory identities are unseen.
unknowns: The clause language, memory type system, and method for inducing variables rather than identity-specific rules are unspecified.
The provenance and independence of conflict-explanation labels are not established.
The proposed intervention budget may scale combinatorially without an active selection rule.

removable_atoms: Explicit triple interventions, unless an ablation shows that pairwise interventions and clause composition cannot identify genuinely higher-order conflicts.
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: A contextual incompatibility classifier or risk-sensitive bandit that scores each retrieved memory set and suppresses unsafe combinations.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The loop is coherent: controlled co-retrieval senses interaction failures, outcomes assign credit to memory combinations, clauses persist as retrieval constraints, and frozen unseen-combination tests measure future behavior. Type induction and explanation-label independence remain underspecified.

real_problem.zh: 旧 Probe 会失去预测价值，但简单退役可能删除仍重要的边界测试。
real_problem.en: Old probes decay, but simple retirement may delete tests that still protect important boundaries.

composition_logic.zh: 学习 Probe 的未来价值，并在退役前生成保持原失败边界但改变表面形式的变异 Probe；策略在保留、变异、合并和退役之间分配固定预算。
composition_logic.en: Learn future probe value and mutate probes before retirement to preserve the original failure boundary under new surface forms, allocating a fixed budget across keep, mutate, merge, and retire.

learning_signal.zh: 历史版本命中、Probe 谱系、变异结果和更新 diff。
learning_signal.en: Historical hits, probe lineage, mutation outcomes, and update diffs.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未来版本回退召回、冗余率和测试成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Future-regression recall, redundancy, and testing cost.

strongest_baseline.zh: 全部保留、半衰期退役、IRT、随机变异和固定回归集。
strongest_baseline.en: Keep-all, half-life retirement, IRT, random mutation, and fixed suites.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在两条版本流上固定总 Probe 数，比较未来召回和陈旧测试比例。
decisive_pilot.en: Fix total probe count on two version streams and compare future recall and stale-test share.

stop_condition.zh: 若变异只增加难度而不提高召回，或不优于 keep-all 成本前沿，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if mutation only raises difficulty without recall or does not beat the keep-all cost frontier.

external_reviews.finding: The problem is real and the proposal has a defensible standalone boundary: prior work separately studies test relevance decay, mutation-guided test augmentation, and adaptive item selection, but not a fixed-budget, lineage-aware keep/mutate/merge/retire operator optimized for future regressions across version streams. The persistent portfolio is behavior-changing after freezing, and future-regression recall can provide independent temporal supervision. The main risk is that explicit half-life and mutation may collapse to a future-hit predictor plus diversity-constrained top-k selection.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该问题真实存在，且方案具有可辩护的独立边界：既有工作分别研究测试相关性衰减、基于变异的测试增强和自适应题目选择，但尚未形成一个在固定预算下、利用谱系信息并针对跨版本未来回归进行优化的保留、变异、合并和淘汰算子。冻结后的持久化探针组合会改变后续测试行为，未来回归召回率也可提供独立的时间监督。主要风险是显式半衰期和探针变异最终可能退化为未来命中率预测器加多样性约束的 top-k 选择。
external_reviews.required_action: Run a prequential version-stream study with a capacity-matched no-mutation value predictor and require mutation to improve the future-recall versus execution-cost Pareto frontier while preserving each probe's original semantic boundary.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 开展按版本顺序的前瞻评测，加入容量匹配且不进行变异的价值预测基线，并要求探针变异在保持原始语义边界的同时改进未来召回率与执行成本的帕累托前沿。

closest_work.title: Are Benchmark Tests Strong Enough? Mutation-Guided Diagnosis and Augmentation of Regression Suites
Keeping Mutation Test Suites Consistent and Relevant with Long-Standing Mutants
Reliable and Efficient Amortized Model-based Evaluation

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A lineage-preserving, fixed-budget portfolio policy that mutates probes before retirement and is trained on temporally held-out regression value rather than static difficulty or current-suite adequacy.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Capacity-matched future-hit prediction plus submodular diversity selection under the same probe-generation and execution budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: On two chronological version streams, freeze the policy at each round and compare full keep/mutate/merge/retire control against no-mutation learned selection, long-standing-probe selection, IRT, random mutation, and keep-all using identical total probes and generation calls.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the standalone combination claim if the no-mutation learned selector matches future-regression recall within a predeclared equivalence margin at equal cost, or if more than 10% of retained mutations fail independent semantic-boundary validation.
unknowns: No official source verifies that the proposed multi-round version logs include an independent full-suite oracle for future regressions.
The mutation operator and the procedure for proving that a mutated probe preserves the parent failure boundary are unspecified.

removable_atoms: probe half-life as a separate mechanism, because age can be absorbed as one feature of the learned future-value model
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: A learned future-regression-hit predictor followed by diversity-constrained top-k probe selection, with no mutation or explicit retirement policy.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Mostly closed: version diffs and historical outcomes sense decay, future held-out regressions assign credit, and the portfolio update persists into later versions; semantic validation of mutations is the remaining weak link.

real_problem.zh: 检测到 Prompt、记忆和工作流更新不兼容后，现有方法通常只拒绝组合或回滚一个更新。
real_problem.en: After detecting incompatible prompt, memory, and workflow updates, existing methods usually reject the composition or roll back one update.

composition_logic.zh: 从失败组合与成功邻域中学习兼容子句，再编译最小重排、条件化或桥接补丁，使原更新尽量都被保留。
composition_logic.en: Learn compatibility clauses from failed compositions and successful neighbors, then compile minimal reordering, conditioning, or bridge patches that preserve as many original updates as possible.

learning_signal.zh: 更新组合干预、失败模块和独立回归套件结果。
learning_signal.en: Update-composition interventions, failing modules, and independent regression-suite outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见组合上恢复目标能力且不损害已通过能力。
independent_ground_truth.en: Restoration on unseen compositions without harming mastered capabilities.

strongest_baseline.zh: 直接拒绝、最后更新回滚、Delta Debugging、人工重排和风险门控。
strongest_baseline.en: Direct rejection, last-update rollback, delta debugging, manual reordering, and risk gating.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 4–8 个版本化更新中构造单点、双点和顺序故障，比较保留更新数、恢复率和额外测试成本。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct single, pairwise, and order faults over 4–8 versioned updates and compare retained updates, recovery, and testing cost.

stop_condition.zh: 若编译器只是在更贵地搜索已有重排，或保留更新数不优于最小回滚，则降级为工具。
stop_condition.en: Demote to a tool if it only performs costlier search over known reorderings or fails to retain more updates than minimal rollback.

external_reviews.finding: The proposal targets a real failure that rollback-only update management does not solve, and its surviving thesis is preservation-aware repair of incompatible, independently versioned prompt, memory, skill, and workflow updates. Existing workflow optimizers localize and patch failures, and reversible-trace systems accelerate counterfactual repair, but they do not learn reusable compatibility clauses and compile minimal bridges or reorderings that maximize retained updates on unseen compositions. The thesis survives only if clause induction generalizes beyond enumerating the small repair search space.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方案针对的是真实故障：仅回滚更新无法解决多个独立版本化的提示、记忆、技能和工作流更新之间的不兼容。现有工作流优化器可以定位并修补故障，可逆轨迹系统也能加速反事实修复，但它们并未学习可复用的兼容性子句，并在未见组合上编译最小桥接或重排序补丁以最大化保留更新数量。只有当兼容性子句能够超越小规模修复空间的枚举搜索并实现泛化时，该论文主张才成立。
external_reviews.required_action: Hold out entire incompatibility templates and update-surface combinations, then show that learned clauses compile successful minimal repairs with higher retained-update utility and lower oracle calls than an equally expressive constrained graph-search baseline.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 完整留出不兼容模板和更新表面组合，并证明学习到的子句相较于同等表达能力的约束图搜索基线，能够用更少的判定调用编译出成功的最小修复，同时保留更多更新效用。

closest_work.title: Workflow-Localized Mechanism Learning: Attribution-Guided Repair and Knowledge Reuse for Structured Agent Skills
Shepherd: Enabling Programmable Meta-Agents via Reversible Agentic Execution Traces
Automatic Configuration Repair

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Learning reusable cross-surface compatibility clauses and compiling preservation-maximizing repairs for unseen compositions of independently versioned agent updates.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: An oracle-guided, capacity-matched constrained graph-rewrite search using the same repair operators but no learned compatibility clauses.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Create chronological compositions of 4-8 updates with held-out pairwise, order-sensitive, and cross-surface fault templates; compare repair success, retained-update utility, minimality, and regression calls under identical operator sets and budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if constrained search matches repair success and retained-update utility within the predeclared equivalence margin, or if learned clauses fail to improve on unseen fault templates rather than merely unseen instances.
unknowns: No official benchmark currently verifies versioned prompt-memory-skill-workflow composition with module-level fault labels and an independent regression oracle.
The clause language, repair minimality metric, and treatment of interacting nonlocal faults are not specified.

removable_atoms: typed update descriptors as a separate learned atom, if equivalent type information can be deterministically extracted from the versioned update graph
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Best-first constrained search over rollback, reordering, guards, and bridge templates, scored directly by the same regression suite and retained-update objective.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Closed in principle: composition interventions expose incompatibility, module-level failures localize credit, the compiler persists a repaired update program, and independent regression suites evaluate unseen future compositions.

title.zh: 单调适用集合专化器 v4

real_problem.zh: 自由文本反例修复会破坏原本正确的经验区域，直接删除又浪费可迁移部分。
real_problem.en: Free-text counterexample repair damages correct regions, while deletion wastes transferable knowledge.

composition_logic.zh: 把经验表示为类型化前置条件格；每个最小反例只允许添加最小约束或例外，更新必须保持未受影响正例。
composition_logic.en: Represent lessons as a typed precondition lattice; each minimal counterexample may add only a minimal constraint or exception while retaining unaffected positives.

review_ranked_finalists.persistent_update_object: structured lesson with executable exception lineage

learning_signal.zh: 最小反例、未受影响正例和约束删除轨迹。
learning_signal.en: Minimal counterexamples, unaffected positives, and constraint-deletion traces.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 规则适用真值、正例保持率和未见状态错误调用。
independent_ground_truth.en: Applicability ground truth, positive retention, and misuse on unseen states.

strongest_baseline.zh: SkillTracer、SkillAdaptor、自由文本重写、全部删除和 Assay 类选择。
strongest_baseline.en: SkillTracer, SkillAdaptor, free-text rewriting, full deletion, and Assay-style selection.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在规则可执行工具环境中冻结类型语言，比较最小编辑数、错误调用和正例保持。
decisive_pilot.en: Freeze the typed language in an executable-rule environment and compare edit size, misuse, and positive retention.

stop_condition.zh: 若类型语言需按任务人工设计，或与 SkillAdaptor 等价，则作为可解释组件保留。
stop_condition.en: Retain as an interpretable component if the type language is task-specific or equivalent to SkillAdaptor.

revival_condition.zh: 必须冻结可执行类型语言，并证明单调专化比自由修复更好保持正例。
revival_condition.en: Revives only with a frozen executable type language and evidence that monotone specialization preserves unaffected positives better than free repair.

external_reviews.finding: The revived proposal materially changes the learned object from free-text repair into monotone specialization of an executable applicability set. The frozen precondition lattice defines the legal hypothesis space, minimal counterexamples identify the boundary to exclude, and the positive-retention constraint prevents collateral deletion of valid regions. SkillAdaptor and SkillTracer perform localized skill repair, while GraSP uses typed preconditions and local graph operators, but none directly establishes minimal monotone narrowing of one persistent lesson with executable exception lineage and guaranteed retention testing. This is a defensible standalone operator if it outperforms generic symbolic rule learning under the same vocabulary and complexity budget.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该复活方案将学习对象从自由文本修复实质性地改为可执行适用集合的单调特化。冻结的前置条件格定义合法假设空间，最小反例确定需要排除的边界，正例保持约束则防止误删原本正确的区域。SkillAdaptor 和 SkillTracer 执行局部技能修复，GraSP 采用类型化前置条件和局部图算子，但它们均未直接实现带可执行异常谱系、经过保持性验证的单一持久规则最小单调收缩。若该算子在相同谓词词表和复杂度预算下优于通用符号规则学习，则可形成独立论文贡献。
external_reviews.required_action: Freeze the executable predicate language before observing counterexamples and show that monotone specialization dominates capacity-matched ILP, decision-tree, and SkillAdaptor variants on the misuse-retention-rule-complexity Pareto frontier.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 在观察反例前冻结可执行谓词语言，并证明单调特化在误用率、正例保持率和规则复杂度的帕累托前沿上优于容量匹配的 ILP、决策树及 SkillAdaptor 变体。

closest_work.title: SkillAdaptor: Self-Adapting Skills for LLM Agents from Trajectories
SkillTracer: Structural Failure Attribution and Refinement of Agentic Skills in Long-Horizon Web Tasks
GraSP: Graph-Structured Skill Compositions for LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Minimal monotone specialization of one persistent applicability set in a frozen executable hypothesis language, with explicit exception lineage and preservation tests for every unaffected positive region.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: SkillAdaptor constrained to the same predicate vocabulary together with a capacity-matched ILP rule learner
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: In an executable-rule environment, freeze one typed predicate language, stream minimal counterexamples, and compare against ILP, decision trees, free-text repair, deletion, and SkillAdaptor using the same evidence and rule-complexity budget. Measure false applicability, retained-positive accuracy, edit size, and performance on unseen states and counterexample orders.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the standalone claim if a generic rule learner or same-vocabulary SkillAdaptor matches the misuse-retention-edit-size frontier, if new domains require adding predicates after seeing test failures, or if purportedly minimal edits do not alter frozen execution behavior.
unknowns: No cross-domain frozen predicate language with complete applicability ground truth is identified.
It is unclear whether minimal counterexamples can be generated without an oracle.
Equivalence to SkillAdaptor constrained to the same executable vocabulary has not been tested.

combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: A capacity-matched ILP or decision-tree rule learner over the identical typed predicates with post-hoc positive-retention validation
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The loop is coherent: executable predicates sense applicability, minimal counterexamples identify erroneous regions, constrained edits persistently narrow the lesson, retained positives control regressions, and unseen-state execution measures future misuse and coverage.

real_problem.zh: 评价器失败往往来自 Rubric 某个条件缺失或权重错误，整体微调难以解释且可能破坏其他评分维度。
real_problem.en: Evaluator failures often come from missing rubric conditions or wrong weights; full fine-tuning is hard to interpret and may damage other criteria.

composition_logic.zh: 把 Rubric 分解为可执行原子，通过独立因果／中性干预定位缺失或过强原子，再学习最小新增、删除或重加权编辑。
composition_logic.en: Atomize the rubric, use independent causal and neutral interventions to localize missing or over-weighted atoms, then learn minimal add/delete/reweight edits.

learning_signal.zh: 干预对、Rubric 原子激活和独立任务结果。
learning_signal.en: Intervention pairs, rubric-atom activation, and independent task outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见任务上的排序改进与中性维度保持。
independent_ground_truth.en: Ranking improvement and neutral-dimension preservation on unseen tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 整体 Reward 微调、Prompt 重写、冻结 Rubric、CROME／PRISM。
strongest_baseline.en: Full reward fine-tuning, prompt rewriting, frozen rubric, and CROME/PRISM.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在程序可验证任务中构造 3–5 类 Rubric 故障，比较编辑大小、排序正确率和中性保持。
decisive_pilot.en: Inject 3–5 rubric fault types in verifier-rich tasks and compare edit size, ranking correctness, and neutral preservation.

stop_condition.zh: 若最小编辑不能优于完整微调的圈外表现，或需要同一评价器自证，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if minimal edits do not beat full fine-tuning out of loop or require evaluator self-validation.

external_reviews.finding: The problem is real, but the present composition sits directly inside an already crowded mechanism boundary. CROME supplies causal and neutral rubric interventions, RRD decomposes, filters, and reweights rubric criteria, and PReMISE discovers, audits, and repairs reusable rubrics. Applying a sparse add/delete/reweight optimizer to those signals does not yet identify a new learning operator; a CROME-augmented RRD or PReMISE baseline can reproduce the proposed behavior. The idea becomes defensible only if each intervention estimates an identifiable rubric-atom effect and a formally constrained solver edits an existing deployed rubric with guarantees or empirically unique neutral-dimension preservation.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该问题是真实的，但当前组合直接落在已经十分拥挤的方法边界内。CROME 已提供因果与中性 rubric 干预，RRD 已进行准则分解、过滤和重加权，PReMISE 已发现、审计并修复可复用 rubric。仅对这些信号应用稀疏的增删与重加权优化器，尚未形成新的学习算子；加入 CROME 数据的 RRD 或 PReMISE 基线即可复现其行为。只有当每个干预都能估计可识别的 rubric 原子效应，并由形式化约束求解器修改已有部署 rubric，同时提供保证或独有的中性维度保持能力时，该想法才足以成立。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace generic minimal rewriting with an intervention-effect matrix and an explicitly constrained sparse edit solver, then compare it against CROME-augmented RRD and PReMISE.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将通用的最小重写改为“干预效应矩阵加显式约束的稀疏编辑求解器”，并与使用 CROME 干预数据的 RRD 和 PReMISE 比较。

closest_work.title: Robust Reward Modeling via Causal Rubrics
Rethinking Rubric Generation for Improving LLM Judge and Reward Modeling for Open-ended Tasks
PReMISE: Policy Rubrics as Measurement Specifications for LLM Judges

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A possible narrow boundary is causal diagnosis and sparse repair of an already deployed, versioned rubric rather than rubric discovery, general refinement, or reward-model weight training; this boundary is not yet operationally distinct.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: PReMISE or RRD using the same CROME-style causal and neutral intervention pairs, the same evaluator, and a matched sparsity penalty.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Inject missing, duplicated, reversed, and misweighted rubric atoms into verifier-rich tasks; allocate identical intervention pairs and evaluator calls; compare ranking accuracy, neutral-dimension invariance, edit size, and cross-task transfer after freezing.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Falsify the proposal if CROME-augmented PReMISE or RRD is statistically indistinguishable on both held-out ranking accuracy and neutral preservation, or if the proposed edits are not materially smaller.
unknowns: The source and independence of rubric-atom activation supervision are unspecified.
The intended PRISM comparator is ambiguous because multiple unrelated 2026 methods use that name.
No exact optimization objective defines what counts as a minimal add, delete, or reweight edit.

removable_atoms: Hard minimal-edit search; a sparsity-regularized rubric refiner may preserve the same ranking and neutral-preservation behavior.
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: RRD or PReMISE trained with CROME causal and neutral augmentations plus an L1 or L0 edit penalty.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The outline closes the loop from counterfactual sensing to rubric-atom credit, persistent rubric editing, and held-out ranking evaluation, but the source and independence of rubric-atom activation labels are unresolved.

title.zh: 更新条件化的权限租约

real_problem.zh: Agent 更新后沿用旧权限会产生新越权，永久最低权限又损害任务效用。
real_problem.en: Inherited permissions can create new overreach after an agent update, while permanent minimum privilege harms utility.

composition_logic.zh: 根据 Prompt、记忆、技能或工作流 diff 预测受影响权限与最小临时权限集，并用独立 Canary 决定逐级续租。
composition_logic.en: Predict affected permissions and a minimal temporary set from prompt, memory, skill, or workflow diffs, then renew authority stepwise using independent canaries.

learning_signal.zh: 更新 diff、Canary 结果、越权和任务效用。
learning_signal.en: Update diffs, canary outcomes, overreach, and task utility.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新算子上的安全—效用结果。
independent_ground_truth.en: Safety-utility outcomes on unseen update operators.

strongest_baseline.zh: 静态最小权限、ABAC/MAC、统一降权和完整重认证。
strongest_baseline.en: Static least privilege, ABAC/MAC, uniform downgrade, and full reauthorization.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 ToolPrivBench/AuthBench 风格任务上训练三种更新类型并留出第四种。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three update types and hold out a fourth on ToolPrivBench/AuthBench-style tasks.

stop_condition.zh: 若收益来自永久禁权，或留出更新类型上无法校准，则降级为治理组件。
stop_condition.en: Demote to governance if gains come from permanent denial or calibration fails on held-out update types.

external_reviews.finding: The deployment problem is real, but the current composition is too close to existing dynamic least-privilege policy generation, task-context capability scoping, and risk-adaptive task-based access control. A task-bounded renewable lease is primarily an authorization wrapper, while the persistent lease state is not yet a distinct learned behavior-changing object. The only plausible standalone boundary is causal prediction of which permissions become newly unsafe because of a specific agent update, validated by independent probes on held-out update operators.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该部署问题真实存在，但当前组合与既有的动态最小权限策略生成、基于任务上下文的能力范围控制以及风险自适应任务访问控制过于接近。任务边界内可续租的权限本质上仍是授权包装器，持久化租约状态尚未构成独立的、通过学习改变行为的对象。唯一可能成立的独立边界，是因果预测某次智能体更新会使哪些权限新增风险，并通过针对未见更新算子的独立探针进行验证。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace generic lease renewal with an intervention-trained update-diff-to-permission causal model and evaluate it against Progent-style dynamic policies on held-out update operators, with canaries generated and scored independently of that model.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 用基于干预训练的“更新差异到权限风险”因果模型替代通用租约续期，并在未见更新算子上与 Progent 式动态策略比较，同时确保金丝雀探针的生成和评分独立于该模型。

closest_work.title: Progent: Programmable Privilege Control for LLM Agents
Dynamic Capability Scoping for Enterprise AI Agents: A Synthetic Dataset and Three-Source Permission Architecture
Uncertainty-Aware, Risk-Adaptive Access Control for Agentic Systems using an LLM-Judged TBAC Model

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Permission-risk prediction conditioned specifically on versioned prompt, memory, skill, or workflow diffs and tested for transfer to unseen update operators.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Progent-style dynamically updated least-privilege policies augmented with the same task-context classifier and independent probe schedule.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train on three causally distinct update operators, hold out a fourth operator and permission families, and compare overreach, benign task success, calibration, and authorization calls under identical tools, tasks, and probe budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the method claim if a dynamic policy baseline matches the safety-utility frontier, or if held-out-update permission-risk calibration has expected calibration error above 0.10 or fails to beat a task-only classifier.
unknowns: The exact ToolPrivBench/AuthBench-style assets, labels, and update-operator splits are not specified in official sources.
It is unknown whether the proposed canaries are independent of the risk model and whether they measure real overreach rather than policy-defined violations.

removable_atoms: task-bounded lease, because a dynamic ABAC or Progent-style policy can enforce the same temporary scope
stepwise renewal as a separate mechanism, because repeated risk gating can reproduce it
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: A task-context permission classifier plus dynamic ABAC enforcement and periodic independent risk checks.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Only partially closed: update diffs sense possible risk and outcomes evaluate safety-utility, but credit between the update-diff model, lease policy, and canaries is confounded unless the probes are independently generated and interventions identify permission-specific effects.

real_problem.zh: 纠错信用只能解释哪一步有用，却不能把重复纠错模式压缩成可迁移技能。
real_problem.en: Correction credit explains useful steps but does not compress recurring correction patterns into transferable skills.

composition_logic.zh: 把失败定位结果映射到观察、计划、工具和动作槽位，归纳带前置条件和最小动作序列的纠错技能语法。
composition_logic.en: Map localized failures to observation, plan, tool, and action slots, then induce correction-skill grammars with preconditions and minimal action sequences.

learning_signal.zh: 模块替换干预、动作必要性和未来复用结果。
learning_signal.en: Module-replacement interventions, action necessity, and future reuse outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见失败组合上的技能调用正确率和任务恢复率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Skill-invocation precision and task recovery on unseen failure compositions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 整轨迹反思、技能摘要、成功轨迹 SFT 和模块级反思。
strongest_baseline.en: Whole-trajectory reflection, skill summarization, success-trace SFT, and module-level reflection.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在两类工具任务上训练三种失败组合，留出新的错误组合和第二模型。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three failure compositions across two tool domains and hold out new combinations and a second model.

stop_condition.zh: 若语法不能比自然语言技能更好迁移，或需要人工槽位标签，则返回 repair。
stop_condition.en: Return to repair if the grammar does not transfer better than natural-language skills or needs manual slot labels.

revival_condition.zh: 必须把纠错信用转化为可执行、可复用的持久技能语法。
revival_condition.en: Revives only by converting correction credit into executable reusable persistent skill grammar.

external_reviews.finding: Converting correction credit into a persistent executable grammar is a material revival, but the proposed combination is heavily bordered by existing work. ASI and NSI already induce reusable programmatic or logic-grounded skills, SkillGen verifies skill effects through controlled with-skill versus without-skill interventions, and REFLECT uses controlled replay to validate error attribution. Typed failure slots may reduce to manual labels, while a nearest retrieved repair program may reproduce the claimed recovery without grammar induction. The surviving thesis requires evidence that learned productions recombine on unseen failure compositions rather than storing one repair per observed trace.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 将纠错信用转化为持久的可执行语法属于实质性复活，但该组合与已有工作高度接近。ASI 和 NSI 已归纳可复用的程序化或逻辑化技能，SkillGen 通过有技能与无技能的受控干预验证技能效果，REFLECT 则通过受控重放验证错误归因。类型化失败槽可能退化为人工标签，最近邻修复程序检索也可能在无需语法归纳的情况下复现恢复效果。剩余的独立命题必须证明语法产生式能够在未见失败组合上重新组合，而不是为每条训练轨迹存储一个修复。
external_reviews.required_action: Demonstrate automatically induced failure slots and grammar-level compositional generalization against ASI, NSI, flat skill induction, and intervention-verified nearest-repair retrieval under identical trajectories and inference budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 在相同轨迹数据和推理预算下，与 ASI、NSI、扁平技能归纳及经干预验证的最近修复检索比较，证明失败槽能够自动归纳且语法具有组合泛化能力。

closest_work.title: Lifting Traces to Logic: Programmatic Skill Induction with Neuro-Symbolic Learning for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
SkillGen: Verified Inference-Time Agent Skill Synthesis
REFLECT: Intervention-Supported Error Attribution for Silent Failures in LLM Agent Traces

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A correction-specific grammar whose productions are credited to necessary actions and systematically recombine across unseen failure compositions, tool domains, and backbone models.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: NSI or ASI program induction combined with intervention-verified nearest-repair retrieval
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train on primitive correction types and only a strict subset of their pairwise compositions across two tool domains. Test held-out compositions and a second frozen model under matched traces, calls, and executable-skill capacity, comparing the full method with ASI, NSI, nearest-repair retrieval, flat natural-language skills, and an ablation without action-necessity interventions.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the grammar claim if it does not outperform retrieval or flat programmatic skills on unseen compositions, if failure slots require manual annotation, or if the number of productions grows approximately one-for-one with training traces.
unknowns: No independent automatic ground truth is specified for observation, plan, tool, and action failure slots.
It is unclear whether module-replacement interventions are executable and semantically comparable across both proposed domains and the second model.
The proposed environments may not provide unique or verifiably minimal correction-action sequences.

removable_atoms: typed failure slots
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Intervention-verified nearest repair-program retrieval using ASI- or NSI-style program induction without grammar productions
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Controlled replacements provide a plausible sensing and credit path, and the grammar is an exact persistent update. However, slot identifiability and production-level credit are unresolved, so future recovery may be attributable to case retrieval rather than grammar composition.

title.zh: API 语义工作流编译器

real_problem.zh: 工作流通常绑定具体工具 schema，更换等价 API 后需要人工重写。
real_problem.en: Workflows are tied to concrete tool schemas and often need manual rewriting for semantically equivalent APIs.

composition_logic.zh: 把工作流编译到带前置条件、效果和错误语义的中间表示，再为目标 API 生成调用绑定和恢复分支；训练目标是行为保持而非文本相似。
composition_logic.en: Compile workflows into an intermediate representation with preconditions, effects, and error semantics, then generate target-API bindings and recovery branches under behavior-preservation objectives.

learning_signal.zh: 源／目标 API 执行轨迹、状态效果和失败语义。
learning_signal.en: Source/target API traces, state effects, and failure semantics.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见 API 上的行为等价、成功率和恢复能力。
independent_ground_truth.en: Behavioral equivalence, success, and recovery on unseen APIs.

strongest_baseline.zh: 手工 schema 映射、SkCC、语义相似度和直接 LLM 重写。
strongest_baseline.en: Manual schema mapping, SkCC, semantic similarity, and direct LLM rewriting.

decisive_pilot.zh: 使用两组等价工具 API 和留出第三组，冻结 IR 与编译器，匹配调用预算。
decisive_pilot.en: Use two equivalent API families and hold out a third while freezing the IR and compiler under matched calls.

stop_condition.zh: 若行为等价仅在训练 API 成立，或 IR 无法覆盖错误恢复，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if equivalence holds only on training APIs or the IR cannot express error recovery.

external_reviews.finding: The portability problem is real, but canonical semantics, an intermediate workflow representation, and target compilation are established ideas across workflow compilation, semantics-preserving API migration, and tool-schema generalization. The proposal currently names a compiler architecture rather than an identifiable learned operator: source/target traces do not specify how preconditions, effects, and error semantics are induced or why direct verified rewriting cannot reproduce the result. A standalone claim could survive only around learned, family-invariant semantic induction that supports recovery-preserving compilation to genuinely unseen APIs.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 工作流可移植性问题真实存在，但规范化语义、工作流中间表示和目标端编译在工作流编译、保持语义的 API 迁移以及工具模式泛化中都已有明确先例。当前方案更像是一个编译器架构名称，而不是可识别的学习算子：源端和目标端轨迹并未说明如何归纳前置条件、状态效果和错误语义，也未证明经过执行验证的直接重写无法得到同等结果。只有围绕可学习的、跨 API 家族不变的语义归纳，并能将恢复逻辑保持地编译到真正未见 API，才可能形成独立论文主张。
external_reviews.required_action: Define and train an explicit semantic-induction operator, then hold out an entire API family and require frozen-IR compilation to outperform direct LLM rewriting plus execution repair on behavioral equivalence and recovery under matched calls.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 定义并训练显式的语义归纳算子，完整留出一个 API 家族，并要求冻结中间表示后的编译在匹配调用预算下，在行为等价性和错误恢复方面优于直接 LLM 重写加执行修复。

closest_work.title: COVENANT: Natural-Language Workflow Compilation for Aligned Agent Execution
A Sound Static Analysis Approach to I/O API Migration
RIMRULE: Improving Tool-Using Language Agents via MDL-Guided Rule Learning

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A portable agent-workflow IR whose learned precondition, effect, and error semantics remain valid across semantically equivalent but structurally unseen API families and preserve recovery branches.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Capacity-matched direct schema-to-schema LLM rewriting with execution-guided repair and the same behavioral verifier.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use three API families with independently specified semantic equivalence, train semantic induction on two, freeze the IR and compiler, and test the third under identical calls, retries, and verification executions.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if frozen-IR transfer does not exceed direct verified rewriting by the predeclared margin on both end-task success and recovery-branch equivalence, or if equivalence holds only after target-family fine-tuning.
unknowns: The proposed three equivalent API families and their independent semantic-equivalence specifications are not identified.
ToolBench does not by itself provide proven equivalence classes, precondition/effect annotations, or recovery-semantics oracles for this pilot.

removable_atoms: canonical tool semantics as a separate atom, because it can be folded into the workflow IR
a learned compiler, if direct constrained rewriting with execution verification matches frozen-IR transfer
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Direct LLM workflow rewriting against the target schema followed by execution-guided repair and behavioral regression tests, with the same model calls.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Incomplete as written: traces sense API behavior and execution can evaluate outputs, but the credit assignment and update rule for inducing reusable semantics are unspecified; future evaluation is coherent only with an independent equivalence and recovery oracle.

title.zh: 评价器锚点残差修正器

real_problem.zh: 执行者与评价器共同更新时，交互残差能发现偏差，但单纯拒绝提交不会改善评价器。
real_problem.en: When actor and evaluator co-evolve, interaction residuals can expose bias, but commit rejection does not improve the evaluator.

composition_logic.zh: 用跨版本评分矩阵分离 actor 能力、任务难度和 evaluator 偏置，再训练小型残差修正头，使锚点任务排序与外部真值一致。
composition_logic.en: Factor cross-version scores into actor ability, task difficulty, and evaluator bias, then train a small residual corrector aligned to independent anchor-task rankings.

learning_signal.zh: 跨版本评分、外部锚点排序和未来轮次偏差。
learning_signal.en: Cross-version scores, external anchor rankings, and future-round bias.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 冻结外部验证器上的真实能力与排序稳定性。
independent_ground_truth.en: True capability and ranking stability under a frozen external verifier.

strongest_baseline.zh: 冻结评价器、评价器 Ensemble、CREAM 式一致性和普通 Pairwise Fine-tuning。
strongest_baseline.en: Frozen evaluator, evaluator ensemble, CREAM-style consistency, and ordinary pairwise fine-tuning.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造 6–10 轮 actor/evaluator 版本，留出未来版本并匹配评价调用。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct 6–10 actor/evaluator rounds, hold out future versions, and match evaluator calls.

stop_condition.zh: 若修正头只提高锚点拟合而不提高圈外策略选择，则作为校准组件保留。
stop_condition.en: Retain only as calibration if it improves anchor fit but not out-of-loop policy selection.

external_reviews.finding: Evaluator co-adaptation is a real failure and independent anchors can provide identifiable supervision, but the current composition is close to static judge calibration. Bridge already models latent target judgments and systematic judge deviations, SAJA trains a lightweight calibration head from external labels, and CREAM regularizes reward consistency across self-rewarding iterations. The proposed factorization becomes a standalone method only if crossed actor-evaluator histories reveal future-version bias that a capacity-matched static calibration head cannot predict.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 评估器随演员共同适应是真实失效，独立锚点也能提供可识别监督，但当前组合与静态评估器校准非常接近。Bridge 已建模潜在真实判断及评估器系统偏差，SAJA 使用外部标签训练轻量校准头，CREAM 则约束多轮自奖励中的评分一致性。只有当演员与评估器版本的交叉历史能够预测静态校准头无法预测的未来版本偏差时，该方法才构成独立论文。
external_reviews.required_action: Use a fully crossed actor-version by evaluator-version design and constrain the residual head to predict held-out future evaluator bias beyond a capacity-matched Bridge or SAJA-style static calibrator.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 采用完整的演员版本乘评估器版本交叉设计，并要求残差头在预测未见未来评估器偏差时显著超过容量匹配的 Bridge 或 SAJA 式静态校准器。

closest_work.title: Bridging Human and LLM Judgments: Understanding and Narrowing the Gap
SAJA: A Simple Approach to Judge Alignment for LLM-as-a-Judge
CREAM: Consistency Regularized Self-Rewarding Language Models

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The potentially new boundary is correction of evaluator drift from a longitudinal, crossed actor-evaluator matrix with prospective evaluation on future co-evolution rounds and downstream policy selection.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched static calibration head trained on the identical anchor judgments and score features, with no cross-version factorization
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Create at least eight actor versions and eight evaluator versions, score every actor with every evaluator on fixed independent anchors, train through round five, and predict rounds six through eight with identical evaluator calls; compare frozen judges, ensembles, Bridge, SAJA-style calibration, an item-response model, and the residual corrector on ranking error and independently verified quality of the selected policy.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Reduce the work to evaluator calibration if a static calibrator matches future-round ranking accuracy, the latent factors are unstable across random seeds, or improved anchor fit does not improve independently verified policy selection.
unknowns: Whether the actor-evaluator score matrix will be dense enough for identifiable factorization
Whether the external verifier is genuinely independent of the evolving actors and evaluators
Which features and parameters are available to the residual head
Whether future evaluator versions differ through genuine bias drift rather than ordinary capability improvement

removable_atoms: cross-version score factorization if a direct calibration head trained on the same anchors produces equivalent future rankings
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: A SAJA-style calibration head or Bridge regression fitted directly to the same independent anchor labels without actor-ability and evaluator-bias factorization
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Independent anchors, persistent correction, and future policy-selection evaluation can form a loop, but actor ability, task difficulty, and evaluator bias are not identifiable unless actor and evaluator versions are sufficiently crossed.

title.zh: 检索介导的记忆伤害分解器

real_problem.zh: 记忆条目造成的未来失败既可能来自条目内容本身，也可能来自检索频率、位置和与其他记忆的交互。
real_problem.en: Future memory failures may come from content, retrieval exposure, position, or interactions with other memories.

composition_logic.zh: 先随机化条目是否被检索，再把总效应分成内容直接效应、检索介导效应和条目交互效应；系统不只决定是否保留，还把主要伤害来源编译成重写、降频或互斥约束。
composition_logic.en: Randomize retrieval exposure, decompose total effect into direct content, retrieval-mediated, and interaction effects, then compile the dominant harm source into rewrite, down-weighting, or mutual-exclusion constraints.

review_ranked_finalists.persistent_update_object: versioned memory entry plus retrieval policy

learning_signal.zh: 条目级随机检索日志、后续任务奖励和共同检索集合。
learning_signal.en: Entry-level randomized retrieval logs, future-task rewards, and co-retrieval sets.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 独立环境奖励下的未来帮助、直接伤害和介导伤害。
independent_ground_truth.en: Future benefit, direct harm, and mediated harm under independent environment rewards.

strongest_baseline.zh: 标准因果中介分析、A-MAC、写入／删除门控和固定检索降权。
strongest_baseline.en: Standard causal mediation, A-MAC, write/delete gating, and fixed retrieval down-weighting.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebArena-Lite 的时间任务流中随机化条目暴露，比较删除、重写、降频和互斥四种持久修复。
decisive_pilot.en: Randomize entry exposure in chronological ALFWorld and WebArena-Lite streams and compare deletion, rewriting, down-weighting, and mutual exclusion.

stop_condition.zh: 若中介分解不能指导比统一删除更好的修复，或第二模型上效应方向不稳定，则降级为分析工具。
stop_condition.en: Demote to analysis if decomposition does not guide better repair than uniform deletion or effect signs are unstable on a second model.

external_reviews.finding: The problem is real and the proposed loop extends beyond existing causal memory selection by attempting pathway-specific persistent repair. However, randomizing only retrieval exposure identifies an inclusion effect, not separate direct content, retrieval-position, and co-memory interaction effects. MemAudit already performs counterfactual causal attribution, Causal Memory Intervention selects or suppresses memories through controlled interventions, and Memory Worth exposes retrieval-outcome and co-retrieval confounding. A factorial intervention design and a direct repair-policy baseline are required before causal mediation is an identifiable and necessary mechanism.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该问题真实存在，而且方案试图把因果分析进一步编译为针对不同伤害路径的持久化修复，边界比现有因果记忆选择更强。但仅随机化是否检索，只能识别记忆纳入效应，无法分别识别内容直接效应、检索位置效应和多记忆交互效应。MemAudit 已进行反事实因果归因，Causal Memory Intervention 已通过受控干预选择或抑制记忆，Memory Worth 也揭示了检索结果关联及共同检索混杂。因此必须加入析因干预和直接修复策略基线，才能证明因果中介既可识别又不可替代。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace single exposure randomization with a preregistered factorial intervention over inclusion, content substitution, rank or position, and co-retrieval, and compare the resulting decomposer against a direct contextual repair bandit trained from the same interventions.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将单一的检索暴露随机化替换为预注册析因干预，分别操纵是否纳入、内容替换、排序或位置以及共同检索，并使用相同干预数据与直接学习修复动作的上下文多臂老虎机比较。

closest_work.title: Causal Intervention-Based Memory Selection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
MemAudit: Post-hoc Auditing of Poisoned Agent Memory via Causal Attribution and Structural Anomaly Detection
When to Forget: A Memory Governance Primitive

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving boundary is identification of distinct content, retrieval, position, and co-memory pathways followed by pathway-specific persistent rewriting or retrieval constraints under independent environment rewards.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A matched-data contextual repair bandit that directly chooses keep, delete, rewrite, down-weight, or mutual exclusion from randomized outcome logs
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: For chronological tasks, independently randomize memory inclusion, rank, content-preserving versus semantic-changing rewrites, and co-retrieval partners; train on the first stream segment, freeze all repairs, and compare mediation-guided repair, direct repair bandits, causal selection, uniform deletion, and fixed down-weighting on future tasks with identical retrieval and interaction budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Demote the proposal to an analysis tool if pathway effects are not identifiable with stable signs across two model families, if the inferred pathway does not predict the best repair action, or if the direct repair bandit matches frozen future-task utility.
unknowns: The causal graph and formal definitions of direct, retrieval-mediated, positional, and interaction effects
Whether sequential interference and adaptive retrieval violate the required mediation assumptions
How sufficient positivity will be maintained for rare memories and co-retrieval combinations
Whether ALFWorld and WebArena-Lite provide reward signals granular and independent enough for entry-level causal attribution

removable_atoms: causal mediation if a direct contextual policy can choose deletion, rewriting, down-weighting, or exclusion from the same randomized outcomes with equal performance
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Per-memory randomized ablation with a contextual bandit that directly selects the best repair action without estimating mediation pathways
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Randomized sensing, independent task reward, persistent memory and retrieval updates, and frozen future evaluation could close the loop, but the currently stated exposure intervention does not identify the claimed direct, mediated, positional, and interaction components.

title.zh: 工作流失败模式重写器

real_problem.zh: 工作流在新 API 或任务图模式上失败时，证书只能拒绝提交，无法学习如何修复控制流。
real_problem.en: When workflows fail on new APIs or task motifs, certificates can reject commits but do not learn how to repair control flow.

composition_logic.zh: 从失败轨迹和成功邻域中提取缺失检查、错误分支、工具顺序和恢复节点模式，学习最小图重写模板并冻结到未见 API。
composition_logic.en: Mine missing checks, wrong branches, tool order, and recovery motifs from failed traces and successful neighbors, then learn minimal graph-rewrite templates frozen to unseen APIs.

learning_signal.zh: 失败轨迹、图差分、独立任务结果和工具语义。
learning_signal.en: Failure traces, graph diffs, independent outcomes, and tool semantics.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见 API 与未见任务图模式上的修复成功率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Repair success on unseen APIs and unseen task-graph motifs.

strongest_baseline.zh: AFlow、人工工作流修复、性能预测器、通用代码补丁。
strongest_baseline.en: AFlow, manual workflow repair, performance predictors, and generic code repair.

decisive_pilot.zh: 独立生成 200 个小工作流故障，训练部分 motif，留出 API 与 motif 双重迁移。
decisive_pilot.en: Generate 200 small workflow faults, train on a subset of motifs, and hold out both APIs and motifs.

stop_condition.zh: 若模板只记住 API 名称，或通用图修复同样有效，则降级为工程工具。
stop_condition.en: Demote to engineering if templates memorize API names or generic graph repair matches performance.

external_reviews.finding: The deployment failure is real and the proposed library is an exact persistent update object, but the current composition is not yet isolated from existing failure-driven workflow and harness repair. Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement already mines concentrated failure signatures and applies constrained graph edits, while HarnessFix consolidates recurring diagnoses into scoped repair operators. Frozen transfer is an evaluation boundary rather than a necessary learning atom. A standalone contribution survives only if the method induces reusable structural rewrite templates across API-disjoint and motif-disjoint tasks without generating a fresh patch at test time.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该部署问题真实存在，重写模板库也是明确的持久更新对象，但当前组合尚未与已有的失败驱动工作流和智能体框架修复方法拉开边界。Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement 已从集中失败模式中执行受约束图编辑，HarnessFix 也会聚合重复诊断并生成局部修复算子。冻结迁移属于评测边界，而不是必要的学习机制。只有在禁止测试时重新生成补丁的情况下，证明方法能够跨 API 和跨结构故障类型归纳并复用重写模板，才构成独立贡献。
external_reviews.required_action: Constrain the learned object to a fixed structural rewrite language and demonstrate frozen cross-API, cross-motif reuse against Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement, HarnessFix, and nearest-graph-diff retrieval with identical model-call and tool-call budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将学习对象限制为固定的结构重写语言，并在相同模型调用和工具调用预算下，与 Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement、HarnessFix 及最近图差分检索比较，证明冻结后能够跨 API、跨故障模式复用。

closest_work.title: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement
From Failed Trajectories to Reliable LLM Agents: Diagnosing and Repairing Harness Flaws
AFlow: Automating Agentic Workflow Generation

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A persistent, fixed-language library of structural repair templates that is learned once and directly reused on API-disjoint and motif-disjoint workflows without test-time workflow search or patch synthesis.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement augmented with nearest-neighbor retrieval of previously successful graph edits
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Partition 200 injected workflow faults simultaneously by API and structural motif family. Learn templates only on source partitions, freeze the library, and test unseen APIs plus unseen motif compositions against Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement, HarnessFix-style scoped repair, nearest-diff retrieval, and a fixed-operator ablation under matched calls, tokens, and traces.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the standalone method claim if generic constrained repair or nearest-diff retrieval matches held-out repair success within the confidence interval, if templates depend on API identifiers, or if no positive transfer appears on unseen motif compositions.
unknowns: Whether a public workflow graph extractor provides canonical graph diffs across the proposed environments.
Whether enough successful-neighbor traces exist for simultaneously API-disjoint and motif-disjoint splits.
Whether a fixed rewrite language can express the required repairs without embedding API-specific constants.

removable_atoms: frozen transfer
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Nearest-neighbor retrieval of successful graph diffs followed by a fixed typed graph-repair rule set
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Failure sensing and persistent updating are coherent, but credit from an individual failure to a reusable template is under-specified. Future evaluation does not distinguish reusable learning from per-instance repair unless all test-time patch generation is prohibited.

real_problem.zh: 按难度或失败率选任务，未必能判断相邻版本是否真的变好。
real_problem.en: Difficulty- or failure-based curricula may not reveal whether adjacent versions truly improve.

composition_logic.zh: 同时估计任务对相邻版本的判别效应和未来有效半衰期，选择能持续区分真实改进而非偶然波动的课程。
composition_logic.en: Jointly estimate adjacent-version discrimination and future utility half-life, selecting tasks that distinguish real improvement from noise over time.

learning_signal.zh: 相邻 Checkpoint 配对结果、版本时间和任务覆盖。
learning_signal.en: Paired adjacent-checkpoint outcomes, version time, and task coverage.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 留出版本上的真实能力趋势与课程收益。
independent_ground_truth.en: True capability trends and curriculum gain on held-out versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 失败率、难度、学习进度、IRT 和随机课程。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure-rate, difficulty, learning-progress, IRT, and random curricula.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少使用两条真实 5–8 轮版本流，用早期轮次学习并冻结到后续轮次。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least two real 5–8-round version streams, learn on early rounds, and freeze for later rounds.

stop_condition.zh: 若只在合成版本流成立，或不优于 learning-progress，则列为评测方向。
stop_condition.en: Keep as evaluation only if it works solely on synthetic streams or fails to beat learning progress.

external_reviews.finding: The problem of distinguishing real checkpoint progress from evaluation noise is important, but the specified persistent object is primarily an adaptive evaluation registry rather than a behavior-changing curriculum. Fluid Benchmarking, Item Response Scaling Laws, and Scales++ already cover efficient discriminative item selection or forecasting across changing model populations and checkpoints. Adjacent-checkpoint information gain can be implemented by paired IRT, and a fixed recency-decay model may replace the survival component. The proposal becomes a learning method only if its selected tasks causally improve subsequent checkpoints under a fixed training budget.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 区分真实检查点进步与评测噪声是重要问题，但当前持久对象主要是自适应评测注册表，而不是能够改变模型行为的课程。Fluid Benchmarking、Item Response Scaling Laws 和 Scales++ 已覆盖面向变化模型或检查点的高效判别样本选择与性能预测。相邻检查点的信息增益可以由配对 IRT 实现，固定的时间衰减模型也可能替代生存模型。只有证明所选任务在固定训练预算下能够因果性地提升后续检查点，该方案才是学习方法而非评测方法。
external_reviews.required_action: Close the training loop by using the frozen selector to allocate the next checkpoint's training examples and demonstrate causal held-out gains over paired IRT, learning-progress selection, fixed recency decay, and random curricula.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 闭合训练环路：用冻结后的选择器分配下一检查点的训练样本，并证明其相对配对 IRT、学习进度选择、固定时间衰减和随机课程能够带来因果性的留出性能提升。

closest_work.title: Fluid Language Model Benchmarking
Item Response Scaling Laws: A Measurement Theory Approach for Efficient and Generalizable Neural Scaling Estimation
Scales++: Compute Efficient Evaluation Subset Selection with Cognitive Scales Embeddings

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Causal use of checkpoint-discrimination and temporal-utility estimates to select training tasks that improve later checkpoints, rather than merely selecting evaluation probes.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Paired IRT discrimination with learning-progress ranking and a fixed exponential half-life
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use two genuine streams containing at least five sequential checkpoints. Fit selectors only on early rounds, then allocate identical numbers of training episodes to the proposed method, paired IRT, learning progress, and random selection before producing each later checkpoint. Evaluate both adjacent-version discrimination and independently held-out next-checkpoint capability.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the curriculum claim if the method improves probe efficiency but does not improve subsequent checkpoint behavior, if paired IRT with fixed decay matches future utility, or if results hold only on synthetic checkpoint streams.
unknowns: Availability of two genuine five-to-eight-round version streams with stable task semantics and task-level outcomes.
Whether selected evaluation tasks can be inserted into subsequent training rounds under controlled budgets.
How true capability trends will be labeled independently of the same probe registry used for selection.

removable_atoms: probe survival model
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Paired IRT item discrimination combined with exponential recency decay and learning-progress task selection
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Sensing and future evaluation are specified, but the update currently changes only the probe registry. There is no closed causal path from task selection to training of the next checkpoint and then to independently measured future behavior.

real_problem.zh: 某个更新修复目标失败却破坏其他能力时，回滚会丢失目标收益，继续提交又会留下回退。
real_problem.en: When an update fixes the target but harms other capabilities, rollback loses the gain while commit preserves regression.

composition_logic.zh: 固定原更新，仅在小型补丁语法中主动搜索最小稳定化补丁；补丁必须恢复回归套件且不抹掉目标收益。
composition_logic.en: Freeze the original update and actively search a small patch grammar for the minimal stabilizer that restores regressions without erasing target gains.

review_ranked_finalists.persistent_update_object: stabilizing patch attached to an update commit

learning_signal.zh: 回归反例、补丁执行结果和目标能力保持。
learning_signal.en: Regression counterexamples, patch outcomes, and target-gain retention.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 独立目标测试与回归测试上的双重恢复。
independent_ground_truth.en: Joint restoration on independent target and regression suites.

strongest_baseline.zh: 完整回滚、重新训练原更新、通用 Prompt 修补、信赖域拒绝。
strongest_baseline.en: Full rollback, retraining the original update, generic prompt repair, and trust-region rejection.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选择 Prompt 或记忆单一更新表面，限制补丁语法和调用预算，在两个任务域测试。
decisive_pilot.en: Use one prompt or memory update surface, bound the patch grammar and call budget, and test in two domains.

stop_condition.zh: 若需要与原更新同规模的重写，或补丁不能跨 seed 保持，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if stabilization requires a rewrite as large as the original update or fails across seeds.

external_reviews.finding: The regression problem is real, but the proposed method is generic constrained optimization rather than an identifiable new learning mechanism. HarnessFix already generates scoped patches with regression-aware validation, ANNEAL commits constrained typed patches with canary testing and rollback, and GEPA or ProTeGi searches prompt edits from failure feedback. Freezing the first update and attaching the smallest accepted second patch does not create a new operator: jointly re-optimizing the original update against target and regression losses under the same grammar, edit budget, and call budget is an equivalent and usually simpler baseline. This should remain a repair component unless the patch becomes a learned update-conditioned inverse operator that transfers across update instances.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 回归问题是真实的，但所提方法本质上是通用受约束优化，而不是可识别的新学习机制。HarnessFix 已生成带回归验证的局部补丁，ANNEAL 已通过金丝雀测试和回滚提交受约束的类型化补丁，GEPA 或 ProTeGi 也会根据失败反馈搜索提示词编辑。冻结第一次更新并附加最小的第二补丁，并不会形成新算子：在相同语法、编辑预算和调用预算下，针对目标收益与回归损失联合重新优化原始更新，是等价且通常更简单的基线。除非补丁被改为能够跨更新实例迁移的、以原更新为条件的逆算子，否则该方案应仅作为修复组件。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace per-instance patch search with a learned update-conditioned inverse or residual operator and demonstrate transfer to unseen update commits against matched joint re-optimization.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将逐实例补丁搜索改为可学习的、以原更新为条件的逆向或残差算子，并在未见过的更新提交上相对预算匹配的联合重优化证明迁移能力。

closest_work.title: From Failed Trajectories to Reliable LLM Agents: Diagnosing and Repairing Harness Flaws
ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning
GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: GEPA or ProTeGi jointly optimizing the original update on a combined target-plus-regression suite with the identical patch grammar, evaluation set, and call budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate prompt or memory commits that improve a target split while degrading an independent regression split. Compare second-order stabilizing patches with joint re-optimization and HarnessFix-style scoped repair under identical candidate, token, edit-distance, and evaluation budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep the idea blocked if joint re-optimization is statistically indistinguishable on joint success and target retention, or if the stabilizing patch is not smaller than the jointly rewritten update across seeds.
unknowns: The patch grammar and its effective capacity are unspecified.
The trust-region distance and acceptance thresholds are undefined.
No mechanism is given for learning across patch episodes rather than restarting search for every update.

removable_atoms: Active counterexample search when a fixed matched regression suite supplies equivalent failures.
Trust-region acceptance as a separate atom; it can be implemented as ordinary multi-objective constraints or validation thresholds.
The small patch grammar as a distinct mechanism; it is equivalent to the edit space used by a constrained prompt or memory optimizer.
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Jointly re-optimize the original prompt or memory update on target and regression objectives under the same edit grammar, candidate count, and model-call budget.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The engineering loop is operationally closed because regressions generate candidates and joint suites gate commit, but no distinctive credit or update operator separates it from standard constrained re-optimization.

real_problem.zh: 同一条自然语言经验在不同基础模型上可能触发不同推理模式，兼容性预测只能发现问题，不能修复。
real_problem.en: The same natural-language memory can trigger different reasoning across backbones; compatibility prediction detects but does not repair the problem.

composition_logic.zh: 把源模型上的经验转换为目标模型专用记忆，同时约束源任务行为锚点、圈外行为锚点和双向翻译一致性；学习对象是记忆变换器而不是兼容性分数。
composition_logic.en: Transform source-model memories into target-model-specific assets while preserving source-task and out-of-loop behavior anchors plus cycle consistency; the learned object is a translator, not a score.

learning_signal.zh: 源／目标模型在锚点任务上的行为差和翻译后效用。
learning_signal.en: Source/target behavior gaps on anchor tasks and utility after translation.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 目标模型上的持久成功、负迁移和锚点保持。
independent_ground_truth.en: Persistent success, negative transfer, and anchor preservation on target models.

strongest_baseline.zh: 直接复制、目标模型重写、PromptBridge、MASA 和语义改写。
strongest_baseline.en: Direct copy, target-model rewriting, PromptBridge, MASA, and semantic rewriting.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三个开放模型家族、两类任务和 60–100 条经验，留出目标模型家族与经验类别。
decisive_pilot.en: Use three open model families, two domains, and 60–100 memories with held-out target families and memory categories.

stop_condition.zh: 若变换器不能优于目标模型直接重写，或锚点保持以牺牲任务效用为代价，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the translator does not beat direct target-model rewriting or preserves anchors only by sacrificing utility.

external_reviews.finding: The model-swap problem is real and the translator is a persistent object, but the stated method is not yet distinguishable from cross-model prompt transfer. PromptBridge already learns a mapping from source-model prompts to target-model prompts using calibrated source-target pairs and evaluates transfer to unseen tasks. Because the proposed memories are natural-language assets, renaming prompts as memories, adding generic behavior anchors, and imposing cycle consistency does not establish a new learning operator. Equal-budget target-model rewriting or PromptBridge can plausibly reproduce the claimed behavior.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 模型切换导致资产失效是真实问题，翻译器也是持久化对象，但当前方法尚无法与跨模型提示迁移区分。PromptBridge 已利用源模型与目标模型的校准提示对学习映射，并在未见任务上迁移。由于这里的记忆仍是自然语言资产，把提示改称记忆、增加通用行为锚点和循环一致性，并不能形成新的学习算子；等预算的目标模型重写或 PromptBridge 很可能复现其效果。
external_reviews.required_action: Redefine the learned object as a composition-aware translator over typed procedural memories, retrieval links, and execution constraints rather than plain text, and require superiority to equal-budget PromptBridge and target-model rewriting on held-out target families.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将学习对象实质性改为面向类型化程序记忆、检索链接和执行约束的组合感知翻译器，而非纯文本映射，并要求其在未见目标模型家族上超过等预算的 PromptBridge 和目标模型直接重写。

closest_work.title: PromptBridge: Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is deployment on persistent agent memories with anchor preservation, but no method-level distinction survives while those memories are represented and translated as ordinary natural-language prompts.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: PromptBridge plus per-memory target-model rewriting using exactly the same target-model calls and anchor tasks
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train on two source-target model-family pairs and typed memory categories, then freeze all methods and evaluate on a held-out target family with matched target calls, memory tokens, and optimization examples; compare direct copy, semantic rewriting, PromptBridge, per-memory target rewriting, and the proposed translator on task utility, negative transfer, and anchor preservation.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Block the translator thesis if PromptBridge or independent target rewriting matches its held-out utility and anchor preservation within the preregistered confidence interval, or if removing cycle consistency does not materially change transfer.
unknowns: Whether a memory contains structure beyond text that PromptBridge cannot represent
How source-target training pairs are obtained without per-target optimization equivalent to the rewriting baseline
Whether anchor tasks are independent of translator training and representative of future memory use
Whether translation to a genuinely unseen target family is possible without target-family calibration

removable_atoms: cycle consistency, because direct target-behavior optimization can train the same source-to-target mapping
canonical behavior anchors as a distinct atom, because they function as ordinary calibration or validation tasks unless tied to structured memory semantics
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: PromptBridge trained on the same source-target behavior pairs, followed by equal-budget target-model rewriting of each memory
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The proposal senses cross-model behavior gaps, updates a translator, and evaluates frozen translations, but it does not close a memory-specific loop beyond existing prompt calibration and transfer.

title.zh: 无模拟器部署的风险程序蒸馏

real_problem.zh: 不可逆动作的反事实后果可由模拟器发现，但部署时持续调用模拟器既昂贵又不算持久学习。
real_problem.en: Simulators can reveal irreversible consequences, but deployment-time simulator calls are expensive and not persistent learning.

composition_logic.zh: 发现阶段用独立转移验证器生成反事实状态替换，把结果编译为带前置条件、例外和弃权的类型化风险程序，冻结后完全关闭模拟器。
composition_logic.en: Use an independent transition verifier during discovery to generate counterfactual substitutions, compile them into typed risk programs with preconditions, exceptions, and abstention, then disable the simulator entirely.

learning_signal.zh: 状态替换、动作后果、程序覆盖与冲突。
learning_signal.en: State substitutions, action consequences, program coverage, and conflicts.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 模拟器关闭后未见状态上的不可逆错误与任务成功。
independent_ground_truth.en: Irreversible errors and task success on unseen states with the simulator disabled.

strongest_baseline.zh: 在线模拟器、自然语言反思、AutoSpec／AgentSpec 类规则、固定安全 Prompt。
strongest_baseline.en: Online simulator, verbal reflection, AutoSpec/AgentSpec-style rules, and fixed safety prompts.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选择一个精确转移环境，独立生成／接纳／评测验证器，冻结后迁移到第二转移系统。
decisive_pilot.en: Use one exact-transition environment with separate generation/admission/evaluation verifiers, then freeze and transfer to a second transition system.

stop_condition.zh: 若不能脱离模拟器保持收益，或可归约为现有规则归纳，则作为安全基准组件保留。
stop_condition.en: Retain only as a safety benchmark component if gains vanish without the simulator or reduce to existing rule induction.

external_reviews.finding: The deployment problem is real and simulator-off evaluation correctly separates persistent learning from online planning, but the proposed mechanism is already covered by counterexample-guided safety-rule synthesis and runtime specification enforcement. AutoSpec mines false-positive and false-negative counterexamples, induces discriminative predicates, edits symbolic rules, and verifies candidate revisions; AgentSpec provides executable trigger-predicate-enforcement rules for runtime agent safety. Generating the training counterexamples with a simulator and freezing the resulting rule library changes the data source and deployment boundary, not the underlying learning operator.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 部署问题真实存在，而且关闭模拟器后的评测能够正确区分持久学习与在线规划；但所述机制已被反例引导的安全规则合成和运行时规范执行覆盖。AutoSpec 会挖掘假阳性和假阴性反例、归纳区分谓词、修改符号规则并验证候选版本；AgentSpec 则提供可执行的触发器、谓词和执行规则。使用模拟器生成训练反例并冻结规则库，只改变数据来源和部署边界，没有形成新的学习算子。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the rule-library thesis with a formally certified learned transition abstraction or inductive invariant whose soundness, abstention behavior, and compositional transfer cannot be reproduced by AutoSpec, AgentSpec, or a capacity-matched rule learner.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将规则库论文实质性改为具有形式化认证的学习型转移抽象或归纳不变量，并证明其可靠性、弃判行为和组合迁移能力无法被 AutoSpec、AgentSpec 或容量匹配的规则学习器复现。

closest_work.title: AutoSpec: Safety Rule Evolution for LLM Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
AgentSpec: Customizable Runtime Enforcement for Safe and Reliable LLM Agents
Automating the Refinement of Reinforcement Learning Specifications

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Only the use of verified irreversible-action counterfactuals and explicit simulator-off transfer remains, and these are currently data-generation and evaluation choices rather than a standalone method.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: AutoSpec trained on exactly the same verified counterfactual traces and restricted to the same predicate vocabulary, program size, abstention budget, and runtime cost
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate one shared counterfactual trace set from an exact transition environment, train AutoSpec, a decision tree, a lookup-table shield, and the proposed typed synthesizer under the same predicate and program-size budget, disable the simulator, and evaluate unseen states plus transfer to a second transition system.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep the work only as a component or benchmark if AutoSpec or a capacity-matched rule learner matches simulator-off safety and utility, if transfer requires manually remapping most predicates, or if the synthesized programs lack a stronger formal guarantee than empirical rule accuracy.
unknowns: The formal syntax and semantics of the typed risk-program language
Whether the transition verifier is sound and complete over generated substitutions
What synthesis algorithm differs from existing CEGIS or inductive logic programming
