composition_logic.en: Jointly estimate adjacent-version discrimination and future utility half-life, selecting tasks that distinguish real improvement from noise over time.

learning_signal.zh: 相邻 Checkpoint 配对结果、版本时间和任务覆盖。
learning_signal.en: Paired adjacent-checkpoint outcomes, version time, and task coverage.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 留出版本上的真实能力趋势与课程收益。
independent_ground_truth.en: True capability trends and curriculum gain on held-out versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 失败率、难度、学习进度、IRT 和随机课程。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure-rate, difficulty, learning-progress, IRT, and random curricula.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少使用两条真实 5–8 轮版本流，用早期轮次学习并冻结到后续轮次。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least two real 5–8-round version streams, learn on early rounds, and freeze for later rounds.

stop_condition.zh: 若只在合成版本流成立，或不优于 learning-progress，则列为评测方向。
stop_condition.en: Keep as evaluation only if it works solely on synthetic streams or fails to beat learning progress.

external_reviews.finding: The problem of distinguishing real checkpoint progress from evaluation noise is important, but the specified persistent object is primarily an adaptive evaluation registry rather than a behavior-changing curriculum. Fluid Benchmarking, Item Response Scaling Laws, and Scales++ already cover efficient discriminative item selection or forecasting across changing model populations and checkpoints. Adjacent-checkpoint information gain can be implemented by paired IRT, and a fixed recency-decay model may replace the survival component. The proposal becomes a learning method only if its selected tasks causally improve subsequent checkpoints under a fixed training budget.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 区分真实检查点进步与评测噪声是重要问题，但当前持久对象主要是自适应评测注册表，而不是能够改变模型行为的课程。Fluid Benchmarking、Item Response Scaling Laws 和 Scales++ 已覆盖面向变化模型或检查点的高效判别样本选择与性能预测。相邻检查点的信息增益可以由配对 IRT 实现，固定的时间衰减模型也可能替代生存模型。只有证明所选任务在固定训练预算下能够因果性地提升后续检查点，该方案才是学习方法而非评测方法。
external_reviews.required_action: Close the training loop by using the frozen selector to allocate the next checkpoint's training examples and demonstrate causal held-out gains over paired IRT, learning-progress selection, fixed recency decay, and random curricula.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 闭合训练环路：用冻结后的选择器分配下一检查点的训练样本，并证明其相对配对 IRT、学习进度选择、固定时间衰减和随机课程能够带来因果性的留出性能提升。

closest_work.title: Fluid Language Model Benchmarking
Item Response Scaling Laws: A Measurement Theory Approach for Efficient and Generalizable Neural Scaling Estimation
Scales++: Compute Efficient Evaluation Subset Selection with Cognitive Scales Embeddings

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Causal use of checkpoint-discrimination and temporal-utility estimates to select training tasks that improve later checkpoints, rather than merely selecting evaluation probes.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Paired IRT discrimination with learning-progress ranking and a fixed exponential half-life
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use two genuine streams containing at least five sequential checkpoints. Fit selectors only on early rounds, then allocate identical numbers of training episodes to the proposed method, paired IRT, learning progress, and random selection before producing each later checkpoint. Evaluate both adjacent-version discrimination and independently held-out next-checkpoint capability.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the curriculum claim if the method improves probe efficiency but does not improve subsequent checkpoint behavior, if paired IRT with fixed decay matches future utility, or if results hold only on synthetic checkpoint streams.
unknowns: Availability of two genuine five-to-eight-round version streams with stable task semantics and task-level outcomes.
Whether selected evaluation tasks can be inserted into subsequent training rounds under controlled budgets.
How true capability trends will be labeled independently of the same probe registry used for selection.

removable_atoms: probe survival model
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Paired IRT item discrimination combined with exponential recency decay and learning-progress task selection
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Sensing and future evaluation are specified, but the update currently changes only the probe registry. There is no closed causal path from task selection to training of the next checkpoint and then to independently measured future behavior.

title.zh: 单调适用集合专化器 v4

real_problem.zh: 自由文本反例修复会破坏原本正确的经验区域，直接删除又浪费可迁移部分。
real_problem.en: Free-text counterexample repair damages correct regions, while deletion wastes transferable knowledge.

composition_logic.zh: 把经验表示为类型化前置条件格；每个最小反例只允许添加最小约束或例外，更新必须保持未受影响正例。
composition_logic.en: Represent lessons as a typed precondition lattice; each minimal counterexample may add only a minimal constraint or exception while retaining unaffected positives.

all_candidates.persistent_update_object: structured lesson with executable exception lineage

learning_signal.zh: 最小反例、未受影响正例和约束删除轨迹。
learning_signal.en: Minimal counterexamples, unaffected positives, and constraint-deletion traces.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 规则适用真值、正例保持率和未见状态错误调用。
independent_ground_truth.en: Applicability ground truth, positive retention, and misuse on unseen states.

strongest_baseline.zh: SkillTracer、SkillAdaptor、自由文本重写、全部删除和 Assay 类选择。
strongest_baseline.en: SkillTracer, SkillAdaptor, free-text rewriting, full deletion, and Assay-style selection.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在规则可执行工具环境中冻结类型语言，比较最小编辑数、错误调用和正例保持。
decisive_pilot.en: Freeze the typed language in an executable-rule environment and compare edit size, misuse, and positive retention.

stop_condition.zh: 若类型语言需按任务人工设计，或与 SkillAdaptor 等价，则作为可解释组件保留。
stop_condition.en: Retain as an interpretable component if the type language is task-specific or equivalent to SkillAdaptor.

revival_condition.zh: 必须冻结可执行类型语言，并证明单调专化比自由修复更好保持正例。
revival_condition.en: Revives only with a frozen executable type language and evidence that monotone specialization preserves unaffected positives better than free repair.

external_reviews.finding: The revived proposal materially changes the learned object from free-text repair into monotone specialization of an executable applicability set. The frozen precondition lattice defines the legal hypothesis space, minimal counterexamples identify the boundary to exclude, and the positive-retention constraint prevents collateral deletion of valid regions. SkillAdaptor and SkillTracer perform localized skill repair, while GraSP uses typed preconditions and local graph operators, but none directly establishes minimal monotone narrowing of one persistent lesson with executable exception lineage and guaranteed retention testing. This is a defensible standalone operator if it outperforms generic symbolic rule learning under the same vocabulary and complexity budget.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该复活方案将学习对象从自由文本修复实质性地改为可执行适用集合的单调特化。冻结的前置条件格定义合法假设空间，最小反例确定需要排除的边界，正例保持约束则防止误删原本正确的区域。SkillAdaptor 和 SkillTracer 执行局部技能修复，GraSP 采用类型化前置条件和局部图算子，但它们均未直接实现带可执行异常谱系、经过保持性验证的单一持久规则最小单调收缩。若该算子在相同谓词词表和复杂度预算下优于通用符号规则学习，则可形成独立论文贡献。
external_reviews.required_action: Freeze the executable predicate language before observing counterexamples and show that monotone specialization dominates capacity-matched ILP, decision-tree, and SkillAdaptor variants on the misuse-retention-rule-complexity Pareto frontier.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 在观察反例前冻结可执行谓词语言，并证明单调特化在误用率、正例保持率和规则复杂度的帕累托前沿上优于容量匹配的 ILP、决策树及 SkillAdaptor 变体。

closest_work.title: SkillAdaptor: Self-Adapting Skills for LLM Agents from Trajectories
SkillTracer: Structural Failure Attribution and Refinement of Agentic Skills in Long-Horizon Web Tasks
GraSP: Graph-Structured Skill Compositions for LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Minimal monotone specialization of one persistent applicability set in a frozen executable hypothesis language, with explicit exception lineage and preservation tests for every unaffected positive region.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: SkillAdaptor constrained to the same predicate vocabulary together with a capacity-matched ILP rule learner
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: In an executable-rule environment, freeze one typed predicate language, stream minimal counterexamples, and compare against ILP, decision trees, free-text repair, deletion, and SkillAdaptor using the same evidence and rule-complexity budget. Measure false applicability, retained-positive accuracy, edit size, and performance on unseen states and counterexample orders.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the standalone claim if a generic rule learner or same-vocabulary SkillAdaptor matches the misuse-retention-edit-size frontier, if new domains require adding predicates after seeing test failures, or if purportedly minimal edits do not alter frozen execution behavior.
unknowns: No cross-domain frozen predicate language with complete applicability ground truth is identified.
It is unclear whether minimal counterexamples can be generated without an oracle.
Equivalence to SkillAdaptor constrained to the same executable vocabulary has not been tested.

combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: A capacity-matched ILP or decision-tree rule learner over the identical typed predicates with post-hoc positive-retention validation
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The loop is coherent: executable predicates sense applicability, minimal counterexamples identify erroneous regions, constrained edits persistently narrow the lesson, retained positives control regressions, and unseen-state execution measures future misuse and coverage.

real_problem.zh: 纠错信用只能解释哪一步有用，却不能把重复纠错模式压缩成可迁移技能。
real_problem.en: Correction credit explains useful steps but does not compress recurring correction patterns into transferable skills.

composition_logic.zh: 把失败定位结果映射到观察、计划、工具和动作槽位，归纳带前置条件和最小动作序列的纠错技能语法。
composition_logic.en: Map localized failures to observation, plan, tool, and action slots, then induce correction-skill grammars with preconditions and minimal action sequences.

learning_signal.zh: 模块替换干预、动作必要性和未来复用结果。
learning_signal.en: Module-replacement interventions, action necessity, and future reuse outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见失败组合上的技能调用正确率和任务恢复率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Skill-invocation precision and task recovery on unseen failure compositions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 整轨迹反思、技能摘要、成功轨迹 SFT 和模块级反思。
strongest_baseline.en: Whole-trajectory reflection, skill summarization, success-trace SFT, and module-level reflection.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在两类工具任务上训练三种失败组合，留出新的错误组合和第二模型。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three failure compositions across two tool domains and hold out new combinations and a second model.

stop_condition.zh: 若语法不能比自然语言技能更好迁移，或需要人工槽位标签，则返回 repair。
stop_condition.en: Return to repair if the grammar does not transfer better than natural-language skills or needs manual slot labels.

revival_condition.zh: 必须把纠错信用转化为可执行、可复用的持久技能语法。
revival_condition.en: Revives only by converting correction credit into executable reusable persistent skill grammar.

external_reviews.finding: Converting correction credit into a persistent executable grammar is a material revival, but the proposed combination is heavily bordered by existing work. ASI and NSI already induce reusable programmatic or logic-grounded skills, SkillGen verifies skill effects through controlled with-skill versus without-skill interventions, and REFLECT uses controlled replay to validate error attribution. Typed failure slots may reduce to manual labels, while a nearest retrieved repair program may reproduce the claimed recovery without grammar induction. The surviving thesis requires evidence that learned productions recombine on unseen failure compositions rather than storing one repair per observed trace.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 将纠错信用转化为持久的可执行语法属于实质性复活，但该组合与已有工作高度接近。ASI 和 NSI 已归纳可复用的程序化或逻辑化技能，SkillGen 通过有技能与无技能的受控干预验证技能效果，REFLECT 则通过受控重放验证错误归因。类型化失败槽可能退化为人工标签，最近邻修复程序检索也可能在无需语法归纳的情况下复现恢复效果。剩余的独立命题必须证明语法产生式能够在未见失败组合上重新组合，而不是为每条训练轨迹存储一个修复。
external_reviews.required_action: Demonstrate automatically induced failure slots and grammar-level compositional generalization against ASI, NSI, flat skill induction, and intervention-verified nearest-repair retrieval under identical trajectories and inference budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 在相同轨迹数据和推理预算下，与 ASI、NSI、扁平技能归纳及经干预验证的最近修复检索比较，证明失败槽能够自动归纳且语法具有组合泛化能力。

closest_work.title: Lifting Traces to Logic: Programmatic Skill Induction with Neuro-Symbolic Learning for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
SkillGen: Verified Inference-Time Agent Skill Synthesis
REFLECT: Intervention-Supported Error Attribution for Silent Failures in LLM Agent Traces

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A correction-specific grammar whose productions are credited to necessary actions and systematically recombine across unseen failure compositions, tool domains, and backbone models.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: NSI or ASI program induction combined with intervention-verified nearest-repair retrieval
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train on primitive correction types and only a strict subset of their pairwise compositions across two tool domains. Test held-out compositions and a second frozen model under matched traces, calls, and executable-skill capacity, comparing the full method with ASI, NSI, nearest-repair retrieval, flat natural-language skills, and an ablation without action-necessity interventions.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the grammar claim if it does not outperform retrieval or flat programmatic skills on unseen compositions, if failure slots require manual annotation, or if the number of productions grows approximately one-for-one with training traces.
unknowns: No independent automatic ground truth is specified for observation, plan, tool, and action failure slots.
It is unclear whether module-replacement interventions are executable and semantically comparable across both proposed domains and the second model.
The proposed environments may not provide unique or verifiably minimal correction-action sequences.

removable_atoms: typed failure slots
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Intervention-verified nearest repair-program retrieval using ASI- or NSI-style program induction without grammar productions
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Controlled replacements provide a plausible sensing and credit path, and the grammar is an exact persistent update. However, slot identifiability and production-level credit are unresolved, so future recovery may be attributable to case retrieval rather than grammar composition.

title.zh: 工作流分支责任重写器

real_problem.zh: 工作流失败可能由多个分支交互造成，单纯归因或删除分支不能保留有效路径。
real_problem.en: Workflow failures may arise from branch interactions, and attribution or deletion alone cannot preserve useful paths.

composition_logic.zh: 用分支启用／禁用和替换干预估计责任与交互，再学习最小控制流重写，使责任分支被条件化而非直接删除。
composition_logic.en: Estimate branch responsibility and interactions with enable/disable and replacement interventions, then learn minimal control-flow rewrites that condition rather than delete responsible branches.

learning_signal.zh: 分支干预、交互结果和独立任务成功。
learning_signal.en: Branch interventions, interaction outcomes, and independent task success.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见图模式上的修复成功与有效分支保持。
independent_ground_truth.en: Repair success and useful-branch retention on unseen graph motifs.

strongest_baseline.zh: Shapley 分支信用、直接删除、Delta Debugging、AFlow 和人工图修复。
strongest_baseline.en: Shapley branch credit, direct deletion, delta debugging, AFlow, and manual graph repair.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在带可执行分支的工具环境中注入单点与交互故障，比较保留分支数和圈外成功。
decisive_pilot.en: Inject single and interacting faults in executable workflows and compare retained branches and out-of-loop success.

stop_condition.zh: 若重写不能优于最小分支删除，或责任标签依赖同一模型自评，则返回 component。
stop_condition.en: Return to component if rewriting does not beat minimal branch deletion or responsibility labels rely on self-evaluation.

revival_condition.zh: 必须从归因子系统升级为真实改变控制流的持久重写算子。
revival_condition.en: Revives only by becoming a persistent control-flow rewrite operator rather than an attribution subsystem.

real_problem.zh: 资产兼容证书只能预测模型替换风险，不能把 Prompt、记忆或工作流变成目标模型可用形式。
real_problem.en: Asset compatibility certificates predict model-swap risk but do not transform prompts, memories, or workflows for the target model.

composition_logic.zh: 先选择一种资产类别，学习规范中间表示和目标模型编译器；用源／目标行为锚点约束变换，而不是统一做兼容评分。
composition_logic.en: Choose one asset class, learn a canonical intermediate representation and target-model compiler, and constrain transformation with source/target behavior anchors rather than a universal score.

learning_signal.zh: 源资产、目标模型行为、锚点任务和编译后效用。
learning_signal.en: Source assets, target-model behavior, anchor tasks, and compiled utility.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 留出模型家族上的持久任务成功与锚点保持。
independent_ground_truth.en: Persistent task success and anchor preservation on held-out model families.

strongest_baseline.zh: 直接复制、目标模型重写、PromptBridge、MASA、SkCC 和语义翻译。
strongest_baseline.en: Direct copy, target rewriting, PromptBridge, MASA, SkCC, and semantic translation.

decisive_pilot.zh: 先做记忆或工作流单一资产类别，三模型家族训练、第四家族留出。
decisive_pilot.en: Start with one memory or workflow asset class, train on three model families, and hold out a fourth.

stop_condition.zh: 若不能优于目标模型直接重写，或 IR 无法表达恢复行为，则返回 component。
stop_condition.en: Return to component if it does not beat direct target rewriting or the IR cannot express recovery behavior.

revival_condition.zh: 必须从兼容性预测改为实际变换一种资产，并冻结到未见模型家族。
revival_condition.en: Revives only by replacing prediction with an actual transformation operator for one asset class, frozen to unseen model families.

title.zh: 干预认证的 Reward 修复

real_problem.zh: Reward 审计能发现捷径或漂移，但不会生成更可靠的持久评价器。
real_problem.en: Reward audits reveal shortcuts or drift but do not create a more reliable persistent evaluator.

composition_logic.zh: 用独立认证的因果与中性干预定位 Rubric 原子，再训练小型修正头或最小 Rubric 编辑，同时限制中性维度和外部锚点上的变化。
composition_logic.en: Use independently certified causal and neutral interventions to localize rubric atoms, then train a small corrector or minimal rubric edit under neutral-dimension and external-anchor constraints.

all_candidates.persistent_update_object: versioned reward rubric plus correction head

learning_signal.zh: 干预对、Rubric 激活、外部锚点和下游候选结果。
learning_signal.en: Intervention pairs, rubric activation, external anchors, and downstream candidate outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 冻结下游策略选择与中性维度保持。
independent_ground_truth.en: Frozen downstream policy selection and neutral-dimension preservation.

strongest_baseline.zh: CROME、PRISM、普通 Pairwise Fine-tuning、冻结 Reward 和只做审计。
strongest_baseline.en: CROME, PRISM, ordinary pairwise fine-tuning, frozen reward, and audit-only baselines.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在程序可验证环境中比较修正头、Rubric 编辑和完整微调，匹配数据与计算。
decisive_pilot.en: Compare a corrector, rubric edits, and full fine-tuning in a verifier-rich environment with matched data and compute.

stop_condition.zh: 若只提高干预集而不提高冻结下游选择，或同一验证器闭环监督，则返回 repair。
stop_condition.en: Return to repair if gains are limited to the intervention set or supervision closes through the same verifier.

revival_condition.zh: 必须从审计转为明确的 Reward/Rubric 持久更新，并用独立下游选择验证。
revival_condition.en: Revives only by becoming an explicit persistent reward/rubric update validated through independent downstream selection.

real_problem.zh: 最小回滚只能修复当前版本，未来出现相似更新组合时仍会重复回退。
real_problem.en: Minimal rollback repairs the current version but does not prevent similar future update compositions from regressing again.

composition_logic.zh: 在固定类型化更新描述符语言中，从带噪回滚干预归纳 no-good、兼容和前置子句，并给子句附带置信度、过期条件和误阻断预算。
composition_logic.en: Induce no-good, compatibility, and prerequisite clauses from noisy rollback interventions in a fixed typed descriptor language, with confidence, expiry, and false-block budgets.

learning_signal.zh: 更新组合干预、恢复结果、描述符和误阻断反馈。
learning_signal.en: Update-composition interventions, restoration outcomes, descriptors, and false-block feedback.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新组合上的回退预防与误阻断率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Regression prevention and false-block rate on unseen update compositions.

strongest_baseline.zh: ProbDD/PMA、直接风险门控和 ANNEAL/SKILL.nb 类符号补丁。
strongest_baseline.en: ProbDD/PMA, direct risk gating, and ANNEAL/SKILL.nb-style symbolic patches.

decisive_pilot.zh: 冻结描述符语言，在合成与真实版本历史中比较子句泛化、误阻断和保留收益。
decisive_pilot.en: Freeze the descriptor language and compare clause generalization, false blocks, and retained gains on synthetic and real histories.

stop_condition.zh: 若子句不能优于同一干预历史训练的直接风险门控，或语言需按任务人工重写，则返回 repair。
stop_condition.en: Return to repair if clauses do not beat a direct risk gate trained on the same interventions or require task-specific language redesign.

revival_condition.zh: 必须把学习对象从一次性故障集合改成可泛化的持久兼容子句，并冻结类型语言。
revival_condition.en: Revives only by changing the learned object from a one-off fault set to generalizable persistent compatibility clauses in a frozen typed language.

title.zh: 迁移校准的经验专化器

real_problem.zh: 经验在源任务上有效，但在未见任务族中可能只适用于部分状态；单纯证书只能弃权。
real_problem.en: A lesson may help on its source task yet apply only to a subset of states in unseen task families; a certificate can only abstain.

composition_logic.zh: 学习跨任务稳定支持集合，并在不确定区域自动收缩经验前置条件；输出被专化的持久经验，而不是迁移分数。
composition_logic.en: Learn cross-task stable support sets and shrink lesson preconditions in uncertain regions, producing a specialized persistent lesson rather than a transfer score.

all_candidates.persistent_update_object: specialized lesson with calibrated support set

learning_signal.zh: 多任务 matched replay、状态约束特征和任务族级校准残差。
learning_signal.en: Multi-task matched replay, state-constraint features, and family-level calibration residuals.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 留出任务族上的效应符号、覆盖与错误调用率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Effect sign, coverage, and misuse on held-out task families.

strongest_baseline.zh: Conformal R-learner、语义相似度、源任务准入、SkillCAT 和固定边界。
strongest_baseline.en: Conformal R-learner, semantic similarity, source admission, SkillCAT, and fixed boundaries.

decisive_pilot.zh: 用足够多任务族做分层校准，冻结后在第二模型和新任务族上评测专化经验。
decisive_pilot.en: Use enough task families for hierarchical calibration, then freeze and evaluate specialized lessons on a second model and unseen families.

stop_condition.zh: 若只靠覆盖率坍缩降低错误，或不优于带弃权的效应预测器，则返回 component。
stop_condition.en: Return to component if error falls only through coverage collapse or it fails to beat an abstaining effect predictor.

revival_condition.zh: 必须从预测效应升级为真正改变经验适用集合的持久专化算子。
revival_condition.en: Revives only by changing from effect prediction to a persistent specialization operator that edits the lesson's applicability set.

title.zh: 随机检索介导的记忆策略

real_problem.zh: 记忆动作会经过未来检索暴露和条目间干扰产生延迟影响，标准上下文 Bandit 忽略这一结构。
real_problem.en: Memory actions act through future retrieval exposure and entry interference, which standard contextual bandits ignore.

composition_logic.zh: 分别随机化记忆动作与未来检索暴露，显式建模条目干扰和延迟中介，再学习写入、摘要、隔离和删除策略。
composition_logic.en: Randomize memory actions and future retrieval exposure separately, model entry interference and delayed mediation, then learn write, summarize, quarantine, and delete policies.

learning_signal.zh: 动作随机化、检索随机化、共同检索集合和未来结果。
learning_signal.en: Action randomization, retrieval randomization, co-retrieval sets, and future outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 独立环境奖励下的动作特异总效应与介导效应。
independent_ground_truth.en: Action-specific total and mediated effects under independent rewards.

strongest_baseline.zh: 标准 Doubly-Robust Bandit、A-MAC 和无干扰记忆控制。
strongest_baseline.en: Standard doubly robust bandits, A-MAC, and no-interference memory control.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在小型记忆池中控制条目数量和共同检索，比较干扰感知策略与标准 Bandit。
decisive_pilot.en: Control pool size and co-retrieval in a small memory bank and compare against standard bandits.

stop_condition.zh: 若显式中介与干扰项不能改善圈外决策，或随机化成本过高，则保留为因果分析。
stop_condition.en: Retain as causal analysis if mediation/interference does not improve out-of-loop decisions or randomization cost is prohibitive.

revival_condition.zh: 必须引入记忆特有的检索中介与条目干扰，并证明相同日志上的标准 Bandit 不能复现。
revival_condition.en: Revives only with memory-specific retrieval mediation and entry interference that standard bandits on the same logs cannot reproduce.

real_problem.zh: 两个轨迹结果相同但过程风险不同，若只按成功结果写入经验，会把危险或脆弱过程固化。
real_problem.en: Trajectories can share outcomes but differ in process risk; outcome-only admission can persist dangerous or brittle behavior.

composition_logic.zh: 对观察、工具或动作进行独立过程干预，学习哪些过程差异会改变未来复用风险，并据此写入、摘要或隔离经验。
composition_logic.en: Apply independent process interventions to observations, tools, or actions, learn which process differences change future reuse risk, and use them for write, summarize, or quarantine decisions.

learning_signal.zh: 过程干预、相同终点配对和未来复用结果。
learning_signal.en: Process interventions, outcome-matched trajectory pairs, and future reuse outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未来任务上的过程违规、成功和负迁移。
independent_ground_truth.en: Process violations, success, and negative transfer on future tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 结果准入、轨迹相似度、因果经验准入和过程分类器。
strongest_baseline.en: Outcome admission, trajectory similarity, causal admission, and process classifiers.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在一个 verifier-rich 环境中构造结果相同但过程不同的轨迹，冻结准入器跨任务评测。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct outcome-equivalent but process-distinct trajectories in one verifier-rich environment and freeze the admission model across tasks.

stop_condition.zh: 若过程干预不能预测未来复用风险，或只是安全分类器，则降级为评测方向。
stop_condition.en: Demote to evaluation if process interventions do not predict future reuse risk or reduce to a safety classifier.

title.zh: 更新差分条件化的回归测试生成

real_problem.zh: 固定回归集与普通自适应选题不能针对本次更新中新引入的语义边界。
real_problem.en: Fixed regression suites and generic adaptive testing do not target semantic boundaries introduced by the current update.

composition_logic.zh: 从 Prompt、记忆、技能或工作流 diff 提取受影响约束，检索历史边界 Probe，并生成语义保持和语义改变的 matched 测试对。
composition_logic.en: Parse affected constraints from prompt, memory, skill, or workflow diffs, retrieve historical boundary probes, and generate matched semantics-preserving and semantics-changing test pairs.

learning_signal.zh: 更新 diff、历史回退、Probe 谱系和独立执行结果。
learning_signal.en: Update diffs, historical regressions, probe lineage, and independent execution outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 当前更新导致的回退召回和误报。
independent_ground_truth.en: Recall and false positives for regressions caused by the current update.

strongest_baseline.zh: 随机子集、IRT、AutoJudger、固定小回归集和 LLM 直接出题。
strongest_baseline.en: Random subsets, IRT, AutoJudger, fixed suites, and direct LLM test generation.

decisive_pilot.zh: 注入三类更新回退，固定生成与执行预算，比较未见更新类型上的召回。
decisive_pilot.en: Inject three update-regression types under fixed generation and execution budgets and test recall on a held-out update type.

stop_condition.zh: 若测试收益仅来自更多题目，或无法在留出更新类型上泛化，则保留为测试工具。
stop_condition.en: Retain as a testing tool if gains come only from more items or fail to generalize to held-out update types.

title.zh: 预算化进化锦标赛控制器

real_problem.zh: 进化系统常在单一候选序列上继续、提交或停止，容易早收敛且无法维持方法多样性。
real_problem.en: Evolution systems often continue, commit, or stop on one candidate sequence, causing premature convergence and poor method diversity.

composition_logic.zh: 维护多个持久更新分支，以成对锦标赛和邻近图分配探索预算；决策控制器在继续、提交、合并和停止之间分配固定调用。
composition_logic.en: Maintain multiple persistent-update branches, allocate exploration through pairwise tournaments and proximity graphs, and budget continue, commit, merge, or stop decisions.

learning_signal.zh: 成对比较、分支距离、部分实验结果和成本。
learning_signal.en: Pairwise comparisons, branch distance, partial experiment results, and cost.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 固定总预算下的最终最优分支、覆盖多样性和回退。
independent_ground_truth.en: Best final branch, diversity coverage, and regression under a fixed total budget.

strongest_baseline.zh: 单轨 Bandit、固定轮数、标准 Successive Halving 和随机分配。
strongest_baseline.en: Single-track bandits, fixed rounds, standard successive halving, and random allocation.

decisive_pilot.zh: 先在离线可重放候选池中比较预算分配，再考虑在线 Agent 更新。
decisive_pilot.en: First compare budget allocation in an offline replayable candidate pool before online agent updates.

stop_condition.zh: 若锦标赛只改善选择效率而不产生更好持久更新，则作为搜索基础设施保留。
stop_condition.en: Retain as search infrastructure if tournaments improve selection efficiency but not persistent updates.

real_problem.zh: 课程更新会逐渐偏离核心能力边界，但仅检测漂移不会恢复覆盖。
real_problem.en: Curriculum updates can drift away from core capability boundaries, while detection alone does not restore coverage.

composition_logic.zh: 维护能力轴覆盖债务；当某轴判别力下降时，从历史边界任务生成新的反例课程，并在固定预算下恢复覆盖。
composition_logic.en: Track coverage debt across capability axes; when discrimination decays, regenerate counterexample curricula from historical boundary tasks under a fixed budget.

learning_signal.zh: 能力轴覆盖、相邻版本判别和课程命中历史。
learning_signal.en: Capability-axis coverage, adjacent-version discrimination, and curriculum hit history.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 留出版本上的边界覆盖和最坏能力回退。
independent_ground_truth.en: Boundary coverage and worst capability regression on held-out versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定课程、失败率采样、learning progress 和随机补题。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed curricula, failure-rate sampling, learning progress, and random replenishment.

decisive_pilot.zh: 先用现有多轮版本日志验证覆盖债务是否预测回退，再决定是否开发控制器。
decisive_pilot.en: First test whether coverage debt predicts regressions on existing multi-round logs before building the controller.

stop_condition.zh: 若覆盖债务不能预测回退，或生成任务只重复旧题，则作为评测指标保留。
stop_condition.en: Retain as an evaluation metric if coverage debt does not predict regressions or generated tasks only repeat old items.

title.zh: 矛盾触发的经验分裂器

real_problem.zh: 压缩记忆中的矛盾如果只被保留为文本，未来检索时仍可能混在一起触发错误。
real_problem.en: Contradictions preserved only as text may still be retrieved together and cause errors.

composition_logic.zh: 检测会改变结论的矛盾后，把一个经验分裂成带不同适用条件的多个子经验，并保存共同父节点与互斥检索约束。
composition_logic.en: When a conclusion-changing contradiction appears, split one lesson into condition-specific children with a shared parent and mutually exclusive retrieval constraints.

learning_signal.zh: 矛盾对、状态条件、未来检索和任务结果。
learning_signal.en: Contradiction pairs, state conditions, future retrievals, and task outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见状态上的正确分支选择与存储开销。
independent_ground_truth.en: Correct branch selection and storage cost on unseen states.

strongest_baseline.zh: 保留全部矛盾、摘要、聚类和简单条件路由。
strongest_baseline.en: Preserve-all contradiction memory, summarization, clustering, and simple conditional routing.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在可验证条件任务中构造结论翻转矛盾，比较分裂、保留和摘要。
decisive_pilot.en: Create conclusion-flipping contradictions in verifiable conditional tasks and compare splitting, preserving, and summarizing.

stop_condition.zh: 若分裂只增加存储，或条件路由与简单聚类等价，则作为记忆组件。
stop_condition.en: Keep as a memory component if splitting only increases storage or reduces to simple clustering.

real_problem.zh: 同一失败可能需要 Prompt、记忆和工作流的组合修复，固定路由一个表面会留下残余错误。
real_problem.en: One failure may require a combination of prompt, memory, and workflow repairs; routing to one surface can leave residual errors.

composition_logic.zh: 在受限 DSL 中合成跨表面的最小修复程序，每个编辑原子都必须通过模块级反事实和组合回归验证。
composition_logic.en: Synthesize minimal cross-surface repair programs in a bounded DSL, requiring module-level counterfactual and composition regression validation for every edit atom.

learning_signal.zh: 模块级替换、组合执行和独立回归结果。
learning_signal.en: Module replacements, composed execution, and independent regression outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 圈外任务上的完整修复与编辑成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Complete repair and edit cost on out-of-loop tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 单表面路由、穷举组合、人工修复和通用程序合成。
strongest_baseline.en: Single-surface routing, exhaustive combinations, manual repair, and generic program synthesis.

decisive_pilot.zh: 先在三个表面、最多两步修复的合成故障上验证，不直接作为主论文。
decisive_pilot.en: First validate on synthetic faults with three surfaces and at most two edits; do not treat as a primary paper yet.

stop_condition.zh: 若穷举小组合已经足够，或 DSL 需任务定制，则只作为系统组件。
stop_condition.en: Keep only as a system component if small exhaustive search is sufficient or the DSL is task-specific.

policy.discussion_ready_definition: external PASS under official-source review; prior main-bank and v4 PASS remain counted separately

pattern.zh: 联合真实数据失败模式与文献假设，而不是只从论文空白生成问题。
pattern.en: Union empirical failure evidence with literature hypotheses rather than relying on literature gaps alone.

pattern.zh: 让 Proposer、Critic 与 Judge 对抗，主动寻找可被标准方法替代的弱方案。
pattern.en: Use proposer-critic-judge adversarial debate to expose ideas reducible to standard methods.

pattern.zh: 用可操作性、证据深度和文献支撑等多维 rubric 审查 Idea。
pattern.en: Review ideas with literature-grounded rubrics for actionability, depth, and evidential support.

pattern.zh: 把 Idea 评价建模为知识约束、多视角推理，而不是单一新颖性分数。
pattern.en: Treat idea evaluation as knowledge-grounded multi-perspective reasoning rather than one novelty score.

pattern.zh: 从科学知识图谱的邻域和桥接关系检索机制，不只做标题相似度搜索。
pattern.en: Retrieve mechanism neighborhoods and bridge relations from a scientific knowledge graph.

pattern.zh: 把长程记忆、算法发现和复现实验纳入持续研究循环。
pattern.en: Integrate long-horizon memory, algorithm discovery, and reproduction into the research loop.

pattern.zh: 让不同研究角色自组织并长期运行，避免单一 Agent 的搜索偏置。
pattern.en: Use self-organizing research teams to reduce single-agent search bias over long runs.

pattern.zh: 保留失败实验状态，继续 collider 或显式 pivot，而不是每轮从零生成 Idea。
pattern.en: Reuse failed experiment state through collider continuation or explicit pivot instead of restarting ideation.

pattern.zh: 固定小实验预算，改动后只根据独立指标 keep/revert。
pattern.en: Use fixed-budget micro-experiments and keep/revert decisions under an independent metric.

pattern.zh: 利用新鲜团队、跨团队讨论和不同角色拓扑扩大 Idea 多样性。
pattern.en: Increase idea diversity through fresh teams, inter-team discussion, and role topology.

pattern.zh: 只修 Reviewer 低分维度并保留历史。
pattern.en: Repair low-scoring reviewer dimensions while preserving history.

pattern.zh: 保留多个方法与实验分支，用实验经理做渐进式树搜索。
pattern.en: Preserve multiple method and experiment branches with progressive agentic tree search.

pattern.zh: 冻结评测 Harness 和预算，避免 Idea 通过改变测试方式获得优势。
pattern.en: Freeze the evaluation harness and budget so ideas cannot win by changing evaluation.

output.zh: 失败日志、实验结果、论文局限和 Reviewer objection 被归一为同一个 problem capsule。
output.en: Normalize failure logs, experiment outcomes, paper limitations, and reviewer objections into one problem capsule.

output.zh: 从文献图谱、跨领域方法和已有代码中检索可迁移机制。
output.en: Retrieve transportable mechanisms from literature graphs, adjacent domains, and existing code.

output.zh: 独立 proposer 团队分别生成机制、监督、更新表面和实验分支。
output.en: Independent proposer teams generate mechanism, supervision, update-surface, and experiment branches.

output.zh: Critic 必须提出更简单的容量匹配替代方案；若能复现则候选降级。
output.en: Critics must propose simpler capacity-matched alternatives; reproducible ideas are demoted.

output.zh: 允许合理组合，但要求每个组件对应独立失败路径且删除后性能下降。
output.en: Allow combinations only when each component closes a distinct failure path and deletion degrades performance.

output.zh: 旧 REVISE/BLOCK 在关键假设、学习对象或监督闭环变化后重新进入。
output.en: Revive prior REVISE/BLOCK branches after material changes to assumptions, learned objects, or supervision.

output.zh: 优先设计 1–6 小时现象实验，结果可直接改变 Idea 排名与分支。
output.en: Use 1–6 hour phenomenon tests whose results directly change ranking and branching.

output.zh: 分别审查真实问题、机制必要性、独立监督、泛化、成本和论文叙事。
output.en: Separately review problem reality, mechanism necessity, independent supervision, transfer, cost, and thesis clarity.

output.zh: REVISE 生成定向 child；BLOCK 保留为组件或复活源，不永久删除。
output.en: Generate targeted children from REVISE; retain BLOCK as components or revival sources rather than deleting them.

problem.zh: 同一工具能力在不同 API 中返回不同错误语义，迁移后旧恢复策略会静默失效。
problem.en: Equivalent tool capabilities expose different error semantics across APIs, silently breaking recovery policies after migration.

exact_mechanism.zh: 学习跨 API 的错误语义中间表示，将 provider-specific 错误映射为规范恢复状态，并编译目标 API 修复动作。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn an API-invariant error-semantics representation, map provider-specific failures into canonical recovery states, and compile target-API repair actions.

learning_signal.zh: 等价工具的错误轨迹、恢复动作和最终环境结果。
learning_signal.en: Error traces, recovery actions, and final outcomes for semantically equivalent tools.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见 API 家族上的恢复成功率和错误分类一致性。
independent_ground_truth.en: Recovery success and error-class consistency on an unseen API family.

strongest_baseline.zh: 直接 LLM 重写、API-Semantic Workflow Compiler、错误文本检索、人工映射。
strongest_baseline.en: Direct LLM rewrite, API-Semantic Workflow Compiler, error-text retrieval, and manual mapping.

decisive_pilot.zh: 完整留出一个 API 家族，冻结语义表示后迁移恢复策略。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out an entire API family and freeze the semantic representation before transferring recovery policies.

stop_condition.zh: 不能跨 API 家族迁移，或错误文本最近邻同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it cannot transfer across API families or nearest error-text retrieval is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 错误状态归一化解决迁移语义差异，修复编译把规范状态转成目标动作。
necessity_logic.en: Error-state normalization resolves semantic drift and repair compilation converts canonical states to target actions.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real, the adapter is a genuinely persistent learned object, and the held-out-API-family boundary makes the mechanism identifiable. PALADIN already trains transferable tool-failure recovery and reports generalization to unseen tool APIs, while Self-Reflective APIs and Agent-First Tool API normalize or enrich error semantics, but none of the located work learns an explicitly provider-invariant error-state representation from semantically equivalent APIs and then decodes that state into provider-specific repair actions. The thesis survives only if this canonical latent beats a much simpler discrete error-taxonomy classifier plus provider-specific repair templates under the same recovery data and inference budget.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实，适配器属于冻结后仍会改变未来行为的持久学习对象，而且整族 API 留出的测试边界使机制具有可识别性。PALADIN 已经学习工具故障恢复并测试未见 API，Self-Reflective APIs 和 Agent-First Tool API 也分别结构化或规范化错误语义，但本次检索未发现已有工作从语义等价 API 中学习显式的 provider-invariant 错误状态表示，再将该状态解码成目标 API 的专用修复动作。因此该方向仍有独立论文空间；但必须证明连续/学习式 canonical latent 不能被更简单的离散错误 taxonomy 加 provider-specific repair template 替代。
external_reviews.required_action: Keep the invariant error state as the central learned object and add a matched-budget canonical-taxonomy-plus-template baseline in addition to PALADIN and nearest-error retrieval. Train the representation only on source API families, freeze it before target-family evaluation, and prevent target API documentation, error strings, or repair traces from leaking into representation learning.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 保持“跨 API 不变错误状态”作为核心学习对象，并在 PALADIN、最近错误检索之外加入严格等预算的“离散 canonical taxonomy 分类器 + provider-specific 修复模板”基线。表示只能在源 API 家族上训练，并在目标家族测试前冻结；目标 API 的文档、错误文本或修复轨迹不得泄漏进表示学习。

closest_work.title: PALADIN: Self-Correcting Language Model Agents to Cure Tool-Failure Cases
Self-Reflective APIs: Structure Beats Verbosity for AI Agent Recovery
Agent-First Tool API: A Semantic Interface Paradigm for Enterprise AI Agent Systems

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving boundary is representation-level cross-provider canonicalization learned from equivalent failures, followed by provider-specific repair decoding, rather than generic failure-recovery training, exemplar retrieval, or provider-authored structured errors.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: PALADIN-style failure-trained recovery plus nearest-error retrieval, and a fixed canonical error classifier with provider-specific repair templates, all trained on the identical source traces and evaluated with identical recovery-call and token budgets.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct at least three semantically overlapping API families, train on two and hold one family out completely. Freeze the error representation and compare recovery success and canonical-state consistency against PALADIN-style recovery, nearest-error retrieval, and fixed-taxonomy-plus-template repair under identical training examples, calls, retries, and tokens.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the standalone thesis if the fixed-taxonomy-plus-template baseline or PALADIN-style recovery is statistically indistinguishable from the learned invariant adapter on held-out API-family recovery across the preregistered seeds, or if canonical states cannot align equivalent failures without target-family supervision.
unknowns: Whether sufficiently many semantically equivalent failures across independent API providers can be labeled without introducing correspondence leakage.
Whether provider-specific repair decoding remains identifiable when multiple distinct repairs can recover from the same canonical error state.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Classify each raw failure into a fixed canonical error taxonomy, then execute a provider-specific templated repair selected from the same training traces; use exactly the same API calls, recovery attempts, tokens, and training examples.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned cross-provider error representation whose transfer advantage remains after discrete taxonomy classification and retrieval/template baselines are capacity- and budget-matched.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Error-state induction removes provider-specific semantic drift, while repair compilation converts the invariant state back into an executable target-provider recovery action.

PALADIN already trains transferable tool-failure recovery and reports generalization to unseen tool APIs, while Self-Reflective APIs and Agent-First Tool API normalize or enrich error semantics, but none of the located work learns an explicitly provider-invariant error-state representation from semantically equivalent APIs and then decodes that state into provider-specific repair actions. The thesis survives only if this canonical latent beats a much simpler discrete error-taxonomy classifier plus provider-specific repair templates under the same recovery data and inference budget.

Train the representation only on source API families, freeze it before target-family evaluation, and prevent target API documentation, error strings, or repair traces from leaking into representation learning.
discussion_ready.external_required_action_zh: 保持“跨 API 不变错误状态”作为核心学习对象，并在 PALADIN、最近错误检索之外加入严格等预算的“离散 canonical taxonomy 分类器 + provider-specific 修复模板”基线。表示只能在源 API 家族上训练，并在目标家族测试前冻结；目标 API 的文档、错误文本或修复轨迹不得泄漏进表示学习。

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Error-state induction removes provider-specific semantic drift, while repair compilation converts the invariant state back into an executable target-provider recovery action.

problem.zh: 重复工作流结构故障每次重新搜索补丁，无法跨 API 或图结构复用。
problem.en: Recurring structural workflow failures are patched from scratch and do not transfer across APIs or graph motifs.

exact_mechanism.zh: 在冻结的结构重写语言中从失败/修复图差分归纳产生式，学习触发条件和局部重写，禁止测试时重新搜索。
exact_mechanism.en: Induce productions from failure/repair graph diffs in a frozen structural rewrite language, learn triggers and local rewrites, and prohibit test-time search.

learning_signal.zh: 工作流图差分、失败 motif 和独立验证的修复成功结果。
learning_signal.en: Workflow graph diffs, failure motifs, and independently verified post-repair success.

independent_ground_truth.zh: API-disjoint 与 motif-disjoint 工作流上的冻结重写成功。
independent_ground_truth.en: Frozen rewrite success on API-disjoint and motif-disjoint workflows.

strongest_baseline.zh: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement、HarnessFix、图差分检索、测试时搜索。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement, HarnessFix, graph-diff retrieval, and test-time search.

decisive_pilot.zh: 训练/测试按 API 和 motif 双重留出，禁止测试时生成新规则。
decisive_pilot.en: Use double holdout by API and motif and forbid new rule generation at test time.

stop_condition.zh: 产生式不能组合泛化，或最近图差分检索同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if productions do not compositionally generalize or nearest graph-diff retrieval is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 图差分抽象提炼局部结构变化，语法归纳使变化可在未见结构上组合复用。
necessity_logic.en: Graph-diff abstraction isolates structural changes and grammar induction enables compositional reuse on unseen structures.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real and the learned object is persistent. Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement and HarnessFix already convert recurring trace failures into localized structural graph or harness edits, while WISE-Flow induces reusable workflows, but the checked work does not establish the same frozen repair grammar learned from repair graph diffs with zero test-time rule generation and joint API-disjoint plus motif-disjoint compositional transfer. The thesis therefore survives, but only if production composition—not retrieval or template instantiation—causes the held-out gain.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实，且学习对象具有持久性。Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement 与 HarnessFix 已能把重复轨迹失败转成局部结构化图/框架修复，WISE-Flow 也会诱导可复用工作流；但已核查工作尚未覆盖“从修复前后图差分中学习冻结的修复文法，并在测试时禁止新规则生成，同时跨 API 与跨 motif 组合迁移”这一完整边界。因此该题可以成立，但必须证明收益来自 production 的组合泛化，而不是检索或模板实例化。
external_reviews.required_action: Pre-register a capacity-matched canonical graph-diff retrieval/template-instantiation baseline using exactly the same repaired pairs, model calls, tokens, and validation budget. Freeze the production inventory before evaluation, use a crossed API-by-motif holdout, and report production-level reuse/composition so that a successful unseen repair can be attributed to the grammar rather than semantic nearest-neighbor reuse.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 预注册一个容量匹配的“规范化 graph-diff 检索 + 模板实例化”基线，使用完全相同的修复对、模型调用、token 与验证预算。评测前冻结 production 集合，采用 API×motif 交叉留出，并报告 production 级复用/组合证据，使未见修复的成功能够归因于文法而非语义近邻复用。

closest_work.title: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement
From Failed Trajectories to Reliable LLM Agents: Diagnosing and Repairing Harness Flaws
WISE-Flow: Workflow-Induced Structured Experience for Self-Evolving Conversational Service Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving boundary is frozen graph-rewrite production induction with no test-time search and demonstrated systematic composition on workflows disjoint in both API and structural motif.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement or HarnessFix-style failure localization followed by canonical graph-diff template retrieval/instantiation under the identical repair and validation budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train on a factorial subset of API families and graph motifs, freeze all rules, and evaluate crossed held-outs where neither the API nor the repair motif appears in the same training pair; compare against canonical graph-diff retrieval with identical calls and tokens and require a statistically reliable repair-success margin plus direct evidence that unseen repairs use multi-production compositions.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if nearest graph-diff/template retrieval matches the grammar within the pre-registered equivalence margin, if successful held-out repairs require generating or editing rules at test time, or if gains vanish when both API and motif are jointly held out.
unknowns: Whether the proposed rewrite language admits a nontrivial set of compositional productions rather than one production per repair template.
Whether enough independently verified API-by-motif repair pairs can be collected at low resource to estimate double-holdout generalization.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Canonicalize every successful graph diff into a typed edit template and retrieve/instantiate the nearest template at test time, with the same data and call budget but no grammar induction.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned production-composition operator that synthesizes a correct unseen structural repair from previously learned productions without a target-motif exemplar, new rule generation, or search.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Graph-diff abstraction identifies reusable structural change units, while grammar induction must turn those units into frozen productions whose composition repairs unseen API/motif combinations.

discussion_ready.external_finding: The failure is real and the learned object is persistent. Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement and HarnessFix already convert recurring trace failures into localized structural graph or harness edits, while WISE-Flow induces reusable workflows, but the checked work does not establish the same frozen repair grammar learned from repair graph diffs with zero test-time rule generation and joint API-disjoint plus motif-disjoint compositional transfer. The thesis therefore survives, but only if production composition—not retrieval or template instantiation—causes the held-out gain.
discussion_ready.external_finding_zh: 问题真实，且学习对象具有持久性。Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement 与 HarnessFix 已能把重复轨迹失败转成局部结构化图/框架修复，WISE-Flow 也会诱导可复用工作流；但已核查工作尚未覆盖“从修复前后图差分中学习冻结的修复文法，并在测试时禁止新规则生成，同时跨 API 与跨 motif 组合迁移”这一完整边界。因此该题可以成立，但必须证明收益来自 production 的组合泛化，而不是检索或模板实例化。
discussion_ready.external_required_action: Pre-register a capacity-matched canonical graph-diff retrieval/template-instantiation baseline using exactly the same repaired pairs, model calls, tokens, and validation budget. Freeze the production inventory before evaluation, use a crossed API-by-motif holdout, and report production-level reuse/composition so that a successful unseen repair can be attributed to the grammar rather than semantic nearest-neighbor reuse.
discussion_ready.external_required_action_zh: 预注册一个容量匹配的“规范化 graph-diff 检索 + 模板实例化”基线，使用完全相同的修复对、模型调用、token 与验证预算。评测前冻结 production 集合，采用 API×motif 交叉留出，并报告 production 级复用/组合证据，使未见修复的成功能够归因于文法而非语义近邻复用。

problem.zh: 回滚定位可以找出故障更新，但若证据不能转成未来更新组合规则，同类回退仍会重复。
problem.en: Rollback localization can identify faulty updates, but without reusable composition rules the same regressions recur.

exact_mechanism.zh: 在冻结的类型化更新描述符语言中，从随机回滚干预归纳带置信度的 no-good、compatibility 与 precedence 子句，并显式控制误阻断。
exact_mechanism.en: In a frozen typed update-descriptor language, induce confidence-bearing no-good, compatibility, and precedence clauses from randomized rollback interventions with explicit false-block control.

learning_signal.zh: 回滚干预、更新描述符、恢复结果和误阻断标签。
learning_signal.en: Rollback interventions, update descriptors, restoration outcomes, and false-block labels.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新组合上的回归预防率、误阻断率和效用保留。
independent_ground_truth.en: Regression prevention, false-block rate, and utility retention on unseen update compositions.

strongest_baseline.zh: ANNEAL、PMA/ProbDD 后验风险门控、Update-Composition Repair Compiler。
strongest_baseline.en: ANNEAL, PMA/ProbDD posterior risk gating, and Update-Composition Repair Compiler.

decisive_pilot.zh: 完整留出组合模板，比较子句库与相同干预历史训练的直接风险 gate。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out composition templates completely and compare the clause library with a direct risk gate trained on identical intervention history.

stop_condition.zh: 不能超越直接风险 gate 或误阻断过高则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat direct risk gating or false blocking is excessive.

necessity_logic.zh: 子句归纳产生可复用结构知识，误阻断控制保证它不是简单保守 gate。
necessity_logic.en: Clause induction creates reusable structural knowledge and false-block control prevents collapse into a conservative gate.

revival_condition.zh: 只有类型语言、概率语义和误阻断控制均明确时复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only when the typed language, probabilistic semantics, and false-block control are all explicit.

external_reviews.finding: This revival makes a material change: it turns rollback outcomes into a persistent relational clause library rather than only localizing or reverting a bad update. ANNEAL already learns governed typed symbolic patches with canary validation and rollback, and governed capability evolution already checks compatibility and rollback, but the checked work does not directly learn confidence-bearing no-good, compatibility, and precedence clauses from randomized rollback interventions and test them on unseen update compositions at a controlled false-block rate. The main erasure risk is a calibrated direct risk gate trained on the same interventions.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该 revival 的变化是实质性的：它把 rollback 结果转化为持久的关系型 clause library，而不只是定位或回滚坏更新。ANNEAL 已经学习带 canary 验证与回滚的 typed symbolic patch，governed capability evolution 也已有兼容性检查与回滚，但已核查工作尚未直接从随机化 rollback 干预中学习带置信度的 no-good、compatibility、precedence clauses，并在未见更新组合上以受控 false-block rate 验证。最大的消解风险是：同一干预历史训练出的校准直接风险门是否已经足够。
external_reviews.required_action: Make clause induction explicitly relational and composition-level: randomize update presence/order where feasible, hold out entire composition templates, calibrate both clause confidence and the direct-gate baseline to the same false-block operating point, and show extrapolation to unseen compositions rather than interpolation over descriptor vectors.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 把 clause induction 明确定义为关系型、组合级学习：在可行范围内随机化更新的存在/顺序，完整留出 composition template，把 clause confidence 与直接风险门校准到相同 false-block 工作点，并证明对未见组合的外推，而不是 descriptor 向量上的插值。

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is learned probabilistic relational constraints over update composition and precedence, induced from interventions and evaluated for out-of-template regression prevention at matched false-block cost.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A calibrated direct posterior regression-risk gate over typed update descriptors trained on exactly the same randomized rollback history, with the threshold chosen to match false-block rate and utility.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Create factorial update sets with randomized inclusion and ordering, hold out full composition templates, and compare the frozen clause library with a capacity-matched direct probabilistic gate using identical intervention data; require lower unseen-composition regression at the same false-block rate and retained utility.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the direct risk gate matches clause induction on held-out composition templates within the pre-registered equivalence margin, if clause gains disappear at matched false-block rate, or if useful-update acceptance collapses.
unknowns: Whether randomized rollback interventions are sufficiently safe and numerous to identify precedence and compatibility rather than mere correlation.
Whether the typed descriptor language is expressive enough for real update interactions without becoming domain-specific.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Train a calibrated direct regression-risk classifier on the same update descriptors, rollback interventions, restoration outcomes, and false-block labels, then gate updates at a threshold chosen to match the clause system's false-block rate.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: Relational no-good/compatibility/precedence clauses that extrapolate to unseen update compositions and orderings where a capacity-matched direct risk gate fails at the same false-block rate.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Probabilistic clause induction converts intervention outcomes into reusable composition constraints, and false-block control prevents those learned constraints from degenerating into a reject-most-updates safety gate.

problem.zh: 评价 rubric 的少数原子可能造成系统性偏差，但整体重写会破坏中性维度。
problem.en: A few rubric atoms can cause systematic bias while whole-rubric rewriting damages neutral dimensions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从因果/中性干预构建 rubric-atom 效应矩阵，用约束稀疏求解器最小增删/重加权，并显式保持中性维度。
exact_mechanism.en: Build a rubric-atom effect matrix from causal/neutral interventions and solve a constrained sparse add/drop/reweight edit while explicitly preserving neutral dimensions.

learning_signal.zh: rubric 原子干预、排序变化和中性保持标签。
learning_signal.en: Rubric-atom interventions, ranking changes, and neutral-preservation labels.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 冻结独立任务上的偏差降低、真实排序和中性维度保持。
independent_ground_truth.en: Bias reduction, true ranking, and neutral-dimension preservation on frozen independent tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: RRD、PReMISE、CROME 数据上的普通重写、Reward 微调。
strongest_baseline.en: RRD, PReMISE, generic rewriting on CROME interventions, and reward fine-tuning.

decisive_pilot.zh: 预注册 rubric 原子与因果/中性干预，匹配调用预算比较稀疏编辑与强基线。
decisive_pilot.en: Pre-register rubric atoms and causal/neutral interventions and compare sparse editing with strong baselines under matched calls.

stop_condition.zh: 不能保持中性维度，或普通重写同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if neutral dimensions are not preserved or generic rewriting is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 效应矩阵定位偏差原子，稀疏求解器在保持约束下执行最小持久修复。
necessity_logic.en: The effect matrix localizes biased atoms and the sparse solver performs minimal persistent repair under preservation constraints.

external_reviews.finding: This is a defensible standalone thesis if the intervention labels are independently grounded. RRD already decomposes, filters, and reweights rubric criteria, while PReMISE audits and refines rubric sets and RubricBench demonstrates persistent rubric-alignment failures. The surviving mechanism is sharper: estimate atom-level causal effects using pre-registered causal and neutral interventions, then make a minimal persistent edit subject to explicit neutral-preservation constraints. A simpler L1-style solver can instantiate the sparse editor, but it does not erase the core contribution because the non-removable object is the independently identified intervention-effect representation plus preservation-constrained update. ([arXiv][3])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 如果干预标签具有独立可靠的真值来源，这个方向可以形成独立论文。RRD 已经会分解、过滤和重新加权 rubric，PReMISE 也会审计并修复 rubric 集合，RubricBench 则证明了 rubric 与人类标准之间仍存在系统性问题。这里仍然保留下来的机制更明确：通过预注册的因果/中性干预识别 rubric 原子的因果效应，再在显式的中性维度保持约束下执行最小持久编辑。稀疏编辑器本身可以用更简单的 L1 类求解器实现，但这不会消除核心贡献，因为不可移除的对象是独立识别得到的干预效应结构以及带保持约束的更新。
external_reviews.required_action: Lock the claim to causally identified minimal rubric repair. Ensure causal and neutral labels come from an external human, executable, or otherwise independent oracle rather than the judge being repaired; include a direct L1/constrained-regression implementation as the simplest instantiation, plus held-out task, judge-model, and bias-composition transfer.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将论文命题锁定为“因果识别的最小 rubric 修复”。因果与中性标签必须来自外部人工、可执行规则或其他独立 oracle，而不能来自正在被修复的 judge；同时加入直接的 L1/约束回归实现作为最简实例，并进行未见任务、未见 judge 模型以及未见偏差组合的迁移。

closest_work.title: Rethinking Rubric Generation for Improving LLM Judge and Reward Modeling for Open-ended Tasks
PReMISE: Policy Rubrics as Measurement Specifications for LLM Judges
RubricBench: Aligning Model-Generated Rubrics with Human Standards

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The distinct boundary is interventionally identified atom-level causal repair with an explicit sparse optimization objective that preserves independently measured neutral dimensions.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Capacity-matched L1-constrained rubric reweighting using exactly the same atom intervention observations and neutral constraints, alongside RRD/PReMISE-style rubric refinement under the same evaluator calls and token budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Pre-register biased atoms, causal perturbations, neutral perturbations, and external ground truth; estimate the effect matrix on one task/judge set, freeze the edited rubric, and evaluate unseen tasks, a held-out judge model, and unseen combinations of bias factors against the direct L1 baseline and generic rubric rewriting under matched calls.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the intervention-derived editor fails to preserve pre-registered neutral dimensions, if its held-out bias reduction disappears with an independent ground-truth evaluator, or if an unconstrained/matched L1 baseline reproduces both bias reduction and neutral preservation.
unknowns: The provenance and independence of the proposed neutral-preservation labels and true-ranking ground truth.
Whether rubric-atom effects are sufficiently stable under interactions for a sparse effect model to transfer.
The exact public identity of the candidate's named CROME intervention baseline could not be verified from the allowed official sources.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Fit an L1-regularized linear or logistic model directly from the same rubric-atom intervention matrix to ranking errors, then solve for the smallest add/drop/reweight vector satisfying identical neutral-dimension constraints.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: Intervention-derived atom effects that predict held-out causal consequences, together with hard neutral-preservation constraints that prevent an unconstrained rewrite or reweighting method from matching the repair.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Controlled atom interventions identify which rubric components cause biased ranking changes, and the constrained sparse editor persists only the necessary repair while explicitly protecting neutral dimensions.

problem.zh: 多轮 Prompt/记忆/工作流更新形成长版本链，重复约束和被覆盖规则增加冲突与维护成本。
problem.en: Long prompt/memory/workflow version chains accumulate redundant and shadowed rules, increasing conflict and maintenance cost.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把版本链转成类型化行为约束图，用反事实重放识别被覆盖与等价更新，再编译为更短规范状态并保留回滚映射。
exact_mechanism.en: Convert version history into a typed behavioral-constraint graph, identify shadowed/equivalent updates with counterfactual replay, and compile a shorter canonical state with rollback mapping.

learning_signal.zh: 版本链、更新依赖和反事实重放结果。
learning_signal.en: Version history, update dependencies, and counterfactual replay outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 规范化后冻结任务上的行为等价、回归和上下文成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Behavioral equivalence, regression, and context cost after canonicalization.

strongest_baseline.zh: 保留全部、文本摘要、最后版本、语义去重。
strongest_baseline.en: Keep-all, text summarization, last-version-only, and semantic deduplication.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造 10–30 轮更新链，压缩到固定预算，测试圈外任务与回滚恢复。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct 10–30 round update histories, compress to a fixed budget, and test out-of-loop tasks plus rollback recovery.

stop_condition.zh: 显著压缩下不能保持行为，或回滚映射不可靠则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if behavior cannot be preserved under meaningful compression or rollback mapping is unreliable.

necessity_logic.zh: 版本效应图识别可消去更新，规范编译器保证压缩后仍是可部署状态。
necessity_logic.en: The version-effect graph identifies removable updates and the canonical compiler guarantees a deployable compressed state.

external_reviews.finding: This has a plausible standalone mechanism and a clear persistent output: a canonicalized update state that replaces the original history before future tasks. Recent work already provides versioned graph memory, semantic rollback, and learned memory consolidation, but the reviewed work does not erase the specific combination of behaviorally testing shadow/equivalence relations across a multi-round update history, compiling the surviving constraints into a shorter canonical state, and preserving a rollback correspondence. The main risk is simplification to semantic deduplication plus replay, so the thesis must focus on histories with non-local, order-sensitive, or interacting constraints where text similarity is insufficient. ([arXiv][5])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方向具备较清晰的独立机制，持久输出也明确：用规范化后的更新状态真正替换原始历史，再影响未来任务。近期工作已经覆盖版本化图记忆、语义回滚和学习式记忆整合，但目前检索到的工作尚未直接覆盖这一完整组合：跨多轮更新历史通过行为反事实测试识别遮蔽/等价关系，将剩余约束编译成更短的规范状态，同时保留可回滚映射。主要风险是被“语义去重 + replay 验证”简化，因此论文必须聚焦文本相似度无法处理的非局部、顺序敏感或交互式约束历史。
external_reviews.required_action: Define the behavioral-constraint graph over genuinely interacting histories, separate replay probes used for compaction decisions from the held-out equivalence suite, and include a capacity-matched semantic-deduplication-plus-replay baseline. Demonstrate frozen transfer across update compositions and at least one held-out model or update surface.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要在真正存在交互的更新历史上定义行为约束图，并将用于决定压缩的 replay probes 与最终独立等价性测试集严格分离；加入容量匹配的“语义去重 + replay”基线，并展示对未见更新组合以及至少一个未见模型或更新表面的冻结迁移。

closest_work.title: Graph-Native Cognitive Memory for AI Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving contribution is behavior-preserving canonical compilation of an entire interacting update history, backed by counterfactual effect relations and an explicit mapping from canonical state back to rollback-relevant history.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Semantic entailment/deduplication plus last-write-wins and greedy counterfactual replay validation, using the same model calls, history, replay probes, final context budget, and rollback metadata.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate 10–30-round histories containing redundant, superseding, order-sensitive, and interacting constraints; learn compaction using one replay probe set, freeze the canonical state, and evaluate disjoint out-of-loop tasks, unseen update compositions, and rollback queries against the semantic-deduplication-plus-replay baseline at the same context budget.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if meaningful compression cannot preserve held-out behavior, if rollback mapping fails on pre-registered recovery queries, or if semantic deduplication plus replay achieves equivalent compression, behavior preservation, and rollback accuracy.
unknowns: How complete counterfactual replay must be to distinguish true behavioral equivalence from equivalence on sampled probes.
Whether rollback mapping is defined for partially overlapping or non-commutative updates.
Whether the proposed 10–30-round histories produce enough non-local interactions for the graph representation to be necessary.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Semantically cluster or entailment-deduplicate history entries, apply last-write-wins to obvious supersessions, then replay the same behavioral probes and greedily restore any deletion that changes behavior.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned or induced dependency/effect graph that safely canonicalizes non-local and order-sensitive update interactions and provides a valid rollback mapping where similarity-based deduplication plus replay fails.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Counterfactual replay identifies the behavioral dependencies and supersessions accumulated across updates, and the compiler replaces that history with a shorter deployable state while retaining behavioral and rollback semantics.

discussion_ready.external_finding: This has a plausible standalone mechanism and a clear persistent output: a canonicalized update state that replaces the original history before future tasks. Recent work already provides versioned graph memory, semantic rollback, and learned memory consolidation, but the reviewed work does not erase the specific combination of behaviorally testing shadow/equivalence relations across a multi-round update history, compiling the surviving constraints into a shorter canonical state, and preserving a rollback correspondence. The main risk is simplification to semantic deduplication plus replay, so the thesis must focus on histories with non-local, order-sensitive, or interacting constraints where text similarity is insufficient. ([arXiv][5])
discussion_ready.external_finding_zh: 该方向具备较清晰的独立机制，持久输出也明确：用规范化后的更新状态真正替换原始历史，再影响未来任务。近期工作已经覆盖版本化图记忆、语义回滚和学习式记忆整合，但目前检索到的工作尚未直接覆盖这一完整组合：跨多轮更新历史通过行为反事实测试识别遮蔽/等价关系，将剩余约束编译成更短的规范状态，同时保留可回滚映射。主要风险是被“语义去重 + replay 验证”简化，因此论文必须聚焦文本相似度无法处理的非局部、顺序敏感或交互式约束历史。
discussion_ready.external_required_action: Define the behavioral-constraint graph over genuinely interacting histories, separate replay probes used for compaction decisions from the held-out equivalence suite, and include a capacity-matched semantic-deduplication-plus-replay baseline. Demonstrate frozen transfer across update compositions and at least one held-out model or update surface.
discussion_ready.external_required_action_zh: 需要在真正存在交互的更新历史上定义行为约束图，并将用于决定压缩的 replay probes 与最终独立等价性测试集严格分离；加入容量匹配的“语义去重 + replay”基线，并展示对未见更新组合以及至少一个未见模型或更新表面的冻结迁移。

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Counterfactual replay identifies the behavioral dependencies and supersessions accumulated across updates, and the compiler replaces that history with a shorter deployable state while retaining behavioral and rollback semantics.

title.zh: 效应迁移经验专化 v5

problem.zh: 一条经验在源任务有效，却可能在目标任务族产生负迁移；只输出迁移证书仍不改变持久知识。
problem.en: A lesson may help its source task but harm a target family; a transport certificate alone does not change persistent knowledge.

exact_mechanism.zh: 用多任务随机化效应和支持重叠学习可迁移区域；对不可全局迁移的经验自动分裂为任务族条件子经验，并对未知区域弃权。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn transportable regions from randomized multi-task effects and support overlap; automatically split non-global lessons into task-family-conditioned descendants and abstain outside support.

learning_signal.zh: 跨任务族随机化经验效应、支持描述和模型家族信息。
learning_signal.en: Randomized lesson effects across task families, support descriptors, and model-family information.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 完全未见任务族上的效应符号、负迁移率和覆盖率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Effect sign, negative-transfer rate, and coverage on fully unseen task families.

strongest_baseline.zh: Conformal/R-learner 迁移 gate、语义相似度、Effect-Bifurcation Memory Learner。
strongest_baseline.en: Conformal/R-learner transport gates, semantic similarity, and Effect-Bifurcation Memory Learner.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少 10 个任务族用于校准/留出，冻结后不得用目标标签，比较 gate-only 与自动专化。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least ten task families for calibration/holdout, forbid target labels after freezing, and compare gate-only versus automatic specialization.

stop_condition.zh: 校准无效、覆盖过低或专化不优于 gate-only 则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if calibration is invalid, coverage too low, or specialization does not beat gate-only.

necessity_logic.zh: 迁移风险估计确定适用区域，经验专化实际改变持久知识；只输出证书不能解决负迁移。
necessity_logic.en: Transport-risk estimation determines support and lesson specialization actually changes persistent knowledge; a certificate alone cannot repair negative transfer.

revival_condition.zh: 只有具备足够任务族和有效支持假设时复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only with enough task families and valid support assumptions.

external_reviews.finding: The problem is independently established and the v5 mechanism materially repairs the weakness of certificate-only ancestors. A 2026 systematic study finds non-trivial negative transfer for model-generated skills, including 25% negative extractor-target cells overall and substantially higher rates in some domains; personalized skill evolution likewise reports that one global library is suboptimal for heterogeneous clients. ([arXiv][4]) Unlike a transport certificate or inference-time gate, this proposal makes the estimated heterogeneity change persistent knowledge by splitting a lesson into supported task-family-conditioned descendants and retaining abstention outside identified support. No searched work combines randomized lesson-level effects, support-aware transport estimation, and persistent lineage specialization in this form. The thesis survives provided specialization beats both gate-only causal estimation and a capacity-matched non-causal task-conditioned router on the risk-coverage frontier.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该问题已有独立实证，而且 v5 的机制相对于仅做 certificate 的父方案产生了实质性修复。2026 年对 model-generated skills 的系统研究观察到明显的负迁移：整体 extractor-target 单元中约 25% 出现负迁移，部分领域更高；个性化 skill evolution 也表明异构用户使用单一全局 skill library 并非最优。([arXiv][4]) 与 transport certificate 或仅在推理时 gate 掉风险 lesson 不同，本方案会让估计出的 effect heterogeneity 真正修改持久知识：把非全局 lesson 自动拆成受支持的 task-family-conditioned descendants，并在无支持区域弃判。目前检索到的工作中，没有发现同时使用 lesson 级随机干预、support-aware effect transport 和持久 lineage specialization 的直接方案。成立的关键是 specialization 必须在 risk-coverage frontier 上同时胜过 gate-only 因果估计器以及同容量的非因果 task-conditioned router。
external_reviews.required_action: Keep the persistent lineage split as the central learned operator and make the causal identification contract explicit: randomize lesson inclusion versus exclusion within calibration families, cross-fit effect estimation, define support descriptors before seeing held-out outcomes, and forbid held-out-family labels after freezing. Add a capacity-matched semantic task-conditioned router/specializer—not just gate-only—as the primary erasing baseline. Report negative-transfer risk at matched coverage as well as aggregate reward, so specialization cannot win merely by abstaining more often.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 保留“持久 lesson lineage 拆分”作为核心学习算子，并明确因果识别条件：在 calibration families 内随机化 lesson inclusion/exclusion，采用 cross-fitting 估计 effect，在看到 held-out outcome 前冻结 support descriptors，并且冻结后禁止使用 held-out-family labels。除 gate-only 外，必须加入同容量的 semantic task-conditioned router/specializer 作为主要消融基线。同时报告 matched coverage 下的负迁移风险和总效用，避免 specialization 仅靠更多 abstention 获胜。

closest_work.title: From Raw Experience to Skill Consumption: A Systematic Study of Model-Generated Agent Skills
closest_work.overlap: problem — the study directly establishes substantial target- and domain-dependent negative transfer and reduces it using a utility-grounded extraction meta-skill, but does not learn causal transport regions or persistently bifurcate an existing lesson lineage. ([arXiv][4])

closest_work.title: FederatedSkill: Federated Learning for Agentic Skill Evolution
closest_work.overlap: combination — FederatedSkill maintains personalized persistent skill libraries and specializes global skills for heterogeneous model/harness/task distributions, but specialization is driven by client patch histories rather than randomized lesson effects and support-aware causal transport. ([arXiv][5])

closest_work.title: Integrative R-learner of heterogeneous treatment effects combining experimental and observational studies
closest_work.overlap: mechanism — R-learner methodology already supplies a principled route for estimating heterogeneous intervention effects from randomized evidence, so treatment-effect estimation itself is not the contribution; the surviving object is its conversion into persistent lesson specialization. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][6])

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving method boundary is a closed causal memory-update loop: randomized lesson interventions identify where a lesson transports, unsupported/global failures trigger persistent lineage bifurcation, and the resulting descendants are frozen and evaluated on completely unseen task families.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A matched-budget cross-fitted R-learner/conformal gate that never changes the lesson plus a capacity-matched task-descriptor router that directly selects among global or family-specific lesson rewrites; both receive the same randomized trials, descriptors, model calls, tokens, and evaluation budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use at least ten genuinely distinct task families and randomized lesson-on versus lesson-off interventions. Split by whole family, not instances: estimate effects and specialization rules on calibration families, freeze them, and evaluate completely unseen families with no target outcomes available to the learner. Compare global reuse, semantic routing, effect gate-only, and effect-driven persistent specialization under identical trial budgets. The decisive endpoint is the negative-transfer-versus-coverage frontier plus average treatment utility; additionally test a held-out model family if the trial budget permits.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if randomized treatment-effect estimates fail pre-specified calibration or overlap checks, if useful coverage collapses under valid support, if the semantic task-conditioned router matches specialization at matched negative-transfer risk and budget, or if specialization does not strictly improve the risk-coverage frontier over gate-only on leave-family-out evaluation.
unknowns: How many statistically independent task families and randomized repetitions are required for stable transport-risk calibration at the intended resource budget.
Whether lesson interventions satisfy a usable no-interference assumption when multiple stored lessons interact during execution.
Whether task-family support descriptors can be fixed independently of held-out outcome information and still predict effect modification.
Whether automatically generated descendants preserve lesson semantics rather than introducing new uncontrolled interventions.
Whether the gain persists under model-family holdout rather than only task-family holdout.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: A capacity-matched task-descriptor router that keeps one global lesson plus per-family rewritten copies and learns which copy to retrieve directly from observed task outcomes, without estimating randomized treatment effects, transport support, or conformal risk.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: Randomized effect-based support estimation must produce safer or broader leave-family-out transfer than direct semantic routing, while persistent lesson splitting must recover useful coverage that an otherwise identical gate-only estimator sacrifices.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: A globally stored lesson causes heterogeneous positive and negative effects across task families; transport-risk estimation identifies supported effect regions, and lesson specialization converts those regions into persistent descendants that improve future use while abstaining outside support.
