combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Effect matching must identify the invariant behavioral change to preserve, and typed translation must realize that change on a target update surface that is unavailable in the source form.

problem.zh: 同一经验对不同任务子群可能产生相反的未来效应，统一保留或删除都会出错。
problem.en: One experience can have opposite future effects across task subpopulations, so global keep/delete decisions are unsafe.

exact_mechanism.zh: 用随机化重放估计异质处理效应；出现多峰或符号冲突时，把经验分裂成带不同适用条件的子经验并冻结分裂规则。
exact_mechanism.en: Estimate heterogeneous treatment effects with randomized replay; split a memory into applicability-bounded descendants when effects are multimodal or sign-conflicted, then freeze the split rules.

finalists.update_surface: versioned experience memory with descendant lineage

learning_signal.zh: 经验写入/不写入的随机化未来效应。
learning_signal.en: Randomized future effects of writing versus withholding the experience.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 时间留出任务中的子经验帮助/伤害效应。
independent_ground_truth.en: Benefit/harm effects of descendants on chronologically held-out tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 统一经验、语义聚类分裂、上下文门控、A-MAC 类准入。
strongest_baseline.en: Unspecialized memory, semantic-cluster splitting, contextual gating, and A-MAC-style admission.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个任务域中构造效应符号异质经验，比较未来负迁移、正收益和分裂复杂度。
decisive_pilot.en: Create sign-heterogeneous experiences in two domains and compare future negative transfer, positive gain, and split complexity.

stop_condition.zh: 未见任务子群上不能降低负迁移，或语义聚类同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if negative transfer does not fall on unseen subgroups or semantic clustering is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 异质效应决定何时分叉，适用条件学习决定如何分叉；两者缺一不可。
necessity_logic.en: Effect heterogeneity decides when to split and applicability learning decides how; neither alone closes the failure loop.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real: downstream experience use can propagate harmful or misaligned memories, and recent memory work already treats validated future-task impact as a utility signal. However, the proposed bifurcation operator does not yet survive simplification. Once randomized write-versus-withhold effects are available, a capacity-matched contextual applicability gate over one unsplit memory can implement the same subgroup-specific use/suppress behavior. Unless descendants learn genuinely different content or operators rather than different applicability regions, splitting is representational duplication rather than a standalone learning mechanism. ([ACL Anthology][1])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实存在：经验记忆可能在后续任务中产生错误传播或负迁移，近期工作也已经利用经验证的下游影响来衡量记忆效用。但当前“分叉”算子还没有通过简化挑战。既然已经通过随机写入/不写入实验获得条件效应，一个容量匹配的上下文适用性门控器就可以在不拆分记忆的情况下，对不同子群执行使用或抑制。除非不同后代记忆学习到真正不同的内容或行为算子，否则分叉更像表示层面的复制，而不是独立的方法贡献。
external_reviews.required_action: Either collapse the thesis to causal applicability gating, or make descendants learn subgroup-specific memory transformations/content and demonstrate that these descendants outperform an effect-conditioned contextual gate under identical replay, storage, inference-call, and training budgets on held-out subgroup identities and domains.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 要么将论文收缩为“因果效应驱动的记忆适用性门控”，要么让不同后代真正学习子群特定的记忆内容或变换，并在完全相同的回放、存储、推理调用和训练预算下，证明其在未见子群身份和领域上显著优于基于效应的上下文门控。

closest_work.title: How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Explicit randomized estimation of sign-heterogeneous treatment effects followed by frozen subgroup-specific descendants is not directly covered, but the descendant operation itself is not yet shown to be non-reducible.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched causal contextual gate trained from exactly the same randomized write/withhold effects, with one unsplit memory and task-conditioned retrieve/suppress decisions; additionally compare semantic clustering and admission-only policies.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct two domains in which the same experience has positive treatment effect for one latent subgroup and negative effect for another. Randomize write/withhold during training, freeze all learned rules, and evaluate on completely held-out subgroup identities and a held-out domain. Compare descendant splitting against the causal contextual gate using identical intervention counts, memory capacity, retrieval calls, and model tokens, measuring positive gain and negative transfer separately.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the bifurcation thesis if the contextual gate matches the split learner within 1 percentage point on both positive gain and negative-transfer rate across both domains, or if activating different descendants produces no behavior beyond selecting versus suppressing the original memory.
unknowns: Whether stable heterogeneous treatment effects can be estimated with a low-resource number of randomized replay interventions.
Whether sign heterogeneity transfers across task identities, domains, and model versions.
Whether proposed descendants would learn different content rather than only different applicability masks.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Estimate a conditional write-versus-withhold treatment effect tau(x,m) from the same randomized replay data and keep one unsplit memory, retrieving it only when the learned effect is positive; use the same estimator capacity, observations, calls, and memory budget.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A descendant-specific learned content transformation or behavioral operator that changes future decisions in a way an applicability gate over the original memory cannot represent.

removable_components: applicability-specialization
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Randomized interventions can identify heterogeneous memory effects, but the current specialization step is not necessary because contextual gating can close the harmful-retrieval loop without materialized descendants.

problem.zh: 长期自进化会积累语义不同但行为作用等价的经验，造成上下文膨胀和冲突。
problem.en: Long-running evolution accumulates semantically different memories with behaviorally equivalent effects, causing context bloat and conflicts.

exact_mechanism.zh: 用跨任务干预效应签名而非文本相似度判断可合并性，只合并效应向量和适用边界等价的经验，并保留可逆来源映射。
exact_mechanism.en: Use cross-task intervention-effect signatures instead of text similarity; merge only memories equivalent in effect and applicability while preserving reversible provenance.

learning_signal.zh: 条目级跨任务干预效应向量和容量压力。
learning_signal.en: Entry-level cross-task intervention-effect vectors and memory-capacity pressure.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 冻结后的任务成功、回归和检索成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Frozen downstream success, regression, and retrieval cost.

strongest_baseline.zh: 语义去重、摘要压缩、LRU、全部保留。
strongest_baseline.en: Semantic deduplication, summary compression, LRU eviction, and keep-all.

decisive_pilot.zh: 持续任务流中匹配存储预算，比较压缩率、未来性能和错误合并回归。
decisive_pilot.en: Match memory budgets on continual task streams and compare compression, future performance, and regressions from false merges.

stop_condition.zh: 相同压缩率下不优于语义去重，或错误合并率过高则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat semantic deduplication at the same compression rate or false merges are excessive.

necessity_logic.zh: 效应签名提供功能等价标准，合并编译器提供持久压缩。
necessity_logic.en: Effect signatures define functional equivalence and the merge compiler provides persistent compression.

external_reviews.finding: Defining memory redundancy by downstream intervention effects rather than text similarity is a promising surviving axis, and existing work on downstream memory utility and adaptive distillation does not directly establish effect-equivalence merging. The present two-component mechanism is nevertheless over-specified: effect-signature clustering followed by retaining one medoid plus a reversible alias/provenance table can plausibly reproduce the claimed compression, applicability preservation, and rollback without a learned merge compiler. The thesis needs an interaction case in which representative selection provably or empirically fails. ([arXiv][2])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 以“下游干预效应”而非文本相似度定义记忆冗余，是目前仍有潜力的新轴；现有下游记忆效用与自适应蒸馏工作并未直接完成这种效应等价合并。但当前两组件机制仍然偏复杂：对效应签名做聚类、保留一个 medoid，并用可逆别名/溯源表记录被压缩项，就可能复现压缩、适用性保持与回滚能力，而不需要单独的学习式 merge compiler。论文必须给出代表项保留法会失败、而真正合并算子能够解决的交互情形。
external_reviews.required_action: Make the non-reducible object explicit. The strongest route is to model group or interaction-effect equivalence, where memories with similar marginal effect vectors are not safely replaceable by a medoid because their joint effects differ. Otherwise remove the merge compiler and present the contribution narrowly as intervention-effect-based deduplication.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要明确不可约的学习对象。最强的修改方向是学习“组级或交互效应等价”：即边际效应向量相似的记忆仍可能因为联合效应不同而不能简单保留一个代表项。否则应删除 merge compiler，将贡献收缩为基于干预效应的记忆去重。

closest_work.title: Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization
What Deserves Memory: Adaptive Memory Distillation for LLM Agents
RecMem: Recurrence-based Memory Consolidation for Efficient and Effective Long-Running LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is consolidation according to experimentally measured cross-task intervention-effect equivalence rather than semantic recurrence, predicted utility, or textual redundancy.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Effect-signature clustering with the same applicability features and intervention data, one retained medoid per cluster, and a reversible alias map, evaluated at exactly the same final memory size and retrieval budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Build a continual stream containing semantically dissimilar but behaviorally equivalent memories, plus adversarial groups whose marginal effect signatures are similar while joint retrieval effects differ. Freeze the compactor and evaluate held-out domains and a second model at matched compression ratios against effect-medoid clustering, semantic deduplication, LRU, and keep-all.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the compiler thesis if effect-signature medoid retention matches downstream success and regression within 1 percentage point at the same compression ratio, or if estimated effect equivalence is too unstable to reduce false merges relative to semantic deduplication.
unknowns: The intervention sample complexity required for reliable entry-level effect signatures.
Whether effect equivalence remains stable after actor or model-version changes.
Whether approximate effect equivalence is sufficiently transitive for safe DAG-level merging.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Compute the same cross-task effect signatures and applicability masks, cluster entries under a fixed threshold, retain one medoid per cluster, and keep a reversible alias table for provenance and rollback.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: An effect-equivalence operator that preserves behavior under joint retrieval or interaction settings where effect-vector clustering plus representative retention necessarily makes false merges.

removable_components: reversible-merge-compiler
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Causal-effect signatures can identify behavioral redundancy, but reversible compression does not require a learned compiler unless merging changes future behavior beyond representative retention.

title.zh: 纵向评价器漂移修正器

problem.zh: Actor 与 evaluator 共同更新后，静态校准器无法识别仅在特定版本配对中出现的评分偏差。
problem.en: When actor and evaluator co-evolve, static calibration cannot identify biases specific to version pairings.

exact_mechanism.zh: 构建 actor-version × evaluator-version 交叉评分矩阵，学习时间残差与交互项，并用独立锚点任务训练可冻结的偏差修正头。
exact_mechanism.en: Build a crossed actor-version by evaluator-version score matrix, learn temporal residuals and interactions, and train a frozen bias-correction head from independent anchor tasks.

learning_signal.zh: 跨版本评分矩阵、锚点任务和外部真值。
learning_signal.en: Cross-version score matrices, anchor tasks, and external ground truth.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未来未见 evaluator 版本上的真实排序和下游策略选择质量。
independent_ground_truth.en: True ranking and downstream policy-selection quality on unseen future evaluator versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: Bridge/SAJA 式静态校准、冻结 evaluator、Evaluator Ensemble。
strongest_baseline.en: Bridge/SAJA-style static calibration, frozen evaluator, and evaluator ensembles.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少 6 轮 actor/evaluator 历史，按未来版本留出，比较偏差预测和策略选择。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least six actor/evaluator rounds with future-version holdout and compare bias prediction plus policy selection.

stop_condition.zh: 不能显著超过静态校准器预测未来偏差则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not significantly beat static calibration on future-version bias.

necessity_logic.zh: 纵向交互模型捕获共同进化偏差，独立锚点把残差约束到真实能力。
necessity_logic.en: The longitudinal interaction model captures co-evolution bias while independent anchors tie residuals to real capability.

external_reviews.finding: The longitudinal evaluator-drift problem is credible, and static judge calibration is already a substantial literature baseline. The present formulation has an identifiability gap: a crossed actor-version by evaluator-version interaction model cannot estimate a free interaction for a genuinely unseen evaluator version without observations from that version. If future-version anchors are supplied, a static Bridge/SAJA-style calibration model trained on exactly those anchors may erase the claimed need for the longitudinal matrix. The method therefore needs an explicit extrapolative version representation and a precisely defined information boundary. ([OpenReview][3])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 评估器随版本共同演化而产生漂移的问题可信，而且静态 judge calibration 已经形成很强的基线。当前方案存在关键可辨识性缺口：actor-version × evaluator-version 的交叉交互模型无法在完全没有该新版本观测的情况下估计一个真正未见 evaluator version 的自由交互项；如果允许给新版本提供 anchor，那么使用同样 anchor 的静态 Bridge/SAJA 式校准又可能消除纵向矩阵的必要性。因此必须明确未来版本可使用的信息边界，并学习能够外推的版本表示。
external_reviews.required_action: Separate zero-anchor and few-anchor future-version regimes. For zero-anchor transfer, learn a low-rank temporal/version-state representation from observable evaluator fingerprints available before ground truth and forbid any held-out-version labels. For few-anchor transfer, give exactly the same anchors to a static calibration baseline and show that historical cross-version dynamics provide additional predictive value.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将未来版本评测明确拆分为 zero-anchor 与 few-anchor 两种制度。zero-anchor 场景必须利用无需真实标签即可获得的 evaluator 指纹学习低秩时间/版本状态，并禁止使用任何留出版本真实标签；few-anchor 场景则必须给静态校准基线完全相同的 anchor，并证明历史跨版本动态仍有额外预测价值。

closest_work.title: Bridging Human and LLM Judgments: Understanding and Narrowing the Gap
SAJA: A Simple Approach to Judge Alignment for LLM-as-a-Judge

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The potentially novel boundary is prediction and correction of actor-evaluator version-pair interactions across time, especially extrapolation to a chronologically held-out evaluator version rather than calibration within a fixed judge population.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched pooled calibration head with the same anchor budget, evaluator scores, actor/evaluator observable descriptors, and recency features, trained without an explicit cross-version interaction model.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use at least six reproducible actor/evaluator rounds and leave the final evaluator version chronologically held out. Run both zero-anchor and fixed-k-anchor protocols; in the latter, expose exactly the same k anchors to every method. Freeze correction before evaluation and measure bias RMSE, pairwise ranking accuracy, and downstream policy-selection regret on unseen actor-evaluator pairings.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the pooled static calibration baseline is within 5 percent relative bias RMSE and 1 percentage point of policy-selection accuracy under both information regimes, or if successful prediction requires ground-truth labels from the nominally unseen evaluator version beyond the declared anchor budget.
unknowns: Whether sufficiently many reproducible historical evaluator versions can be queried under a consistent task protocol.
Whether evaluator drift has a temporally predictable structure rather than arbitrary version discontinuities.
Which version fingerprints are available without leaking held-out anchor ground truth.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Fit a pooled Bridge/SAJA-style calibration head using the same anchor examples and evaluator outputs, optionally adding actor version, evaluator version descriptors, and recency as ordinary covariates, without an explicit crossed residual matrix.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: An extrapolative latent version-state operator that predicts held-out evaluator-version bias beyond a static calibration head supplied with the same observable information.

removable_components: cross-version-residual-model
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Independent anchors ground evaluator bias, but historical cross-version residual modeling closes an additional failure loop only if it improves prediction for a future version beyond calibration on the same available anchors.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Independent anchors ground evaluator bias, but historical cross-version residual modeling closes an additional failure loop only if it improves prediction for a future version beyond calibration on the same available anchors.

problem.zh: 多条记忆各自有用，但检索顺序改变会导致规划冲突或错误覆盖。
problem.en: Several memories may each be useful while retrieval order changes planning and causes destructive override.

exact_mechanism.zh: 随机化共同检索集合的排列，学习类型化 precedence/commutativity 子句，并在推理前约束排序。
exact_mechanism.en: Randomize permutations within co-retrieved sets, learn typed precedence/commutativity clauses, and constrain ordering before inference.

learning_signal.zh: 同一记忆集合不同排列的环境结果。
learning_signal.en: Environment outcomes under different permutations of the same memory set.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见记忆身份和高阶组合上的顺序效应。
independent_ground_truth.en: Order effects on unseen memory identities and higher-order combinations.

strongest_baseline.zh: 时间顺序、相关度排序、Memory Interaction Clause Learner、随机顺序。
strongest_baseline.en: Chronological order, relevance sorting, Memory Interaction Clause Learner, and random order.

decisive_pilot.zh: 二元/三元组合训练，完整留出记忆身份测试排序泛化。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on pair/triple sets and hold out memory identities completely to test ordering transfer.

stop_condition.zh: 子句不能跨身份泛化，或简单相关度排序同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if clauses do not generalize across identities or simple relevance sorting is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 干预识别顺序效应，子句学习把它变成未来可执行约束。
necessity_logic.en: Interventions identify order effects and clause induction turns them into executable future constraints.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is well supported: identical retrieved content can produce materially different behavior under permutation, and agent memories can alter control flow. A frozen executable ordering registry is also a legitimate persistent learned object. The unresolved issue is mechanism necessity. From the same permutation interventions, a capacity-matched pairwise precedence scorer followed by sorting or tournament/topological decoding may reproduce the claimed behavior without symbolic typed clauses. Moreover, identity-held-out transfer is not identifiable until the proposed memory types are defined independently of the outcome labels. ([ACL Anthology][5])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 失败现象有充分依据：相同检索内容仅改变排列顺序就可能显著改变模型行为，代理记忆也可能改变控制流；冻结后的可执行顺序约束表也确实属于持久学习对象。但目前仍缺少组件必要性证明。从完全相同的 permutation intervention 数据出发，一个容量匹配的成对优先级打分器再配合排序、锦标赛或拓扑解码，可能无需符号化 typed clauses 就能复现效果。同时，如果“memory type”本身没有在结果标签之外独立定义，那么跨未见 memory identity 的迁移也无法清晰辨识。
external_reviews.required_action: Define memory types independently and make the target relation strictly richer than scalar ranking. Include conditional, commutative, and higher-order cases in which pairwise scores are insufficient, then demonstrate transfer to unseen memory identities, unseen type compositions, and preferably a held-out model. Otherwise simplify the paper to learned retrieval ordering.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须独立定义 memory type，并让目标关系严格超出标量排序的表达能力。实验中应包含条件优先、可交换以及高阶组合等成对打分无法表达的情形，并验证对未见 memory identity、未见类型组合以及最好是未见模型的迁移；否则论文应收缩为一般的学习式检索排序。

external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the clause-learning thesis if the pairwise scorer is within 1 percentage point of task success and constraint-violation rate on held-out identities and compositions, or if learned clauses fail to transfer when surface memory identities are replaced.
unknowns: Whether real agent memories exhibit stable precedence relations across tasks rather than prompt-specific order sensitivity.
How memory types can be defined or learned without leaking permutation-outcome labels.
The number of permutation interventions required to identify higher-order clauses.
Whether learned ordering constraints remain valid after the base model changes.

simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A higher-order typed constraint operator whose correct ordering decisions cannot be represented by any scalar or pairwise precedence scorer with matched capacity.

title.zh: 多 Agent 角色专化编译器

problem.zh: 通用子 Agent 长期处理重复任务 motif 时，固定角色 Prompt 会产生上下文浪费和能力冲突。
problem.en: General subagents repeatedly handling the same motifs waste context and create capability conflicts under fixed role prompts.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从跨任务轨迹中聚类稳定职责与成功修复模式，编译为带输入契约、工具权限和退出条件的专化角色，并学习路由。
exact_mechanism.en: Cluster stable responsibilities and successful repair patterns across tasks, compile them into specialized roles with input contracts, tool permissions, and exit conditions, and learn routing.

learning_signal.zh: 任务 motif、子 Agent 贡献、工具调用和团队结果。
learning_signal.en: Task motifs, subagent contribution, tool calls, and team outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见任务上的团队成功、角色复用率和成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Team success, role reuse rate, and cost on unseen tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定角色、动态 prompt 角色、Skill library、router-only。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed roles, dynamically prompted roles, skill libraries, and router-only systems.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按任务族留出训练/测试，冻结角色库，允许路由但禁止测试时生成新角色。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out task families, freeze the role library, allow routing but no test-time role generation.

stop_condition.zh: 角色无法跨任务复用，或动态 prompt 角色同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if roles do not reuse across tasks or dynamic role prompting is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 角色归纳找稳定职责，编译把职责变成可执行持久角色；仅路由不能创造专化能力。
necessity_logic.en: Role induction finds stable responsibilities and compilation turns them into executable persistent roles; routing alone cannot create specialization.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is credible and the frozen versioned role library is a legitimate persistent learned object, but the present mechanism does not yet survive the simplification challenge. AgentNet already learns dynamic specialization and routing, while MetaGen generates query-conditioned roles and topologies; a motif-clustered retrieval system that instantiates dynamic role prompts with the same permissions, exit guards, router, calls, and tokens could plausibly reproduce the claimed benefit without a compiled role library. The surviving thesis must therefore be that cross-task induction discovers reusable executable role contracts that cannot be replaced by retrieval or inference-time role generation. ([NeurIPS Proceedings][1])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实，冻结后的版本化角色库也确实属于能够影响未来行为的持久学习对象，但当前机制尚未通过简化挑战。AgentNet 已经学习动态角色专门化与路由，MetaGen 也会按查询动态生成角色和拓扑；如果用相同权限、退出条件、路由器、调用次数和 token 预算，仅对成功轨迹进行 motif 聚类并检索动态角色提示，就可能复现主要收益。因此真正需要保住的论文命题应是：跨任务角色归纳能够产生不可由检索式或测试时动态角色生成替代的、可执行且可复用的角色契约。
external_reviews.required_action: Make contracted compilation behaviorally substantive rather than textual: contracts must enforce tool/action interfaces or termination semantics, and the frozen compiled library must beat a capacity-matched motif-retrieval plus dynamic-role baseline on held-out task families and preferably a held-out base model. Include ablations removing compilation while retaining the same learned router and permissions.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须让“契约化编译”产生真实的行为约束，而不只是改写角色文本，例如真正约束工具/动作接口或终止语义；冻结角色库后，要在未见任务族、最好再加未见基础模型上，击败容量匹配的“motif 检索 + 动态角色生成”基线，并加入仅移除编译、保留同一路由器和权限配置的消融。

closest_work.title: AgentNet: Decentralized Evolutionary Coordination for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
MetaGen: Self-Evolving Roles and Topologies for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
MAS-GPT: Training LLMs to Build LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The potentially novel boundary is offline induction of a versioned, frozen, cross-task role library whose contracts are executable artifacts rather than query-conditioned role text or online coordination choices.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Motif-clustered retrieval of dynamically instantiated roles plus a learned router, with the same role descriptions, permission masks, termination rules, training trajectories, test-time calls, and token budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train the compiler and the retrieval baseline on identical trajectories from several task families, freeze both, and evaluate unseen families plus one held-out model with no test-time role synthesis for the compiler; require higher team success or lower matched cost together with substantial cross-task reuse, and show that replacing compiled contracts with retrieved prompts removes the gain.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the matched dynamic-role retrieval baseline falls within the pre-registered equivalence margin of the compiler on held-out success and cost, or if induced roles show negligible reuse outside their source task family.
unknowns: Whether subagent contribution can be estimated independently enough to avoid credit-assignment leakage from team outcome.
Whether input contracts, tool permissions, and exit conditions are executable enforcement mechanisms or only prompt text.
How task-family overlap will be controlled so apparent role reuse is not template leakage.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Cluster successful traces into task motifs, retrieve one motif at test time, instantiate an ordinary dynamic role prompt with identical tool permissions and exit guards, and use the same learned router; allocate exactly the same training examples, inference calls, and token budget.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A frozen cross-task library of executable role contracts whose reuse and transfer advantage remains after dynamic prompting, retrieval, routing capacity, permissions, and inference budget are matched.

removable_components: contracted-role-compilation
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Repeated successful responsibilities are induced across tasks, compiled into reusable executable roles, and routed on future tasks so repeated context construction and role conflicts are reduced after freezing.

problem.zh: 回滚通常只能撤销整个更新，无法保留更新中有益部分。
problem.en: Rollback usually removes an entire update even when only part of it caused regression.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从部分回滚干预学习条件逆算子，将失败更新分解为可逆原子并生成仅抵消有害效应的 inverse patch。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn a conditional inverse operator from partial rollback interventions, decompose failed updates into reversible atoms, and generate an inverse patch that cancels only harmful effects.

learning_signal.zh: 更新原子启用/禁用结果和回归恢复程度。
learning_signal.en: Enable/disable outcomes of update atoms and degree of regression recovery.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新上的效用保留率、回归恢复率和 inverse patch 大小。
independent_ground_truth.en: Utility retention, regression recovery, and inverse-patch size on unseen updates.

strongest_baseline.zh: 完整回滚、最小稳定补丁、联合重优化、Delta Debugging。
strongest_baseline.en: Full rollback, minimal stabilizing patch, joint re-optimization, and delta debugging.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在混合有益/有害更新中预注册可逆原子，训练后冻结到未见更新。
decisive_pilot.en: Pre-register reversible atoms in mixed-benefit/harm updates and freeze the learned inverter on unseen updates.

stop_condition.zh: 无法比完整回滚保留更多效用，或原子分解不稳定则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not retain more utility than full rollback or atom decomposition is unstable.

necessity_logic.zh: 干预识别需抵消部分，逆算子把证据泛化为未来修复；只做定位仍会全量回滚。
necessity_logic.en: Interventions identify what to cancel and the inverse operator generalizes that evidence into future repair; localization alone still implies whole rollback.

external_reviews.finding: The selective-rollback problem is important and the frozen inverse operator would be a persistent learned object, but the current formulation makes the learned inverter potentially unnecessary. Task arithmetic already shows that stored update vectors can be negated or combined, and OneEdit includes targeted rollback of prior edits. If the proposed update atoms are pre-registered and individually reversible, the same intervention outcomes can simply train a harmful-atom selector followed by exact subtraction of stored atom deltas. A standalone thesis requires non-additive or coupled updates for which no subset of known inverse atoms can produce the needed repair. ([OpenReview][2])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 选择性回滚的问题重要，冻结后的逆更新算子也属于持久学习对象，但当前设定下“学习逆算子”可能是多余的。Task Arithmetic 已证明可对更新向量直接取反或组合，OneEdit 也包含针对既有编辑的定向回滚。如果候选方法预先定义了可逆原子，并且每个原子的逆操作已知，那么相同的干预数据只需学习“哪些原子有害”，再直接减去对应更新即可。要成为独立论文，必须进入非加性或存在耦合效应的更新场景，使任何已存原子逆操作的子集都无法完成所需修复。
external_reviews.required_action: Change the target regime from separable reversible atoms to coupled or non-additive updates. Define an inverter that must synthesize or condition an inverse patch from interaction evidence, and explicitly test cases where oracle subset rollback over all stored atom deltas is insufficient.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要把目标场景从“可分离、已知逆操作的原子”改成存在耦合或非加性效应的更新。逆算子必须利用交互证据合成或条件化地产生新的逆补丁，并明确构造“即便 oracle 知道应回滚哪些原子，所有已有原子逆操作的任意子集仍不足以修复”的测试。

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Oracle-capacity sparse atom selection using the same intervention matrix followed by exact atom rollback or task-vector negation, with a capacity-matched residual stabilizing patch.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Create mixed-benefit/harm updates with pre-registered interaction terms, train only on some interaction families, freeze the inverter, and test unseen interactions against oracle subset rollback using identical intervention and optimization budgets; the inverter must recover regressions and retain more utility specifically on cases where no subset of stored inverse atoms is adequate.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if oracle subset rollback or linear task-vector composition matches the learned inverter within the pre-registered equivalence margin, or if the alleged interaction effects are not reproducible across seeds.
unknowns: What constitutes an update atom across prompt, memory, workflow, and parameter-update surfaces.
Whether atom inverses are already stored or cheaply computable.
Whether the intended update families exhibit reproducible non-additive interactions at the proposed experimental scale.

problem.zh: 一次 Prompt/记忆/技能更新可能引入特定新脆弱性，但固定回归集通常覆盖不到更新语义附近的风险。
problem.en: A prompt/memory/skill update can introduce update-specific vulnerabilities that a fixed regression suite misses.

exact_mechanism.zh: 解析更新 diff 与被改变的行为契约，生成针对潜在副作用的挑战任务；失败挑战经独立判定后回流为训练或修复数据。
exact_mechanism.en: Parse update diffs and changed behavioral contracts, generate challenges targeting plausible side effects, and feed independently verified failures back as training or repair data.

learning_signal.zh: 更新 diff、行为契约、挑战结果和独立评分。
learning_signal.en: Update diffs, behavioral contracts, challenge outcomes, and independent scores.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新类型上的回归发现率与修复后泛化。
independent_ground_truth.en: Regression discovery and post-repair generalization on unseen update types.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定回归集、随机任务生成、Change-Triggered Regression Exams、红队 Prompt。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed regression suites, random task generation, Change-Triggered Regression Exams, and generic red-team prompts.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三类更新训练、一类更新留出；匹配测试/生成预算并评测发现后修复收益。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three update types and hold out a fourth under matched testing/generation budgets; measure downstream repair gains.

stop_condition.zh: 只提高发现率但不能带来修复收益，或固定回归同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it improves discovery but not repair, or fixed regression testing is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: diff 条件生成把测试聚焦到真实改变表面，失败回流使挑战真正影响持久更新而非只做评测。
necessity_logic.en: Diff conditioning focuses tests on the changed surface and feedback turns discovered failures into persistent updates rather than evaluation only.

external_reviews.finding: The regression problem is real, but the proposed learning object is underspecified: a persistent challenge curriculum may be only an accumulated dataset rather than a learned mechanism. PromptPex already extracts checkable specifications from prompts and generates targeted tests, Agent-Testing Agent automates adversarial agent testing, and ReCatcher addresses regression across model updates. A capacity-matched system can therefore parse the entire post-update specification, generate generic adversarial tests, and replay verified failures without learning a diff-conditioned policy. The thesis survives only if prior updates train a frozen diff-to-failure-family generator whose cross-update prior discovers failures that full-state specification testing does not. ([arXiv][4])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 回归测试问题确实真实，但当前“持久挑战课程”还没有被定义成明确的学习对象，它可能只是不断累积的数据集。PromptPex 已经能从 prompt 中抽取可检查规范并生成针对性测试，Agent-Testing Agent 会自动生成对抗式 agent 测试，ReCatcher 也研究模型更新间的回归。因此，一个容量匹配的简化系统完全可以读取更新后的完整规范、生成通用对抗测试并回放已验证失败，而无需学习 diff 条件策略。要保住论文命题，必须让历史更新真正训练出一个冻结的“diff→失败家族”生成策略，并证明这种跨更新先验能够发现完整状态规范测试发现不了的回归。
external_reviews.required_action: Specify and train the persistent object itself: a parameterized update-diff-to-challenge-family policy that is updated from independently verified failures and then frozen. Compare it directly with full-current-state specification extraction plus generic adversarial generation and hard-example replay, under identical generation, verifier, repair, and token budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要明确并训练真正的持久对象：一个从更新 diff 映射到挑战/失败家族的参数化策略，由独立验证的失败进行更新，之后冻结测试。必须直接与“读取完整当前状态进行规范抽取 + 通用对抗生成 + hard-example replay”的方案比较，并严格匹配生成、验证、修复和 token 预算。

closest_work.title: Automatic Test Generation for Language Model Prompts
Agent-Testing Agent: A Meta-Agent for Automated Testing and Evaluation of Conversational AI Agents
ReCatcher: Towards LLMs Regression Testing for Code Generation

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is persistent learning across update histories of which failure families are implied by particular update diffs, followed by frozen transfer to unseen update types.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: PromptPex-style full-state specification extraction plus generic adaptive red teaming and verified-failure replay, with the exact same generator model, evaluator, repair algorithm, calls, examples, and tokens.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train the diff-conditioned policy on three structurally distinct update types, freeze it, and test a fourth update type plus a held-out base model; under matched challenge counts and verifier calls, require both additional unique verified regressions over the full-state baseline and higher post-repair held-out generalization.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if diff conditioning increases only test diversity but not unique verified regression discovery and downstream repair, if the frozen policy fails on the held-out update type, or if full-state specification testing matches it within the pre-registered margin.
unknowns: Which parameters or persistent state constitute the proposed challenge curriculum rather than merely a stored test corpus.
How the independent verifier and behavioral ground truth will be constructed.
Whether the downstream repair method is fixed across approaches or itself contributes most of the gain.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Ignore the diff, extract specifications from the complete post-update prompt/memory/skill state, generate targeted tests with a PromptPex-style generator plus generic adversarial prompting, and append independently verified failures to a replay buffer used by the same repair algorithm.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned frozen cross-update prior mapping structural update diffs to failure families that yields additional independently verified regressions and downstream repair gains beyond full-state specification testing.

removable_components: failure-feedback-loop
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Update changes should condition a learned challenge policy, independently verified failures should update that persistent policy and the repaired system, and the frozen policy should anticipate regressions from unseen update types.

title.zh: API 语义工作流 IR v5

problem.zh: 工作流跨 API 迁移时，函数名和 schema 相似并不保证前置条件、效应与错误恢复语义相同。
problem.en: Across API migrations, similar names and schemas do not guarantee equivalent preconditions, effects, or recovery semantics.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从执行差分学习跨 API 不变的 precondition/effect/error 语义 IR，并将源工作流编译到目标 API，保持恢复分支。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn an API-invariant semantic IR for preconditions, effects, and errors from execution differences, then compile source workflows to target APIs while preserving recovery branches.

learning_signal.zh: 跨 API 等价任务、执行状态差分和错误恢复结果。
learning_signal.en: Cross-API equivalent tasks, execution-state differences, and recovery outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 完全未见 API 家族上的行为等价、恢复成功和成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Behavioral equivalence, recovery success, and cost on a completely unseen API family.

strongest_baseline.zh: 直接 LLM 重写、SkCC、手写中间表示、执行修复循环。
strongest_baseline.en: Direct LLM rewrite, SkCC, handwritten IRs, and execution-repair loops.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三 API 家族训练两家留一家，冻结 IR 后编译，禁止测试时重新学习语义。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on two of three API families, freeze the IR, and compile to the held-out family without test-time semantic learning.

stop_condition.zh: 冻结 IR 不能跨家族保持恢复语义，或直接执行修复同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the frozen IR does not preserve recovery semantics across families or direct execution repair is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: IR 归纳负责可迁移语义，编译器负责实际目标工作流；必须共同超过直接重写。
necessity_logic.en: IR induction supplies transferable semantics and the compiler creates the target workflow; together they must beat direct rewriting.

revival_condition.zh: 只有明确学习算子并在 API 家族留出上超过直接重写才复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only with an explicit learned semantic operator that beats direct rewriting on held-out API families.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real and the proposed frozen semantic IR is a persistent learned object, but the held-out-API-family claim is currently under-specified: compilation to a completely unseen API is not identifiable unless the target-side observation contract is fixed. SkCC already establishes typed IR plus target-specific compilation for agent portability, while M3 semantically models APIs for migration and SPELL distills API-migration knowledge into reusable transformation programs. The surviving thesis is therefore not IR-plus-compilation itself, but learned precondition/effect/error semantics that preserve recovery behavior under a tightly bounded target-observation budget. ([arXiv][1])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实，冻结后的语义 IR 也确实属于能够持续改变后续行为的学习对象；但目前“完全未见 API family 上直接编译”的可识别性不足：必须明确目标 API 在迁移时究竟允许观察哪些信息。SkCC 已经覆盖了类型化 IR 加目标侧编译的可移植框架，M3 已经从行为层面对 API 做语义建模并用于迁移，SPELL 则把迁移知识蒸馏成可复用变换程序。因此真正剩下的论文边界应当是：在严格限定的目标侧观测预算下，学习并冻结前置条件、效果和错误语义，并证明它能保留恢复分支。 ([arXiv][1])
external_reviews.required_action: Specify a fixed target-observation contract, such as documentation/schema plus exactly N execution probes; make the learned object an explicit precondition/effect/error transition operator; and compare its frozen transfer against direct rewrite plus execution repair and a hand-designed/general IR with identical target calls, tokens, and repair budget.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须固定目标 API 的可观测边界，例如仅允许文档/Schema 加严格限定的 N 次执行 probe；把学习对象明确为前置条件、效果和错误转移算子；然后在完全相同的目标调用次数、token 和修复预算下，对比直接重写加执行修复以及手工/通用 IR。

closest_work.title: SkCC: Portable and Secure Skill Compilation for Cross-Framework LLM Agents
M3: Semantic API Migrations
SPELL: Synthesis of Programmatic Edits using LLMs

direct_collision.surviving_difference: None of the closest work found jointly learns API-invariant precondition/effect/error semantics from cross-API execution differences and tests frozen preservation of recovery branches on a new API family under a fixed semantic-observation budget. ([arXiv][1])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Direct LLM rewrite with the same target documentation/schema, identical execution probes, and an identical bounded execution-repair loop.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train the semantic operator on two API families, freeze it, expose every method to the same target documentation and fixed N probes on a third family, and compare recovery-branch equivalence, task success, and cost against direct rewrite plus repair and hand-designed IR compilation.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the 95% confidence interval for held-out recovery-success improvement over direct rewrite plus repair includes zero and semantic-violation rate is not lower at the identical probe/call budget.
unknowns: What target API information is available when the family is unseen.
Whether sufficiently aligned cross-API tasks with independently checkable recovery semantics exist at useful scale.
Whether a portable semantic state space can represent heterogeneous authentication, side-effect, transaction, and error conventions.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Direct LLM workflow rewriting conditioned on the same source/target documentation and schema, followed by the same bounded execution-repair loop and target probes.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A frozen semantic transition/error operator whose predictions improve held-out recovery-branch preservation beyond direct rewriting and repair under the identical target-observation budget.

removable_components: semantic-ir-induction if a direct execution-conditioned rewriter matches held-out recovery preservation under the same budget
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Semantic induction must infer portable behavioral contracts and compilation must instantiate those contracts on the target API so that migration preserves both successful execution and recovery semantics.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Semantic induction must infer portable behavioral contracts and compilation must instantiate those contracts on the target API so that migration preserves both successful execution and recovery semantics.

problem.zh: 多轮自进化后，旧课程可能继续强化已掌握能力，同时忽略新出现的失败边界。
problem.en: After multiple evolution rounds, stale curricula can oversample mastered capabilities while ignoring newly emerging failure boundaries.

exact_mechanism.zh: 学习任务族的训练边际收益与版本漂移，周期性重分配训练预算到效用上升或新失败边界，并保留稳定任务作为回归锚点。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn task-family marginal training gain and version drift, reallocating training budget toward rising utility or new failure boundaries while preserving stable tasks as regression anchors.

learning_signal.zh: 历史训练分配、checkpoint 变化、任务族效应和回归锚点。
learning_signal.en: Historical training allocation, checkpoint changes, task-family effects, and regression anchors.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 后续 checkpoint 的圈外提升、遗忘和预算效率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Out-of-loop improvement, forgetting, and budget efficiency of later checkpoints.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定课程、学习进度、失败率课程、Checkpoint-Discriminative Training Curriculum。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed curricula, learning progress, failure-rate curricula, and Checkpoint-Discriminative Training Curriculum.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两条真实版本流、固定训练预算、至少 4 轮重新分配，评测未见任务族。
decisive_pilot.en: Use two real version streams, fixed training budgets, at least four reallocations, and evaluate unseen task families.

stop_condition.zh: 不能提高后续 checkpoint 或遗忘恶化则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if later checkpoints do not improve or forgetting worsens.

necessity_logic.zh: 漂移估计判断课程何时过期，预算重分配真正改变训练数据；仅审计课程不构成学习机制。
necessity_logic.en: Drift estimation identifies stale curricula and budget reallocation actually changes training data; audit alone is not a learning mechanism.

revival_condition.zh: 只有闭合训练环且在后续 checkpoint 有因果收益时复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only when the training loop closes and causes gains in later checkpoints.

external_reviews.finding: The stale-curriculum failure is plausible, but the current mechanism is too close to established adaptive curriculum and data-mixture control unless 'version drift' becomes a causally identifiable quantity. Automated Curriculum Learning already reallocates sampling using learning-progress rewards; Teacher-Student Curriculum Learning explicitly prioritizes both improving and worsening tasks to address forgetting; Skill-it! and DoReMi provide strong learned data-allocation baselines. Historical allocations and checkpoint deltas alone are confounded because task families receiving more training are precisely those whose gains are subsequently observed. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][2])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 陈旧课程导致训练预算浪费的问题成立，但当前机制如果只是根据学习进展、失败率和遗忘情况重新分配数据，与已有自适应课程和数据配比工作高度重合。Automated Curriculum Learning 已经根据学习增益动态分配任务，Teacher-Student Curriculum Learning 同时关注进步和性能下降以处理遗忘，Skill-it! 与 DoReMi 也构成很强的数据分配基线。更关键的是，仅依靠历史训练分配和 checkpoint 变化无法识别真正的边际训练收益，因为“获得更多训练的任务”和“随后观察到更大变化的任务”本身就是混杂的。 ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][2])
external_reviews.required_action: Replace observational marginal-gain estimation with an intervention-grounded estimator: reserve randomized micro-allocations or logged exploration probabilities at every reallocation, estimate causal marginal utility with uncertainty, and make version-conditioned causal gain rather than generic learning progress the controller's distinctive learned object.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要把观察式的边际收益估计改成干预式估计：每轮保留随机微量预算扰动或明确记录探索概率，用这些数据估计带不确定性的因果边际训练收益，并把“版本条件下的因果训练收益”而不是普通学习进展作为核心学习对象。

closest_work.title: Automated Curriculum Learning for Neural Networks
Teacher-Student Curriculum Learning
Skill-it! A data-driven skills framework for understanding and training language models
DoReMi: Optimizing Data Mixtures Speeds Up Language Model Pretraining

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The credible remaining boundary is causal, version-conditioned estimation of the next-unit training return across repeated model-evolution rounds, followed by frozen transfer of that allocation rule to a separate version stream; generic progress-based adaptive curricula are already well covered. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][2])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A matched-budget TSCL/Automated-Curriculum controller using exponentially smoothed validation improvement, failure rate, and a forgetting floor at exactly the same reallocation cadence.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: At each of at least four reallocations, randomize a small fixed fraction of training budget across task families to identify marginal gain; learn the controller on one version stream, freeze it, and compare against the simple progress-plus-forgetting controller on a separate version stream and unseen task families with identical total tokens and optimizer steps.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the 95% confidence interval for held-out utility improvement over the progress-plus-forgetting baseline includes zero, or if forgetting exceeds that baseline by more than 1 percentage point under the same total training budget.
unknowns: Whether existing training logs contain randomized allocation or propensity information sufficient for causal estimation.
Whether two genuinely independent multi-version model streams with comparable task families are available.
Whether version-conditioned marginal gains remain stable enough to transfer after the controller is frozen.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: A TSCL-style controller that reallocates the same budget using only recent held-out learning-progress slope plus a forgetting/regression floor, with no learned drift model.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A version-conditioned causal marginal-training-gain estimator that predicts which task family benefits from the next unit of training better than simple progress, failure-rate, or forgetting statistics.

removable_components: drift-estimation if recent learning-progress and forgetting statistics produce the same allocations and downstream gains
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Causal drift estimation must identify where an additional training unit has newly increased value, and budget reallocation must turn that estimate into persistent checkpoint changes while regression anchors constrain forgetting.

title.zh: 评价器残差策略修正 v5

problem.zh: 静态评价器校准无法处理 actor 与 evaluator 版本共同变化造成的未来评分偏差。
problem.en: Static evaluator calibration cannot handle future bias caused by joint actor/evaluator version drift.

exact_mechanism.zh: 用完整 actor-version×evaluator-version 交叉历史学习低秩时间交互残差，并将残差修正头用于未来版本的候选策略排序与选择。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn low-rank temporal interaction residuals from a fully crossed actor-version by evaluator-version history and use a residual correction head for future-version policy ranking and selection.

learning_signal.zh: 交叉版本评分、独立锚点和真实下游任务结果。
learning_signal.en: Crossed version scores, independent anchors, and true downstream task outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未来 evaluator 版本上的策略选择 regret 和真实能力排序。
independent_ground_truth.en: Policy-selection regret and true capability ranking on future evaluator versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: Bridge、SAJA、冻结 evaluator、Evaluator Ensemble。
strongest_baseline.en: Bridge, SAJA, frozen evaluators, and evaluator ensembles.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少 6 轮交叉历史，未来两个版本完全留出，比较静态与纵向校准。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least six crossed rounds and hold out two future versions completely to compare static and longitudinal calibration.

stop_condition.zh: 纵向交互不提高未来策略选择则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if longitudinal interactions do not improve future policy selection.

necessity_logic.zh: 交叉历史提供静态校准缺失的信息，最终以策略选择而不是偏差预测作为持久效果。
necessity_logic.en: Crossed history provides information absent from static calibration and policy selection, not bias prediction alone, is the persistent effect.

revival_condition.zh: 只有在未来版本策略选择上超过静态校准才复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only if future-version policy selection beats static calibration.

external_reviews.finding: Evaluator replacement drift is now directly documented, and Bridge and SAJA already establish strong calibration baselines. The proposed actor-version by evaluator-version interaction is potentially distinct, but completely holding out a future evaluator makes arbitrary future bias unidentifiable unless some observable feature or independent anchor from that evaluator is supplied. A temporal low-rank factorization cannot infer an unconstrained new evaluator merely from historical version index. ([NeurIPS Proceedings][3])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 评测器升级导致测量漂移已经有直接证据，Bridge 和 SAJA 也已经提供了很强的校准基线。候选方案中 actor-version × evaluator-version 的纵向交互建模仍有潜在新意，但如果未来 evaluator 被完全留出且完全不给任何可观测信息，那么未来偏差原则上无法由历史版本编号唯一识别；低秩时间模型只能依赖额外的结构假设进行外推。 ([NeurIPS Proceedings][3])
external_reviews.required_action: Define the observability contract for a future evaluator. Prefer a fixed, tiny, externally labeled blind anchor panel available equally to every method; condition the longitudinal interaction model on those observations and test whether crossed history reduces future policy-selection regret beyond per-evaluator affine/isotonic, Bridge, and SAJA-style calibration with the same anchors.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须明确未来 evaluator 的可观测条件。建议给所有方法完全相同的一小组外部人工标注盲测 anchor，然后让纵向交互模型以这些 anchor 为条件，并验证历史 crossed data 是否能在相同标注预算下进一步降低未来策略选择 regret，而不是只与未校准 evaluator 比较。

closest_work.title: Bridging Human and LLM Judgments: Understanding and Narrowing the Gap
SAJA: A Simple Approach to Judge Alignment for LLM-as-a-Judge
When the Judge Changes, So Does the Measurement: Auditing LLM-as-Judge Reliability

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is prospective policy selection using actor-by-evaluator longitudinal interactions across multiple historical versions, rather than static human alignment or an audit showing that evaluator replacement changes measurements. ([NeurIPS Proceedings][3])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A per-evaluator SAJA/Bridge-style or affine/isotonic calibration model using exactly the same independent future-version anchors, followed by direct policy ranking.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Build at least six fully crossed historical actor/evaluator rounds; hold out two later evaluator versions and held-out actor policies; expose every calibration method to the same small blind anchor panel from each future evaluator; then compare true downstream policy-selection regret under identical calls and human-label budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the longitudinal model does not reduce future policy-selection regret versus the strongest static/per-version calibration with a 95% confidence interval excluding zero, or if the learned interaction factors are unstable across reasonable temporal splits.
unknowns: Whether six or more genuinely crossed actor/evaluator version rounds are available.
What information about a future evaluator is observable before policy selection.
Whether evaluator drift has a sufficiently low-rank and temporally stable interaction structure to extrapolate.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Per-evaluator affine or isotonic calibration, or a SAJA/Bridge-style lightweight calibration head, trained on exactly the same future-evaluator anchor panel and followed by direct ranking.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A crossed actor-evaluator interaction term learned from history that lowers double-held-out policy-selection regret beyond static/per-version calibration given identical future anchors.

removable_components: policy-selection-correction as a separate module if simply ranking the crossed-model corrected scores yields identical decisions
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Crossed longitudinal modeling must estimate version-specific interaction bias, and those corrected scores must causally change which frozen policy is selected on later evaluator versions.

title.zh: 更新差分因果重授权器

problem.zh: Agent 更新后继续沿用旧权限会引入新越权，而统一降权又损害效用。
problem.en: Reusing old permissions after an agent update can create new overreach, while uniform downgrade harms utility.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对 Prompt/记忆/技能/工作流 diff 做干预式表示学习，预测哪些权限因本次更新新增风险，只运行针对这些权限的独立 canary，再更新租约。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn intervention-grounded representations of prompt/memory/skill/workflow diffs, predict which permissions become newly risky, run independent canaries only for those permissions, and update the lease.

learning_signal.zh: 更新 diff、权限干预、canary 结果、越权和任务效用。
learning_signal.en: Update diffs, permission interventions, canary outcomes, overreach, and task utility.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新算子上的安全-效用 Pareto 与权限恢复正确率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Safety-utility Pareto and permission-restoration accuracy on unseen update operators.

strongest_baseline.zh: Progent 式动态策略、静态最小权限、统一降权、完整重认证。
strongest_baseline.en: Progent-style dynamic policy, static least privilege, uniform downgrade, and full reauthorization.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三类更新训练、一类更新留出；canary 生成与评分独立于风险模型。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three update types and hold out a fourth; canary generation and scoring remain independent of the risk model.

stop_condition.zh: 未见更新算子上不优于动态策略或完整重认证则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat dynamic policy or full reauthorization on unseen update operators.

necessity_logic.zh: diff 风险模型缩小需要重认证的权限集合，独立 canary 决定实际权限更新；两者共同避免循环自评。
necessity_logic.en: The diff-risk model narrows permissions needing reauthorization and independent canaries decide actual updates, avoiding circular self-evaluation.

revival_condition.zh: 只有在未见更新算子上稳定降低重认证成本且不牺牲安全时复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only if it reduces reauthorization cost on unseen update operators without sacrificing safety.

external_reviews.finding: The problem has a very recent direct collision: Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? explicitly formulates authorization continuity after evolving-agent mutations and introduces state-bound grants, transition envelopes, and an immutable effect ceiling. Progent, SkillGuard, and SkillScope also make dynamic or fine-grained least-privilege controls strong baselines. The candidate can still survive as a learned permission-level triage mechanism that predicts which grants require independent re-testing after a mutation, but it no longer owns the broad 'does old authorization survive an update?' thesis. ([arXiv][4])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 这里已经出现非常直接的最新碰撞：Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? 已经明确提出“agent 演化后旧授权是否仍然有效”的 authorization continuity 问题，并给出 state-bound grant、transition envelope 和不可提升的 effect ceiling。Progent、SkillGuard、SkillScope 也构成动态或细粒度最小权限的强基线。因此该候选不能再把“更新后重新授权”本身作为主要新颖性，真正可能保留下来的贡献是：学习到 permission-level 的更新风险，从而只对少数可疑授权执行独立 canary 重测。 ([arXiv][4])
external_reviews.required_action: Reframe the method as a learned cost-reduction layer inside state-bound authorization rather than a new authorization-continuity framework. Keep an immutable effect ceiling, obtain causal supervision from randomized permission interventions, keep canary generation/scoring independent, and compare learned triage against deterministic manifest/effect-diff triage, Progent-style policies, and full reauthorization.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 应把方法重构为 state-bound authorization 内部的“降低重新授权成本”的学习层，而不是重新提出 authorization continuity 框架。保留不可提升的 effect ceiling；通过随机权限干预获得因果监督；canary 的生成和评分必须与风险模型独立；并与基于 manifest/effect diff 的确定性筛选、Progent 类动态策略和全量重新授权进行严格对比。

closest_work.title: Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? Earned Authority under a Fixed Ceiling for Evolving Agents
Progent: Programmable Privilege Control for LLM Agents
SkillGuard: A Permission Framework for Agent Skills
SkillScope: Toward Fine-Grained Least-Privilege Enforcement for Agent Skills

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The direct collision formalizes when authorization should survive mutation, whereas the candidate can still contribute a learned, intervention-grounded permission-level predictor for minimizing which grants require independent reauthorization under unseen mutation operators. ([arXiv][4])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: State-bound authorization with immutable effect ceiling plus deterministic manifest/effect-diff targeted reauthorization and the identical independent canary budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate randomized permission interventions for three mutation classes, train and freeze the diff-risk predictor, then test a fourth unseen mutation class with a fixed canary budget against deterministic effect-diff triage and full reauthorization; canary generation and scoring must be produced by held-out components.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the learned method's unsafe-allow rate fails a pre-registered 1-percentage-point non-inferiority margin versus full reauthorization, or if it reduces reauthorization/canary cost by less than 20% relative to deterministic effect-diff triage at matched task utility.
unknowns: Whether update diffs can be normalized across prompt, memory, skill, workflow, model, and harness mutations without leaking mutation identity.
Whether permission-level randomized interventions are feasible at enough scale to learn transferable causal risk.
Whether independent canaries cover realized effects well enough to support a safety non-inferiority claim.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Deterministically reauthorize only permissions whose declared manifest, reachable-effect set, or dependency graph changed, then run the same independent canaries on that subset.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned intervention-grounded diff-risk predictor that reduces the number of permissions/canaries requiring reauthorization on unseen mutation operators without increasing unauthorized realized effects.

removable_components: causal-diff-risk-model if deterministic manifest/effect-diff triage attains the same safety and reauthorization cost
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The risk model must narrow the permissions whose validity is uncertain after an update, while independent targeted canaries provide non-circular evidence for changing the persistent permission lease.

title.zh: 检索介导伤害析因修复 v5

problem.zh: 记忆伤害可能来自内容、位置、共同检索或检索本身，单一暴露随机化无法区分。
problem.en: Memory harm can arise from content, position, co-retrieval, or retrieval itself, which single exposure randomization cannot separate.

exact_mechanism.zh: 预注册析因干预分别操纵是否纳入、内容替换、排序位置和共同检索，估计路径效应后学习对应的重写/排序/互斥修复策略。
exact_mechanism.en: Pre-register factorial interventions over inclusion, content substitution, rank position, and co-retrieval; estimate pathway effects and learn pathway-specific rewrite/order/exclusion repairs.

learning_signal.zh: 析因干预结果、环境奖励和未来重用结果。
learning_signal.en: Factorial-intervention outcomes, environment rewards, and future reuse outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见记忆身份上的路径识别准确度和修复收益。
independent_ground_truth.en: Pathway-identification accuracy and repair gain on unseen memory identities.

strongest_baseline.zh: Causal Memory Intervention、MemAudit、上下文 Bandit 直接学修复动作。
strongest_baseline.en: Causal Memory Intervention, MemAudit, and contextual-bandit direct repair learning.

decisive_pilot.zh: 相同干预数据下比较路径分解+修复与直接多臂老虎机，匹配调用和存储预算。
decisive_pilot.en: Compare pathway decomposition plus repair against direct contextual-bandit repair on identical intervention data and matched call/storage budgets.

stop_condition.zh: 路径分解不能提高圈外修复，或直接 Bandit 同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if pathway decomposition does not improve out-of-loop repair or direct bandit learning is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 析因干预使伤害路径可识别，路径特定修复检验这种识别是否有独立价值。
necessity_logic.en: Factorial interventions make harm pathways identifiable and pathway-specific repair tests whether that identification adds independent value.

revival_condition.zh: 只有相对直接修复学习器存在稳定增益时才复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only if pathway identification adds stable value over direct repair learning.

external_reviews.finding: The idea has a credible novelty boundary beyond existing causal memory selection and post-hoc memory attribution: CMI intervenes on memory usefulness/harm, while MemAudit performs counterfactual attribution and removal, but neither source found establishes a pathway-specific repair policy over content, rank, co-retrieval, and retrieval exposure. However, the proposed 'factorial' design is not yet causally well-formed: content and rank are undefined when the focal memory is excluded, creating structural cells rather than an ordinary fully crossed factorial, and pathway-identification accuracy is not independent ground truth if it is derived from the same intervention outcomes used for training. ([arXiv][5])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方向相对于现有 causal memory selection 和 post-hoc attribution 确实还有清晰空间：CMI 已经通过干预判断记忆是否有益/有害，MemAudit 也已经进行反事实归因和删除修复，但目前查到的工作没有同时分解内容、排序位置、共同检索和是否检索这些路径并学习对应修复策略。问题在于当前所谓的“factorial”设计并不是普通的完全析因实验：当目标记忆不被检索时，其内容替换和排序位置在结构上不存在；此外，如果 pathway label 直接由训练时的同一组干预结果推导，那么所谓 pathway-identification accuracy 也不是独立 ground truth。 ([arXiv][5])
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the naive full factorial with a preregistered nested/structural causal design: randomize retrieval inclusion first, then randomize content, rank, and co-retrieval only in valid descendant cells. Obtain independent pathway labels from controlled synthetic/semisynthetic memory generators or make held-out future-reuse repair gain the primary endpoint. Retain the matched-data direct contextual-bandit repair baseline.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要把简单的完全析因设计改成预注册的嵌套/结构因果实验：先随机化是否检索，只有在记忆实际被包含的有效分支中再随机化内容、排序和共同检索。路径真值应来自独立构造的合成/半合成机制，或者直接把未来复用时的修复收益设为主要终点；同时必须保留使用完全相同干预数据的直接 contextual-bandit 修复作为消融基线。

closest_work.title: Causal Intervention-Based Memory Selection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
MemAudit: Post-hoc Auditing of Poisoned Agent Memory via Causal Attribution and Structural Anomaly Detection

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving contribution is identification of multiple structurally distinct retrieval-mediated harm pathways followed by a learned pathway-specific persistent repair, rather than binary useful/harmful selection or post-hoc culprit removal. ([arXiv][5])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A direct contextual-bandit repair policy mapping the raw randomized intervention/context features to rewrite, reorder, or exclusion actions using exactly the same trajectories, model calls, and memory budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Run a nested randomized intervention study with independently generated known-pathway harms; train decomposition-plus-repair and direct-bandit repair on identical samples; freeze both and evaluate future reuse on unseen memory identities plus a held-out retriever/ranker or composition, measuring repair gain and pathway recovery separately.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if decomposition-plus-repair does not outperform direct contextual-bandit repair on held-out future-reuse reward with a 95% confidence interval excluding zero, or if estimated pathway effects fail to reproduce under the held-out retriever/ranker.
unknowns: Whether realistic memory failures can be generated with independently known pathway ground truth rather than labels inferred from the intervention estimator itself.
How interactions among content, rank, and co-retrieval should be parameterized without an infeasible number of intervention cells.
Whether pathway effects transfer across retrievers, rerankers, agent models, and unseen memory compositions.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: A contextual bandit trained directly on the identical intervention/context tuples to select rewrite, reorder, or exclusion actions, without explicitly estimating mediation pathways.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: An explicit pathway estimator whose decomposition yields better held-out repair or materially better sample efficiency than direct repair learning under identical intervention, call, and storage budgets.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: A valid nested intervention design identifies which retrieval pathway causes harm, and pathway-specific repair must persistently alter memory content/order/exclusion so that later independent reuse improves.

([arXiv][5])

Obtain independent pathway labels from controlled synthetic/semisynthetic memory generators or make held-out future-reuse repair gain the primary endpoint. Retain the matched-data direct contextual-bandit repair baseline.
finalists.external_required_action_zh: 需要把简单的完全析因设计改成预注册的嵌套/结构因果实验：先随机化是否检索，只有在记忆实际被包含的有效分支中再随机化内容、排序和共同检索。路径真值应来自独立构造的合成/半合成机制，或者直接把未来复用时的修复收益设为主要终点；同时必须保留使用完全相同干预数据的直接 contextual-bandit 修复作为消融基线。

title.zh: 跨表面模型替换重写器

problem.zh: 换 backbone 后，原更新表面可能不再适合：旧模型需要 Prompt 修复，新模型可能更适合记忆或工具约束。
problem.en: After a backbone swap, the previously effective update surface may become inappropriate: a prompt fix may need to become memory or a tool constraint.

exact_mechanism.zh: 联合学习模型差分与跨表面行为等价映射，选择并转译到目标模型最稳定的更新表面，而不是只改写原资产。
exact_mechanism.en: Jointly learn model-difference features and cross-surface behavioral equivalence, choosing and transpiling to the most stable update surface for the target model instead of merely rewriting the original asset.

learning_signal.zh: 源/目标模型行为差分、跨表面修复对和迁移结果。
learning_signal.en: Source/target behavioral differences, cross-surface repair pairs, and migration outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见模型家族上的迁移成功、回归和资产复杂度。
independent_ground_truth.en: Migration success, regression, and asset complexity on an unseen model family.

strongest_baseline.zh: MASA、PromptBridge、固定表面重写、Cross-Surface Update Transpiler。
strongest_baseline.en: MASA, PromptBridge, fixed-surface rewriting, and Cross-Surface Update Transpiler.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三个模型家族×三更新表面，双重留出模型家族和修复类型。
decisive_pilot.en: Use three model families by three update surfaces with double holdout over model family and repair type.

stop_condition.zh: 表面选择不能泛化到未见模型，或固定表面同样稳定则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if surface choice does not generalize to unseen models or a fixed surface is equally stable.

necessity_logic.zh: 模型差分决定哪类表面稳定，跨表面转译产生实际迁移资产；只做其中之一无法完成 model-swap repair。
necessity_logic.en: Model differences determine the stable surface and transpilation creates the migrated asset; either alone cannot complete model-swap repair.

external_reviews.finding: Model-swap incompatibility is well established for prompts and skills: PromptBridge transfers prompts across models, Prompt Migration addresses model-upgrade prompt repair, and MASA learns model-conditioned skill rewriting. The proposed cross-surface boundary is more ambitious and was not directly covered by the closest work found, but the current model-difference encoder is vulnerable to a decisive simplification: if target-model probes are permitted, simply generate candidates on prompt, memory, and tool-constraint surfaces and select the best with the same validation-call budget; if no target observations are permitted, the encoder needs an explicit observable model descriptor or its unseen-family prediction is not identifiable. ([arXiv][6])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 模型更换导致 prompt 或 skill 失效已经有充分直接工作：PromptBridge 处理跨模型 prompt 转移，Prompt Migration 研究模型升级后的 prompt 迁移，MASA 则学习 model-conditioned skill rewriting。候选方案真正可能的新颖边界是跨 update surface 的迁移，即 prompt、memory、tool constraint 之间发生类型变化；但当前的 model-difference encoder 面临一个很强的简化挑战：如果迁移时允许访问目标模型，那么可以直接在多个 surface 上各生成候选并用相同 probe 预算选择最佳项；如果完全不允许目标侧观察，则必须说明依靠什么可观测模型特征预测未见模型，否则 surface choice 不可识别。 ([arXiv][6])
external_reviews.required_action: Define both a target-model observation budget and a typed cross-surface behavioral/effect contract. Compare the learned router-transpiler against matched-budget target-time surface search and strongest within-surface migration methods. The thesis should require the frozen router to predict a stable target surface with fewer target evaluations while the transpiler preserves the common contract on a held-out model family and repair family.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须同时固定目标模型的观测预算，并定义跨 prompt、memory、tool constraint 都适用的类型化行为/效果契约。学习式 router-transpiler 应与相同预算下的目标侧 surface 搜索，以及各 surface 内最强迁移方法比较。核心贡献必须体现为：冻结 router 用更少的目标模型评测就能预测稳定 surface，同时 transpiler 在未见模型 family 和未见 repair family 上仍保持共同契约。

closest_work.title: PromptBridge: Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models
Skill is Not One-Size-Fits-All: Model-Aware Skill Alignment for LLM Agents
Prompt Migration: Stabilizing GenAI Applications with Evolving Large Language Models
SkCC: Portable and Secure Skill Compilation for Cross-Framework LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The closest work found migrates prompts or skills while keeping the representation class fixed; the remaining boundary is learned selection among fundamentally different persistent update surfaces followed by contract-preserving transpilation under backbone swap. ([arXiv][6])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Matched-budget target-time surface search that generates prompt, memory, and tool-constraint candidates, evaluates them with the exact same target-model probes, and selects the best candidate without learning model-difference features.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use at least four genuinely distinct model families and three update surfaces; train the router/transpiler on three families, freeze it, hold out the fourth family and one repair composition, and compare against fixed-surface migration plus matched-budget surface search with exactly equal target calls, tokens, candidate capacity, and evaluation data.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if matched-budget target-surface search matches or exceeds the learned router on held-out migration success and regression, if a single fixed surface is statistically equivalent, or if cross-surface transpilation violates the preregistered behavioral/effect contract above its tolerance.
unknowns: Whether prompt, memory, and tool-constraint repairs admit a common independently checkable equivalence contract.
Whether enough semantically aligned cross-surface repair pairs exist without manually encoding the desired answer.
What target-model observations are permitted at migration time.
Whether four sufficiently distinct model families can be evaluated within the intended low-resource budget.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: For each target model, generate one capacity-matched candidate on every allowed update surface, evaluate all candidates on the same fixed migration probe set, and select the best success-regression-complexity tradeoff without a learned model-difference encoder.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A frozen model-conditioned surface-selection operator that predicts the best surface with strictly fewer target evaluations than matched-budget search, plus a transpiler that preserves a typed behavioral/effect contract across surface types.

removable_components: model-difference-encoder if matched-budget target-surface search achieves equal migration success and stability
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The model-difference component must predict which update surface remains stable after a backbone change, and surface transpilation must instantiate an equivalent persistent repair on that selected surface.
