title.zh: 结构化记忆模型迁移器

problem.zh: 自然语言记忆在模型替换后会因检索习惯、工具约束和程序格式差异失效，普通 Prompt 转移不足以处理结构化资产。
problem.en: Structured agent memories can fail after a model swap because retrieval conventions, tool constraints, and program formats change; prompt transfer is insufficient.

exact_mechanism.zh: 将记忆拆成前置条件、动作程序、检索链接和约束，学习源模型到目标模型的组件级映射与重组，并在未见模型家族冻结。
exact_mechanism.en: Decompose memories into preconditions, action programs, retrieval links, and constraints; learn component-level mappings and recomposition from source to target models and freeze on an unseen model family.

learning_signal.zh: 跨模型结构化记忆对、执行轨迹和行为锚点。
learning_signal.en: Cross-model structured-memory pairs, execution traces, and behavioral anchors.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见模型家族上的记忆可用率、任务成功和回归。
independent_ground_truth.en: Memory usability, task success, and regression on an unseen model family.

strongest_baseline.zh: PromptBridge、MASA、目标模型从零重写、自然语言翻译。
strongest_baseline.en: PromptBridge, MASA, target-model rewrite-from-scratch, and natural-language translation.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三个开放模型家族，训练两家留一，冻结翻译器测试两任务域。
decisive_pilot.en: Use three open model families, train on two and hold out one, then freeze the translator across two task domains.

stop_condition.zh: 不能超过目标模型从零重写或 PromptBridge 类映射则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat target-model rewriting or PromptBridge-style mapping.

necessity_logic.zh: 结构分解把普通文本迁移变成资产语义迁移，组件翻译才能保留程序与约束关系。
necessity_logic.en: Structured decomposition turns text transfer into asset-semantic transfer, and component translation preserves program/constraint relations.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real, but the proposed thesis is currently squeezed by two very close 2026 directions. MASA already learns a model-conditioned rewriter that converts cross-model skill artifacts into target-backbone-specific persistent skill libraries, while SkVM explicitly decomposes skill requirements into primitive capabilities and compiles skills for heterogeneous model-harness pairs; PromptBridge additionally establishes learned cross-model artifact mapping as a strong simplification baseline. ([arXiv][1]) The surviving contribution cannot therefore be merely 'decompose memory and translate components'. It must demonstrate that typed decomposition of preconditions, action programs, retrieval links, and constraints preserves behavioral invariants under swaps that a capacity-matched monolithic rewriter cannot preserve.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实，但当前方法空间已被两个非常接近的 2026 年方向明显挤压。MASA 已经学习面向目标模型的 skill rewriter，把跨模型技能资产改写成目标 backbone 专属的持久技能库；SkVM 更进一步显式分解技能所需的 primitive capabilities，并针对异构 model-harness 对进行编译；PromptBridge 还使“学习一个跨模型资产映射”本身成为很强的简化基线。([arXiv][1]) 因而剩余贡献不能只是“结构化分解后逐组件翻译”，而必须证明 precondition、action program、retrieval link、constraint 的类型化分解能够在模型/执行环境切换时保持行为不变量，而同容量的整体改写器做不到。
external_reviews.required_action: Sharpen the learned object from a generic structured-memory translator into a typed invariant-preserving translator, preferably under joint model plus harness/tool-schema swaps. Define explicit type/consistency constraints for preconditions, programs, retrieval edges, and execution constraints, and train/evaluate the translator so those relations—not merely text similarity or target success—are preserved. The main comparison must give MASA-style monolithic rewriting, PromptBridge-style mapping, and target-model rewrite-from-scratch exactly the same source/target traces, model calls, tokens, and optimization budget.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 把学习对象从泛化的 structured-memory translator 收紧为“保持类型化不变量的 translator”，最好同时覆盖 model swap 与 harness/tool-schema swap。需要为 precondition、program、retrieval edge、execution constraint 定义明确的类型和一致性约束，并让训练与评测直接检验这些关系是否被保持，而不是只看文本相似度或最终成功率。主实验必须让 MASA 式整体改写、PromptBridge 式映射以及 target-model rewrite-from-scratch 使用完全相同的 source/target traces、模型调用、token 和优化预算。

closest_work.title: Skill is Not One-Size-Fits-All: Model-Aware Skill Alignment for LLM Agents
closest_work.overlap: mechanism — MASA optimizes a persistent skill library for each target backbone and trains a lightweight model-conditioned rewriter using cross-model skill transfers as training inputs. ([arXiv][1])

closest_work.title: SkVM: Revisiting Language VM for Skills across Heterogenous LLMs and Harnesses
closest_work.overlap: combination — SkVM targets skill portability across heterogeneous LLM-harness pairs, decomposes skill requirements into primitive capabilities, and performs capability-aware compilation and environment binding. ([arXiv][2])

closest_work.title: PromptBridge: Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models
closest_work.overlap: problem — PromptBridge identifies model drifting and learns a cross-model mapping from calibrated source-target prompt pairs for deployment on unseen tasks. ([arXiv][3])

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The defensible boundary is translation of a typed, relational memory object whose preconditions, executable programs, retrieval topology, and constraints must remain jointly valid after freezing; the searched works do not establish this exact invariant-preserving structured-memory translation objective.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A same-capacity MASA-style monolithic rewriter, additionally matched against target-model rewrite-from-scratch, with identical calibration tasks, execution traces, target-model calls, token budget, and training updates.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct source memories with explicit precondition/program/retrieval/constraint fields across two training model families and at least two harness or tool-schema regimes. Freeze all translators and evaluate a third model family plus unseen compositions. Compare typed translation, monolithic rewriting, PromptBridge-style mapping, and rewrite-from-scratch under identical budgets. Pre-register a hard subset in which one or more structural relations must change while semantic task intent is fixed, and measure both task success and relation-level execution validity.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop or collapse the idea into a baseline/component if the capacity-matched monolithic rewriter is statistically equivalent on held-out task success and structural-validity metrics, if decomposition gains disappear after equalizing calls/tokens, or if gains occur only on model families or schemas observed during translator training.
unknowns: Whether sufficient paired structured-memory assets can be generated without leaking held-out target execution labels into translation supervision.
Whether the proposed decomposition exposes invariants that are actually causal for transfer rather than merely convenient serialization fields.
Whether joint model/harness/tool-schema swaps remain feasible under the intended low-resource budget.
Whether retrieval-link translation contributes independently once preconditions, programs, and constraints are translated.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: A capacity-matched MASA-style model-conditioned monolithic rewriter trained on exactly the same source-target structured-memory pairs and execution traces, but receiving each memory asset as one serialization rather than decomposing it into typed components.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: Typed component decomposition plus relation-preserving recomposition must improve held-out executable-memory transfer beyond the monolithic rewriter, especially on cases where preconditions, tool schemas, retrieval dependencies, or action-program formats change.

removable_components: structured-asset-decomposition, unless typed-decomposition ablations show that a monolithic model-conditioned rewriter cannot recover the same frozen transfer behavior
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: A source-model memory asset becomes incompatible after a model or harness swap; the learned translator rewrites the persistent asset into a target-compatible structured object whose preserved relations improve future frozen executions.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: A source-model memory asset becomes incompatible after a model or harness swap; the learned translator rewrites the persistent asset into a target-compatible structured object whose preserved relations improve future frozen executions.

problem.zh: 技能在单任务中有效，但组合或跨工具时常因输入/状态假设不一致而失败。
problem.en: Skills can work alone but fail in composition or across tools because their input and state assumptions mismatch.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从技能执行轨迹归纳类型化输入契约、状态后置条件和错误出口，编译兼容检查与必要的接口适配器后再允许组合。
exact_mechanism.en: Induce typed input contracts, state postconditions, and error exits from skill traces, then compile compatibility checks and minimal interface adapters before composition.

learning_signal.zh: 技能轨迹、状态差分、组合成功/失败和工具 schema。
learning_signal.en: Skill traces, state diffs, composition success/failure, and tool schemas.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见技能组合和未见工具上的组合成功率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Composition success on unseen skill combinations and unseen tools.

strongest_baseline.zh: SkillCAT、SkCC、schema 匹配、测试时 LLM 修复。
strongest_baseline.en: SkillCAT, SkCC, schema matching, and test-time LLM repair.

decisive_pilot.zh: 完整留出技能对和工具，禁止测试时新写契约，比较组合成功与适配成本。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out skill pairs and tools completely, forbid test-time contract generation, and compare composition success plus adaptation cost.

stop_condition.zh: 契约不能预测并修复未见组合，或 schema 匹配同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if contracts cannot predict and repair unseen compositions or schema matching is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 契约归纳识别接口不匹配，适配器编译把不匹配转换为可执行桥接；仅检测不解决组合失败。
necessity_logic.en: Contract induction identifies interface mismatch and adapter compilation turns mismatch into executable bridges; detection alone does not repair composition.

external_reviews.finding: This candidate directly collides with SkillOps. SkillOps represents skills using typed contracts containing preconditions, operations, artifacts, validators, and failure modes; mines contract information from execution logs; checks dependency and compatibility before composition; inserts adapters for incompatible interfaces; and persistently maintains the skill library. Those elements cover the proposed contract induction plus compatibility checking plus adapter compilation loop almost verbatim. Explicit state postconditions and stronger held-out-tool evaluation are useful extensions, but they do not presently create a distinct ICLR method thesis.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该候选与 SkillOps 构成直接碰撞。SkillOps 已经用包含 precondition、operation、artifact、validator、failure mode 的 typed contract 表示技能，从执行日志中维护/挖掘 contract 信息，在组合前检查 dependency 和 compatibility，并在接口不兼容时插入 adapter，同时持久维护 skill library。这基本覆盖了本候选的“contract induction + compatibility checking + adapter compilation”完整闭环。显式 state postcondition 以及更严格的未见工具迁移可以作为扩展实验，但目前不足以形成独立 ICLR 方法论文。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not pursue the current formulation as a standalone method. Retain it as a component or baseline unless the learned object is materially changed beyond SkillOps, for example toward a probabilistic relational state-transition contract that predicts latent cross-skill side effects unavailable from typed input/output compatibility and whose learned uncertainty directly controls composition.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不要以当前形式继续作为独立方法。可保留为组件或基线；只有在学习对象实质超出 SkillOps 时才值得复活，例如学习 typed I/O compatibility 无法表达的概率关系型状态转移 contract，预测跨技能隐式副作用，并让 contract uncertainty 直接控制组合决策。

closest_work.title: SkillOps: Managing LLM Agent Skill Libraries as Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystems

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Only a substantially richer learned state-transition semantics or another contract object beyond SkillOps's typed precondition/artifact/failure/compatibility representation remains potentially open; ordinary contract induction and adapter insertion do not.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: SkillOps itself, using the same skill traces and library, with its typed contracts, compatibility/dependency checks, adapter insertion, and persistent maintenance loop.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Before any large experiment, reproduce a SkillOps-equivalent baseline on the identical held-out skill-pair/tool split. Test whether the candidate predicts composition failures and repairs them beyond SkillOps when both receive the same traces and no test-time contract generation.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep BLOCK if the candidate does not significantly outperform a faithful SkillOps implementation on held-out skill combinations and unseen tools under identical traces, calls, and adapter budget, or if its learned contracts collapse to typed precondition/output compatibility.
unknowns: Whether the proposed state postconditions contain relational environment-state information materially richer than SkillOps's preconditions and typed produced artifacts.
Whether the intended adapter compiler differs algorithmically from SkillOps adapter insertion rather than only in naming or implementation.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Run SkillOps-style typed skill contracts, compatibility checking, dependency stitching, and adapter insertion on the same traces and skill library.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A contract object encoding and learning consequential state semantics that SkillOps-style precondition/artifact/failure contracts cannot represent or reproduce.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Contract induction detects incompatible assumptions and adapter compilation repairs them before composition, but this complete loop is already implemented by the closest prior work.

problem.zh: 工具 schema 只描述参数，很少显式表示调用前置条件、状态效应和可恢复错误。
problem.en: Tool schemas describe arguments but rarely encode operational preconditions, state effects, and recoverable errors.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从成功/失败调用对和环境差分中归纳可执行工具契约，学习 precondition/effect/error-transition，并在规划前约束调用。
exact_mechanism.en: Induce executable tool contracts from success/failure calls and environment diffs, learning preconditions, effects, and error transitions that constrain planning before calls.

learning_signal.zh: 调用轨迹、状态差分、错误码和环境验证。
learning_signal.en: Tool traces, state diffs, error codes, and environment validation.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见任务和 API 版本上的非法调用率与任务成功。
independent_ground_truth.en: Invalid-call rate and task success on unseen tasks and API versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 原始 schema、自然语言工具说明、经验记忆、手写规则。
strongest_baseline.en: Raw schemas, natural-language tool descriptions, experience memory, and handwritten rules.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个可验证状态的工具环境中学习契约，完整留出工具和 API 版本。
decisive_pilot.en: Learn contracts in two verifiable tool environments and hold out tools and API versions completely.

stop_condition.zh: 契约不能跨版本迁移，或原始 schema+反思同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if contracts do not transfer across versions or raw schema plus reflection is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 状态差分归纳真实工具语义，契约执行把语义变成持久规划约束。
necessity_logic.en: State-difference induction learns actual tool semantics and contract enforcement turns them into persistent planning constraints.

external_reviews.finding: Contract2Tool is a direct pre-cutoff collision with the core thesis. It explicitly observes that standard tool schemas specify how to call tools rather than when they are appropriate or what state they produce, then learns normalized tool contracts containing preconditions and effects from metadata, documentation, schemas, and execution traces and deploys those contracts inside downstream tool filtering. The candidate's transition induction plus contract enforcement differs mainly in evidence emphasis and planning language, not in the learned object or failure loop. Holding out API versions is a stronger evaluation protocol, not a new mechanism.
external_reviews.finding_zh: Contract2Tool 在截止日期前已经直接覆盖该候选的核心命题。它明确指出普通 tool schema 只描述“怎么调用”，却没有描述“什么时候可调用”以及“会产生什么状态效果”，随后从 metadata、documentation、schema 和 execution trace 中学习包含 precondition/effect 的规范化 tool contract，并将这些 contract 用于下游工具过滤。因此本候选的 transition induction + contract enforcement 与其主要只是证据来源侧重和规划表述不同，学习对象和失败闭环没有实质变化。完全留出 API version 是更强的评测边界，但不是新的机制。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not pursue precondition/effect contract induction as the standalone contribution. Either absorb Contract2Tool as the baseline and change the learned object materially—for example to stochastic, history-dependent, or version-drift transition contracts with calibrated uncertainty—or retain this idea only as infrastructure for another thesis.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不要继续把 precondition/effect contract induction 本身作为独立创新。应直接把 Contract2Tool 作为基线，并实质改变学习对象，例如学习带校准不确定性的随机、历史依赖或 version-drift transition contract；否则仅将本方向保留为其他论文的基础设施组件。

closest_work.title: Contract2Tool: Learning Preconditions and Effects for Reliable Tool-Augmented LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The current proposal has no sufficient surviving mechanism difference; unseen API-version transfer and environment-diff supervision strengthen evaluation but do not change the learned precondition/effect contract object.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Contract2Tool trained from the identical schemas, traces, documentation availability, and execution budget, followed by its learned-contract causal tool filtering, plus raw-schema-and-reflection as a simpler control.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: First reproduce Contract2Tool on the same two tool environments and identical held-out-tool/API-version split. Only continue if the proposed transition learner improves unseen-version invalid-call rate and task success under matched evidence and inference budget for a reason traceable to a new contract representation rather than additional supervision.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Maintain BLOCK if a faithful Contract2Tool baseline matches the candidate on unseen tools and API versions under identical evidence and budget, or if removing the candidate-specific representation leaves precondition/effect predictions and downstream planning unchanged.
unknowns: Whether the candidate intends state effects that are stochastic or history-dependent rather than the symbolic effects already learned by Contract2Tool.
Whether environment validation supplies genuinely independent supervision or merely restates the execution traces used for contract induction.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Use Contract2Tool to infer normalized precondition/effect contracts from the same tool evidence and enforce them through its downstream causal tool filtering.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A materially different learned transition object, such as non-stationary or stochastic state effects with calibrated uncertainty, that cannot be represented by Contract2Tool's normalized symbolic contracts.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Transition induction learns operational semantics and enforcement prevents invalid plans, but the same induction-to-enforcement loop is already the central mechanism of Contract2Tool.

problem.zh: 能区分相邻 checkpoint 的任务常被用作评测，但没有反过来用于选择下一轮真正有学习价值的训练任务。
problem.en: Tasks that discriminate adjacent checkpoints are used for evaluation but rarely drive selection of training tasks that causally improve the next checkpoint.

exact_mechanism.zh: 学习任务的 checkpoint 判别力与时间效用，把它作为训练样本价值先验；冻结选择器后分配下一 checkpoint 的训练预算。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn checkpoint discrimination and temporal utility as a prior for training-sample value, then freeze the selector to allocate the next checkpoint's training budget.

learning_signal.zh: 相邻 checkpoint 的 paired outcomes、训练后增益和任务特征。
learning_signal.en: Paired adjacent-checkpoint outcomes, post-training gains, and task features.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 后续 checkpoint 在留出任务上的因果提升。
independent_ground_truth.en: Causal improvement of later checkpoints on held-out tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: paired IRT、学习进度、失败率课程、随机课程。
strongest_baseline.en: Paired IRT, learning-progress curricula, failure-rate curricula, and random curricula.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两条独立版本流，固定训练样本数，比较下一 checkpoint 的圈外提升。
decisive_pilot.en: Use two independent version streams with fixed training-sample counts and compare out-of-loop improvement of the next checkpoint.

stop_condition.zh: 只能提高评测判别而不能提高训练后表现则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it improves evaluation discrimination but not post-training performance.

necessity_logic.zh: 判别估计器发现正在变化的能力边界，训练分配器把边界信息转化为真正模型更新。
necessity_logic.en: The discrimination estimator locates changing capability boundaries and the allocator turns that information into actual learning updates.

external_reviews.finding: The current thesis is directly pre-empted by Level Up, which explicitly uses a series of models such as periodic checkpoints to identify transitional problems relative to model ability and shows that training on appropriately calibrated next-level problems efficiently improves the model. RAISE independently learns a task-objective-driven instruction selector based on expected contribution to performance improvement. Combining a Level Up-style adjacent-checkpoint transitional score with a trivial fixed-budget top-k allocator reproduces the central claim without the proposed persistent curriculum registry, so the present learning object does not survive simplification.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 当前 thesis 与 Level Up 发生直接碰撞：该工作明确使用一系列模型（包括 periodic checkpoints）来识别相对于模型能力的 transitional problems，并验证训练“下一层级”的适配问题能够更高效地提升模型。RAISE 又独立学习了以预期性能增益为目标的 instruction selector。用 Level Up 式相邻 checkpoint transitional score 再配一个固定预算 top-k 分配器，就能复现本候选的核心主张，不需要所谓 persistent curriculum registry，因此当前学习对象无法通过简化挑战。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not continue the current formulation as a standalone method. A revival must introduce a different persistent learned object, such as a cross-lineage transition operator that predicts causal training value on unseen model/version streams after conditioning out Level Up-style transitional difficulty and direct post-training utility, and must beat both components under identical sample counts.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不要以当前形式继续作为独立方法。若 revival，必须引入不同的持久学习对象，例如能够在未见模型/版本流上预测因果训练价值的 cross-lineage transition operator，并在控制 Level Up 式 transitional difficulty 与直接 post-training utility 后仍有独立增益；同时必须在相同样本数下击败两类现有方法。

closest_work.title: Level Up: Defining and Exploiting Transitional Problems for Curriculum Learning
RAISE: Reinforenced Adaptive Instruction Selection For Large Language Models

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Only the specific use of a learned temporal-utility prior and frozen transfer across independent version streams remains, which is insufficient as currently defined because direct utility selection and transitional-problem curricula already erase the claimed mechanism.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Level Up-style transitional-problem curriculum selection from the same adjacent checkpoints, with fixed top-k budget allocation and the same number of training examples; additionally compare to RAISE-style direct expected-improvement selection.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: On two independent model-version streams, use identical candidate samples and fixed training counts to compare the proposed selector against Level Up transitional scoring and direct expected-improvement selection; measure only out-of-loop next-checkpoint gains on held-out tasks and lineages.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the current branch if Level Up-style transitional selection or direct expected-improvement selection matches the proposed selector within the pre-registered equivalence margin on either independent version stream.
unknowns: Whether the proposed temporal-utility signal contains information not already captured by transitional-problem scores and direct post-training gain estimates.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Compute a Level Up-style transitional score from adjacent checkpoints and allocate the fixed next-round budget to the top-scoring samples; no learned temporal-utility registry or separate allocator is required.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A transferable causal sample-value operator that predicts next-checkpoint gains beyond checkpoint-relative transitional difficulty and direct expected-utility selection.

removable_components: training-budget-allocator as a learned component; fixed top-k allocation over checkpoint-relative transitional scores is capacity-matched
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The proposed estimator-to-allocator loop targets a real training-selection problem, but the loop is already closed by existing checkpoint-relative curriculum scoring plus ordinary budget allocation.

problem.zh: 多 Agent 通信图进化后，局部性能提升可能牺牲旧任务中的信息路径和容错。
problem.en: Evolving a multi-agent communication graph can improve local performance while breaking information paths and fault tolerance on mastered tasks.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对候选拓扑编辑执行边级归因重放和留出任务连通性测试，学习允许的拓扑变更信赖域并将失败编辑写入禁配约束。
exact_mechanism.en: Run edge-attribution replay and held-out connectivity tests for candidate topology edits, learn a trust region over allowable graph changes, and persist failed edits as incompatibility constraints.

learning_signal.zh: 候选图编辑、边级贡献、留出任务和故障注入结果。
learning_signal.en: Candidate graph edits, edge contributions, held-out tasks, and failure-injection outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未来任务上的成功率、通信成本和故障恢复。
independent_ground_truth.en: Future-task success, communication cost, and fault recovery.

strongest_baseline.zh: 无门控拓扑搜索、固定图、普通 Regression-Gated、随机回滚。
strongest_baseline.en: Ungated topology search, fixed graphs, generic Regression-Gated, and random rollback.

decisive_pilot.zh: 4 轮拓扑进化，匹配调用预算，测试新任务与旧任务双向回归。
decisive_pilot.en: Run four topology-evolution rounds under matched call budgets and test both new-task gain and old-task regression.

stop_condition.zh: 不能减少拓扑更新后的旧任务回归，或限制过强导致无改进则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not reduce old-task regression after topology updates or blocks nearly all useful changes.

necessity_logic.zh: 边信用定义哪些路径不可破坏，信赖域约束实际拓扑更新；普通门控没有结构级约束。
necessity_logic.en: Edge credit identifies paths that must be preserved and the trust region constrains actual topology updates; generic gating lacks graph-structural constraints.

external_reviews.finding: QueenBee Planner is a direct collision with the proposed learning object: it freezes workers, evolves communication DAGs, performs held-out acceptance, variance-aware/motif-level credit, transfer trust and falsification, and persists Preserve/Modify/Avoid design rules so failed topology patterns constrain future generation. Adding old-task regression and failure-injection metrics to that acceptance gate is a capacity-matched simplification of the proposed edge-credit replay plus graph trust region. The candidate's current trust-region wording therefore does not establish a distinct learning operator.
external_reviews.finding_zh: QueenBee Planner 与该候选的学习对象直接碰撞：它冻结 worker、进化通信 DAG，使用 held-out acceptance、variance-aware/motif-level credit、transfer trust 与 falsification，并持久化 Preserve/Modify/Avoid 设计规则，使失败拓扑模式约束未来图生成。只需在其 acceptance gate 中加入旧任务回归与 failure-injection 指标，就得到一个容量匹配的简化版，足以替代本候选的 edge-credit replay + graph trust region。因此当前“trust region”表述尚未形成独立学习算子。
external_reviews.required_action: Block this formulation and retain it as a regression-governance component. To revive it, define a mathematically or operationally distinct edit-space trust-region operator—for example, interventionally estimated edge influence constraints followed by projection of candidate edits into a certified feasible set—and show that QueenBee-style Preserve/Modify/Avoid rules plus held-out regression gating cannot reproduce fault-recovery guarantees at the same budget.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 阻止当前形式，将其保留为 regression-governance 组件。若 revival，需要定义数学上或操作上真正不同的 edit-space trust-region 算子，例如用干预估计 edge influence constraints，再把候选编辑投影到可认证的 feasible set；并证明 QueenBee 式 Preserve/Modify/Avoid 规则加 held-out regression gate 在相同预算下无法复现 fault-recovery 保证。

closest_work.title: QueenBee Planner: Skill-Evolving Communication Topologies for Token-Efficient LLM Multi-Agent Systems
AgentNet: Decentralized Evolutionary Coordination for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The only plausible remaining boundary is an explicit local trust-region geometry or certified projection for graph edits that targets mastered-task preservation and injected-fault recovery, rather than persistent design rules and acceptance gates.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: QueenBee Planner with its existing attribution, held-out acceptance, transfer trust and Avoid-rule memory, augmented only with the same old-task regression and failure-injection metrics used by the candidate.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Across four matched-budget topology-evolution rounds, compare against QueenBee augmented with identical old-task and fault-injection acceptance metrics; require a pre-registered reduction in mastered-task regression and improved fault recovery at matched new-task gain, communication cost, and edit acceptance rate.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if QueenBee plus regression/fault acceptance matches the proposed guard, if the learned trust region rejects nearly all beneficial edits, or if edge-credit estimates do not transfer across held-out tasks/topology motifs.
unknowns: Whether the intended trust region has any representation or update rule beyond a learned/generic acceptance gate.
Whether edge contributions are causally identifiable under interacting communication paths without prohibitively many interventions.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Run QueenBee Planner unchanged except score candidate topology edits on both new-task utility and old-task/failure-injection regression, reject edits outside fixed thresholds, and persist rejected motifs as Avoid rules.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A distinct learned feasible-set or projection operator over graph edits that provides regression/fault-tolerance behavior not reproducible by held-out acceptance gating plus persistent Avoid rules.

removable_components: graph-trust-region as currently specified; it can be replaced by held-out acceptance thresholds plus persistent Avoid constraints
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The proposed loop detects damaging topology edits and constrains future edits, but QueenBee already closes essentially the same credit-to-persistent-topology-constraint loop.

problem.zh: 自进化系统经常重复训练明显失败样本，而不是学习当前能力边界附近最有价值的反例。
problem.en: Self-evolving systems often retrain on obvious failures rather than counterexamples near the current capability boundary.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从最近版本的成功/失败对学习边界表示，生成最小扰动的近边界任务，并只保留独立验证器确认能区分当前/上一版本的样本进入训练。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn a boundary representation from recent success/failure pairs, generate minimally perturbed near-boundary tasks, and admit only independently verified samples that distinguish current from previous versions.

learning_signal.zh: 版本差异、生成任务和独立可解性/正确性验证。
learning_signal.en: Version differences, generated tasks, and independent solvability/correctness verification.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 下一版本在留出分布上的提升与遗忘。
independent_ground_truth.en: Next-version improvement and forgetting on held-out distributions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 失败重放、难度课程、随机增强、Counterexample-Generating Curriculum。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure replay, difficulty curricula, random augmentation, and Counterexample-Generating Curriculum.

decisive_pilot.zh: 固定生成和训练预算，两个模型三 seed，比较圈外增益与遗忘。
decisive_pilot.en: Fix generation and training budgets, use two models and three seeds, and compare out-of-loop gain and forgetting.

stop_condition.zh: 边界生成不优于失败重放，或只提升生成器同分布任务则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if boundary generation does not beat failure replay or improves only generator-matched tasks.

necessity_logic.zh: 边界模型决定生成位置，独立验证器确保样本不是无效难题；两者共同把失败前沿变成训练信号。
necessity_logic.en: The boundary model chooses where to generate and the independent verifier prevents invalid hard examples; together they turn the failure frontier into training signal.

external_reviews.finding: The broad thesis is already directly occupied by 2025-2026 capability-frontier data-generation work. PROPEL explicitly trains a task generator toward a target solver's learnable frontier with validity gating, AgentFrontier synthesizes ZPD/frontier tasks, and Frontier Learning targets training at the edge of capability. The candidate's current-versus-previous-version criterion is a narrower distinction, but the listed boundary model still fails simplification: generate a candidate pool, independently verify it, and retain examples on which adjacent versions disagree. That rejection sampler implements the central selection rule without learning a boundary representation. ([arXiv][4])
external_reviews.finding_zh: “在能力前沿生成训练任务”这一宽泛论文主张已经被 2025-2026 年的工作直接占据。PROPEL 已明确训练生成器去寻找目标 solver 的可学习前沿并加入有效性门控，AgentFrontier 直接生成 ZPD/能力前沿任务，Frontier Learning 也聚焦能力边缘训练。候选方案新增的“当前版本与上一版本差异”更窄，但 boundary model 仍未通过简化挑战：生成候选、独立验证，然后仅保留相邻版本表现不同的任务，就能实现核心筛选原则而无需学习边界表示。

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Explicit adjacent-version discrimination and minimal perturbation remain different details, but neither is currently formulated as a non-reducible learning operator distinct from frontier generation plus disagreement filtering.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: PROPEL-style frontier generation or the candidate's own generator followed by independent validity checking and direct current-versus-previous disagreement filtering, with exactly matched generation calls, solver executions, retained-example count, and downstream training tokens.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: At fixed generator, verifier, solver-call, and training budgets, compare the full learned boundary against direct adjacent-version disagreement filtering and a PROPEL-style frontier score. Freeze the generated curriculum, train two model families with three seeds, and evaluate gains and forgetting on held-out domains and a generator-independent test set.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep this idea blocked if direct disagreement filtering or PROPEL-style frontier selection matches the full method within 1 percentage point of held-out improvement and forgetting, or if gains disappear on generator-independent tasks.
unknowns: Whether adjacent-version disagreement reflects learnable progress rather than stochasticity, regressions, or benchmark noise.
Whether minimal perturbations remain semantically valid and independently solvable.
Whether the verifier is independent enough to prevent generator-verifier co-adaptation.
Whether a version-contrastive representation transfers across model families.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Use the same task generator and independent verifier, execute every valid candidate on the current and previous models, and retain a fixed-budget band of tasks where their correctness differs; train on those tasks without learning any boundary representation.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned version-contrastive boundary representation that predicts future learning progress on held-out domains or models beyond what raw current-versus-previous disagreement can select.

problem.zh: Reward 模型会在策略进化后出现新 shortcut，但只做不变性审计不能修复评价器。
problem.en: Reward models develop new shortcuts after policy evolution, while invariance audits alone cannot repair the evaluator.

exact_mechanism.zh: 独立生成 evaluator 与环境真值分歧的锚点反例，训练小型修正头使因果方向一致、中性变换不变，并用留出策略冻结验证。
exact_mechanism.en: Generate independent anchor counterexamples where evaluator and environment disagree; train a small correction head for causal-direction agreement and neutral invariance, then freeze on held-out policies.

learning_signal.zh: 锚点反例、环境真值和 evaluator 分数。
learning_signal.en: Anchor counterexamples, environment truth, and evaluator scores.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见策略版本上的真实候选选择与 shortcut 鲁棒性。
independent_ground_truth.en: True candidate selection and shortcut robustness on unseen policy versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 冻结 Reward、PRISM/CROME 式审计、普通 Pairwise Fine-tuning。
strongest_baseline.en: Frozen reward, PRISM/CROME-style audits, and ordinary pairwise fine-tuning.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个策略版本训练，一个未来策略版本冻结测试，严格分离反例生成器和最终评测。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on two policy versions and freeze-test on a future version, separating counterexample generation from final evaluation.

stop_condition.zh: 只改善锚点集而不改善未来策略选择则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it improves only anchor sets without improving future policy selection.

necessity_logic.zh: 独立锚点暴露新 shortcut，修正头把审计证据内化为持久评价器更新。
necessity_logic.en: Independent anchors expose new shortcuts and the correction head internalizes audit evidence into persistent evaluator updates.

external_reviews.finding: The move from auditing to persistent repair is substantively useful, but the proposed mechanism is already crowded by direct reward-model repair work. REFORM discovers reward-inconsistent adversarial examples and fine-tunes the reward model, PRISM explicitly targets shortcut behavior through invariance, and policy-feedback reward modeling addresses reward-model mismatch as the policy distribution evolves. Given the same environment-labeled disagreement examples, an ordinary same-size calibration head trained with pairwise loss is also a strong erasing simplification; the proposal does not yet identify what causal-direction agreement plus neutral invariance learns that this simpler correction cannot. ([ACL Anthology][6])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 从“只做审计”转向“持久修复”本身是实质变化，但当前机制已经与现有 reward-model repair 工作高度拥挤。REFORM 会发现 reward-inconsistent 对抗样本并继续训练奖励模型，PRISM 明确利用不变性处理 shortcut，policy-feedback reward modeling 也针对策略分布演化后的奖励模型失配。更关键的是，给定完全相同的环境真实标签与 evaluator 分歧样本，一个同等容量、采用普通 pairwise loss 的校准头就是很强的消融基线；当前方案尚未证明“因果方向一致性 + neutral invariance”能够学习到该简单修正头无法获得的东西。
external_reviews.required_action: Keep this as a component or baseline unless it is rebuilt around a distinct intervention-identifiable shortcut representation. A viable revival must learn causal shortcut directions from interventions and show zero-shot or low-shot correction of unseen shortcut classes and unseen policy versions that ordinary calibration, REFORM-style adversarial repair, PRISM-style invariance, and policy-feedback adaptation cannot reproduce.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 除非围绕一种可通过干预独立识别的 shortcut 表示重新构建，否则更适合作为组件或基线。可行的复活版本需要通过干预学习因果 shortcut 方向，并证明其能在未见 shortcut 类别和未见策略版本上实现普通校准、REFORM 式对抗修复、PRISM 式不变性训练以及 policy-feedback adaptation 都无法复现的零样本或低样本修正。

closest_work.title: Teach a Reward Model to Correct Itself: Reward Guided Adversarial Failure Discovery for Robust Reward Modeling
Rectifying Shortcut Behaviors in Preference-based Reward Learning
Reinforcement Reward Model with Policy Feedback

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining distinction is an independently environment-grounded small correction head combining directional and neutral-invariance constraints, but those ingredients are not yet shown to produce behavior unavailable from standard supervised correction on the same counterexamples.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A same-parameter correction head trained on exactly the same environment-labeled evaluator disagreements using ordinary pairwise loss, plus REFORM-style adversarial failure discovery, PRISM-style shortcut regularization, and a policy-feedback adaptation baseline under matched example and optimization budgets.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train all methods on counterexamples from two policy versions, freeze them, and evaluate a third policy version produced by a different optimizer or model family. Use a sequestered counterexample generator plus naturally occurring policy outputs for final evaluation. Match correction-head size, labeled anchors, optimization steps, and evaluator calls, and measure true candidate-selection regret and robustness to shortcut classes absent from training.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep the idea blocked if the ordinary pairwise correction head or REFORM-style repair is within 1 percentage point of future-policy candidate-selection accuracy, or if gains are confined to the generated anchor distribution and disappear on natural or unseen-shortcut evaluations.
unknowns: Whether environment truth is genuinely independent of the evaluator and counterexample generator.
Whether the proposed causal direction can be identified rather than merely correlated with the observed shortcut.
Whether neutral-invariance constraints improve future-policy selection beyond standard supervised calibration.
Whether unseen policy versions introduce genuinely new shortcut mechanisms rather than ordinary distribution shift.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Mine the same evaluator-versus-environment disagreement examples and train a correction head of identical parameter count using ordinary pairwise classification or regression loss, with the same data, labels, optimization steps, and frozen future-policy evaluation.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: An intervention-identified causal shortcut representation whose correction transfers to previously unseen shortcut mechanisms and policy versions beyond ordinary environment-supervised calibration.

removable_components: independent-anchor-generation
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Persistent correction closes the audit-to-update loop, but bespoke anchor generation is not necessary if ordinary disagreement or adversarial mining supplies equally effective environment-labeled repair examples.

title.zh: 工作流反例模板挖掘器

problem.zh: 工作流修复常只看到失败实例，缺少能区分正确和错误结构的最小反例模板。
problem.en: Workflow repair sees failure instances but lacks minimal counterexample templates that separate valid from invalid structures.

exact_mechanism.zh: 通过结构删除/替换寻找最小故障保持子图，聚合为类型化反例模板，并用模板指导未来修复与测试生成。
exact_mechanism.en: Find minimal failure-preserving subgraphs via structural deletion/substitution, aggregate them into typed counterexample templates, and use them to guide future repair and test generation.

learning_signal.zh: 最小故障子图、匹配正例和修复后结果。
learning_signal.en: Minimal failure subgraphs, matched positives, and post-repair outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见工作流上的故障召回、修复效率和误报率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Failure recall, repair efficiency, and false-positive rate on unseen workflows.

strongest_baseline.zh: 失败日志聚类、图异常检测、最近故障检索、手写 motif。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure-log clustering, graph anomaly detection, nearest-failure retrieval, and handwritten motifs.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个工作流环境中学习模板，按 motif 和 API 双重留出测试。
decisive_pilot.en: Learn templates in two workflow environments and evaluate with motif/API double holdout.

stop_condition.zh: 模板不比日志聚类提高圈外修复效率，或误报高则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if templates do not improve out-of-loop repair efficiency over log clustering or false positives are high.

necessity_logic.zh: 最小反例提取给出结构因果边界，模板复用使其成为未来持久知识。
necessity_logic.en: Minimal counterexample extraction identifies structural causal boundaries and template reuse turns them into persistent future knowledge.

external_reviews.finding: The problem and persistent template library are coherent, but the current idea is too close to an existing failure-localization-and-repair stack to support a standalone thesis. Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement already builds recurring failure structure from counterexamples and performs targeted workflow edits; AgenTracer uses counterfactual interventions to localize causal failure points; CausalFlow likewise performs interventional failure attribution and counterfactual repair. Replacing explicit minimal-subgraph mining with failure-signature clustering plus nearest-counterexample retrieval is a strong same-budget simplification, leaving 'typed templates' primarily as a representation choice unless their minimality produces a separately falsifiable transfer law. ([arXiv][6])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题本身成立，持久的反例模板库也具有一致性，但当前方案与已有“失败定位—修复”路线过于接近，尚不足以成为独立论文。Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement 已经从反例中归纳重复失败结构并进行针对性的工作流编辑；AgenTracer 使用反事实干预定位因果失败位置；CausalFlow 也执行干预式失败归因与反事实修复。若用失败签名聚类加最近反例检索替代显式的最小子图挖掘，在相同预算下很可能复现主要收益，因此“typed template”目前更像一种表示形式，而不是不可替代的学习机制，除非最小性本身能够带来独立可证伪的迁移规律。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not proceed with the current template-library thesis as a standalone method. A viable revival must materially change the learned object to something stronger than clustered failure motifs, such as a compositional counterexample grammar or certified anti-pattern operators whose learned composition predicts failures and repairs on unseen graph sizes, APIs, and motif combinations without retrieving source counterexamples.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不建议以当前“模板库”形式继续作为独立方法论文。若要复活，必须实质改变学习对象，使其明显强于失败 motif 聚类，例如学习可组合的反例语法或带可验证最小性/因果性的 anti-pattern 算子，并要求它们在不检索原始反例的情况下，对未见图规模、API 和 motif 组合预测失败并指导修复。

closest_work.title: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement
AgenTracer: Who Is Inducing Failure in the LLM Agentic Systems?
CausalFlow: Causal Attribution and Counterfactual Repair for LLM Agent Failures

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The narrow remaining boundary is inclusion-minimal structural counterexamples aggregated into a reusable typed library and evaluated under motif/API double holdout, but minimality has not yet been shown to create capabilities unavailable from existing failure-mode clustering and causal localization.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement-style recurring failure signatures plus causal localization and nearest-failure retrieval, with identical failed/positive traces, repair model, test generator, calls, and token budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Before reviving, construct unseen workflows containing novel compositions of known motifs and unseen APIs, prohibit retrieval of source counterexamples, and compare learned minimal operators against clustered failure signatures; require a pre-registered gain in failure prediction and repair efficiency that persists after matching template/library capacity.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep blocked if clustered failure signatures plus retrieval match the proposed templates on double-holdout failure recall and repair efficiency, or if structural minimality does not predict transfer after controlling for template size and frequency.
unknowns: Whether minimal failure-preserving subgraphs are unique or stable under different valid deletion and substitution sequences.
How typed templates are canonicalized across APIs and semantically equivalent workflow implementations.
Whether template minimality provides information beyond the recurring failure signatures already exploited by existing workflow-refinement methods.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Use the same failed and matched-positive workflows to compute ordinary failure signatures, cluster them, retrieve the nearest cluster exemplars for each new workflow, and feed those exemplars to the identical repair/test generator without extracting minimal subgraphs or compiling typed templates.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A formally or empirically identifiable minimal structural operator whose composition transfers to unseen workflows better than failure clustering, exemplar retrieval, and existing causal-localization methods.

problem.zh: 同一工具能力在不同 API 中返回不同错误语义，迁移后旧恢复策略会静默失效。
problem.en: Equivalent tool capabilities expose different error semantics across APIs, silently breaking recovery policies after migration.

exact_mechanism.zh: 学习跨 API 的错误语义中间表示，将 provider-specific 错误映射为规范恢复状态，并编译目标 API 修复动作。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn an API-invariant error-semantics representation, map provider-specific failures into canonical recovery states, and compile target-API repair actions.

learning_signal.zh: 等价工具的错误轨迹、恢复动作和最终环境结果。
learning_signal.en: Error traces, recovery actions, and final outcomes for semantically equivalent tools.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见 API 家族上的恢复成功率和错误分类一致性。
independent_ground_truth.en: Recovery success and error-class consistency on an unseen API family.

strongest_baseline.zh: 直接 LLM 重写、API-Semantic Workflow Compiler、错误文本检索、人工映射。
strongest_baseline.en: Direct LLM rewrite, API-Semantic Workflow Compiler, error-text retrieval, and manual mapping.

decisive_pilot.zh: 完整留出一个 API 家族，冻结语义表示后迁移恢复策略。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out an entire API family and freeze the semantic representation before transferring recovery policies.

stop_condition.zh: 不能跨 API 家族迁移，或错误文本最近邻同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it cannot transfer across API families or nearest error-text retrieval is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 错误状态归一化解决迁移语义差异，修复编译把规范状态转成目标动作。
necessity_logic.en: Error-state normalization resolves semantic drift and repair compilation converts canonical states to target actions.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real, the adapter is a genuinely persistent learned object, and the held-out-API-family boundary makes the mechanism identifiable. PALADIN already trains transferable tool-failure recovery and reports generalization to unseen tool APIs, while Self-Reflective APIs and Agent-First Tool API normalize or enrich error semantics, but none of the located work learns an explicitly provider-invariant error-state representation from semantically equivalent APIs and then decodes that state into provider-specific repair actions. The thesis survives only if this canonical latent beats a much simpler discrete error-taxonomy classifier plus provider-specific repair templates under the same recovery data and inference budget.

Train the representation only on source API families, freeze it before target-family evaluation, and prevent target API documentation, error strings, or repair traces from leaking into representation learning.

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving boundary is representation-level cross-provider canonicalization learned from equivalent failures, followed by provider-specific repair decoding, rather than generic failure-recovery training, exemplar retrieval, or provider-authored structured errors.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: PALADIN-style failure-trained recovery plus nearest-error retrieval, and a fixed canonical error classifier with provider-specific repair templates, all trained on the identical source traces and evaluated with identical recovery-call and token budgets.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct at least three semantically overlapping API families, train on two and hold one family out completely. Freeze the error representation and compare recovery success and canonical-state consistency against PALADIN-style recovery, nearest-error retrieval, and fixed-taxonomy-plus-template repair under identical training examples, calls, retries, and tokens.

unknowns: Whether sufficiently many semantically equivalent failures across independent API providers can be labeled without introducing correspondence leakage.
Whether provider-specific repair decoding remains identifiable when multiple distinct repairs can recover from the same canonical error state.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Classify each raw failure into a fixed canonical error taxonomy, then execute a provider-specific templated repair selected from the same training traces; use exactly the same API calls, recovery attempts, tokens, and training examples.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned cross-provider error representation whose transfer advantage remains after discrete taxonomy classification and retrieval/template baselines are capacity- and budget-matched.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Error-state induction removes provider-specific semantic drift, while repair compilation converts the invariant state back into an executable target-provider recovery action.

problem.zh: 旧更新可能已被后续更新完全覆盖，但系统仍长期携带它们并承担交互风险。
problem.en: Old updates may be fully shadowed by later updates yet remain deployed and continue to create interaction risk.

exact_mechanism.zh: 周期性做预算受限的禁用干预，识别对留出能力无边际贡献的更新，并在安全证书通过后回收。
exact_mechanism.en: Perform budgeted disable interventions, identify updates with no marginal contribution to held-out capabilities, and garbage-collect them after a safety certificate passes.

learning_signal.zh: 更新禁用干预、留出能力结果和依赖图。
learning_signal.en: Update-disable interventions, held-out capability outcomes, and dependency graph.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 删除后的跨域能力保持和未来交互回归。
independent_ground_truth.en: Cross-domain capability preservation and future interaction regression after deletion.

strongest_baseline.zh: 按年龄删除、最后使用时间、语义冗余、全部保留。
strongest_baseline.en: Age-based deletion, last-use, semantic redundancy, and keep-all.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 12+ 轮版本链上固定干预预算，比较删除率、性能保持和未来冲突。
decisive_pilot.en: Use 12+ round version chains under a fixed intervention budget and compare deletion rate, performance preservation, and future conflicts.

stop_condition.zh: 删除率很低或跨模型出现不可接受回归则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if deletion rate is negligible or cross-model regressions are unacceptable.

necessity_logic.zh: 禁用干预给出边际贡献证据，删除证书避免把一次审计直接当动作。
necessity_logic.en: Disable interventions provide marginal-contribution evidence and the deletion certificate prevents one audit from directly becoming an action.

external_reviews.finding: The persistent-update-debt problem is important and SkillOps independently confirms that persistent libraries need merge, retire, repair, and compatibility maintenance. However, the current mechanism is too close to a budgeted leave-one-update-out ablation followed by held-out validation: calling that intervention causal does not by itself create a new learning operator. More importantly, testing only individual marginal contribution is insufficient for the stated shadowing problem because updates can have higher-order redundancy or become necessary after another deletion. The idea becomes stronger if the learned object is an interaction-aware causal dependency model that predicts safe deletion sets under a fixed intervention budget, rather than a registry modified by repeated ablation tests.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 持久更新债务是真实且重要的问题，SkillOps 也独立说明了长期技能库需要 merge、retire、repair 和 compatibility maintenance。但当前机制基本可以化约为“固定预算下逐个禁用更新做 leave-one-out 消融，再用留出集验证后删除”，仅仅把这种消融称作 causal intervention 并不足以形成新的学习算子。更关键的是，单更新边际贡献无法完整处理题目声称的 shadowing：两个更新可能存在高阶冗余，删除其中一个以后另一个又重新变得必要。建议把真正的持久学习对象改成能够在有限干预算下学习更新间交互关系并预测安全删除集合的因果依赖模型。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace single-update marginal testing with an explicitly interaction-aware deletion objective, for example a sparse dependency/hypergraph or learned set-effect model inferred from budgeted disable interventions. The method must predict deletion sets and then freeze those predictions before independent future-version evaluation; the certificate should remain a safety gate rather than being counted as a separate novelty component.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将单更新边际测试改成显式考虑交互效应的删除目标，例如利用有限 disable interventions 学习稀疏 dependency/hypergraph 或 set-effect model。方法应预测“删除集合”，随后冻结预测并在独立的未来版本上验证；safe-deletion certificate 可以保留为安全门控，但不要把普通留出验证本身当作独立创新。

closest_work.title: SkillOps: Managing LLM Agent Skill Libraries as Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystems

direct_collision.surviving_difference: SkillOps retires low-utility skills and merges redundancy using library-health signals; a genuinely interaction-aware intervention model for causal safe deletion of sequential updates would remain distinct.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: SkillOps-style utility/redundancy retirement plus greedy leave-one-update-out held-out ablation with rollback, using exactly the same intervention count and evaluation episodes.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate 12+ round update chains containing known single-update redundancy, pairwise shadowing, and higher-order interactions. Under a fixed disable-intervention budget, compare the learned interaction model with greedy leave-one-out deletion and SkillOps-style retirement, then freeze the retained set and evaluate unseen domains and subsequent update rounds.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the interaction-aware method does not improve the Pareto frontier of safely deleted updates versus held-out/future regression over the greedy leave-one-out baseline under the same intervention budget, or if its inferred deletion sets are unstable across seeds.
unknowns: Whether the proposed intervention budget is sufficient to identify pairwise or higher-order update interactions.
Whether realistic version chains contain enough truly shadowed updates for deletion to matter beyond ordinary pruning.
How intervention effects will be estimated when disabling an old update changes the applicability of later updates.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Greedy leave-one-update-out ablation on a held-out capability suite, deleting every update whose removal causes no measurable drop and restoring it whenever validation fails.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: An interaction-aware learned operator that identifies jointly removable update sets more accurately or with fewer interventions than greedy leave-one-out testing.

removable_components: safe-deletion-certificate as a claimed method component; ordinary independent held-out validation can serve the same gate
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Disable interventions diagnose whether historical updates still matter, and persistent deletion removes obsolete updates, but the current pair does not identify higher-order update interactions.

title.zh: 多 Agent 消息图进化

problem.zh: 多 Agent 系统通常固定通信拓扑，即使某些消息边在不同任务上持续造成干扰或冗余。
problem.en: Multi-agent systems usually freeze communication topology even when some message edges consistently cause interference or redundancy.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对消息边进行受控遮蔽/替换，学习任务 motif 条件下的边际贡献与交互，周期性增删/定向通信边并冻结到未见任务。
exact_mechanism.en: Intervene on message edges with masking/replacement, learn motif-conditioned marginal and interaction effects, and persistently add/remove/redirect edges before freezing on unseen tasks.

learning_signal.zh: 消息边干预、团队结果、token 成本和任务 motif。
learning_signal.en: Message-edge interventions, team outcomes, token cost, and task motifs.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见任务上的团队成功率、通信成本和单点故障鲁棒性。
independent_ground_truth.en: Team success, communication cost, and single-point-failure robustness on unseen tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定全连接、层级通信、随机稀疏、AFlow/工作流搜索。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed full connectivity, hierarchical communication, random sparsity, and AFlow/workflow search.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个多 Agent benchmark 上做 4–6 轮拓扑更新，匹配 token 和调用预算，冻结后跨任务。
decisive_pilot.en: Run 4–6 topology-update rounds on two multi-agent benchmarks under matched token/call budgets and freeze across tasks.

stop_condition.zh: 收益可由简单稀疏化复现，或跨任务拓扑不稳定则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if simple sparsification reproduces gains or topology is unstable across tasks.

necessity_logic.zh: 边干预提供通信信用，拓扑编辑把信用变成可部署结构；只做 workflow search 无法解释边级必要性。
necessity_logic.en: Edge interventions provide communication credit and topology edits turn it into deployable structure; generic workflow search lacks edge-level necessity.

external_reviews.finding: Communication-topology optimization is already a crowded direct-collision area. GPTSwarm optimizes graph connectivity, AgentPrune prunes redundant or malicious edges, and Adaptive Graph Pruning learns task-adaptive node and edge pruning. Therefore a persistently edited communication graph is not itself a new learned object. The potentially surviving contribution is intervention-based, motif-conditioned causal credit that transfers across tasks. As written, however, that credit estimator can be removed and replaced by direct validation-driven edge scoring or existing graph optimization while preserving the claimed topology improvement. The thesis should therefore move the learned object from the graph to a transferable edge-interaction model.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 通信拓扑优化已经存在非常直接且拥挤的碰撞。GPTSwarm 会优化图连接，AgentPrune 会剪除冗余或恶意通信边，Adaptive Graph Pruning 进一步学习 task-adaptive 的节点和边剪枝，因此“持续修改 multi-agent communication graph”本身已不能构成新的学习对象。当前仍可能成立的创新点是：通过干预得到 motif-conditioned 的边因果贡献模型，并让这个贡献模型跨任务迁移。但按现有描述，edge-intervention-credit 可以被普通 validation-driven edge score 或已有图优化替代，同时仍获得同样的拓扑变化，因此需要把论文核心从‘学图’改成‘学可迁移的边交互效应模型’。
external_reviews.required_action: Change the persistent learned object to a motif-conditioned edge-effect or edge-interaction predictor trained from controlled interventions, and use that frozen predictor to construct graphs for completely unseen tasks. Do not claim novelty from add/remove/redirect graph edits themselves. Compare directly against GPTSwarm, AgentPrune, and an Adaptive-Graph-Pruning-style predictor with matched graph evaluations and token budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将持久学习对象改成由受控干预训练得到的 motif-conditioned edge-effect/edge-interaction predictor，并冻结该预测器后为完全未见任务构建图。不要再把 add/remove/redirect 边本身作为创新。必须在相同图评估次数、LLM 调用和 token 预算下直接对比 GPTSwarm、AgentPrune 和 Adaptive Graph Pruning 类方法。

closest_work.title: GPTSwarm: Language Agents as Optimizable Graphs
Cut the Crap: An Economical Communication Pipeline for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
Adaptive Graph Pruning for Multi-Agent Communication

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Explicit controlled edge interventions could support a task-transferable causal edge-interaction model; persistent topology editing, pruning, and task-conditioned graph generation themselves are already occupied.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: GPTSwarm/AgentPrune/Adaptive-Graph-Pruning-style topology optimization using the same candidate graphs, LLM calls, token budget, training tasks, and graph-evaluation budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train the proposed edge-effect predictor from a fixed number of masking/replacement interventions on one task family, freeze it, and generate communication graphs for held-out task motifs and a second benchmark. Compare against direct validation edge scoring and existing topology optimizers given exactly the same number of graph executions and communication tokens.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if direct edge scoring, AgentPrune, or an Adaptive-Graph-Pruning-style model matches the success-cost-robustness frontier on unseen tasks, or if the learned edge-effect ranking changes substantially across task instances sharing the same declared motif.
unknowns: Whether task motifs can be defined independently of the outcome labels used for edge credit.
Whether masking or replacing a message edge constitutes a faithful intervention rather than creating out-of-distribution agent behavior.
Whether edge interaction effects transfer across model families rather than only across tasks using the same agents.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Score every candidate edge by its validation utility or a learned task-edge score, prune the lowest-value edges under the same evaluation/token budget, and freeze the resulting graph.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A transferable intervention-trained edge-effect model that predicts beneficial and harmful communication interactions on unseen tasks better than direct edge optimization or sparsification.

removable_components: edge-intervention-credit in its current form, because direct edge scoring or graph search can currently replace it
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Edge credit is intended to diagnose harmful communication and topology edits persist the repair, but existing topology optimizers already close the latter loop without the proposed credit mechanism.

problem.zh: 逐实例最小补丁可修复当前更新，但无法复用于新的版本提交。
problem.en: Per-instance minimal patches can fix the current update but do not transfer to new commits.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从失败更新及成功二次补丁中学习条件残差算子，根据更新描述符和失败签名直接生成最小补丁，并冻结到未见提交。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn a conditional residual operator from failed updates and successful second patches; generate minimal patches from update descriptors and failure signatures and freeze it on unseen commits.

learning_signal.zh: 失败更新→最小稳定补丁训练对和独立回归结果。
learning_signal.en: Failed-update to minimal-stabilizing-patch pairs with independent regression outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新提交上的修复成功、补丁大小和圈外回归。
independent_ground_truth.en: Repair success, patch size, and out-of-loop regression on unseen update commits.

strongest_baseline.zh: 联合重优化、HarnessFix、每次重新搜索、最近补丁检索。
strongest_baseline.en: Joint re-optimization, HarnessFix, per-instance search, and nearest-patch retrieval.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按提交级拆分训练/测试，冻结算子后对未见 Prompt/记忆更新生成残差补丁。
decisive_pilot.en: Split by update commit, freeze the operator, and generate residual patches for unseen prompt/memory updates.

stop_condition.zh: 不能超过容量匹配联合重优化或最近补丁检索则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat capacity-matched joint re-optimization or nearest-patch retrieval.

necessity_logic.zh: 补丁对暴露跨提交规律，冻结残差算子提供真正迁移；逐实例搜索不能替代。
necessity_logic.en: Patch pairs expose cross-commit structure and the frozen residual operator provides true transfer; per-instance search cannot replace it.

external_reviews.finding: Cross-commit transfer is a meaningful improvement over per-instance patch search, but the current operator is still underspecified as a generic conditional patch generator trained on failed-update/successful-second-patch pairs. Learning to Evolve already meta-learns from historical optimization successes and failures to propose future agent-system updates, while RiOT performs residual prompt refinement to preserve useful prior content. Their combination places substantial pressure on the claimed novelty. A standalone thesis requires a non-removable residual operator with an explicit structured locality/composition constraint, not merely supervised fine-tuning of a model to emit the next patch.

external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Split completely by update commit and preferably by update type. Whether patch minimality correlates with future stability rather than merely reducing edit size.

problem.zh: 技能在单任务中有效，但组合或跨工具时常因输入/状态假设不一致而失败。
problem.en: Skills can work alone but fail in composition or across tools because their input and state assumptions mismatch.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从技能执行轨迹归纳类型化输入契约、状态后置条件和错误出口，编译兼容检查与必要的接口适配器后再允许组合。
exact_mechanism.en: Induce typed input contracts, state postconditions, and error exits from skill traces, then compile compatibility checks and minimal interface adapters before composition.

learning_signal.zh: 技能轨迹、状态差分、组合成功/失败和工具 schema。
learning_signal.en: Skill traces, state diffs, composition success/failure, and tool schemas.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见技能组合和未见工具上的组合成功率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Composition success on unseen skill combinations and unseen tools.

strongest_baseline.zh: SkillCAT、SkCC、schema 匹配、测试时 LLM 修复。
strongest_baseline.en: SkillCAT, SkCC, schema matching, and test-time LLM repair.

decisive_pilot.zh: 完整留出技能对和工具，禁止测试时新写契约，比较组合成功与适配成本。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out skill pairs and tools completely, forbid test-time contract generation, and compare composition success plus adaptation cost.

stop_condition.zh: 契约不能预测并修复未见组合，或 schema 匹配同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if contracts cannot predict and repair unseen compositions or schema matching is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 契约归纳识别接口不匹配，适配器编译把不匹配转换为可执行桥接；仅检测不解决组合失败。
necessity_logic.en: Contract induction identifies interface mismatch and adapter compilation turns mismatch into executable bridges; detection alone does not repair composition.

external_reviews.finding: This candidate directly collides with SkillOps. SkillOps represents skills using typed contracts containing preconditions, operations, artifacts, validators, and failure modes; mines contract information from execution logs; checks dependency and compatibility before composition; inserts adapters for incompatible interfaces; and persistently maintains the skill library. Those elements cover the proposed contract induction plus compatibility checking plus adapter compilation loop almost verbatim. Explicit state postconditions and stronger held-out-tool evaluation are useful extensions, but they do not presently create a distinct ICLR method thesis.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该候选与 SkillOps 构成直接碰撞。SkillOps 已经用包含 precondition、operation、artifact、validator、failure mode 的 typed contract 表示技能，从执行日志中维护/挖掘 contract 信息，在组合前检查 dependency 和 compatibility，并在接口不兼容时插入 adapter，同时持久维护 skill library。这基本覆盖了本候选的“contract induction + compatibility checking + adapter compilation”完整闭环。显式 state postcondition 以及更严格的未见工具迁移可以作为扩展实验，但目前不足以形成独立 ICLR 方法论文。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not pursue the current formulation as a standalone method. Retain it as a component or baseline unless the learned object is materially changed beyond SkillOps, for example toward a probabilistic relational state-transition contract that predicts latent cross-skill side effects unavailable from typed input/output compatibility and whose learned uncertainty directly controls composition.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不要以当前形式继续作为独立方法。可保留为组件或基线；只有在学习对象实质超出 SkillOps 时才值得复活，例如学习 typed I/O compatibility 无法表达的概率关系型状态转移 contract，预测跨技能隐式副作用，并让 contract uncertainty 直接控制组合决策。

external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Before any large experiment, reproduce a SkillOps-equivalent baseline on the identical held-out skill-pair/tool split. Test whether the candidate predicts composition failures and repairs them beyond SkillOps when both receive the same traces and no test-time contract generation.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep BLOCK if the candidate does not significantly outperform a faithful SkillOps implementation on held-out skill combinations and unseen tools under identical traces, calls, and adapter budget, or if its learned contracts collapse to typed precondition/output compatibility.
unknowns: Whether the proposed state postconditions contain relational environment-state information materially richer than SkillOps's preconditions and typed produced artifacts.
Whether the intended adapter compiler differs algorithmically from SkillOps adapter insertion rather than only in naming or implementation.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Run SkillOps-style typed skill contracts, compatibility checking, dependency stitching, and adapter insertion on the same traces and skill library.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A contract object encoding and learning consequential state semantics that SkillOps-style precondition/artifact/failure contracts cannot represent or reproduce.

problem.zh: 工具 schema 只描述参数，很少显式表示调用前置条件、状态效应和可恢复错误。
problem.en: Tool schemas describe arguments but rarely encode operational preconditions, state effects, and recoverable errors.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从成功/失败调用对和环境差分中归纳可执行工具契约，学习 precondition/effect/error-transition，并在规划前约束调用。
exact_mechanism.en: Induce executable tool contracts from success/failure calls and environment diffs, learning preconditions, effects, and error transitions that constrain planning before calls.

learning_signal.zh: 调用轨迹、状态差分、错误码和环境验证。
learning_signal.en: Tool traces, state diffs, error codes, and environment validation.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见任务和 API 版本上的非法调用率与任务成功。
independent_ground_truth.en: Invalid-call rate and task success on unseen tasks and API versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 原始 schema、自然语言工具说明、经验记忆、手写规则。
strongest_baseline.en: Raw schemas, natural-language tool descriptions, experience memory, and handwritten rules.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个可验证状态的工具环境中学习契约，完整留出工具和 API 版本。
decisive_pilot.en: Learn contracts in two verifiable tool environments and hold out tools and API versions completely.

stop_condition.zh: 契约不能跨版本迁移，或原始 schema+反思同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if contracts do not transfer across versions or raw schema plus reflection is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 状态差分归纳真实工具语义，契约执行把语义变成持久规划约束。
necessity_logic.en: State-difference induction learns actual tool semantics and contract enforcement turns them into persistent planning constraints.

external_reviews.finding: Contract2Tool is a direct pre-cutoff collision with the core thesis. It explicitly observes that standard tool schemas specify how to call tools rather than when they are appropriate or what state they produce, then learns normalized tool contracts containing preconditions and effects from metadata, documentation, schemas, and execution traces and deploys those contracts inside downstream tool filtering. The candidate's transition induction plus contract enforcement differs mainly in evidence emphasis and planning language, not in the learned object or failure loop. Holding out API versions is a stronger evaluation protocol, not a new mechanism.
external_reviews.finding_zh: Contract2Tool 在截止日期前已经直接覆盖该候选的核心命题。它明确指出普通 tool schema 只描述“怎么调用”，却没有描述“什么时候可调用”以及“会产生什么状态效果”，随后从 metadata、documentation、schema 和 execution trace 中学习包含 precondition/effect 的规范化 tool contract，并将这些 contract 用于下游工具过滤。因此本候选的 transition induction + contract enforcement 与其主要只是证据来源侧重和规划表述不同，学习对象和失败闭环没有实质变化。完全留出 API version 是更强的评测边界，但不是新的机制。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not pursue precondition/effect contract induction as the standalone contribution. Either absorb Contract2Tool as the baseline and change the learned object materially—for example to stochastic, history-dependent, or version-drift transition contracts with calibrated uncertainty—or retain this idea only as infrastructure for another thesis.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不要继续把 precondition/effect contract induction 本身作为独立创新。应直接把 Contract2Tool 作为基线，并实质改变学习对象，例如学习带校准不确定性的随机、历史依赖或 version-drift transition contract；否则仅将本方向保留为其他论文的基础设施组件。

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The current proposal has no sufficient surviving mechanism difference; unseen API-version transfer and environment-diff supervision strengthen evaluation but do not change the learned precondition/effect contract object.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Contract2Tool trained from the identical schemas, traces, documentation availability, and execution budget, followed by its learned-contract causal tool filtering, plus raw-schema-and-reflection as a simpler control.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: First reproduce Contract2Tool on the same two tool environments and identical held-out-tool/API-version split. external_reviews.stop_rule: Maintain BLOCK if a faithful Contract2Tool baseline matches the candidate on unseen tools and API versions under identical evidence and budget, or if removing the candidate-specific representation leaves precondition/effect predictions and downstream planning unchanged.
unknowns: Whether the candidate intends state effects that are stochastic or history-dependent rather than the symbolic effects already learned by Contract2Tool.

simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A materially different learned transition object, such as non-stationary or stochastic state effects with calibrated uncertainty, that cannot be represented by Contract2Tool's normalized symbolic contracts.
