problem.zh: 重复工作流结构故障每次重新搜索补丁，无法跨 API 或图结构复用。
problem.en: Recurring structural workflow failures are patched from scratch and do not transfer across APIs or graph motifs.

exact_mechanism.zh: 在冻结的结构重写语言中从失败/修复图差分归纳产生式，学习触发条件和局部重写，禁止测试时重新搜索。
exact_mechanism.en: Induce productions from failure/repair graph diffs in a frozen structural rewrite language, learn triggers and local rewrites, and prohibit test-time search.

learning_signal.zh: 工作流图差分、失败 motif 和独立验证的修复成功结果。
learning_signal.en: Workflow graph diffs, failure motifs, and independently verified post-repair success.

independent_ground_truth.zh: API-disjoint 与 motif-disjoint 工作流上的冻结重写成功。
independent_ground_truth.en: Frozen rewrite success on API-disjoint and motif-disjoint workflows.

strongest_baseline.zh: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement、HarnessFix、图差分检索、测试时搜索。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement, HarnessFix, graph-diff retrieval, and test-time search.

decisive_pilot.zh: 训练/测试按 API 和 motif 双重留出，禁止测试时生成新规则。
decisive_pilot.en: Use double holdout by API and motif and forbid new rule generation at test time.

stop_condition.zh: 产生式不能组合泛化，或最近图差分检索同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if productions do not compositionally generalize or nearest graph-diff retrieval is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 图差分抽象提炼局部结构变化，语法归纳使变化可在未见结构上组合复用。
necessity_logic.en: Graph-diff abstraction isolates structural changes and grammar induction enables compositional reuse on unseen structures.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real and the learned object is persistent. Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement and HarnessFix already convert recurring trace failures into localized structural graph or harness edits, while WISE-Flow induces reusable workflows, but the checked work does not establish the same frozen repair grammar learned from repair graph diffs with zero test-time rule generation and joint API-disjoint plus motif-disjoint compositional transfer. The thesis therefore survives, but only if production composition—not retrieval or template instantiation—causes the held-out gain.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实，且学习对象具有持久性。Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement 与 HarnessFix 已能把重复轨迹失败转成局部结构化图/框架修复，WISE-Flow 也会诱导可复用工作流；但已核查工作尚未覆盖“从修复前后图差分中学习冻结的修复文法，并在测试时禁止新规则生成，同时跨 API 与跨 motif 组合迁移”这一完整边界。因此该题可以成立，但必须证明收益来自 production 的组合泛化，而不是检索或模板实例化。
external_reviews.required_action: Pre-register a capacity-matched canonical graph-diff retrieval/template-instantiation baseline using exactly the same repaired pairs, model calls, tokens, and validation budget. Freeze the production inventory before evaluation, use a crossed API-by-motif holdout, and report production-level reuse/composition so that a successful unseen repair can be attributed to the grammar rather than semantic nearest-neighbor reuse.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 预注册一个容量匹配的“规范化 graph-diff 检索 + 模板实例化”基线，使用完全相同的修复对、模型调用、token 与验证预算。评测前冻结 production 集合，采用 API×motif 交叉留出，并报告 production 级复用/组合证据，使未见修复的成功能够归因于文法而非语义近邻复用。

closest_work.title: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement
From Failed Trajectories to Reliable LLM Agents: Diagnosing and Repairing Harness Flaws
WISE-Flow: Workflow-Induced Structured Experience for Self-Evolving Conversational Service Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving boundary is frozen graph-rewrite production induction with no test-time search and demonstrated systematic composition on workflows disjoint in both API and structural motif.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement or HarnessFix-style failure localization followed by canonical graph-diff template retrieval/instantiation under the identical repair and validation budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train on a factorial subset of API families and graph motifs, freeze all rules, and evaluate crossed held-outs where neither the API nor the repair motif appears in the same training pair; compare against canonical graph-diff retrieval with identical calls and tokens and require a statistically reliable repair-success margin plus direct evidence that unseen repairs use multi-production compositions.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if nearest graph-diff/template retrieval matches the grammar within the pre-registered equivalence margin, if successful held-out repairs require generating or editing rules at test time, or if gains vanish when both API and motif are jointly held out.
unknowns: Whether the proposed rewrite language admits a nontrivial set of compositional productions rather than one production per repair template.
Whether enough independently verified API-by-motif repair pairs can be collected at low resource to estimate double-holdout generalization.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Canonicalize every successful graph diff into a typed edit template and retrieve/instantiate the nearest template at test time, with the same data and call budget but no grammar induction.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned production-composition operator that synthesizes a correct unseen structural repair from previously learned productions without a target-motif exemplar, new rule generation, or search.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Graph-diff abstraction identifies reusable structural change units, while grammar induction must turn those units into frozen productions whose composition repairs unseen API/motif combinations.

all_candidates.external_finding: The failure is real and the learned object is persistent. Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement and HarnessFix already convert recurring trace failures into localized structural graph or harness edits, while WISE-Flow induces reusable workflows, but the checked work does not establish the same frozen repair grammar learned from repair graph diffs with zero test-time rule generation and joint API-disjoint plus motif-disjoint compositional transfer. The thesis therefore survives, but only if production composition—not retrieval or template instantiation—causes the held-out gain.
all_candidates.external_finding_zh: 问题真实，且学习对象具有持久性。Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement 与 HarnessFix 已能把重复轨迹失败转成局部结构化图/框架修复，WISE-Flow 也会诱导可复用工作流；但已核查工作尚未覆盖“从修复前后图差分中学习冻结的修复文法，并在测试时禁止新规则生成，同时跨 API 与跨 motif 组合迁移”这一完整边界。因此该题可以成立，但必须证明收益来自 production 的组合泛化，而不是检索或模板实例化。
all_candidates.external_required_action: Pre-register a capacity-matched canonical graph-diff retrieval/template-instantiation baseline using exactly the same repaired pairs, model calls, tokens, and validation budget. Freeze the production inventory before evaluation, use a crossed API-by-motif holdout, and report production-level reuse/composition so that a successful unseen repair can be attributed to the grammar rather than semantic nearest-neighbor reuse.
all_candidates.external_required_action_zh: 预注册一个容量匹配的“规范化 graph-diff 检索 + 模板实例化”基线，使用完全相同的修复对、模型调用、token 与验证预算。评测前冻结 production 集合，采用 API×motif 交叉留出，并报告 production 级复用/组合证据，使未见修复的成功能够归因于文法而非语义近邻复用。

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Graph-diff abstraction identifies reusable structural change units, while grammar induction must turn those units into frozen productions whose composition repairs unseen API/motif combinations.

problem.zh: 能区分相邻 checkpoint 的任务常被用作评测，但没有反过来用于选择下一轮真正有学习价值的训练任务。
problem.en: Tasks that discriminate adjacent checkpoints are used for evaluation but rarely drive selection of training tasks that causally improve the next checkpoint.

exact_mechanism.zh: 学习任务的 checkpoint 判别力与时间效用，把它作为训练样本价值先验；冻结选择器后分配下一 checkpoint 的训练预算。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn checkpoint discrimination and temporal utility as a prior for training-sample value, then freeze the selector to allocate the next checkpoint's training budget.

learning_signal.zh: 相邻 checkpoint 的 paired outcomes、训练后增益和任务特征。
learning_signal.en: Paired adjacent-checkpoint outcomes, post-training gains, and task features.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 后续 checkpoint 在留出任务上的因果提升。
independent_ground_truth.en: Causal improvement of later checkpoints on held-out tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: paired IRT、学习进度、失败率课程、随机课程。
strongest_baseline.en: Paired IRT, learning-progress curricula, failure-rate curricula, and random curricula.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两条独立版本流，固定训练样本数，比较下一 checkpoint 的圈外提升。
decisive_pilot.en: Use two independent version streams with fixed training-sample counts and compare out-of-loop improvement of the next checkpoint.

stop_condition.zh: 只能提高评测判别而不能提高训练后表现则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it improves evaluation discrimination but not post-training performance.

necessity_logic.zh: 判别估计器发现正在变化的能力边界，训练分配器把边界信息转化为真正模型更新。
necessity_logic.en: The discrimination estimator locates changing capability boundaries and the allocator turns that information into actual learning updates.

external_reviews.finding: The current thesis is directly pre-empted by Level Up, which explicitly uses a series of models such as periodic checkpoints to identify transitional problems relative to model ability and shows that training on appropriately calibrated next-level problems efficiently improves the model. RAISE independently learns a task-objective-driven instruction selector based on expected contribution to performance improvement. Combining a Level Up-style adjacent-checkpoint transitional score with a trivial fixed-budget top-k allocator reproduces the central claim without the proposed persistent curriculum registry, so the present learning object does not survive simplification.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 当前 thesis 与 Level Up 发生直接碰撞：该工作明确使用一系列模型（包括 periodic checkpoints）来识别相对于模型能力的 transitional problems，并验证训练“下一层级”的适配问题能够更高效地提升模型。RAISE 又独立学习了以预期性能增益为目标的 instruction selector。用 Level Up 式相邻 checkpoint transitional score 再配一个固定预算 top-k 分配器，就能复现本候选的核心主张，不需要所谓 persistent curriculum registry，因此当前学习对象无法通过简化挑战。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not continue the current formulation as a standalone method. A revival must introduce a different persistent learned object, such as a cross-lineage transition operator that predicts causal training value on unseen model/version streams after conditioning out Level Up-style transitional difficulty and direct post-training utility, and must beat both components under identical sample counts.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不要以当前形式继续作为独立方法。若 revival，必须引入不同的持久学习对象，例如能够在未见模型/版本流上预测因果训练价值的 cross-lineage transition operator，并在控制 Level Up 式 transitional difficulty 与直接 post-training utility 后仍有独立增益；同时必须在相同样本数下击败两类现有方法。

closest_work.title: Level Up: Defining and Exploiting Transitional Problems for Curriculum Learning
RAISE: Reinforenced Adaptive Instruction Selection For Large Language Models

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Only the specific use of a learned temporal-utility prior and frozen transfer across independent version streams remains, which is insufficient as currently defined because direct utility selection and transitional-problem curricula already erase the claimed mechanism.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Level Up-style transitional-problem curriculum selection from the same adjacent checkpoints, with fixed top-k budget allocation and the same number of training examples; additionally compare to RAISE-style direct expected-improvement selection.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: On two independent model-version streams, use identical candidate samples and fixed training counts to compare the proposed selector against Level Up transitional scoring and direct expected-improvement selection; measure only out-of-loop next-checkpoint gains on held-out tasks and lineages.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the current branch if Level Up-style transitional selection or direct expected-improvement selection matches the proposed selector within the pre-registered equivalence margin on either independent version stream.
unknowns: Whether the proposed temporal-utility signal contains information not already captured by transitional-problem scores and direct post-training gain estimates.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Compute a Level Up-style transitional score from adjacent checkpoints and allocate the fixed next-round budget to the top-scoring samples; no learned temporal-utility registry or separate allocator is required.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A transferable causal sample-value operator that predicts next-checkpoint gains beyond checkpoint-relative transitional difficulty and direct expected-utility selection.

removable_components: training-budget-allocator as a learned component; fixed top-k allocation over checkpoint-relative transitional scores is capacity-matched
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The proposed estimator-to-allocator loop targets a real training-selection problem, but the loop is already closed by existing checkpoint-relative curriculum scoring plus ordinary budget allocation.

problem.zh: 多 Agent 通信图进化后，局部性能提升可能牺牲旧任务中的信息路径和容错。
problem.en: Evolving a multi-agent communication graph can improve local performance while breaking information paths and fault tolerance on mastered tasks.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对候选拓扑编辑执行边级归因重放和留出任务连通性测试，学习允许的拓扑变更信赖域并将失败编辑写入禁配约束。
exact_mechanism.en: Run edge-attribution replay and held-out connectivity tests for candidate topology edits, learn a trust region over allowable graph changes, and persist failed edits as incompatibility constraints.

learning_signal.zh: 候选图编辑、边级贡献、留出任务和故障注入结果。
learning_signal.en: Candidate graph edits, edge contributions, held-out tasks, and failure-injection outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未来任务上的成功率、通信成本和故障恢复。
independent_ground_truth.en: Future-task success, communication cost, and fault recovery.

strongest_baseline.zh: 无门控拓扑搜索、固定图、普通 Regression-Gated、随机回滚。
strongest_baseline.en: Ungated topology search, fixed graphs, generic Regression-Gated, and random rollback.

decisive_pilot.zh: 4 轮拓扑进化，匹配调用预算，测试新任务与旧任务双向回归。
decisive_pilot.en: Run four topology-evolution rounds under matched call budgets and test both new-task gain and old-task regression.

stop_condition.zh: 不能减少拓扑更新后的旧任务回归，或限制过强导致无改进则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not reduce old-task regression after topology updates or blocks nearly all useful changes.

necessity_logic.zh: 边信用定义哪些路径不可破坏，信赖域约束实际拓扑更新；普通门控没有结构级约束。
necessity_logic.en: Edge credit identifies paths that must be preserved and the trust region constrains actual topology updates; generic gating lacks graph-structural constraints.

external_reviews.finding: QueenBee Planner is a direct collision with the proposed learning object: it freezes workers, evolves communication DAGs, performs held-out acceptance, variance-aware/motif-level credit, transfer trust and falsification, and persists Preserve/Modify/Avoid design rules so failed topology patterns constrain future generation. Adding old-task regression and failure-injection metrics to that acceptance gate is a capacity-matched simplification of the proposed edge-credit replay plus graph trust region. The candidate's current trust-region wording therefore does not establish a distinct learning operator.
external_reviews.finding_zh: QueenBee Planner 与该候选的学习对象直接碰撞：它冻结 worker、进化通信 DAG，使用 held-out acceptance、variance-aware/motif-level credit、transfer trust 与 falsification，并持久化 Preserve/Modify/Avoid 设计规则，使失败拓扑模式约束未来图生成。只需在其 acceptance gate 中加入旧任务回归与 failure-injection 指标，就得到一个容量匹配的简化版，足以替代本候选的 edge-credit replay + graph trust region。因此当前“trust region”表述尚未形成独立学习算子。
external_reviews.required_action: Block this formulation and retain it as a regression-governance component. To revive it, define a mathematically or operationally distinct edit-space trust-region operator—for example, interventionally estimated edge influence constraints followed by projection of candidate edits into a certified feasible set—and show that QueenBee-style Preserve/Modify/Avoid rules plus held-out regression gating cannot reproduce fault-recovery guarantees at the same budget.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 阻止当前形式，将其保留为 regression-governance 组件。若 revival，需要定义数学上或操作上真正不同的 edit-space trust-region 算子，例如用干预估计 edge influence constraints，再把候选编辑投影到可认证的 feasible set；并证明 QueenBee 式 Preserve/Modify/Avoid 规则加 held-out regression gate 在相同预算下无法复现 fault-recovery 保证。

closest_work.title: QueenBee Planner: Skill-Evolving Communication Topologies for Token-Efficient LLM Multi-Agent Systems
AgentNet: Decentralized Evolutionary Coordination for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The only plausible remaining boundary is an explicit local trust-region geometry or certified projection for graph edits that targets mastered-task preservation and injected-fault recovery, rather than persistent design rules and acceptance gates.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: QueenBee Planner with its existing attribution, held-out acceptance, transfer trust and Avoid-rule memory, augmented only with the same old-task regression and failure-injection metrics used by the candidate.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Across four matched-budget topology-evolution rounds, compare against QueenBee augmented with identical old-task and fault-injection acceptance metrics; require a pre-registered reduction in mastered-task regression and improved fault recovery at matched new-task gain, communication cost, and edit acceptance rate.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if QueenBee plus regression/fault acceptance matches the proposed guard, if the learned trust region rejects nearly all beneficial edits, or if edge-credit estimates do not transfer across held-out tasks/topology motifs.
unknowns: Whether the intended trust region has any representation or update rule beyond a learned/generic acceptance gate.
Whether edge contributions are causally identifiable under interacting communication paths without prohibitively many interventions.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Run QueenBee Planner unchanged except score candidate topology edits on both new-task utility and old-task/failure-injection regression, reject edits outside fixed thresholds, and persist rejected motifs as Avoid rules.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A distinct learned feasible-set or projection operator over graph edits that provides regression/fault-tolerance behavior not reproducible by held-out acceptance gating plus persistent Avoid rules.

removable_components: graph-trust-region as currently specified; it can be replaced by held-out acceptance thresholds plus persistent Avoid constraints
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The proposed loop detects damaging topology edits and constrains future edits, but QueenBee already closes essentially the same credit-to-persistent-topology-constraint loop.

problem.zh: 同一修复可写入 Prompt、记忆、技能或工作流，但部署环境常只允许部分表面。
problem.en: The same repair may live in prompt, memory, skill, or workflow, but deployments often permit only a subset of surfaces.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从行为等价的跨表面修复对学习类型化转译规则，把源表面更新转换为目标表面更新，并用冻结行为契约校验。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn typed translation rules from behavior-equivalent cross-surface repair pairs, transpile source updates into target surfaces, and validate with frozen behavioral contracts.

learning_signal.zh: 源/目标表面修复对、行为契约和失败签名。
learning_signal.en: Source/target repair pairs, behavioral contracts, and failure signatures.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见故障和未见表面组合上的行为等价与回归。
independent_ground_truth.en: Behavioral equivalence and regression on unseen failures and unseen surface pairs.

strongest_baseline.zh: 目标表面从零重写、Update-Surface Router、人工模板、直接复制文本。
strongest_baseline.en: Target-surface rewrite-from-scratch, Update-Surface Router, manual templates, and direct text copy.

decisive_pilot.zh: 冻结源修复后转译到两个目标表面，匹配模型调用比较修复成功和圈外回归。
decisive_pilot.en: Freeze source repairs and transpile them to two target surfaces under matched model calls; compare repair success and out-of-loop regression.

stop_condition.zh: 不优于目标表面从零重写，或跨模型失效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat target-surface rewrite-from-scratch or fails across models.

necessity_logic.zh: 效应匹配提供跨表面监督，转译器产生可部署目标资产；路由本身不能解决表面不可用。
necessity_logic.en: Effect matching supplies cross-surface supervision and the transpiler creates deployable target assets; routing alone cannot handle an unavailable surface.

external_reviews.finding: The deployment problem is real, but the compiler framing is already partly occupied. SkillCompiler uses a strongly typed shared intermediate representation to compile one agent skill source across heterogeneous platforms, and prior work explicitly studies compiling multi-agent behavior into an equivalent single-agent skill system. The candidate can still be distinct if it learns behavior-preserving translations between genuinely different update surfaces such as prompt, memory, skill and workflow and transfers to unseen source-target surface pairs, but the current formulation does not rule out a simpler source-conditioned target rewrite or a fixed shared-IR emitter.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 部署问题真实，但“compiler”框架已经被部分占据。SkillCompiler 已使用强类型共享中间表示把单一 agent skill source 编译到异构平台；已有工作也明确研究把 multi-agent behavior 编译为等价的 single-agent skill system。该候选仍可能成立，前提是它真正学习 prompt、memory、skill、workflow 等不同 update surface 之间的行为保持翻译，并能迁移到未见 source-target surface pair；但当前定义尚不能排除更简单的 source-conditioned target rewrite 或固定 shared-IR emitter。
external_reviews.required_action: Define a surface-invariant semantic effect representation and separate training contracts from hidden evaluation contracts. Hold out entire directed surface pairs, provide no target-pair exemplars at test time, and compare against both a source-conditioned target rewrite and a SkillIR-like canonical intermediate representation with hand-written emitters under identical calls, tokens, and target-surface capacity.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 定义 surface-invariant 的语义 effect 表示，并把训练用 behavioral contracts 与隐藏评测 contracts 分离。完整留出有向 surface pair，测试时不给 target-pair 示例，同时在完全相同调用、token 与 target-surface 容量下，对比 source-conditioned target rewrite 和 SkillIR 式规范中间表示 + 手写 emitter。

closest_work.title: SkillCompiler: A Unified Compilation Framework for Cross-Platform LLM Agent Skills
When Single-Agent with Skills Replace Multi-Agent Systems and When They Fail

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving boundary is learned translation of persistent repairs across semantically different adaptation surfaces, validated by independent behavioral equivalence and regression tests on unseen directed surface pairs rather than merely cross-platform formatting or MAS-to-skill compilation.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A source-conditioned target-surface rewrite-from-scratch model plus behavioral validation, and a fixed canonical-IR compiler with one emitter per surface, both matched for model calls, tokens, training pairs, and target-surface capacity.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use at least three surfaces so one directed source-target pair is entirely absent from training; freeze source repairs and translator, then evaluate unseen failures on the held-out pair with hidden behavioral contracts against source-conditioned rewriting and fixed-IR emitters at identical budget.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if source-conditioned target rewriting or a fixed-IR emitter matches equivalence and regression within the pre-registered margin, if held-out surface-pair transfer fails, or if training and evaluation rely on the same behavioral contracts.
unknowns: Whether prompt, memory, skill and workflow updates share a sufficiently expressive invariant semantics for nontrivial translation.
Whether behavior-equivalent paired repairs can be obtained without leaking the evaluation contracts or relying on manual target rewrites.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Condition a target-surface rewriter on the frozen source repair and behavioral contract, or map the source into a fixed canonical IR and emit the target asset with a hand-written surface adapter, using the same model-call budget.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned typed cross-surface translation operator that preserves repair effects and regressions on unseen directed surface pairs where source-conditioned rewriting and fixed-IR emitters fail.

removable_components: behavioral-effect-matching as a separate learned component unless it learns a surface-invariant effect representation rather than merely validating candidate outputs
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Effect matching must identify the invariant behavioral change to preserve, and typed translation must realize that change on a target update surface that is unavailable in the source form.

problem.zh: 同一经验对不同任务子群可能产生相反的未来效应，统一保留或删除都会出错。
problem.en: One experience can have opposite future effects across task subpopulations, so global keep/delete decisions are unsafe.

exact_mechanism.zh: 用随机化重放估计异质处理效应；出现多峰或符号冲突时，把经验分裂成带不同适用条件的子经验并冻结分裂规则。
exact_mechanism.en: Estimate heterogeneous treatment effects with randomized replay; split a memory into applicability-bounded descendants when effects are multimodal or sign-conflicted, then freeze the split rules.

all_candidates.update_surface: versioned experience memory with descendant lineage

learning_signal.zh: 经验写入/不写入的随机化未来效应。
learning_signal.en: Randomized future effects of writing versus withholding the experience.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 时间留出任务中的子经验帮助/伤害效应。
independent_ground_truth.en: Benefit/harm effects of descendants on chronologically held-out tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 统一经验、语义聚类分裂、上下文门控、A-MAC 类准入。
strongest_baseline.en: Unspecialized memory, semantic-cluster splitting, contextual gating, and A-MAC-style admission.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个任务域中构造效应符号异质经验，比较未来负迁移、正收益和分裂复杂度。
decisive_pilot.en: Create sign-heterogeneous experiences in two domains and compare future negative transfer, positive gain, and split complexity.

stop_condition.zh: 未见任务子群上不能降低负迁移，或语义聚类同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if negative transfer does not fall on unseen subgroups or semantic clustering is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 异质效应决定何时分叉，适用条件学习决定如何分叉；两者缺一不可。
necessity_logic.en: Effect heterogeneity decides when to split and applicability learning decides how; neither alone closes the failure loop.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real: downstream experience use can propagate harmful or misaligned memories, and recent memory work already treats validated future-task impact as a utility signal. However, the proposed bifurcation operator does not yet survive simplification. Once randomized write-versus-withhold effects are available, a capacity-matched contextual applicability gate over one unsplit memory can implement the same subgroup-specific use/suppress behavior. Unless descendants learn genuinely different content or operators rather than different applicability regions, splitting is representational duplication rather than a standalone learning mechanism. ([ACL Anthology][1])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实存在：经验记忆可能在后续任务中产生错误传播或负迁移，近期工作也已经利用经验证的下游影响来衡量记忆效用。但当前“分叉”算子还没有通过简化挑战。既然已经通过随机写入/不写入实验获得条件效应，一个容量匹配的上下文适用性门控器就可以在不拆分记忆的情况下，对不同子群执行使用或抑制。除非不同后代记忆学习到真正不同的内容或行为算子，否则分叉更像表示层面的复制，而不是独立的方法贡献。
external_reviews.required_action: Either collapse the thesis to causal applicability gating, or make descendants learn subgroup-specific memory transformations/content and demonstrate that these descendants outperform an effect-conditioned contextual gate under identical replay, storage, inference-call, and training budgets on held-out subgroup identities and domains.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 要么将论文收缩为“因果效应驱动的记忆适用性门控”，要么让不同后代真正学习子群特定的记忆内容或变换，并在完全相同的回放、存储、推理调用和训练预算下，证明其在未见子群身份和领域上显著优于基于效应的上下文门控。

closest_work.title: How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Explicit randomized estimation of sign-heterogeneous treatment effects followed by frozen subgroup-specific descendants is not directly covered, but the descendant operation itself is not yet shown to be non-reducible.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched causal contextual gate trained from exactly the same randomized write/withhold effects, with one unsplit memory and task-conditioned retrieve/suppress decisions; additionally compare semantic clustering and admission-only policies.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct two domains in which the same experience has positive treatment effect for one latent subgroup and negative effect for another. Randomize write/withhold during training, freeze all learned rules, and evaluate on completely held-out subgroup identities and a held-out domain. Compare descendant splitting against the causal contextual gate using identical intervention counts, memory capacity, retrieval calls, and model tokens, measuring positive gain and negative transfer separately.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the bifurcation thesis if the contextual gate matches the split learner within 1 percentage point on both positive gain and negative-transfer rate across both domains, or if activating different descendants produces no behavior beyond selecting versus suppressing the original memory.
unknowns: Whether stable heterogeneous treatment effects can be estimated with a low-resource number of randomized replay interventions.
Whether sign heterogeneity transfers across task identities, domains, and model versions.
Whether proposed descendants would learn different content rather than only different applicability masks.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Estimate a conditional write-versus-withhold treatment effect tau(x,m) from the same randomized replay data and keep one unsplit memory, retrieving it only when the learned effect is positive; use the same estimator capacity, observations, calls, and memory budget.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A descendant-specific learned content transformation or behavioral operator that changes future decisions in a way an applicability gate over the original memory cannot represent.

removable_components: applicability-specialization
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Randomized interventions can identify heterogeneous memory effects, but the current specialization step is not necessary because contextual gating can close the harmful-retrieval loop without materialized descendants.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Randomized interventions can identify heterogeneous memory effects, but the current specialization step is not necessary because contextual gating can close the harmful-retrieval loop without materialized descendants.

problem.zh: 长期自进化会积累语义不同但行为作用等价的经验，造成上下文膨胀和冲突。
problem.en: Long-running evolution accumulates semantically different memories with behaviorally equivalent effects, causing context bloat and conflicts.

exact_mechanism.zh: 用跨任务干预效应签名而非文本相似度判断可合并性，只合并效应向量和适用边界等价的经验，并保留可逆来源映射。
exact_mechanism.en: Use cross-task intervention-effect signatures instead of text similarity; merge only memories equivalent in effect and applicability while preserving reversible provenance.

learning_signal.zh: 条目级跨任务干预效应向量和容量压力。
learning_signal.en: Entry-level cross-task intervention-effect vectors and memory-capacity pressure.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 冻结后的任务成功、回归和检索成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Frozen downstream success, regression, and retrieval cost.

strongest_baseline.zh: 语义去重、摘要压缩、LRU、全部保留。
strongest_baseline.en: Semantic deduplication, summary compression, LRU eviction, and keep-all.

decisive_pilot.zh: 持续任务流中匹配存储预算，比较压缩率、未来性能和错误合并回归。
decisive_pilot.en: Match memory budgets on continual task streams and compare compression, future performance, and regressions from false merges.

stop_condition.zh: 相同压缩率下不优于语义去重，或错误合并率过高则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat semantic deduplication at the same compression rate or false merges are excessive.

necessity_logic.zh: 效应签名提供功能等价标准，合并编译器提供持久压缩。
necessity_logic.en: Effect signatures define functional equivalence and the merge compiler provides persistent compression.

external_reviews.finding: Defining memory redundancy by downstream intervention effects rather than text similarity is a promising surviving axis, and existing work on downstream memory utility and adaptive distillation does not directly establish effect-equivalence merging. The present two-component mechanism is nevertheless over-specified: effect-signature clustering followed by retaining one medoid plus a reversible alias/provenance table can plausibly reproduce the claimed compression, applicability preservation, and rollback without a learned merge compiler. The thesis needs an interaction case in which representative selection provably or empirically fails. ([arXiv][2])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 以“下游干预效应”而非文本相似度定义记忆冗余，是目前仍有潜力的新轴；现有下游记忆效用与自适应蒸馏工作并未直接完成这种效应等价合并。但当前两组件机制仍然偏复杂：对效应签名做聚类、保留一个 medoid，并用可逆别名/溯源表记录被压缩项，就可能复现压缩、适用性保持与回滚能力，而不需要单独的学习式 merge compiler。论文必须给出代表项保留法会失败、而真正合并算子能够解决的交互情形。
external_reviews.required_action: Make the non-reducible object explicit. The strongest route is to model group or interaction-effect equivalence, where memories with similar marginal effect vectors are not safely replaceable by a medoid because their joint effects differ. Otherwise remove the merge compiler and present the contribution narrowly as intervention-effect-based deduplication.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要明确不可约的学习对象。最强的修改方向是学习“组级或交互效应等价”：即边际效应向量相似的记忆仍可能因为联合效应不同而不能简单保留一个代表项。否则应删除 merge compiler，将贡献收缩为基于干预效应的记忆去重。

closest_work.title: Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization
What Deserves Memory: Adaptive Memory Distillation for LLM Agents
RecMem: Recurrence-based Memory Consolidation for Efficient and Effective Long-Running LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is consolidation according to experimentally measured cross-task intervention-effect equivalence rather than semantic recurrence, predicted utility, or textual redundancy.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Effect-signature clustering with the same applicability features and intervention data, one retained medoid per cluster, and a reversible alias map, evaluated at exactly the same final memory size and retrieval budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Build a continual stream containing semantically dissimilar but behaviorally equivalent memories, plus adversarial groups whose marginal effect signatures are similar while joint retrieval effects differ. Freeze the compactor and evaluate held-out domains and a second model at matched compression ratios against effect-medoid clustering, semantic deduplication, LRU, and keep-all.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the compiler thesis if effect-signature medoid retention matches downstream success and regression within 1 percentage point at the same compression ratio, or if estimated effect equivalence is too unstable to reduce false merges relative to semantic deduplication.
unknowns: The intervention sample complexity required for reliable entry-level effect signatures.
Whether effect equivalence remains stable after actor or model-version changes.
Whether approximate effect equivalence is sufficiently transitive for safe DAG-level merging.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Compute the same cross-task effect signatures and applicability masks, cluster entries under a fixed threshold, retain one medoid per cluster, and keep a reversible alias table for provenance and rollback.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: An effect-equivalence operator that preserves behavior under joint retrieval or interaction settings where effect-vector clustering plus representative retention necessarily makes false merges.

removable_components: reversible-merge-compiler
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Causal-effect signatures can identify behavioral redundancy, but reversible compression does not require a learned compiler unless merging changes future behavior beyond representative retention.

title.zh: 纵向评价器漂移修正器

problem.zh: Actor 与 evaluator 共同更新后，静态校准器无法识别仅在特定版本配对中出现的评分偏差。
problem.en: When actor and evaluator co-evolve, static calibration cannot identify biases specific to version pairings.

exact_mechanism.zh: 构建 actor-version × evaluator-version 交叉评分矩阵，学习时间残差与交互项，并用独立锚点任务训练可冻结的偏差修正头。
exact_mechanism.en: Build a crossed actor-version by evaluator-version score matrix, learn temporal residuals and interactions, and train a frozen bias-correction head from independent anchor tasks.

learning_signal.zh: 跨版本评分矩阵、锚点任务和外部真值。
learning_signal.en: Cross-version score matrices, anchor tasks, and external ground truth.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未来未见 evaluator 版本上的真实排序和下游策略选择质量。
independent_ground_truth.en: True ranking and downstream policy-selection quality on unseen future evaluator versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: Bridge/SAJA 式静态校准、冻结 evaluator、Evaluator Ensemble。
strongest_baseline.en: Bridge/SAJA-style static calibration, frozen evaluator, and evaluator ensembles.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少 6 轮 actor/evaluator 历史，按未来版本留出，比较偏差预测和策略选择。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least six actor/evaluator rounds with future-version holdout and compare bias prediction plus policy selection.

stop_condition.zh: 不能显著超过静态校准器预测未来偏差则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not significantly beat static calibration on future-version bias.

necessity_logic.zh: 纵向交互模型捕获共同进化偏差，独立锚点把残差约束到真实能力。
necessity_logic.en: The longitudinal interaction model captures co-evolution bias while independent anchors tie residuals to real capability.

external_reviews.finding: The longitudinal evaluator-drift problem is credible, and static judge calibration is already a substantial literature baseline. The present formulation has an identifiability gap: a crossed actor-version by evaluator-version interaction model cannot estimate a free interaction for a genuinely unseen evaluator version without observations from that version. If future-version anchors are supplied, a static Bridge/SAJA-style calibration model trained on exactly those anchors may erase the claimed need for the longitudinal matrix. The method therefore needs an explicit extrapolative version representation and a precisely defined information boundary. ([OpenReview][3])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 评估器随版本共同演化而产生漂移的问题可信，而且静态 judge calibration 已经形成很强的基线。当前方案存在关键可辨识性缺口：actor-version × evaluator-version 的交叉交互模型无法在完全没有该新版本观测的情况下估计一个真正未见 evaluator version 的自由交互项；如果允许给新版本提供 anchor，那么使用同样 anchor 的静态 Bridge/SAJA 式校准又可能消除纵向矩阵的必要性。因此必须明确未来版本可使用的信息边界，并学习能够外推的版本表示。
external_reviews.required_action: Separate zero-anchor and few-anchor future-version regimes. For zero-anchor transfer, learn a low-rank temporal/version-state representation from observable evaluator fingerprints available before ground truth and forbid any held-out-version labels. For few-anchor transfer, give exactly the same anchors to a static calibration baseline and show that historical cross-version dynamics provide additional predictive value.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将未来版本评测明确拆分为 zero-anchor 与 few-anchor 两种制度。zero-anchor 场景必须利用无需真实标签即可获得的 evaluator 指纹学习低秩时间/版本状态，并禁止使用任何留出版本真实标签；few-anchor 场景则必须给静态校准基线完全相同的 anchor，并证明历史跨版本动态仍有额外预测价值。

closest_work.title: Bridging Human and LLM Judgments: Understanding and Narrowing the Gap
SAJA: A Simple Approach to Judge Alignment for LLM-as-a-Judge

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The potentially novel boundary is prediction and correction of actor-evaluator version-pair interactions across time, especially extrapolation to a chronologically held-out evaluator version rather than calibration within a fixed judge population.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched pooled calibration head with the same anchor budget, evaluator scores, actor/evaluator observable descriptors, and recency features, trained without an explicit cross-version interaction model.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use at least six reproducible actor/evaluator rounds and leave the final evaluator version chronologically held out. Run both zero-anchor and fixed-k-anchor protocols; in the latter, expose exactly the same k anchors to every method. Freeze correction before evaluation and measure bias RMSE, pairwise ranking accuracy, and downstream policy-selection regret on unseen actor-evaluator pairings.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the pooled static calibration baseline is within 5 percent relative bias RMSE and 1 percentage point of policy-selection accuracy under both information regimes, or if successful prediction requires ground-truth labels from the nominally unseen evaluator version beyond the declared anchor budget.
unknowns: Whether sufficiently many reproducible historical evaluator versions can be queried under a consistent task protocol.
Whether evaluator drift has a temporally predictable structure rather than arbitrary version discontinuities.
Which version fingerprints are available without leaking held-out anchor ground truth.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Fit a pooled Bridge/SAJA-style calibration head using the same anchor examples and evaluator outputs, optionally adding actor version, evaluator version descriptors, and recency as ordinary covariates, without an explicit crossed residual matrix.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: An extrapolative latent version-state operator that predicts held-out evaluator-version bias beyond a static calibration head supplied with the same observable information.

removable_components: cross-version-residual-model
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Independent anchors ground evaluator bias, but historical cross-version residual modeling closes an additional failure loop only if it improves prediction for a future version beyond calibration on the same available anchors.

removable_components: cross-version-residual-model
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Independent anchors ground evaluator bias, but historical cross-version residual modeling closes an additional failure loop only if it improves prediction for a future version beyond calibration on the same available anchors.

problem.zh: 自进化系统经常重复训练明显失败样本，而不是学习当前能力边界附近最有价值的反例。
problem.en: Self-evolving systems often retrain on obvious failures rather than counterexamples near the current capability boundary.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从最近版本的成功/失败对学习边界表示，生成最小扰动的近边界任务，并只保留独立验证器确认能区分当前/上一版本的样本进入训练。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn a boundary representation from recent success/failure pairs, generate minimally perturbed near-boundary tasks, and admit only independently verified samples that distinguish current from previous versions.

learning_signal.zh: 版本差异、生成任务和独立可解性/正确性验证。
learning_signal.en: Version differences, generated tasks, and independent solvability/correctness verification.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 下一版本在留出分布上的提升与遗忘。
independent_ground_truth.en: Next-version improvement and forgetting on held-out distributions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 失败重放、难度课程、随机增强、Counterexample-Generating Curriculum。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure replay, difficulty curricula, random augmentation, and Counterexample-Generating Curriculum.

decisive_pilot.zh: 固定生成和训练预算，两个模型三 seed，比较圈外增益与遗忘。
decisive_pilot.en: Fix generation and training budgets, use two models and three seeds, and compare out-of-loop gain and forgetting.

stop_condition.zh: 边界生成不优于失败重放，或只提升生成器同分布任务则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if boundary generation does not beat failure replay or improves only generator-matched tasks.

necessity_logic.zh: 边界模型决定生成位置，独立验证器确保样本不是无效难题；两者共同把失败前沿变成训练信号。
necessity_logic.en: The boundary model chooses where to generate and the independent verifier prevents invalid hard examples; together they turn the failure frontier into training signal.

external_reviews.finding: The broad thesis is already directly occupied by 2025-2026 capability-frontier data-generation work. PROPEL explicitly trains a task generator toward a target solver's learnable frontier with validity gating, AgentFrontier synthesizes ZPD/frontier tasks, and Frontier Learning targets training at the edge of capability. The candidate's current-versus-previous-version criterion is a narrower distinction, but the listed boundary model still fails simplification: generate a candidate pool, independently verify it, and retain examples on which adjacent versions disagree. That rejection sampler implements the central selection rule without learning a boundary representation. ([arXiv][4])
external_reviews.finding_zh: “在能力前沿生成训练任务”这一宽泛论文主张已经被 2025-2026 年的工作直接占据。PROPEL 已明确训练生成器去寻找目标 solver 的可学习前沿并加入有效性门控，AgentFrontier 直接生成 ZPD/能力前沿任务，Frontier Learning 也聚焦能力边缘训练。候选方案新增的“当前版本与上一版本差异”更窄，但 boundary model 仍未通过简化挑战：生成候选、独立验证，然后仅保留相邻版本表现不同的任务，就能实现核心筛选原则而无需学习边界表示。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not pursue generic frontier generation as a standalone thesis. A viable revival must pivot to a specifically version-contrastive learning-progress object that predicts transferable improvement or regression directions beyond raw adjacent-version disagreement and beyond PROPEL-style frontier scoring, with a causal training intervention showing that this learned object changes the next frozen model.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不应继续把通用“能力前沿任务生成”作为独立论文主张。若要复活，应改成明确的“版本对比式学习进展”对象：它必须能够预测超越简单相邻版本分歧和 PROPEL 式前沿打分的可迁移提升/退化方向，并通过训练干预证明该对象会改变下一版冻结模型。

AgentFrontier: Expanding the Capability Frontier of LLM Agents with ZPD-Guided Data Synthesis
Frontier Learning: Training LLM Reasoners at the Edge of Capability

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Explicit adjacent-version discrimination and minimal perturbation remain different details, but neither is currently formulated as a non-reducible learning operator distinct from frontier generation plus disagreement filtering.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: PROPEL-style frontier generation or the candidate's own generator followed by independent validity checking and direct current-versus-previous disagreement filtering, with exactly matched generation calls, solver executions, retained-example count, and downstream training tokens.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: At fixed generator, verifier, solver-call, and training budgets, compare the full learned boundary against direct adjacent-version disagreement filtering and a PROPEL-style frontier score. Freeze the generated curriculum, train two model families with three seeds, and evaluate gains and forgetting on held-out domains and a generator-independent test set.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep this idea blocked if direct disagreement filtering or PROPEL-style frontier selection matches the full method within 1 percentage point of held-out improvement and forgetting, or if gains disappear on generator-independent tasks.
unknowns: Whether adjacent-version disagreement reflects learnable progress rather than stochasticity, regressions, or benchmark noise.
Whether minimal perturbations remain semantically valid and independently solvable.
Whether the verifier is independent enough to prevent generator-verifier co-adaptation.
Whether a version-contrastive representation transfers across model families.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Use the same task generator and independent verifier, execute every valid candidate on the current and previous models, and retain a fixed-budget band of tasks where their correctness differs; train on those tasks without learning any boundary representation.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned version-contrastive boundary representation that predicts future learning progress on held-out domains or models beyond what raw current-versus-previous disagreement can select.

problem.zh: 多条记忆各自有用，但检索顺序改变会导致规划冲突或错误覆盖。
problem.en: Several memories may each be useful while retrieval order changes planning and causes destructive override.

exact_mechanism.zh: 随机化共同检索集合的排列，学习类型化 precedence/commutativity 子句，并在推理前约束排序。
exact_mechanism.en: Randomize permutations within co-retrieved sets, learn typed precedence/commutativity clauses, and constrain ordering before inference.

learning_signal.zh: 同一记忆集合不同排列的环境结果。
learning_signal.en: Environment outcomes under different permutations of the same memory set.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见记忆身份和高阶组合上的顺序效应。
independent_ground_truth.en: Order effects on unseen memory identities and higher-order combinations.

strongest_baseline.zh: 时间顺序、相关度排序、Memory Interaction Clause Learner、随机顺序。
strongest_baseline.en: Chronological order, relevance sorting, Memory Interaction Clause Learner, and random order.

decisive_pilot.zh: 二元/三元组合训练，完整留出记忆身份测试排序泛化。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on pair/triple sets and hold out memory identities completely to test ordering transfer.

stop_condition.zh: 子句不能跨身份泛化，或简单相关度排序同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if clauses do not generalize across identities or simple relevance sorting is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 干预识别顺序效应，子句学习把它变成未来可执行约束。
necessity_logic.en: Interventions identify order effects and clause induction turns them into executable future constraints.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is well supported: identical retrieved content can produce materially different behavior under permutation, and agent memories can alter control flow. A frozen executable ordering registry is also a legitimate persistent learned object. The unresolved issue is mechanism necessity. From the same permutation interventions, a capacity-matched pairwise precedence scorer followed by sorting or tournament/topological decoding may reproduce the claimed behavior without symbolic typed clauses. Moreover, identity-held-out transfer is not identifiable until the proposed memory types are defined independently of the outcome labels. ([ACL Anthology][5])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 失败现象有充分依据：相同检索内容仅改变排列顺序就可能显著改变模型行为，代理记忆也可能改变控制流；冻结后的可执行顺序约束表也确实属于持久学习对象。但目前仍缺少组件必要性证明。从完全相同的 permutation intervention 数据出发，一个容量匹配的成对优先级打分器再配合排序、锦标赛或拓扑解码，可能无需符号化 typed clauses 就能复现效果。同时，如果“memory type”本身没有在结果标签之外独立定义，那么跨未见 memory identity 的迁移也无法清晰辨识。
external_reviews.required_action: Define memory types independently and make the target relation strictly richer than scalar ranking. Include conditional, commutative, and higher-order cases in which pairwise scores are insufficient, then demonstrate transfer to unseen memory identities, unseen type compositions, and preferably a held-out model. Otherwise simplify the paper to learned retrieval ordering.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须独立定义 memory type，并让目标关系严格超出标量排序的表达能力。实验中应包含条件优先、可交换以及高阶组合等成对打分无法表达的情形，并验证对未见 memory identity、未见类型组合以及最好是未见模型的迁移；否则论文应收缩为一般的学习式检索排序。

closest_work.title: Stable-RAG: Mitigating Retrieval-Permutation-Induced Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
From Storage to Steering: Memory Control Flow Attacks on LLM Agents
Order-Independence Without Fine Tuning

direct_collision.surviving_difference: No located work directly learns a persistent registry of typed precedence and commutativity constraints from environmental interventions and transfers those constraints to unseen memory identities.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A matched-capacity neural pairwise order-effect scorer trained on exactly the same permutations and outcomes, followed by tournament or topological ordering; include relevance sorting, chronological order, random order, and order-robust inference where budget-matched.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct environments with fixed co-retrieved sets containing known precedence, commutative, conditional, and triple-only interactions. Train on one set of memory identities, freeze all ordering rules, then test entirely unseen identities and unseen type compositions. Match permutation observations and inference calls between the clause learner and pairwise scorer and report task success plus constraint-violation rate.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the clause-learning thesis if the pairwise scorer is within 1 percentage point of task success and constraint-violation rate on held-out identities and compositions, or if learned clauses fail to transfer when surface memory identities are replaced.
unknowns: Whether real agent memories exhibit stable precedence relations across tasks rather than prompt-specific order sensitivity.
How memory types can be defined or learned without leaking permutation-outcome labels.
The number of permutation interventions required to identify higher-order clauses.
Whether learned ordering constraints remain valid after the base model changes.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Use the same randomized permutation outcomes to train a capacity-matched pairwise order-effect scorer over memory embeddings or types, then choose an order with tournament or topological sorting, without explicit precedence or commutativity clauses.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A higher-order typed constraint operator whose correct ordering decisions cannot be represented by any scalar or pairwise precedence scorer with matched capacity.

removable_components: precedence-clause-induction
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Co-retrieval interventions identify order sensitivity, but explicit clause induction is necessary only if higher-order or conditional order structure defeats matched pairwise ordering models.

problem.zh: Reward 模型会在策略进化后出现新 shortcut，但只做不变性审计不能修复评价器。
problem.en: Reward models develop new shortcuts after policy evolution, while invariance audits alone cannot repair the evaluator.

exact_mechanism.zh: 独立生成 evaluator 与环境真值分歧的锚点反例，训练小型修正头使因果方向一致、中性变换不变，并用留出策略冻结验证。
exact_mechanism.en: Generate independent anchor counterexamples where evaluator and environment disagree; train a small correction head for causal-direction agreement and neutral invariance, then freeze on held-out policies.

learning_signal.zh: 锚点反例、环境真值和 evaluator 分数。
learning_signal.en: Anchor counterexamples, environment truth, and evaluator scores.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见策略版本上的真实候选选择与 shortcut 鲁棒性。
independent_ground_truth.en: True candidate selection and shortcut robustness on unseen policy versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 冻结 Reward、PRISM/CROME 式审计、普通 Pairwise Fine-tuning。
strongest_baseline.en: Frozen reward, PRISM/CROME-style audits, and ordinary pairwise fine-tuning.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个策略版本训练，一个未来策略版本冻结测试，严格分离反例生成器和最终评测。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on two policy versions and freeze-test on a future version, separating counterexample generation from final evaluation.

stop_condition.zh: 只改善锚点集而不改善未来策略选择则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it improves only anchor sets without improving future policy selection.

necessity_logic.zh: 独立锚点暴露新 shortcut，修正头把审计证据内化为持久评价器更新。
necessity_logic.en: Independent anchors expose new shortcuts and the correction head internalizes audit evidence into persistent evaluator updates.

external_reviews.finding: The move from auditing to persistent repair is substantively useful, but the proposed mechanism is already crowded by direct reward-model repair work. REFORM discovers reward-inconsistent adversarial examples and fine-tunes the reward model, PRISM explicitly targets shortcut behavior through invariance, and policy-feedback reward modeling addresses reward-model mismatch as the policy distribution evolves. Given the same environment-labeled disagreement examples, an ordinary same-size calibration head trained with pairwise loss is also a strong erasing simplification; the proposal does not yet identify what causal-direction agreement plus neutral invariance learns that this simpler correction cannot. ([ACL Anthology][6])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 从“只做审计”转向“持久修复”本身是实质变化，但当前机制已经与现有 reward-model repair 工作高度拥挤。REFORM 会发现 reward-inconsistent 对抗样本并继续训练奖励模型，PRISM 明确利用不变性处理 shortcut，policy-feedback reward modeling 也针对策略分布演化后的奖励模型失配。更关键的是，给定完全相同的环境真实标签与 evaluator 分歧样本，一个同等容量、采用普通 pairwise loss 的校准头就是很强的消融基线；当前方案尚未证明“因果方向一致性 + neutral invariance”能够学习到该简单修正头无法获得的东西。
external_reviews.required_action: Keep this as a component or baseline unless it is rebuilt around a distinct intervention-identifiable shortcut representation. A viable revival must learn causal shortcut directions from interventions and show zero-shot or low-shot correction of unseen shortcut classes and unseen policy versions that ordinary calibration, REFORM-style adversarial repair, PRISM-style invariance, and policy-feedback adaptation cannot reproduce.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 除非围绕一种可通过干预独立识别的 shortcut 表示重新构建，否则更适合作为组件或基线。可行的复活版本需要通过干预学习因果 shortcut 方向，并证明其能在未见 shortcut 类别和未见策略版本上实现普通校准、REFORM 式对抗修复、PRISM 式不变性训练以及 policy-feedback adaptation 都无法复现的零样本或低样本修正。

closest_work.title: Teach a Reward Model to Correct Itself: Reward Guided Adversarial Failure Discovery for Robust Reward Modeling
Rectifying Shortcut Behaviors in Preference-based Reward Learning
Reinforcement Reward Model with Policy Feedback

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining distinction is an independently environment-grounded small correction head combining directional and neutral-invariance constraints, but those ingredients are not yet shown to produce behavior unavailable from standard supervised correction on the same counterexamples.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A same-parameter correction head trained on exactly the same environment-labeled evaluator disagreements using ordinary pairwise loss, plus REFORM-style adversarial failure discovery, PRISM-style shortcut regularization, and a policy-feedback adaptation baseline under matched example and optimization budgets.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train all methods on counterexamples from two policy versions, freeze them, and evaluate a third policy version produced by a different optimizer or model family. Use a sequestered counterexample generator plus naturally occurring policy outputs for final evaluation. Match correction-head size, labeled anchors, optimization steps, and evaluator calls, and measure true candidate-selection regret and robustness to shortcut classes absent from training.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep the idea blocked if the ordinary pairwise correction head or REFORM-style repair is within 1 percentage point of future-policy candidate-selection accuracy, or if gains are confined to the generated anchor distribution and disappear on natural or unseen-shortcut evaluations.
unknowns: Whether environment truth is genuinely independent of the evaluator and counterexample generator.
Whether the proposed causal direction can be identified rather than merely correlated with the observed shortcut.
Whether neutral-invariance constraints improve future-policy selection beyond standard supervised calibration.
Whether unseen policy versions introduce genuinely new shortcut mechanisms rather than ordinary distribution shift.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Mine the same evaluator-versus-environment disagreement examples and train a correction head of identical parameter count using ordinary pairwise classification or regression loss, with the same data, labels, optimization steps, and frozen future-policy evaluation.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: An intervention-identified causal shortcut representation whose correction transfers to previously unseen shortcut mechanisms and policy versions beyond ordinary environment-supervised calibration.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Persistent correction closes the audit-to-update loop, but bespoke anchor generation is not necessary if ordinary disagreement or adversarial mining supplies equally effective environment-labeled repair examples.

title.zh: 多 Agent 角色专化编译器

problem.zh: 通用子 Agent 长期处理重复任务 motif 时，固定角色 Prompt 会产生上下文浪费和能力冲突。
problem.en: General subagents repeatedly handling the same motifs waste context and create capability conflicts under fixed role prompts.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从跨任务轨迹中聚类稳定职责与成功修复模式，编译为带输入契约、工具权限和退出条件的专化角色，并学习路由。
exact_mechanism.en: Cluster stable responsibilities and successful repair patterns across tasks, compile them into specialized roles with input contracts, tool permissions, and exit conditions, and learn routing.

learning_signal.zh: 任务 motif、子 Agent 贡献、工具调用和团队结果。
learning_signal.en: Task motifs, subagent contribution, tool calls, and team outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见任务上的团队成功、角色复用率和成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Team success, role reuse rate, and cost on unseen tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定角色、动态 prompt 角色、Skill library、router-only。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed roles, dynamically prompted roles, skill libraries, and router-only systems.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按任务族留出训练/测试，冻结角色库，允许路由但禁止测试时生成新角色。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out task families, freeze the role library, allow routing but no test-time role generation.

stop_condition.zh: 角色无法跨任务复用，或动态 prompt 角色同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if roles do not reuse across tasks or dynamic role prompting is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 角色归纳找稳定职责，编译把职责变成可执行持久角色；仅路由不能创造专化能力。
necessity_logic.en: Role induction finds stable responsibilities and compilation turns them into executable persistent roles; routing alone cannot create specialization.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is credible and the frozen versioned role library is a legitimate persistent learned object, but the present mechanism does not yet survive the simplification challenge. AgentNet already learns dynamic specialization and routing, while MetaGen generates query-conditioned roles and topologies; a motif-clustered retrieval system that instantiates dynamic role prompts with the same permissions, exit guards, router, calls, and tokens could plausibly reproduce the claimed benefit without a compiled role library. The surviving thesis must therefore be that cross-task induction discovers reusable executable role contracts that cannot be replaced by retrieval or inference-time role generation. ([NeurIPS Proceedings][1])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实，冻结后的版本化角色库也确实属于能够影响未来行为的持久学习对象，但当前机制尚未通过简化挑战。AgentNet 已经学习动态角色专门化与路由，MetaGen 也会按查询动态生成角色和拓扑；如果用相同权限、退出条件、路由器、调用次数和 token 预算，仅对成功轨迹进行 motif 聚类并检索动态角色提示，就可能复现主要收益。因此真正需要保住的论文命题应是：跨任务角色归纳能够产生不可由检索式或测试时动态角色生成替代的、可执行且可复用的角色契约。
external_reviews.required_action: Make contracted compilation behaviorally substantive rather than textual: contracts must enforce tool/action interfaces or termination semantics, and the frozen compiled library must beat a capacity-matched motif-retrieval plus dynamic-role baseline on held-out task families and preferably a held-out base model. Include ablations removing compilation while retaining the same learned router and permissions.

problem.zh: 回滚通常只能撤销整个更新，无法保留更新中有益部分。
problem.en: Rollback usually removes an entire update even when only part of it caused regression.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从部分回滚干预学习条件逆算子，将失败更新分解为可逆原子并生成仅抵消有害效应的 inverse patch。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn a conditional inverse operator from partial rollback interventions, decompose failed updates into reversible atoms, and generate an inverse patch that cancels only harmful effects.

learning_signal.zh: 更新原子启用/禁用结果和回归恢复程度。
learning_signal.en: Enable/disable outcomes of update atoms and degree of regression recovery.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新上的效用保留率、回归恢复率和 inverse patch 大小。
independent_ground_truth.en: Utility retention, regression recovery, and inverse-patch size on unseen updates.

strongest_baseline.zh: 完整回滚、最小稳定补丁、联合重优化、Delta Debugging。
strongest_baseline.en: Full rollback, minimal stabilizing patch, joint re-optimization, and delta debugging.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在混合有益/有害更新中预注册可逆原子，训练后冻结到未见更新。
decisive_pilot.en: Pre-register reversible atoms in mixed-benefit/harm updates and freeze the learned inverter on unseen updates.

stop_condition.zh: 无法比完整回滚保留更多效用，或原子分解不稳定则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not retain more utility than full rollback or atom decomposition is unstable.

necessity_logic.zh: 干预识别需抵消部分，逆算子把证据泛化为未来修复；只做定位仍会全量回滚。
necessity_logic.en: Interventions identify what to cancel and the inverse operator generalizes that evidence into future repair; localization alone still implies whole rollback.

external_reviews.finding: The selective-rollback problem is important and the frozen inverse operator would be a persistent learned object, but the current formulation makes the learned inverter potentially unnecessary. Task arithmetic already shows that stored update vectors can be negated or combined, and OneEdit includes targeted rollback of prior edits. If the proposed update atoms are pre-registered and individually reversible, the same intervention outcomes can simply train a harmful-atom selector followed by exact subtraction of stored atom deltas. A standalone thesis requires non-additive or coupled updates for which no subset of known inverse atoms can produce the needed repair. ([OpenReview][2])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 选择性回滚的问题重要，冻结后的逆更新算子也属于持久学习对象，但当前设定下“学习逆算子”可能是多余的。Task Arithmetic 已证明可对更新向量直接取反或组合，OneEdit 也包含针对既有编辑的定向回滚。如果候选方法预先定义了可逆原子，并且每个原子的逆操作已知，那么相同的干预数据只需学习“哪些原子有害”，再直接减去对应更新即可。要成为独立论文，必须进入非加性或存在耦合效应的更新场景，使任何已存原子逆操作的子集都无法完成所需修复。
external_reviews.required_action: Change the target regime from separable reversible atoms to coupled or non-additive updates. Define an inverter that must synthesize or condition an inverse patch from interaction evidence, and explicitly test cases where oracle subset rollback over all stored atom deltas is insufficient.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要把目标场景从“可分离、已知逆操作的原子”改成存在耦合或非加性效应的更新。逆算子必须利用交互证据合成或条件化地产生新的逆补丁，并明确构造“即便 oracle 知道应回滚哪些原子，所有已有原子逆操作的任意子集仍不足以修复”的测试。

problem.zh: 评价 rubric 的少数原子可能造成系统性偏差，但整体重写会破坏中性维度。
problem.en: A few rubric atoms can cause systematic bias while whole-rubric rewriting damages neutral dimensions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从因果/中性干预构建 rubric-atom 效应矩阵，用约束稀疏求解器最小增删/重加权，并显式保持中性维度。
exact_mechanism.en: Build a rubric-atom effect matrix from causal/neutral interventions and solve a constrained sparse add/drop/reweight edit while explicitly preserving neutral dimensions.

learning_signal.zh: rubric 原子干预、排序变化和中性保持标签。
learning_signal.en: Rubric-atom interventions, ranking changes, and neutral-preservation labels.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 冻结独立任务上的偏差降低、真实排序和中性维度保持。
independent_ground_truth.en: Bias reduction, true ranking, and neutral-dimension preservation on frozen independent tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: RRD、PReMISE、CROME 数据上的普通重写、Reward 微调。
strongest_baseline.en: RRD, PReMISE, generic rewriting on CROME interventions, and reward fine-tuning.

decisive_pilot.zh: 预注册 rubric 原子与因果/中性干预，匹配调用预算比较稀疏编辑与强基线。
decisive_pilot.en: Pre-register rubric atoms and causal/neutral interventions and compare sparse editing with strong baselines under matched calls.

stop_condition.zh: 不能保持中性维度，或普通重写同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if neutral dimensions are not preserved or generic rewriting is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 效应矩阵定位偏差原子，稀疏求解器在保持约束下执行最小持久修复。
necessity_logic.en: The effect matrix localizes biased atoms and the sparse solver performs minimal persistent repair under preservation constraints.

external_reviews.finding: This is a defensible standalone thesis if the intervention labels are independently grounded. RRD already decomposes, filters, and reweights rubric criteria, while PReMISE audits and refines rubric sets and RubricBench demonstrates persistent rubric-alignment failures. The surviving mechanism is sharper: estimate atom-level causal effects using pre-registered causal and neutral interventions, then make a minimal persistent edit subject to explicit neutral-preservation constraints. A simpler L1-style solver can instantiate the sparse editor, but it does not erase the core contribution because the non-removable object is the independently identified intervention-effect representation plus preservation-constrained update. ([arXiv][3])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 如果干预标签具有独立可靠的真值来源，这个方向可以形成独立论文。RRD 已经会分解、过滤和重新加权 rubric，PReMISE 也会审计并修复 rubric 集合，RubricBench 则证明了 rubric 与人类标准之间仍存在系统性问题。这里仍然保留下来的机制更明确：通过预注册的因果/中性干预识别 rubric 原子的因果效应，再在显式的中性维度保持约束下执行最小持久编辑。稀疏编辑器本身可以用更简单的 L1 类求解器实现，但这不会消除核心贡献，因为不可移除的对象是独立识别得到的干预效应结构以及带保持约束的更新。
external_reviews.required_action: Lock the claim to causally identified minimal rubric repair. Ensure causal and neutral labels come from an external human, executable, or otherwise independent oracle rather than the judge being repaired; include a direct L1/constrained-regression implementation as the simplest instantiation, plus held-out task, judge-model, and bias-composition transfer.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将论文命题锁定为“因果识别的最小 rubric 修复”。因果与中性标签必须来自外部人工、可执行规则或其他独立 oracle，而不能来自正在被修复的 judge；同时加入直接的 L1/约束回归实现作为最简实例，并进行未见任务、未见 judge 模型以及未见偏差组合的迁移。

problem.zh: 一次 Prompt/记忆/技能更新可能引入特定新脆弱性，但固定回归集通常覆盖不到更新语义附近的风险。
problem.en: A prompt/memory/skill update can introduce update-specific vulnerabilities that a fixed regression suite misses.

exact_mechanism.zh: 解析更新 diff 与被改变的行为契约，生成针对潜在副作用的挑战任务；失败挑战经独立判定后回流为训练或修复数据。
exact_mechanism.en: Parse update diffs and changed behavioral contracts, generate challenges targeting plausible side effects, and feed independently verified failures back as training or repair data.

learning_signal.zh: 更新 diff、行为契约、挑战结果和独立评分。
learning_signal.en: Update diffs, behavioral contracts, challenge outcomes, and independent scores.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新类型上的回归发现率与修复后泛化。
independent_ground_truth.en: Regression discovery and post-repair generalization on unseen update types.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定回归集、随机任务生成、Change-Triggered Regression Exams、红队 Prompt。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed regression suites, random task generation, Change-Triggered Regression Exams, and generic red-team prompts.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三类更新训练、一类更新留出；匹配测试/生成预算并评测发现后修复收益。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three update types and hold out a fourth under matched testing/generation budgets; measure downstream repair gains.

stop_condition.zh: 只提高发现率但不能带来修复收益，或固定回归同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it improves discovery but not repair, or fixed regression testing is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: diff 条件生成把测试聚焦到真实改变表面，失败回流使挑战真正影响持久更新而非只做评测。
necessity_logic.en: Diff conditioning focuses tests on the changed surface and feedback turns discovered failures into persistent updates rather than evaluation only.

external_reviews.finding: The regression problem is real, but the proposed learning object is underspecified: a persistent challenge curriculum may be only an accumulated dataset rather than a learned mechanism. PromptPex already extracts checkable specifications from prompts and generates targeted tests, Agent-Testing Agent automates adversarial agent testing, and ReCatcher addresses regression across model updates. A capacity-matched system can therefore parse the entire post-update specification, generate generic adversarial tests, and replay verified failures without learning a diff-conditioned policy. The thesis survives only if prior updates train a frozen diff-to-failure-family generator whose cross-update prior discovers failures that full-state specification testing does not. ([arXiv][4])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 回归测试问题确实真实，但当前“持久挑战课程”还没有被定义成明确的学习对象，它可能只是不断累积的数据集。PromptPex 已经能从 prompt 中抽取可检查规范并生成针对性测试，Agent-Testing Agent 会自动生成对抗式 agent 测试，ReCatcher 也研究模型更新间的回归。因此，一个容量匹配的简化系统完全可以读取更新后的完整规范、生成通用对抗测试并回放已验证失败，而无需学习 diff 条件策略。要保住论文命题，必须让历史更新真正训练出一个冻结的“diff→失败家族”生成策略，并证明这种跨更新先验能够发现完整状态规范测试发现不了的回归。
external_reviews.required_action: Specify and train the persistent object itself: a parameterized update-diff-to-challenge-family policy that is updated from independently verified failures and then frozen. Compare it directly with full-current-state specification extraction plus generic adversarial generation and hard-example replay, under identical generation, verifier, repair, and token budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要明确并训练真正的持久对象：一个从更新 diff 映射到挑战/失败家族的参数化策略，由独立验证的失败进行更新，之后冻结测试。必须直接与“读取完整当前状态进行规范抽取 + 通用对抗生成 + hard-example replay”的方案比较，并严格匹配生成、验证、修复和 token 预算。

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is persistent learning across update histories of which failure families are implied by particular update diffs, followed by frozen transfer to unseen update types.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: PromptPex-style full-state specification extraction plus generic adaptive red teaming and verified-failure replay, with the exact same generator model, evaluator, repair algorithm, calls, examples, and tokens.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train the diff-conditioned policy on three structurally distinct update types, freeze it, and test a fourth update type plus a held-out base model; under matched challenge counts and verifier calls, require both additional unique verified regressions over the full-state baseline and higher post-repair held-out generalization.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if diff conditioning increases only test diversity but not unique verified regression discovery and downstream repair, if the frozen policy fails on the held-out update type, or if full-state specification testing matches it within the pre-registered margin.
unknowns: Which parameters or persistent state constitute the proposed challenge curriculum rather than merely a stored test corpus.
How the independent verifier and behavioral ground truth will be constructed.
Whether the downstream repair method is fixed across approaches or itself contributes most of the gain.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Ignore the diff, extract specifications from the complete post-update prompt/memory/skill state, generate targeted tests with a PromptPex-style generator plus generic adversarial prompting, and append independently verified failures to a replay buffer used by the same repair algorithm.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned frozen cross-update prior mapping structural update diffs to failure families that yields additional independently verified regressions and downstream repair gains beyond full-state specification testing.

removable_components: failure-feedback-loop
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Update changes should condition a learned challenge policy, independently verified failures should update that persistent policy and the repaired system, and the frozen policy should anticipate regressions from unseen update types.

all_candidates.external_finding: The regression problem is real, but the proposed learning object is underspecified: a persistent challenge curriculum may be only an accumulated dataset rather than a learned mechanism. PromptPex already extracts checkable specifications from prompts and generates targeted tests, Agent-Testing Agent automates adversarial agent testing, and ReCatcher addresses regression across model updates. A capacity-matched system can therefore parse the entire post-update specification, generate generic adversarial tests, and replay verified failures without learning a diff-conditioned policy. The thesis survives only if prior updates train a frozen diff-to-failure-family generator whose cross-update prior discovers failures that full-state specification testing does not. ([arXiv][4])
all_candidates.external_finding_zh: 回归测试问题确实真实，但当前“持久挑战课程”还没有被定义成明确的学习对象，它可能只是不断累积的数据集。PromptPex 已经能从 prompt 中抽取可检查规范并生成针对性测试，Agent-Testing Agent 会自动生成对抗式 agent 测试，ReCatcher 也研究模型更新间的回归。因此，一个容量匹配的简化系统完全可以读取更新后的完整规范、生成通用对抗测试并回放已验证失败，而无需学习 diff 条件策略。要保住论文命题，必须让历史更新真正训练出一个冻结的“diff→失败家族”生成策略，并证明这种跨更新先验能够发现完整状态规范测试发现不了的回归。
all_candidates.external_required_action: Specify and train the persistent object itself: a parameterized update-diff-to-challenge-family policy that is updated from independently verified failures and then frozen. Compare it directly with full-current-state specification extraction plus generic adversarial generation and hard-example replay, under identical generation, verifier, repair, and token budgets.
all_candidates.external_required_action_zh: 需要明确并训练真正的持久对象：一个从更新 diff 映射到挑战/失败家族的参数化策略，由独立验证的失败进行更新，之后冻结测试。必须直接与“读取完整当前状态进行规范抽取 + 通用对抗生成 + hard-example replay”的方案比较，并严格匹配生成、验证、修复和 token 预算。
