problem.zh: 多轮 Prompt/记忆/工作流更新形成长版本链，重复约束和被覆盖规则增加冲突与维护成本。
problem.en: Long prompt/memory/workflow version chains accumulate redundant and shadowed rules, increasing conflict and maintenance cost.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把版本链转成类型化行为约束图，用反事实重放识别被覆盖与等价更新，再编译为更短规范状态并保留回滚映射。
exact_mechanism.en: Convert version history into a typed behavioral-constraint graph, identify shadowed/equivalent updates with counterfactual replay, and compile a shorter canonical state with rollback mapping.

learning_signal.zh: 版本链、更新依赖和反事实重放结果。
learning_signal.en: Version history, update dependencies, and counterfactual replay outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 规范化后冻结任务上的行为等价、回归和上下文成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Behavioral equivalence, regression, and context cost after canonicalization.

strongest_baseline.zh: 保留全部、文本摘要、最后版本、语义去重。
strongest_baseline.en: Keep-all, text summarization, last-version-only, and semantic deduplication.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造 10–30 轮更新链，压缩到固定预算，测试圈外任务与回滚恢复。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct 10–30 round update histories, compress to a fixed budget, and test out-of-loop tasks plus rollback recovery.

stop_condition.zh: 显著压缩下不能保持行为，或回滚映射不可靠则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if behavior cannot be preserved under meaningful compression or rollback mapping is unreliable.

necessity_logic.zh: 版本效应图识别可消去更新，规范编译器保证压缩后仍是可部署状态。
necessity_logic.en: The version-effect graph identifies removable updates and the canonical compiler guarantees a deployable compressed state.

external_reviews.finding: This has a plausible standalone mechanism and a clear persistent output: a canonicalized update state that replaces the original history before future tasks. Recent work already provides versioned graph memory, semantic rollback, and learned memory consolidation, but the reviewed work does not erase the specific combination of behaviorally testing shadow/equivalence relations across a multi-round update history, compiling the surviving constraints into a shorter canonical state, and preserving a rollback correspondence. The main risk is simplification to semantic deduplication plus replay, so the thesis must focus on histories with non-local, order-sensitive, or interacting constraints where text similarity is insufficient. ([arXiv][5])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方向具备较清晰的独立机制，持久输出也明确：用规范化后的更新状态真正替换原始历史，再影响未来任务。近期工作已经覆盖版本化图记忆、语义回滚和学习式记忆整合，但目前检索到的工作尚未直接覆盖这一完整组合：跨多轮更新历史通过行为反事实测试识别遮蔽/等价关系，将剩余约束编译成更短的规范状态，同时保留可回滚映射。主要风险是被“语义去重 + replay 验证”简化，因此论文必须聚焦文本相似度无法处理的非局部、顺序敏感或交互式约束历史。
external_reviews.required_action: Define the behavioral-constraint graph over genuinely interacting histories, separate replay probes used for compaction decisions from the held-out equivalence suite, and include a capacity-matched semantic-deduplication-plus-replay baseline. Demonstrate frozen transfer across update compositions and at least one held-out model or update surface.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要在真正存在交互的更新历史上定义行为约束图，并将用于决定压缩的 replay probes 与最终独立等价性测试集严格分离；加入容量匹配的“语义去重 + replay”基线，并展示对未见更新组合以及至少一个未见模型或更新表面的冻结迁移。

closest_work.title: Graph-Native Cognitive Memory for AI Agents
ChronoMem: Version Control and Semantic Rollback for Large Language Model Agent Memory
TRUSTMEM: Learning Trustworthy Memory Consolidation for LLM Agents with Long-Term Memory

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving contribution is behavior-preserving canonical compilation of an entire interacting update history, backed by counterfactual effect relations and an explicit mapping from canonical state back to rollback-relevant history.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Semantic entailment/deduplication plus last-write-wins and greedy counterfactual replay validation, using the same model calls, history, replay probes, final context budget, and rollback metadata.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate 10–30-round histories containing redundant, superseding, order-sensitive, and interacting constraints; learn compaction using one replay probe set, freeze the canonical state, and evaluate disjoint out-of-loop tasks, unseen update compositions, and rollback queries against the semantic-deduplication-plus-replay baseline at the same context budget.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if meaningful compression cannot preserve held-out behavior, if rollback mapping fails on pre-registered recovery queries, or if semantic deduplication plus replay achieves equivalent compression, behavior preservation, and rollback accuracy.
unknowns: How complete counterfactual replay must be to distinguish true behavioral equivalence from equivalence on sampled probes.
Whether rollback mapping is defined for partially overlapping or non-commutative updates.
Whether the proposed 10–30-round histories produce enough non-local interactions for the graph representation to be necessary.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Semantically cluster or entailment-deduplicate history entries, apply last-write-wins to obvious supersessions, then replay the same behavioral probes and greedily restore any deletion that changes behavior.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned or induced dependency/effect graph that safely canonicalizes non-local and order-sensitive update interactions and provides a valid rollback mapping where similarity-based deduplication plus replay fails.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Counterfactual replay identifies the behavioral dependencies and supersessions accumulated across updates, and the compiler replaces that history with a shorter deployable state while retaining behavioral and rollback semantics.

title.zh: 工作流反例模板挖掘器

problem.zh: 工作流修复常只看到失败实例，缺少能区分正确和错误结构的最小反例模板。
problem.en: Workflow repair sees failure instances but lacks minimal counterexample templates that separate valid from invalid structures.

exact_mechanism.zh: 通过结构删除/替换寻找最小故障保持子图，聚合为类型化反例模板，并用模板指导未来修复与测试生成。
exact_mechanism.en: Find minimal failure-preserving subgraphs via structural deletion/substitution, aggregate them into typed counterexample templates, and use them to guide future repair and test generation.

learning_signal.zh: 最小故障子图、匹配正例和修复后结果。
learning_signal.en: Minimal failure subgraphs, matched positives, and post-repair outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见工作流上的故障召回、修复效率和误报率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Failure recall, repair efficiency, and false-positive rate on unseen workflows.

strongest_baseline.zh: 失败日志聚类、图异常检测、最近故障检索、手写 motif。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure-log clustering, graph anomaly detection, nearest-failure retrieval, and handwritten motifs.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个工作流环境中学习模板，按 motif 和 API 双重留出测试。
decisive_pilot.en: Learn templates in two workflow environments and evaluate with motif/API double holdout.

stop_condition.zh: 模板不比日志聚类提高圈外修复效率，或误报高则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if templates do not improve out-of-loop repair efficiency over log clustering or false positives are high.

necessity_logic.zh: 最小反例提取给出结构因果边界，模板复用使其成为未来持久知识。
necessity_logic.en: Minimal counterexample extraction identifies structural causal boundaries and template reuse turns them into persistent future knowledge.

external_reviews.finding: The problem and persistent template library are coherent, but the current idea is too close to an existing failure-localization-and-repair stack to support a standalone thesis. Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement already builds recurring failure structure from counterexamples and performs targeted workflow edits; AgenTracer uses counterfactual interventions to localize causal failure points; CausalFlow likewise performs interventional failure attribution and counterfactual repair. Replacing explicit minimal-subgraph mining with failure-signature clustering plus nearest-counterexample retrieval is a strong same-budget simplification, leaving 'typed templates' primarily as a representation choice unless their minimality produces a separately falsifiable transfer law. ([arXiv][6])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题本身成立，持久的反例模板库也具有一致性，但当前方案与已有“失败定位—修复”路线过于接近，尚不足以成为独立论文。Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement 已经从反例中归纳重复失败结构并进行针对性的工作流编辑；AgenTracer 使用反事实干预定位因果失败位置；CausalFlow 也执行干预式失败归因与反事实修复。若用失败签名聚类加最近反例检索替代显式的最小子图挖掘，在相同预算下很可能复现主要收益，因此“typed template”目前更像一种表示形式，而不是不可替代的学习机制，除非最小性本身能够带来独立可证伪的迁移规律。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not proceed with the current template-library thesis as a standalone method. A viable revival must materially change the learned object to something stronger than clustered failure motifs, such as a compositional counterexample grammar or certified anti-pattern operators whose learned composition predicts failures and repairs on unseen graph sizes, APIs, and motif combinations without retrieving source counterexamples.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不建议以当前“模板库”形式继续作为独立方法论文。若要复活，必须实质改变学习对象，使其明显强于失败 motif 聚类，例如学习可组合的反例语法或带可验证最小性/因果性的 anti-pattern 算子，并要求它们在不检索原始反例的情况下，对未见图规模、API 和 motif 组合预测失败并指导修复。

closest_work.title: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement
AgenTracer: Who Is Inducing Failure in the LLM Agentic Systems?
CausalFlow: Causal Attribution and Counterfactual Repair for LLM Agent Failures

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The narrow remaining boundary is inclusion-minimal structural counterexamples aggregated into a reusable typed library and evaluated under motif/API double holdout, but minimality has not yet been shown to create capabilities unavailable from existing failure-mode clustering and causal localization.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement-style recurring failure signatures plus causal localization and nearest-failure retrieval, with identical failed/positive traces, repair model, test generator, calls, and token budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Before reviving, construct unseen workflows containing novel compositions of known motifs and unseen APIs, prohibit retrieval of source counterexamples, and compare learned minimal operators against clustered failure signatures; require a pre-registered gain in failure prediction and repair efficiency that persists after matching template/library capacity.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep blocked if clustered failure signatures plus retrieval match the proposed templates on double-holdout failure recall and repair efficiency, or if structural minimality does not predict transfer after controlling for template size and frequency.
unknowns: Whether minimal failure-preserving subgraphs are unique or stable under different valid deletion and substitution sequences.
How typed templates are canonicalized across APIs and semantically equivalent workflow implementations.
Whether template minimality provides information beyond the recurring failure signatures already exploited by existing workflow-refinement methods.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Use the same failed and matched-positive workflows to compute ordinary failure signatures, cluster them, retrieve the nearest cluster exemplars for each new workflow, and feed those exemplars to the identical repair/test generator without extracting minimal subgraphs or compiling typed templates.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A formally or empirically identifiable minimal structural operator whose composition transfers to unseen workflows better than failure clustering, exemplar retrieval, and existing causal-localization methods.

template-reuse

title.zh: 跨表面模型替换重写器

problem.zh: 换 backbone 后，原更新表面可能不再适合：旧模型需要 Prompt 修复，新模型可能更适合记忆或工具约束。
problem.en: After a backbone swap, the previously effective update surface may become inappropriate: a prompt fix may need to become memory or a tool constraint.

exact_mechanism.zh: 联合学习模型差分与跨表面行为等价映射，选择并转译到目标模型最稳定的更新表面，而不是只改写原资产。
exact_mechanism.en: Jointly learn model-difference features and cross-surface behavioral equivalence, choosing and transpiling to the most stable update surface for the target model instead of merely rewriting the original asset.

learning_signal.zh: 源/目标模型行为差分、跨表面修复对和迁移结果。
learning_signal.en: Source/target behavioral differences, cross-surface repair pairs, and migration outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见模型家族上的迁移成功、回归和资产复杂度。
independent_ground_truth.en: Migration success, regression, and asset complexity on an unseen model family.

strongest_baseline.zh: MASA、PromptBridge、固定表面重写、Cross-Surface Update Transpiler。
strongest_baseline.en: MASA, PromptBridge, fixed-surface rewriting, and Cross-Surface Update Transpiler.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三个模型家族×三更新表面，双重留出模型家族和修复类型。
decisive_pilot.en: Use three model families by three update surfaces with double holdout over model family and repair type.

stop_condition.zh: 表面选择不能泛化到未见模型，或固定表面同样稳定则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if surface choice does not generalize to unseen models or a fixed surface is equally stable.

necessity_logic.zh: 模型差分决定哪类表面稳定，跨表面转译产生实际迁移资产；只做其中之一无法完成 model-swap repair。
necessity_logic.en: Model differences determine the stable surface and transpilation creates the migrated asset; either alone cannot complete model-swap repair.

external_reviews.finding: Model-swap incompatibility is well established for prompts and skills: PromptBridge transfers prompts across models, Prompt Migration addresses model-upgrade prompt repair, and MASA learns model-conditioned skill rewriting. The proposed cross-surface boundary is more ambitious and was not directly covered by the closest work found, but the current model-difference encoder is vulnerable to a decisive simplification: if target-model probes are permitted, simply generate candidates on prompt, memory, and tool-constraint surfaces and select the best with the same validation-call budget; if no target observations are permitted, the encoder needs an explicit observable model descriptor or its unseen-family prediction is not identifiable. ([arXiv][6])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 模型更换导致 prompt 或 skill 失效已经有充分直接工作：PromptBridge 处理跨模型 prompt 转移，Prompt Migration 研究模型升级后的 prompt 迁移，MASA 则学习 model-conditioned skill rewriting。候选方案真正可能的新颖边界是跨 update surface 的迁移，即 prompt、memory、tool constraint 之间发生类型变化；但当前的 model-difference encoder 面临一个很强的简化挑战：如果迁移时允许访问目标模型，那么可以直接在多个 surface 上各生成候选并用相同 probe 预算选择最佳项；如果完全不允许目标侧观察，则必须说明依靠什么可观测模型特征预测未见模型，否则 surface choice 不可识别。 ([arXiv][6])
external_reviews.required_action: Define both a target-model observation budget and a typed cross-surface behavioral/effect contract. Compare the learned router-transpiler against matched-budget target-time surface search and strongest within-surface migration methods. The thesis should require the frozen router to predict a stable target surface with fewer target evaluations while the transpiler preserves the common contract on a held-out model family and repair family.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须同时固定目标模型的观测预算，并定义跨 prompt、memory、tool constraint 都适用的类型化行为/效果契约。学习式 router-transpiler 应与相同预算下的目标侧 surface 搜索，以及各 surface 内最强迁移方法比较。核心贡献必须体现为：冻结 router 用更少的目标模型评测就能预测稳定 surface，同时 transpiler 在未见模型 family 和未见 repair family 上仍保持共同契约。

closest_work.title: PromptBridge: Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models
Skill is Not One-Size-Fits-All: Model-Aware Skill Alignment for LLM Agents
Prompt Migration: Stabilizing GenAI Applications with Evolving Large Language Models
SkCC: Portable and Secure Skill Compilation for Cross-Framework LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The closest work found migrates prompts or skills while keeping the representation class fixed; the remaining boundary is learned selection among fundamentally different persistent update surfaces followed by contract-preserving transpilation under backbone swap. ([arXiv][6])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Matched-budget target-time surface search that generates prompt, memory, and tool-constraint candidates, evaluates them with the exact same target-model probes, and selects the best candidate without learning model-difference features.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use at least four genuinely distinct model families and three update surfaces; train the router/transpiler on three families, freeze it, hold out the fourth family and one repair composition, and compare against fixed-surface migration plus matched-budget surface search with exactly equal target calls, tokens, candidate capacity, and evaluation data.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if matched-budget target-surface search matches or exceeds the learned router on held-out migration success and regression, if a single fixed surface is statistically equivalent, or if cross-surface transpilation violates the preregistered behavioral/effect contract above its tolerance.
unknowns: Whether prompt, memory, and tool-constraint repairs admit a common independently checkable equivalence contract.
Whether enough semantically aligned cross-surface repair pairs exist without manually encoding the desired answer.
What target-model observations are permitted at migration time.
Whether four sufficiently distinct model families can be evaluated within the intended low-resource budget.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: For each target model, generate one capacity-matched candidate on every allowed update surface, evaluate all candidates on the same fixed migration probe set, and select the best success-regression-complexity tradeoff without a learned model-difference encoder.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A frozen model-conditioned surface-selection operator that predicts the best surface with strictly fewer target evaluations than matched-budget search, plus a transpiler that preserves a typed behavioral/effect contract across surface types.

removable_components: model-difference-encoder if matched-budget target-surface search achieves equal migration success and stability
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The model-difference component must predict which update surface remains stable after a backbone change, and surface transpilation must instantiate an equivalent persistent repair on that selected surface.

all_candidates.external_finding: Model-swap incompatibility is well established for prompts and skills: PromptBridge transfers prompts across models, Prompt Migration addresses model-upgrade prompt repair, and MASA learns model-conditioned skill rewriting. The proposed cross-surface boundary is more ambitious and was not directly covered by the closest work found, but the current model-difference encoder is vulnerable to a decisive simplification: if target-model probes are permitted, simply generate candidates on prompt, memory, and tool-constraint surfaces and select the best with the same validation-call budget; if no target observations are permitted, the encoder needs an explicit observable model descriptor or its unseen-family prediction is not identifiable. ([arXiv][6])
all_candidates.external_finding_zh: 模型更换导致 prompt 或 skill 失效已经有充分直接工作：PromptBridge 处理跨模型 prompt 转移，Prompt Migration 研究模型升级后的 prompt 迁移，MASA 则学习 model-conditioned skill rewriting。候选方案真正可能的新颖边界是跨 update surface 的迁移，即 prompt、memory、tool constraint 之间发生类型变化；但当前的 model-difference encoder 面临一个很强的简化挑战：如果迁移时允许访问目标模型，那么可以直接在多个 surface 上各生成候选并用相同 probe 预算选择最佳项；如果完全不允许目标侧观察，则必须说明依靠什么可观测模型特征预测未见模型，否则 surface choice 不可识别。 ([arXiv][6])
all_candidates.external_required_action: Define both a target-model observation budget and a typed cross-surface behavioral/effect contract. Compare the learned router-transpiler against matched-budget target-time surface search and strongest within-surface migration methods. The thesis should require the frozen router to predict a stable target surface with fewer target evaluations while the transpiler preserves the common contract on a held-out model family and repair family.
all_candidates.external_required_action_zh: 必须同时固定目标模型的观测预算，并定义跨 prompt、memory、tool constraint 都适用的类型化行为/效果契约。学习式 router-transpiler 应与相同预算下的目标侧 surface 搜索，以及各 surface 内最强迁移方法比较。核心贡献必须体现为：冻结 router 用更少的目标模型评测就能预测稳定 surface，同时 transpiler 在未见模型 family 和未见 repair family 上仍保持共同契约。

removable_components: model-difference-encoder if matched-budget target-surface search achieves equal migration success and stability
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The model-difference component must predict which update surface remains stable after a backbone change, and surface transpilation must instantiate an equivalent persistent repair on that selected surface.

title.zh: 结构化记忆模型迁移器

problem.zh: 自然语言记忆在模型替换后会因检索习惯、工具约束和程序格式差异失效，普通 Prompt 转移不足以处理结构化资产。
problem.en: Structured agent memories can fail after a model swap because retrieval conventions, tool constraints, and program formats change; prompt transfer is insufficient.

exact_mechanism.zh: 将记忆拆成前置条件、动作程序、检索链接和约束，学习源模型到目标模型的组件级映射与重组，并在未见模型家族冻结。
exact_mechanism.en: Decompose memories into preconditions, action programs, retrieval links, and constraints; learn component-level mappings and recomposition from source to target models and freeze on an unseen model family.

learning_signal.zh: 跨模型结构化记忆对、执行轨迹和行为锚点。
learning_signal.en: Cross-model structured-memory pairs, execution traces, and behavioral anchors.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见模型家族上的记忆可用率、任务成功和回归。
independent_ground_truth.en: Memory usability, task success, and regression on an unseen model family.

strongest_baseline.zh: PromptBridge、MASA、目标模型从零重写、自然语言翻译。
strongest_baseline.en: PromptBridge, MASA, target-model rewrite-from-scratch, and natural-language translation.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三个开放模型家族，训练两家留一，冻结翻译器测试两任务域。
decisive_pilot.en: Use three open model families, train on two and hold out one, then freeze the translator across two task domains.

stop_condition.zh: 不能超过目标模型从零重写或 PromptBridge 类映射则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat target-model rewriting or PromptBridge-style mapping.

necessity_logic.zh: 结构分解把普通文本迁移变成资产语义迁移，组件翻译才能保留程序与约束关系。
necessity_logic.en: Structured decomposition turns text transfer into asset-semantic transfer, and component translation preserves program/constraint relations.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real, but the proposed thesis is currently squeezed by two very close 2026 directions. MASA already learns a model-conditioned rewriter that converts cross-model skill artifacts into target-backbone-specific persistent skill libraries, while SkVM explicitly decomposes skill requirements into primitive capabilities and compiles skills for heterogeneous model-harness pairs; PromptBridge additionally establishes learned cross-model artifact mapping as a strong simplification baseline. ([arXiv][1]) The surviving contribution cannot therefore be merely 'decompose memory and translate components'. It must demonstrate that typed decomposition of preconditions, action programs, retrieval links, and constraints preserves behavioral invariants under swaps that a capacity-matched monolithic rewriter cannot preserve.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实，但当前方法空间已被两个非常接近的 2026 年方向明显挤压。MASA 已经学习面向目标模型的 skill rewriter，把跨模型技能资产改写成目标 backbone 专属的持久技能库；SkVM 更进一步显式分解技能所需的 primitive capabilities，并针对异构 model-harness 对进行编译；PromptBridge 还使“学习一个跨模型资产映射”本身成为很强的简化基线。([arXiv][1]) 因而剩余贡献不能只是“结构化分解后逐组件翻译”，而必须证明 precondition、action program、retrieval link、constraint 的类型化分解能够在模型/执行环境切换时保持行为不变量，而同容量的整体改写器做不到。
external_reviews.required_action: Sharpen the learned object from a generic structured-memory translator into a typed invariant-preserving translator, preferably under joint model plus harness/tool-schema swaps. Define explicit type/consistency constraints for preconditions, programs, retrieval edges, and execution constraints, and train/evaluate the translator so those relations—not merely text similarity or target success—are preserved. The main comparison must give MASA-style monolithic rewriting, PromptBridge-style mapping, and target-model rewrite-from-scratch exactly the same source/target traces, model calls, tokens, and optimization budget.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 把学习对象从泛化的 structured-memory translator 收紧为“保持类型化不变量的 translator”，最好同时覆盖 model swap 与 harness/tool-schema swap。需要为 precondition、program、retrieval edge、execution constraint 定义明确的类型和一致性约束，并让训练与评测直接检验这些关系是否被保持，而不是只看文本相似度或最终成功率。主实验必须让 MASA 式整体改写、PromptBridge 式映射以及 target-model rewrite-from-scratch 使用完全相同的 source/target traces、模型调用、token 和优化预算。

closest_work.title: Skill is Not One-Size-Fits-All: Model-Aware Skill Alignment for LLM Agents
closest_work.overlap: mechanism — MASA optimizes a persistent skill library for each target backbone and trains a lightweight model-conditioned rewriter using cross-model skill transfers as training inputs. ([arXiv][1])

closest_work.title: SkVM: Revisiting Language VM for Skills across Heterogenous LLMs and Harnesses
closest_work.overlap: combination — SkVM targets skill portability across heterogeneous LLM-harness pairs, decomposes skill requirements into primitive capabilities, and performs capability-aware compilation and environment binding. ([arXiv][2])

closest_work.title: PromptBridge: Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models
closest_work.overlap: problem — PromptBridge identifies model drifting and learns a cross-model mapping from calibrated source-target prompt pairs for deployment on unseen tasks. ([arXiv][3])

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The defensible boundary is translation of a typed, relational memory object whose preconditions, executable programs, retrieval topology, and constraints must remain jointly valid after freezing; the searched works do not establish this exact invariant-preserving structured-memory translation objective.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A same-capacity MASA-style monolithic rewriter, additionally matched against target-model rewrite-from-scratch, with identical calibration tasks, execution traces, target-model calls, token budget, and training updates.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct source memories with explicit precondition/program/retrieval/constraint fields across two training model families and at least two harness or tool-schema regimes. Freeze all translators and evaluate a third model family plus unseen compositions. Compare typed translation, monolithic rewriting, PromptBridge-style mapping, and rewrite-from-scratch under identical budgets. Pre-register a hard subset in which one or more structural relations must change while semantic task intent is fixed, and measure both task success and relation-level execution validity.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop or collapse the idea into a baseline/component if the capacity-matched monolithic rewriter is statistically equivalent on held-out task success and structural-validity metrics, if decomposition gains disappear after equalizing calls/tokens, or if gains occur only on model families or schemas observed during translator training.
unknowns: Whether sufficient paired structured-memory assets can be generated without leaking held-out target execution labels into translation supervision.
Whether the proposed decomposition exposes invariants that are actually causal for transfer rather than merely convenient serialization fields.
Whether joint model/harness/tool-schema swaps remain feasible under the intended low-resource budget.
Whether retrieval-link translation contributes independently once preconditions, programs, and constraints are translated.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: A capacity-matched MASA-style model-conditioned monolithic rewriter trained on exactly the same source-target structured-memory pairs and execution traces, but receiving each memory asset as one serialization rather than decomposing it into typed components.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: Typed component decomposition plus relation-preserving recomposition must improve held-out executable-memory transfer beyond the monolithic rewriter, especially on cases where preconditions, tool schemas, retrieval dependencies, or action-program formats change.

removable_components: structured-asset-decomposition, unless typed-decomposition ablations show that a monolithic model-conditioned rewriter cannot recover the same frozen transfer behavior
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: A source-model memory asset becomes incompatible after a model or harness swap; the learned translator rewrites the persistent asset into a target-compatible structured object whose preserved relations improve future frozen executions.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: A source-model memory asset becomes incompatible after a model or harness swap; the learned translator rewrites the persistent asset into a target-compatible structured object whose preserved relations improve future frozen executions.

problem.zh: 回滚定位可以找出故障更新，但若证据不能转成未来更新组合规则，同类回退仍会重复。
problem.en: Rollback localization can identify faulty updates, but without reusable composition rules the same regressions recur.

exact_mechanism.zh: 在冻结的类型化更新描述符语言中，从随机回滚干预归纳带置信度的 no-good、compatibility 与 precedence 子句，并显式控制误阻断。
exact_mechanism.en: In a frozen typed update-descriptor language, induce confidence-bearing no-good, compatibility, and precedence clauses from randomized rollback interventions with explicit false-block control.

learning_signal.zh: 回滚干预、更新描述符、恢复结果和误阻断标签。
learning_signal.en: Rollback interventions, update descriptors, restoration outcomes, and false-block labels.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新组合上的回归预防率、误阻断率和效用保留。
independent_ground_truth.en: Regression prevention, false-block rate, and utility retention on unseen update compositions.

strongest_baseline.zh: ANNEAL、PMA/ProbDD 后验风险门控、Update-Composition Repair Compiler。
strongest_baseline.en: ANNEAL, PMA/ProbDD posterior risk gating, and Update-Composition Repair Compiler.

decisive_pilot.zh: 完整留出组合模板，比较子句库与相同干预历史训练的直接风险 gate。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out composition templates completely and compare the clause library with a direct risk gate trained on identical intervention history.

stop_condition.zh: 不能超越直接风险 gate 或误阻断过高则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat direct risk gating or false blocking is excessive.

necessity_logic.zh: 子句归纳产生可复用结构知识，误阻断控制保证它不是简单保守 gate。
necessity_logic.en: Clause induction creates reusable structural knowledge and false-block control prevents collapse into a conservative gate.

revival_condition.zh: 只有类型语言、概率语义和误阻断控制均明确时复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only when the typed language, probabilistic semantics, and false-block control are all explicit.

external_reviews.finding: This revival makes a material change: it turns rollback outcomes into a persistent relational clause library rather than only localizing or reverting a bad update. ANNEAL already learns governed typed symbolic patches with canary validation and rollback, and governed capability evolution already checks compatibility and rollback, but the checked work does not directly learn confidence-bearing no-good, compatibility, and precedence clauses from randomized rollback interventions and test them on unseen update compositions at a controlled false-block rate. The main erasure risk is a calibrated direct risk gate trained on the same interventions.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该 revival 的变化是实质性的：它把 rollback 结果转化为持久的关系型 clause library，而不只是定位或回滚坏更新。ANNEAL 已经学习带 canary 验证与回滚的 typed symbolic patch，governed capability evolution 也已有兼容性检查与回滚，但已核查工作尚未直接从随机化 rollback 干预中学习带置信度的 no-good、compatibility、precedence clauses，并在未见更新组合上以受控 false-block rate 验证。最大的消解风险是：同一干预历史训练出的校准直接风险门是否已经足够。
external_reviews.required_action: Make clause induction explicitly relational and composition-level: randomize update presence/order where feasible, hold out entire composition templates, calibrate both clause confidence and the direct-gate baseline to the same false-block operating point, and show extrapolation to unseen compositions rather than interpolation over descriptor vectors.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 把 clause induction 明确定义为关系型、组合级学习：在可行范围内随机化更新的存在/顺序，完整留出 composition template，把 clause confidence 与直接风险门校准到相同 false-block 工作点，并证明对未见组合的外推，而不是 descriptor 向量上的插值。

closest_work.title: ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning
Governed Capability Evolution for Embodied Agents: Safe Upgrade, Compatibility Checking, and Runtime Rollback for Embodied Capability Modules

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is learned probabilistic relational constraints over update composition and precedence, induced from interventions and evaluated for out-of-template regression prevention at matched false-block cost.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A calibrated direct posterior regression-risk gate over typed update descriptors trained on exactly the same randomized rollback history, with the threshold chosen to match false-block rate and utility.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Create factorial update sets with randomized inclusion and ordering, hold out full composition templates, and compare the frozen clause library with a capacity-matched direct probabilistic gate using identical intervention data; require lower unseen-composition regression at the same false-block rate and retained utility.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the direct risk gate matches clause induction on held-out composition templates within the pre-registered equivalence margin, if clause gains disappear at matched false-block rate, or if useful-update acceptance collapses.
unknowns: Whether randomized rollback interventions are sufficiently safe and numerous to identify precedence and compatibility rather than mere correlation.
Whether the typed descriptor language is expressive enough for real update interactions without becoming domain-specific.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Train a calibrated direct regression-risk classifier on the same update descriptors, rollback interventions, restoration outcomes, and false-block labels, then gate updates at a threshold chosen to match the clause system's false-block rate.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: Relational no-good/compatibility/precedence clauses that extrapolate to unseen update compositions and orderings where a capacity-matched direct risk gate fails at the same false-block rate.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Probabilistic clause induction converts intervention outcomes into reusable composition constraints, and false-block control prevents those learned constraints from degenerating into a reject-most-updates safety gate.

title.zh: 类型化纠错技能语法 v5

problem.zh: 纠错技能若只是按失败轨迹存储，很难在未见失败组合上重组。
problem.en: Correction skills stored per failure trace do not systematically recombine on unseen failure compositions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 自动归纳感知/规划/工具/执行失败槽，把必要纠错动作编译为产生式；冻结语法后在未见失败组合、工具域和模型上组合调用。
exact_mechanism.en: Automatically induce perception/planning/tool/execution failure slots and compile necessary correction actions into productions; freeze the grammar and compose it on unseen failure combinations, tool domains, and models.

learning_signal.zh: 模块替换干预、必要纠错动作和自动失败槽。
learning_signal.en: Module-replacement interventions, necessary correction actions, and automatically induced failure slots.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见失败组合上的修复成功和产生式复用率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Repair success and production reuse on unseen failure compositions.

strongest_baseline.zh: ASI、NSI、扁平技能库、最近修复检索、Correction-Action Causal Compiler。
strongest_baseline.en: ASI, NSI, flat skill libraries, nearest-repair retrieval, and Correction-Action Causal Compiler.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按失败组合和工具域双重留出，禁止测试时新增产生式。
decisive_pilot.en: Use double holdout over failure composition and tool domain and forbid new productions at test time.

stop_condition.zh: 失败槽需要人工标签，或最近修复检索同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if failure slots require manual labels or nearest-repair retrieval is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 自动失败槽去掉人工标签依赖，语法组合检验是否真的超越平面技能检索。
necessity_logic.en: Automatic failure slots remove manual labels and grammar composition tests whether the method truly exceeds flat repair retrieval.

revival_condition.zh: 只有同时满足自动失败槽与未见组合上的系统性重组，才复活为独立方法。
revival_condition.en: Revive only if failure slots are automatic and productions systematically recombine on unseen compositions.

external_reviews.finding: The revival is materially stronger than a flat correction library because failure slots are intended to be induced automatically and productions are frozen before compositional transfer. However, NSI already lifts traces into modular logic-grounded programs and supports permanent failure-driven skill growth, while SkillGraph and SkillComposer already model structured skill dependencies and composition. As written, the unique part—module-replacement interventions that identify failure slots and necessary correction actions—is not specified tightly enough to show that the grammar learns an interventionally identified correction operator rather than attaching existing compositional skills to a learned failure classifier.

title.zh: API 语义工作流 IR v5

problem.zh: 工作流跨 API 迁移时，函数名和 schema 相似并不保证前置条件、效应与错误恢复语义相同。
problem.en: Across API migrations, similar names and schemas do not guarantee equivalent preconditions, effects, or recovery semantics.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从执行差分学习跨 API 不变的 precondition/effect/error 语义 IR，并将源工作流编译到目标 API，保持恢复分支。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn an API-invariant semantic IR for preconditions, effects, and errors from execution differences, then compile source workflows to target APIs while preserving recovery branches.

learning_signal.zh: 跨 API 等价任务、执行状态差分和错误恢复结果。
learning_signal.en: Cross-API equivalent tasks, execution-state differences, and recovery outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 完全未见 API 家族上的行为等价、恢复成功和成本。
independent_ground_truth.en: Behavioral equivalence, recovery success, and cost on a completely unseen API family.

strongest_baseline.zh: 直接 LLM 重写、SkCC、手写中间表示、执行修复循环。
strongest_baseline.en: Direct LLM rewrite, SkCC, handwritten IRs, and execution-repair loops.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三 API 家族训练两家留一家，冻结 IR 后编译，禁止测试时重新学习语义。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on two of three API families, freeze the IR, and compile to the held-out family without test-time semantic learning.

stop_condition.zh: 冻结 IR 不能跨家族保持恢复语义，或直接执行修复同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the frozen IR does not preserve recovery semantics across families or direct execution repair is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: IR 归纳负责可迁移语义，编译器负责实际目标工作流；必须共同超过直接重写。
necessity_logic.en: IR induction supplies transferable semantics and the compiler creates the target workflow; together they must beat direct rewriting.

revival_condition.zh: 只有明确学习算子并在 API 家族留出上超过直接重写才复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only with an explicit learned semantic operator that beats direct rewriting on held-out API families.

external_reviews.finding: The failure is real and the proposed frozen semantic IR is a persistent learned object, but the held-out-API-family claim is currently under-specified: compilation to a completely unseen API is not identifiable unless the target-side observation contract is fixed. SkCC already establishes typed IR plus target-specific compilation for agent portability, while M3 semantically models APIs for migration and SPELL distills API-migration knowledge into reusable transformation programs. The surviving thesis is therefore not IR-plus-compilation itself, but learned precondition/effect/error semantics that preserve recovery behavior under a tightly bounded target-observation budget. ([arXiv][1])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 问题真实，冻结后的语义 IR 也确实属于能够持续改变后续行为的学习对象；但目前“完全未见 API family 上直接编译”的可识别性不足：必须明确目标 API 在迁移时究竟允许观察哪些信息。SkCC 已经覆盖了类型化 IR 加目标侧编译的可移植框架，M3 已经从行为层面对 API 做语义建模并用于迁移，SPELL 则把迁移知识蒸馏成可复用变换程序。因此真正剩下的论文边界应当是：在严格限定的目标侧观测预算下，学习并冻结前置条件、效果和错误语义，并证明它能保留恢复分支。 ([arXiv][1])
external_reviews.required_action: Specify a fixed target-observation contract, such as documentation/schema plus exactly N execution probes; make the learned object an explicit precondition/effect/error transition operator; and compare its frozen transfer against direct rewrite plus execution repair and a hand-designed/general IR with identical target calls, tokens, and repair budget.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须固定目标 API 的可观测边界，例如仅允许文档/Schema 加严格限定的 N 次执行 probe；把学习对象明确为前置条件、效果和错误转移算子；然后在完全相同的目标调用次数、token 和修复预算下，对比直接重写加执行修复以及手工/通用 IR。

closest_work.title: SkCC: Portable and Secure Skill Compilation for Cross-Framework LLM Agents
M3: Semantic API Migrations
SPELL: Synthesis of Programmatic Edits using LLMs

direct_collision.surviving_difference: None of the closest work found jointly learns API-invariant precondition/effect/error semantics from cross-API execution differences and tests frozen preservation of recovery branches on a new API family under a fixed semantic-observation budget. ([arXiv][1])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Direct LLM rewrite with the same target documentation/schema, identical execution probes, and an identical bounded execution-repair loop.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train the semantic operator on two API families, freeze it, expose every method to the same target documentation and fixed N probes on a third family, and compare recovery-branch equivalence, task success, and cost against direct rewrite plus repair and hand-designed IR compilation.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the 95% confidence interval for held-out recovery-success improvement over direct rewrite plus repair includes zero and semantic-violation rate is not lower at the identical probe/call budget.
unknowns: What target API information is available when the family is unseen.
Whether sufficiently aligned cross-API tasks with independently checkable recovery semantics exist at useful scale.
Whether a portable semantic state space can represent heterogeneous authentication, side-effect, transaction, and error conventions.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Direct LLM workflow rewriting conditioned on the same source/target documentation and schema, followed by the same bounded execution-repair loop and target probes.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A frozen semantic transition/error operator whose predictions improve held-out recovery-branch preservation beyond direct rewriting and repair under the identical target-observation budget.

removable_components: semantic-ir-induction if a direct execution-conditioned rewriter matches held-out recovery preservation under the same budget
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Semantic induction must infer portable behavioral contracts and compilation must instantiate those contracts on the target API so that migration preserves both successful execution and recovery semantics.

problem.zh: 多轮自进化后，旧课程可能继续强化已掌握能力，同时忽略新出现的失败边界。
problem.en: After multiple evolution rounds, stale curricula can oversample mastered capabilities while ignoring newly emerging failure boundaries.

exact_mechanism.zh: 学习任务族的训练边际收益与版本漂移，周期性重分配训练预算到效用上升或新失败边界，并保留稳定任务作为回归锚点。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn task-family marginal training gain and version drift, reallocating training budget toward rising utility or new failure boundaries while preserving stable tasks as regression anchors.

learning_signal.zh: 历史训练分配、checkpoint 变化、任务族效应和回归锚点。
learning_signal.en: Historical training allocation, checkpoint changes, task-family effects, and regression anchors.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 后续 checkpoint 的圈外提升、遗忘和预算效率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Out-of-loop improvement, forgetting, and budget efficiency of later checkpoints.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定课程、学习进度、失败率课程、Checkpoint-Discriminative Training Curriculum。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed curricula, learning progress, failure-rate curricula, and Checkpoint-Discriminative Training Curriculum.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两条真实版本流、固定训练预算、至少 4 轮重新分配，评测未见任务族。
decisive_pilot.en: Use two real version streams, fixed training budgets, at least four reallocations, and evaluate unseen task families.

stop_condition.zh: 不能提高后续 checkpoint 或遗忘恶化则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if later checkpoints do not improve or forgetting worsens.

necessity_logic.zh: 漂移估计判断课程何时过期，预算重分配真正改变训练数据；仅审计课程不构成学习机制。
necessity_logic.en: Drift estimation identifies stale curricula and budget reallocation actually changes training data; audit alone is not a learning mechanism.

revival_condition.zh: 只有闭合训练环且在后续 checkpoint 有因果收益时复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only when the training loop closes and causes gains in later checkpoints.

external_reviews.finding: The stale-curriculum failure is plausible, but the current mechanism is too close to established adaptive curriculum and data-mixture control unless 'version drift' becomes a causally identifiable quantity. Automated Curriculum Learning already reallocates sampling using learning-progress rewards; Teacher-Student Curriculum Learning explicitly prioritizes both improving and worsening tasks to address forgetting; Skill-it! and DoReMi provide strong learned data-allocation baselines. Historical allocations and checkpoint deltas alone are confounded because task families receiving more training are precisely those whose gains are subsequently observed. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][2])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 陈旧课程导致训练预算浪费的问题成立，但当前机制如果只是根据学习进展、失败率和遗忘情况重新分配数据，与已有自适应课程和数据配比工作高度重合。Automated Curriculum Learning 已经根据学习增益动态分配任务，Teacher-Student Curriculum Learning 同时关注进步和性能下降以处理遗忘，Skill-it! 与 DoReMi 也构成很强的数据分配基线。更关键的是，仅依靠历史训练分配和 checkpoint 变化无法识别真正的边际训练收益，因为“获得更多训练的任务”和“随后观察到更大变化的任务”本身就是混杂的。 ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][2])
external_reviews.required_action: Replace observational marginal-gain estimation with an intervention-grounded estimator: reserve randomized micro-allocations or logged exploration probabilities at every reallocation, estimate causal marginal utility with uncertainty, and make version-conditioned causal gain rather than generic learning progress the controller's distinctive learned object.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要把观察式的边际收益估计改成干预式估计：每轮保留随机微量预算扰动或明确记录探索概率，用这些数据估计带不确定性的因果边际训练收益，并把“版本条件下的因果训练收益”而不是普通学习进展作为核心学习对象。

closest_work.title: Automated Curriculum Learning for Neural Networks
Teacher-Student Curriculum Learning
Skill-it! A data-driven skills framework for understanding and training language models
DoReMi: Optimizing Data Mixtures Speeds Up Language Model Pretraining

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The credible remaining boundary is causal, version-conditioned estimation of the next-unit training return across repeated model-evolution rounds, followed by frozen transfer of that allocation rule to a separate version stream; generic progress-based adaptive curricula are already well covered. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][2])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A matched-budget TSCL/Automated-Curriculum controller using exponentially smoothed validation improvement, failure rate, and a forgetting floor at exactly the same reallocation cadence.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: At each of at least four reallocations, randomize a small fixed fraction of training budget across task families to identify marginal gain; learn the controller on one version stream, freeze it, and compare against the simple progress-plus-forgetting controller on a separate version stream and unseen task families with identical total tokens and optimizer steps.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the 95% confidence interval for held-out utility improvement over the progress-plus-forgetting baseline includes zero, or if forgetting exceeds that baseline by more than 1 percentage point under the same total training budget.
unknowns: Whether existing training logs contain randomized allocation or propensity information sufficient for causal estimation.
Whether two genuinely independent multi-version model streams with comparable task families are available.
Whether version-conditioned marginal gains remain stable enough to transfer after the controller is frozen.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: A TSCL-style controller that reallocates the same budget using only recent held-out learning-progress slope plus a forgetting/regression floor, with no learned drift model.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A version-conditioned causal marginal-training-gain estimator that predicts which task family benefits from the next unit of training better than simple progress, failure-rate, or forgetting statistics.

removable_components: drift-estimation if recent learning-progress and forgetting statistics produce the same allocations and downstream gains
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Causal drift estimation must identify where an additional training unit has newly increased value, and budget reallocation must turn that estimate into persistent checkpoint changes while regression anchors constrain forgetting.

title.zh: 评价器残差策略修正 v5

problem.zh: 静态评价器校准无法处理 actor 与 evaluator 版本共同变化造成的未来评分偏差。
problem.en: Static evaluator calibration cannot handle future bias caused by joint actor/evaluator version drift.

exact_mechanism.zh: 用完整 actor-version×evaluator-version 交叉历史学习低秩时间交互残差，并将残差修正头用于未来版本的候选策略排序与选择。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn low-rank temporal interaction residuals from a fully crossed actor-version by evaluator-version history and use a residual correction head for future-version policy ranking and selection.

learning_signal.zh: 交叉版本评分、独立锚点和真实下游任务结果。
learning_signal.en: Crossed version scores, independent anchors, and true downstream task outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未来 evaluator 版本上的策略选择 regret 和真实能力排序。
independent_ground_truth.en: Policy-selection regret and true capability ranking on future evaluator versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: Bridge、SAJA、冻结 evaluator、Evaluator Ensemble。
strongest_baseline.en: Bridge, SAJA, frozen evaluators, and evaluator ensembles.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少 6 轮交叉历史，未来两个版本完全留出，比较静态与纵向校准。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least six crossed rounds and hold out two future versions completely to compare static and longitudinal calibration.

stop_condition.zh: 纵向交互不提高未来策略选择则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if longitudinal interactions do not improve future policy selection.

necessity_logic.zh: 交叉历史提供静态校准缺失的信息，最终以策略选择而不是偏差预测作为持久效果。
necessity_logic.en: Crossed history provides information absent from static calibration and policy selection, not bias prediction alone, is the persistent effect.

revival_condition.zh: 只有在未来版本策略选择上超过静态校准才复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only if future-version policy selection beats static calibration.

external_reviews.finding: Evaluator replacement drift is now directly documented, and Bridge and SAJA already establish strong calibration baselines. The proposed actor-version by evaluator-version interaction is potentially distinct, but completely holding out a future evaluator makes arbitrary future bias unidentifiable unless some observable feature or independent anchor from that evaluator is supplied. A temporal low-rank factorization cannot infer an unconstrained new evaluator merely from historical version index. ([NeurIPS Proceedings][3])

title.zh: 更新差分因果重授权器

problem.zh: Agent 更新后继续沿用旧权限会引入新越权，而统一降权又损害效用。
problem.en: Reusing old permissions after an agent update can create new overreach, while uniform downgrade harms utility.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对 Prompt/记忆/技能/工作流 diff 做干预式表示学习，预测哪些权限因本次更新新增风险，只运行针对这些权限的独立 canary，再更新租约。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn intervention-grounded representations of prompt/memory/skill/workflow diffs, predict which permissions become newly risky, run independent canaries only for those permissions, and update the lease.

learning_signal.zh: 更新 diff、权限干预、canary 结果、越权和任务效用。
learning_signal.en: Update diffs, permission interventions, canary outcomes, overreach, and task utility.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见更新算子上的安全-效用 Pareto 与权限恢复正确率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Safety-utility Pareto and permission-restoration accuracy on unseen update operators.

strongest_baseline.zh: Progent 式动态策略、静态最小权限、统一降权、完整重认证。
strongest_baseline.en: Progent-style dynamic policy, static least privilege, uniform downgrade, and full reauthorization.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三类更新训练、一类更新留出；canary 生成与评分独立于风险模型。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three update types and hold out a fourth; canary generation and scoring remain independent of the risk model.

stop_condition.zh: 未见更新算子上不优于动态策略或完整重认证则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat dynamic policy or full reauthorization on unseen update operators.

necessity_logic.zh: diff 风险模型缩小需要重认证的权限集合，独立 canary 决定实际权限更新；两者共同避免循环自评。
necessity_logic.en: The diff-risk model narrows permissions needing reauthorization and independent canaries decide actual updates, avoiding circular self-evaluation.

revival_condition.zh: 只有在未见更新算子上稳定降低重认证成本且不牺牲安全时复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only if it reduces reauthorization cost on unseen update operators without sacrificing safety.

external_reviews.finding: The problem has a very recent direct collision: Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? explicitly formulates authorization continuity after evolving-agent mutations and introduces state-bound grants, transition envelopes, and an immutable effect ceiling. Progent, SkillGuard, and SkillScope also make dynamic or fine-grained least-privilege controls strong baselines. The candidate can still survive as a learned permission-level triage mechanism that predicts which grants require independent re-testing after a mutation, but it no longer owns the broad 'does old authorization survive an update?' thesis. ([arXiv][4])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 这里已经出现非常直接的最新碰撞：Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? 已经明确提出“agent 演化后旧授权是否仍然有效”的 authorization continuity 问题，并给出 state-bound grant、transition envelope 和不可提升的 effect ceiling。Progent、SkillGuard、SkillScope 也构成动态或细粒度最小权限的强基线。因此该候选不能再把“更新后重新授权”本身作为主要新颖性，真正可能保留下来的贡献是：学习到 permission-level 的更新风险，从而只对少数可疑授权执行独立 canary 重测。 ([arXiv][4])
external_reviews.required_action: Reframe the method as a learned cost-reduction layer inside state-bound authorization rather than a new authorization-continuity framework. Keep an immutable effect ceiling, obtain causal supervision from randomized permission interventions, keep canary generation/scoring independent, and compare learned triage against deterministic manifest/effect-diff triage, Progent-style policies, and full reauthorization.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 应把方法重构为 state-bound authorization 内部的“降低重新授权成本”的学习层，而不是重新提出 authorization continuity 框架。保留不可提升的 effect ceiling；通过随机权限干预获得因果监督；canary 的生成和评分必须与风险模型独立；并与基于 manifest/effect diff 的确定性筛选、Progent 类动态策略和全量重新授权进行严格对比。

SkillScope: Toward Fine-Grained Least-Privilege Enforcement for Agent Skills

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: State-bound authorization with immutable effect ceiling plus deterministic manifest/effect-diff targeted reauthorization and the identical independent canary budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate randomized permission interventions for three mutation classes, train and freeze the diff-risk predictor, then test a fourth unseen mutation class with a fixed canary budget against deterministic effect-diff triage and full reauthorization; canary generation and scoring must be produced by held-out components.

unknowns: Whether update diffs can be normalized across prompt, memory, skill, workflow, model, and harness mutations without leaking mutation identity.
Whether permission-level randomized interventions are feasible at enough scale to learn transferable causal risk.
Whether independent canaries cover realized effects well enough to support a safety non-inferiority claim.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: Deterministically reauthorize only permissions whose declared manifest, reachable-effect set, or dependency graph changed, then run the same independent canaries on that subset.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: A learned intervention-grounded diff-risk predictor that reduces the number of permissions/canaries requiring reauthorization on unseen mutation operators without increasing unauthorized realized effects.

removable_components: causal-diff-risk-model if deterministic manifest/effect-diff triage attains the same safety and reauthorization cost
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The risk model must narrow the permissions whose validity is uncertain after an update, while independent targeted canaries provide non-circular evidence for changing the persistent permission lease.

title.zh: 检索介导伤害析因修复 v5

problem.zh: 记忆伤害可能来自内容、位置、共同检索或检索本身，单一暴露随机化无法区分。
problem.en: Memory harm can arise from content, position, co-retrieval, or retrieval itself, which single exposure randomization cannot separate.

exact_mechanism.zh: 预注册析因干预分别操纵是否纳入、内容替换、排序位置和共同检索，估计路径效应后学习对应的重写/排序/互斥修复策略。
exact_mechanism.en: Pre-register factorial interventions over inclusion, content substitution, rank position, and co-retrieval; estimate pathway effects and learn pathway-specific rewrite/order/exclusion repairs.

learning_signal.zh: 析因干预结果、环境奖励和未来重用结果。
learning_signal.en: Factorial-intervention outcomes, environment rewards, and future reuse outcomes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见记忆身份上的路径识别准确度和修复收益。
independent_ground_truth.en: Pathway-identification accuracy and repair gain on unseen memory identities.

strongest_baseline.zh: Causal Memory Intervention、MemAudit、上下文 Bandit 直接学修复动作。
strongest_baseline.en: Causal Memory Intervention, MemAudit, and contextual-bandit direct repair learning.

decisive_pilot.zh: 相同干预数据下比较路径分解+修复与直接多臂老虎机，匹配调用和存储预算。
decisive_pilot.en: Compare pathway decomposition plus repair against direct contextual-bandit repair on identical intervention data and matched call/storage budgets.

stop_condition.zh: 路径分解不能提高圈外修复，或直接 Bandit 同样有效则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if pathway decomposition does not improve out-of-loop repair or direct bandit learning is equally effective.

necessity_logic.zh: 析因干预使伤害路径可识别，路径特定修复检验这种识别是否有独立价值。
necessity_logic.en: Factorial interventions make harm pathways identifiable and pathway-specific repair tests whether that identification adds independent value.

revival_condition.zh: 只有相对直接修复学习器存在稳定增益时才复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only if pathway identification adds stable value over direct repair learning.

external_reviews.finding: The idea has a credible novelty boundary beyond existing causal memory selection and post-hoc memory attribution: CMI intervenes on memory usefulness/harm, while MemAudit performs counterfactual attribution and removal, but neither source found establishes a pathway-specific repair policy over content, rank, co-retrieval, and retrieval exposure. However, the proposed 'factorial' design is not yet causally well-formed: content and rank are undefined when the focal memory is excluded, creating structural cells rather than an ordinary fully crossed factorial, and pathway-identification accuracy is not independent ground truth if it is derived from the same intervention outcomes used for training. ([arXiv][5])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方向相对于现有 causal memory selection 和 post-hoc attribution 确实还有清晰空间：CMI 已经通过干预判断记忆是否有益/有害，MemAudit 也已经进行反事实归因和删除修复，但目前查到的工作没有同时分解内容、排序位置、共同检索和是否检索这些路径并学习对应修复策略。问题在于当前所谓的“factorial”设计并不是普通的完全析因实验：当目标记忆不被检索时，其内容替换和排序位置在结构上不存在；此外，如果 pathway label 直接由训练时的同一组干预结果推导，那么所谓 pathway-identification accuracy 也不是独立 ground truth。 ([arXiv][5])
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the naive full factorial with a preregistered nested/structural causal design: randomize retrieval inclusion first, then randomize content, rank, and co-retrieval only in valid descendant cells. Obtain independent pathway labels from controlled synthetic/semisynthetic memory generators or make held-out future-reuse repair gain the primary endpoint. Retain the matched-data direct contextual-bandit repair baseline.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 需要把简单的完全析因设计改成预注册的嵌套/结构因果实验：先随机化是否检索，只有在记忆实际被包含的有效分支中再随机化内容、排序和共同检索。路径真值应来自独立构造的合成/半合成机制，或者直接把未来复用时的修复收益设为主要终点；同时必须保留使用完全相同干预数据的直接 contextual-bandit 修复作为消融基线。

How interactions among content, rank, and co-retrieval should be parameterized without an infeasible number of intervention cells.
Whether pathway effects transfer across retrievers, rerankers, agent models, and unseen memory compositions.

title.zh: 效应迁移经验专化 v5

problem.zh: 一条经验在源任务有效，却可能在目标任务族产生负迁移；只输出迁移证书仍不改变持久知识。
problem.en: A lesson may help its source task but harm a target family; a transport certificate alone does not change persistent knowledge.

exact_mechanism.zh: 用多任务随机化效应和支持重叠学习可迁移区域；对不可全局迁移的经验自动分裂为任务族条件子经验，并对未知区域弃权。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn transportable regions from randomized multi-task effects and support overlap; automatically split non-global lessons into task-family-conditioned descendants and abstain outside support.

learning_signal.zh: 跨任务族随机化经验效应、支持描述和模型家族信息。
learning_signal.en: Randomized lesson effects across task families, support descriptors, and model-family information.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 完全未见任务族上的效应符号、负迁移率和覆盖率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Effect sign, negative-transfer rate, and coverage on fully unseen task families.

strongest_baseline.zh: Conformal/R-learner 迁移 gate、语义相似度、Effect-Bifurcation Memory Learner。
strongest_baseline.en: Conformal/R-learner transport gates, semantic similarity, and Effect-Bifurcation Memory Learner.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少 10 个任务族用于校准/留出，冻结后不得用目标标签，比较 gate-only 与自动专化。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least ten task families for calibration/holdout, forbid target labels after freezing, and compare gate-only versus automatic specialization.

stop_condition.zh: 校准无效、覆盖过低或专化不优于 gate-only 则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if calibration is invalid, coverage too low, or specialization does not beat gate-only.

necessity_logic.zh: 迁移风险估计确定适用区域，经验专化实际改变持久知识；只输出证书不能解决负迁移。
necessity_logic.en: Transport-risk estimation determines support and lesson specialization actually changes persistent knowledge; a certificate alone cannot repair negative transfer.

revival_condition.zh: 只有具备足够任务族和有效支持假设时复活。
revival_condition.en: Revive only with enough task families and valid support assumptions.

external_reviews.finding: The problem is independently established and the v5 mechanism materially repairs the weakness of certificate-only ancestors. A 2026 systematic study finds non-trivial negative transfer for model-generated skills, including 25% negative extractor-target cells overall and substantially higher rates in some domains; personalized skill evolution likewise reports that one global library is suboptimal for heterogeneous clients. ([arXiv][4]) Unlike a transport certificate or inference-time gate, this proposal makes the estimated heterogeneity change persistent knowledge by splitting a lesson into supported task-family-conditioned descendants and retaining abstention outside identified support. No searched work combines randomized lesson-level effects, support-aware transport estimation, and persistent lineage specialization in this form. The thesis survives provided specialization beats both gate-only causal estimation and a capacity-matched non-causal task-conditioned router on the risk-coverage frontier.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该问题已有独立实证，而且 v5 的机制相对于仅做 certificate 的父方案产生了实质性修复。2026 年对 model-generated skills 的系统研究观察到明显的负迁移：整体 extractor-target 单元中约 25% 出现负迁移，部分领域更高；个性化 skill evolution 也表明异构用户使用单一全局 skill library 并非最优。([arXiv][4]) 与 transport certificate 或仅在推理时 gate 掉风险 lesson 不同，本方案会让估计出的 effect heterogeneity 真正修改持久知识：把非全局 lesson 自动拆成受支持的 task-family-conditioned descendants，并在无支持区域弃判。目前检索到的工作中，没有发现同时使用 lesson 级随机干预、support-aware effect transport 和持久 lineage specialization 的直接方案。成立的关键是 specialization 必须在 risk-coverage frontier 上同时胜过 gate-only 因果估计器以及同容量的非因果 task-conditioned router。
external_reviews.required_action: Keep the persistent lineage split as the central learned operator and make the causal identification contract explicit: randomize lesson inclusion versus exclusion within calibration families, cross-fit effect estimation, define support descriptors before seeing held-out outcomes, and forbid held-out-family labels after freezing. Add a capacity-matched semantic task-conditioned router/specializer—not just gate-only—as the primary erasing baseline. Report negative-transfer risk at matched coverage as well as aggregate reward, so specialization cannot win merely by abstaining more often.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 保留“持久 lesson lineage 拆分”作为核心学习算子，并明确因果识别条件：在 calibration families 内随机化 lesson inclusion/exclusion，采用 cross-fitting 估计 effect，在看到 held-out outcome 前冻结 support descriptors，并且冻结后禁止使用 held-out-family labels。除 gate-only 外，必须加入同容量的 semantic task-conditioned router/specializer 作为主要消融基线。同时报告 matched coverage 下的负迁移风险和总效用，避免 specialization 仅靠更多 abstention 获胜。

closest_work.title: From Raw Experience to Skill Consumption: A Systematic Study of Model-Generated Agent Skills
closest_work.overlap: problem — the study directly establishes substantial target- and domain-dependent negative transfer and reduces it using a utility-grounded extraction meta-skill, but does not learn causal transport regions or persistently bifurcate an existing lesson lineage. ([arXiv][4])

closest_work.title: FederatedSkill: Federated Learning for Agentic Skill Evolution
closest_work.overlap: combination — FederatedSkill maintains personalized persistent skill libraries and specializes global skills for heterogeneous model/harness/task distributions, but specialization is driven by client patch histories rather than randomized lesson effects and support-aware causal transport. ([arXiv][5])

closest_work.title: Integrative R-learner of heterogeneous treatment effects combining experimental and observational studies
closest_work.overlap: mechanism — R-learner methodology already supplies a principled route for estimating heterogeneous intervention effects from randomized evidence, so treatment-effect estimation itself is not the contribution; the surviving object is its conversion into persistent lesson specialization. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][6])

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving method boundary is a closed causal memory-update loop: randomized lesson interventions identify where a lesson transports, unsupported/global failures trigger persistent lineage bifurcation, and the resulting descendants are frozen and evaluated on completely unseen task families.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A matched-budget cross-fitted R-learner/conformal gate that never changes the lesson plus a capacity-matched task-descriptor router that directly selects among global or family-specific lesson rewrites; both receive the same randomized trials, descriptors, model calls, tokens, and evaluation budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use at least ten genuinely distinct task families and randomized lesson-on versus lesson-off interventions. Split by whole family, not instances: estimate effects and specialization rules on calibration families, freeze them, and evaluate completely unseen families with no target outcomes available to the learner. Compare global reuse, semantic routing, effect gate-only, and effect-driven persistent specialization under identical trial budgets. The decisive endpoint is the negative-transfer-versus-coverage frontier plus average treatment utility; additionally test a held-out model family if the trial budget permits.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if randomized treatment-effect estimates fail pre-specified calibration or overlap checks, if useful coverage collapses under valid support, if the semantic task-conditioned router matches specialization at matched negative-transfer risk and budget, or if specialization does not strictly improve the risk-coverage frontier over gate-only on leave-family-out evaluation.
unknowns: How many statistically independent task families and randomized repetitions are required for stable transport-risk calibration at the intended resource budget.
Whether lesson interventions satisfy a usable no-interference assumption when multiple stored lessons interact during execution.
Whether task-family support descriptors can be fixed independently of held-out outcome information and still predict effect modification.
Whether automatically generated descendants preserve lesson semantics rather than introducing new uncontrolled interventions.
Whether the gain persists under model-family holdout rather than only task-family holdout.

simplification_challenge.simplest_equivalent_method: A capacity-matched task-descriptor router that keeps one global lesson plus per-family rewritten copies and learns which copy to retrieve directly from observed task outcomes, without estimating randomized treatment effects, transport support, or conformal risk.
simplification_challenge.what_must_survive: Randomized effect-based support estimation must produce safer or broader leave-family-out transfer than direct semantic routing, while persistent lesson splitting must recover useful coverage that an otherwise identical gate-only estimator sacrifices.

combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: A globally stored lesson causes heterogeneous positive and negative effects across task families; transport-risk estimation identifies supported effect regions, and lesson specialization converts those regions into persistent descendants that improve future use while abstaining outside support.
