title.zh: 随机微分配下一单位收益控制器

problem.zh: 多轮模型演化后，近期学习进展可能把因模型版本变化产生的新训练收益与任务本身的自然波动混为一谈，使课程持续投入已经饱和的任务或错过新失败边界。
problem.en: Across repeated model-evolution rounds, recent learning progress can confound version-induced changes in training return with ordinary task noise, causing curricula to keep funding saturated tasks or miss newly valuable failure boundaries.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把观察到的 loss、成功率斜率或失败率变化当作某任务下一单位训练预算的收益；核心对象改为通过随机预算干预识别的、版本条件化的因果边际收益。
changed_assumption.en: Observed loss, success-rate slopes, or failure-rate changes are no longer treated as the return of the next unit of training. The learned object becomes version-conditioned causal marginal gain identified through randomized allocation interventions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 每轮训练预算中预留固定比例 epsilon 作为随机微分配：对候选任务族按已记录的非零探索概率随机增加一个微型训练块，其余预算由当前控制器分配。对每次微分配记录模型版本表示 v、任务族 k、分配概率 p、训练前后独立验证集指标差和回归指标。使用 inverse-propensity 或 doubly-robust 估计器学习 g(v,k)，即在版本 v 下把下一单位训练给任务 k 的因果效用及置信区间。下一轮只依据 g 的保守下界分配主要预算，同时保留固定回归锚点。训练完成后冻结 g，并将其直接用于另一条未参与拟合的模型版本序列。
exact_mechanism.en: Reserve a fixed epsilon fraction of every training round for randomized micro-allocations: candidate task families receive an extra micro-training block according to logged nonzero exploration probabilities, while the remaining budget follows the current controller. Each intervention logs model-version representation v, task family k, allocation propensity p, independent pre/post validation change, and regression metrics. An inverse-propensity or doubly robust estimator learns g(v,k), the causal utility and uncertainty of assigning the next training unit to task k at version v. The main budget is allocated using a conservative lower bound on g while fixed regression anchors are retained. After training, g is frozen and applied to a separate model-version stream.

children.update_surface: frozen version-conditioned causal marginal-gain controller

learning_signal.zh: 具有已知随机分配概率的任务微训练干预，以及干预前后独立 held-out 能力指标和回归指标的差值。
learning_signal.en: Randomized task micro-training interventions with known assignment propensities and the resulting changes in independent held-out capability and regression metrics.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 对评测版本额外执行不提供给控制器的均匀随机微分配实验，用真实的下一训练块后 held-out 指标变化作为任务族因果收益排序真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: For evaluation versions, run additional uniformly randomized micro-allocations hidden from the controller and use the realized held-out change after the next training block as ground truth for causal task-return ranking.

simplest_baseline.zh: TSCL 风格控制器：在完全相同总训练预算和回归下限下，仅依据近期 held-out 学习进展斜率分配任务，不学习版本漂移或因果收益模型。
simplest_baseline.en: A TSCL-style controller using the identical total training budget and regression floor, reallocating tasks solely from recent held-out learning-progress slopes without a learned drift or causal-gain model.

decisive_pilot.zh: 使用一个可公开复现的小模型和 6 至 10 个任务族构造两条独立版本流，每个新版本通过固定的小规模 continued-training 或 adapter update 产生。第一条版本流学习 g，第二条完全冻结迁移。每轮都用相同训练 token。首先比较各方法预测“下一微训练块最值得给哪个任务”的 top-1/regret，再比较固定总预算后的宏平均能力与回归。决定性结果必须是在第二条版本流上，g 对随机干预真值的 next-unit regret 低于 TSCL、失败率和遗忘启发式，并转化为更高最终效用。
decisive_pilot.en: Use a publicly reproducible small model with 6-10 task families and construct two independent version streams via fixed small continued-training or adapter updates. Learn g only on the first stream and transfer it frozen to the second, with identical training tokens per round. First compare methods on regret for predicting which task should receive the next micro-block using randomized-intervention ground truth, then compare final macro capability and regression under the same total budget. The decisive result is lower next-unit regret than TSCL, failure-rate, and forgetting heuristics on the second stream, coupled with higher final utility.

stop_condition.zh: 如果因果收益估计在独立版本流上的下一单位收益预测不优于简单学习进展，或更准确的收益预测不能改善固定预算下的最终训练结果，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if causal-gain estimates do not outperform simple learning progress in next-unit return prediction on the independent version stream, or if improved prediction fails to improve final training outcomes under a fixed budget.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承多轮模型更新会使课程变陈旧、需要重新分配训练预算并保留回归锚点的问题。
what_is_inherited.en: It inherits the problem that curricula become stale across model updates and therefore require budget reallocation while retaining regression anchors.

material_change.zh: 父方案的观察式“边际学习进展+漂移”被替换为每轮真实随机预算干预得到的版本条件化因果 next-unit return，并要求在独立版本流中冻结迁移。
material_change.en: The parent's observational marginal-progress-plus-drift estimate is replaced by version-conditioned causal next-unit return identified from real randomized budget interventions, with mandatory frozen transfer to an independent version stream.

external_reviews.finding: Randomized micro-allocation and frozen transfer to an independent version stream materially improve the parent's observational learning-progress formulation. However, the declared strongest baseline is no longer adequate. Actor-Curator already formulates LLM post-training curriculum selection as a non-stationary bandit, directly optimizes expected policy improvement, maintains nonzero exploration, and uses importance-weighted unbiased feedback under partial observation. ([arXiv][9]) Earlier task-selection work also explicitly connects curriculum allocation with off-policy/counterfactual estimation. ([arXiv][10]) Consequently, an IPS/DR model of next-unit return is not distinguished by comparing only against TSCL-style learning-progress slopes. The surviving possibility is cross-version causal transport: whether a gain model fitted on randomized interventions in one version-generating process predicts true marginal returns in an independently generated frozen version stream better than a same-data contextual bandit or Actor-Curator-style policy.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 随机微分配以及冻结迁移到独立版本流，确实比父方案基于观察式 learning progress 的设计有实质改进。但当前声明的最强基线已经不足。Actor-Curator 已经把 LLM post-training 的课程选择建模为非平稳 bandit，直接优化期望 policy improvement，保持非零探索概率，并用 importance-weighted 的无偏反馈处理 partial observation。([arXiv][9]) 更早的 task-selection 工作也已经明确把课程预算分配与 off-policy/counterfactual estimation 联系起来。([arXiv][10]) 因此，仅用 TSCL 风格的 learning-progress slope 作比较，不能证明 IPS/DR next-unit return 模型的新颖必要性。真正可能保留下来的边界是跨版本因果迁移：在一条版本生成过程上由随机干预拟合的 gain model，能否在独立生成且冻结的版本流上，比使用相同数据的 contextual bandit 或 Actor-Curator 式方法更准确地预测真实边际收益。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace TSCL as the main simplification test with two matched baselines: (1) Actor-Curator-style policy-improvement bandit with the same exploration budget, and (2) a direct contextual bandit/response model trained on exactly the same randomized micro-allocation tuples and version representation. Make frozen transport across a held-out version-generating operator, not generic causal terminology, the central claim.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将主要简化检验从 TSCL 改为两个严格匹配的基线：(1) 使用相同探索预算的 Actor-Curator 式 policy-improvement bandit；(2) 使用完全相同随机微分配 tuples 和版本表示训练的直接 contextual bandit/response model。核心主张应改成对完整留出的 version-generating operator 的冻结迁移，而不是泛化地强调“causal”。

closest_work: Actor-Curator: Co-adaptive Curriculum Learning via Policy-Improvement Bandits for RL Post-Training — non-stationary bandit curriculum optimized from policy-improvement feedback with importance-weighted exploration. ([arXiv][9])
Task Selection Policies for Multitask Learning — connects task allocation to off-policy evaluation and counterfactual estimation. ([arXiv][10])
Self-Evolving Curriculum for LLM Reasoning — formulates evolving curriculum selection as a non-stationary multi-armed bandit. ([OpenReview][11])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: Explicit randomized next-training-block interventions plus frozen prediction across a separately generated model-version stream could establish transportable marginal-gain estimation, which the online co-adaptive curricula do not establish.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Actor-Curator-style policy-improvement bandit and a version-conditioned contextual bandit using the exact same randomized micro-allocation data, propensities, version features, and total training tokens.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate training and evaluation version streams using disjoint update operators. Collect identical randomized micro-allocation data for the training stream, freeze every learned allocator, and evaluate next-unit regret against hidden uniform-randomized interventions in the second stream. The proposed estimator must beat both matched bandit baselines and translate that reduction into superior final utility at identical token budget.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if a direct same-data contextual bandit or Actor-Curator-style method matches next-unit regret on the held-out version stream, or if lower causal-return prediction error does not improve final fixed-budget training utility.
unknowns: Whether a compact version representation contains stable information that transports across genuinely different update operators.
Whether the cost of randomized micro-training blocks is large enough to erase the curriculum efficiency benefit.

children.external_finding: Randomized micro-allocation and frozen transfer to an independent version stream materially improve the parent's observational learning-progress formulation. However, the declared strongest baseline is no longer adequate. Actor-Curator already formulates LLM post-training curriculum selection as a non-stationary bandit, directly optimizes expected policy improvement, maintains nonzero exploration, and uses importance-weighted unbiased feedback under partial observation. ([arXiv][9]) Earlier task-selection work also explicitly connects curriculum allocation with off-policy/counterfactual estimation. ([arXiv][10]) Consequently, an IPS/DR model of next-unit return is not distinguished by comparing only against TSCL-style learning-progress slopes. The surviving possibility is cross-version causal transport: whether a gain model fitted on randomized interventions in one version-generating process predicts true marginal returns in an independently generated frozen version stream better than a same-data contextual bandit or Actor-Curator-style policy.
children.external_finding_zh: 随机微分配以及冻结迁移到独立版本流，确实比父方案基于观察式 learning progress 的设计有实质改进。但当前声明的最强基线已经不足。Actor-Curator 已经把 LLM post-training 的课程选择建模为非平稳 bandit，直接优化期望 policy improvement，保持非零探索概率，并用 importance-weighted 的无偏反馈处理 partial observation。([arXiv][9]) 更早的 task-selection 工作也已经明确把课程预算分配与 off-policy/counterfactual estimation 联系起来。([arXiv][10]) 因此，仅用 TSCL 风格的 learning-progress slope 作比较，不能证明 IPS/DR next-unit return 模型的新颖必要性。真正可能保留下来的边界是跨版本因果迁移：在一条版本生成过程上由随机干预拟合的 gain model，能否在独立生成且冻结的版本流上，比使用相同数据的 contextual bandit 或 Actor-Curator 式方法更准确地预测真实边际收益。
children.external_required_action: Replace TSCL as the main simplification test with two matched baselines: (1) Actor-Curator-style policy-improvement bandit with the same exploration budget, and (2) a direct contextual bandit/response model trained on exactly the same randomized micro-allocation tuples and version representation. Make frozen transport across a held-out version-generating operator, not generic causal terminology, the central claim.
children.external_required_action_zh: 将主要简化检验从 TSCL 改为两个严格匹配的基线：(1) 使用相同探索预算的 Actor-Curator 式 policy-improvement bandit；(2) 使用完全相同随机微分配 tuples 和版本表示训练的直接 contextual bandit/response model。核心主张应改成对完整留出的 version-generating operator 的冻结迁移，而不是泛化地强调“causal”。

title.zh: 类型契约保持的记忆迁移器

problem.zh: 结构化 agent 记忆在模型与 harness/tool-schema 同时替换后会失效：即使自然语言语义近似不变，前置条件可能不再可判定，程序中的工具调用可能类型不匹配，检索依赖可能断裂，执行约束也可能在新环境中失去一致性。
problem.en: Structured agent memories can fail under a joint model and harness/tool-schema swap even when their natural-language meaning appears preserved: preconditions may become unevaluable, tool calls may become ill-typed, retrieval dependencies may break, and execution constraints may no longer remain jointly consistent.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设成功的迁移主要是源资产到目标文本的条件生成；改为假设真正需要学习的是在环境变化后保持一组可机器检查的类型化关系不变量，文本只是该关系对象的一种序列化。
changed_assumption.en: Instead of assuming transfer is primarily conditional generation from a source asset to target text, assume that the learnable object is preservation of machine-checkable typed relational invariants after the environment changes, with text serving only as one serialization of that object.

exact_mechanism.zh: 先把每个持久记忆编译为一个类型化关系 IR：Precondition 节点声明其所读取的状态字段与谓词类型，Program 节点声明工具签名及输入输出类型，RetrievalEdge 声明被检索对象及其依赖类型，ExecutionConstraint 声明必须在程序前、后或全程成立的约束。给定源和目标 model+harness schema，迁移器不自由重写整段记忆，而是预测一组受限 IR 编辑：字段重绑定、工具签名替换、依赖边重定向和谓词重写。每个候选编辑必须通过静态类型检查、引用完整性检查和约束可满足性检查后才能重新序列化为目标记忆；非法候选直接拒绝。训练时使用相同 source/target traces 中能够恢复可执行目标资产的编辑序列作为监督，并额外惩罚破坏上述关系不变量的候选。
exact_mechanism.en: Compile each persistent memory into a typed relational IR: Precondition nodes declare the state fields and predicate types they consume; Program nodes declare tool signatures and input/output types; RetrievalEdge nodes declare referenced objects and dependency types; and ExecutionConstraint nodes declare conditions that must hold before, after, or throughout execution. Given source and target model+harness schemas, the translator does not freely rewrite the whole memory. It predicts a restricted set of IR edits: field rebinding, tool-signature substitution, dependency-edge redirection, and predicate rewriting. Every candidate edit must pass static type checking, reference-integrity checking, and constraint-satisfiability checking before it can be serialized into the target memory; invalid candidates are rejected. Training uses edit sequences recoverable from the same source/target traces that yield executable target assets, with additional loss on candidates that violate these relational invariants.

children.update_surface: persisted typed relational memory IR plus its target-bound serialized executable asset

learning_signal.zh: 监督信号由同预算 source/target 执行轨迹中恢复出的目标 IR 编辑组成；主损失预测正确编辑操作与绑定，辅助信号仅来自确定性的类型错误、悬空 retrieval edge、工具签名冲突和约束不可满足事件。最终成功率不作为唯一或必要的结构监督。
learning_signal.en: Supervision consists of target IR edits recovered from equal-budget source/target execution traces. The primary loss predicts the correct edit operations and bindings; auxiliary signals come only from deterministic type errors, dangling retrieval edges, tool-signature conflicts, and unsatisfied constraints. End-task success is neither the sole nor a required source of structural supervision.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 独立真值由目标 harness 的真实工具 schema、环境状态字段定义以及独立执行器产生，而不是由迁移模型或目标 LLM 自评。对每个迁移资产，离线检查器验证类型正确性、引用闭合与约束一致性；随后在冻结目标模型上执行，记录工具调用是否合法以及预条件和后置条件是否由环境真实状态满足。
independent_ground_truth.en: Independent ground truth comes from the target harness's actual tool schemas, environment state definitions, and an external executor rather than judgments from the translator or target LLM. For every transferred asset, an offline checker verifies typing, reference closure, and constraint consistency; the asset is then executed with the frozen target model, while legality of tool calls and satisfaction of pre/postconditions are determined from true environment state.

simplest_baseline.zh: 最强的容量匹配简化基线是 MASA 式 model-conditioned 整体重写器：使用与本方法完全相同的 source/target 资产对、执行轨迹、模型调用、token、训练步数和参数预算，但将整个结构化记忆作为单一序列输入输出，不提供类型节点、关系边、受限编辑或不变量检查。另报告 PromptBridge 式映射与 target-model rewrite-from-scratch，二者也严格共享相同观测与优化预算。
simplest_baseline.en: The strongest capacity-matched simpler baseline is a MASA-style model-conditioned monolithic rewriter trained with exactly the same source/target asset pairs, execution traces, model calls, tokens, optimization steps, and parameter budget, but receiving and emitting each structured memory as a single serialization with no typed nodes, relational edges, restricted edits, or invariant checks. PromptBridge-style mapping and target-model rewrite-from-scratch are also reported under exactly the same observations and optimization budget.

decisive_pilot.zh: P0 构造约 80–120 个公开 agent/tool 任务的联合迁移对，并刻意只选择会改变结构关系的 swap：工具重命名并改变参数类型、状态字段拆分/合并、程序输出格式变化、检索键重构。冻结一个未见过的目标模型家族和至少一个未见 harness schema。比较本方法与容量匹配整体重写器，在完全相同预算下测量：(1) 全部类型化不变量同时保持率，(2) 首次执行前静态合法率，(3) 冻结目标上的可执行任务成功率。决定性证据不是平均成功率的小幅提高，而是本方法在关系发生变化的 held-out cases 上显著降低“任务偶尔成功但资产结构已失真”的比例，并在 invariant-preservation 上明显超过整体重写器。如果去掉受限 IR 编辑和检查器后优势消失，则支持核心机制而非模型容量解释。
decisive_pilot.en: For P0, build roughly 80–120 joint transfer pairs from public agent/tool tasks, deliberately selecting swaps that alter structural relations: tool renaming with argument-type changes, state-field splits/merges, program-output-format changes, and retrieval-key restructuring. Freeze one unseen target model family and at least one unseen harness schema. Under identical budgets, compare the method with the capacity-matched monolithic rewriter on (1) joint preservation of all typed invariants, (2) static legality before first execution, and (3) executable task success with the frozen target. The decisive evidence is not a small gain in mean success, but a substantial reduction on held-out relation-changing cases where a task can occasionally succeed despite a structurally corrupted asset, together with a clear invariant-preservation advantage over monolithic rewriting. If the advantage disappears when restricted IR edits and checking are removed, the result supports the proposed mechanism rather than extra capacity.

stop_condition.zh: 若在至少两种 joint model+harness swap 上，容量匹配整体重写器与本方法的 joint invariant-preservation 差异小于 5 个百分点，或本方法的结构优势不能转化为更高的首次合法执行率，则停止该方向；这说明显式类型分解与关系保持并未提供超越整体重写的必要机制。
stop_condition.en: Stop if, across at least two joint model+harness swaps, the capacity-matched monolithic rewriter is within 5 percentage points of the method on joint invariant preservation, or if the structural advantage does not translate into a higher first-attempt legal-execution rate. That outcome would indicate that explicit typing and relation preservation are not a necessary mechanism beyond monolithic rewriting.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承父方案中已经成立的真实问题：模型替换会破坏持久技能/记忆资产，且应在未见模型家族上冻结评测；同时保留结构化资产而非普通 prompt 作为迁移对象。还继承 reviewer 指出的可辩护边界：前置条件、可执行程序、检索拓扑与执行约束需要联合保持。
what_is_inherited.en: The child inherits the established problem that model swaps can break persistent skill/memory assets and that evaluation should freeze an unseen model family. It also retains structured assets, rather than ordinary prompts, as the transfer object, and preserves the reviewer's defensible boundary: preconditions, executable programs, retrieval topology, and execution constraints must remain jointly valid.

material_change.zh: 父方案学习的是泛化的组件级翻译与重组；子方案把学习对象改成了具有显式类型契约的关系 IR，并把迁移限制为可检查的结构编辑，训练和主评测直接针对不变量保持。这样即使整体重写器获得完全相同的数据和容量，它也无法通过文本相似或偶然任务成功替代核心判据。
material_change.en: The parent learned generic component-level translation and recomposition. The child instead changes the learned object to an explicitly typed relational IR and restricts transfer to checkable structural edits, with training and primary evaluation directly targeting invariant preservation. Therefore, even a monolithic rewriter with identical data and capacity cannot satisfy the central criterion merely through textual similarity or accidental task success.

external_reviews.finding: The child is a material improvement: it changes the learned object from unrestricted text rewriting to typed relational edits over preconditions, programs, retrieval dependencies, and execution constraints. This boundary is plausible despite adjacent work: MemIR already demonstrates typed intermediate representations for agent memory, but focuses on provenance/source-role correctness rather than model+harness migration; MASA adapts procedural skills across models; and software-migration systems such as SPELL distill reusable structured transformations for API migration. ([arXiv][15]) The remaining flaw is baseline asymmetry. The proposed method receives deterministic type, reference-integrity, and satisfiability checks, while the capacity-matched monolithic rewriter is explicitly denied those checks. Static verification is already known to catch migration errors in software/API migration settings. ([arXiv][16]) Therefore an observed gain could come entirely from checker access rather than the typed relational representation or restricted edit language.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 子方案是实质性改进：学习对象从无限制文本重写变成了针对 precondition、program、retrieval dependency 与 execution constraint 的类型化关系编辑。尽管存在邻近工作，这一边界仍有可能成立：MemIR 已经把 typed intermediate representation 用于 agent memory，但重点是 provenance/source-role 正确性而不是 model+harness migration；MASA 做跨模型 procedural skill 适配；SPELL 等软件迁移系统则把迁移知识蒸馏成可复用的结构化 API transformation。([arXiv][15]) 目前剩余的关键问题是基线不对称。本方法拥有确定性的 type checking、reference-integrity checking 和 satisfiability checking，而容量匹配的 monolithic rewriter 被明确禁止使用这些检查。软件/API migration 中的既有工作已经表明静态验证可以发现迁移错误。([arXiv][16]) 因而当前实验即使出现优势，也可能完全来自 checker access，而不是 typed relational representation 或 restricted edit language。
external_reviews.required_action: Equalize verifier access. The monolithic rewriter must receive the same static type/reference/constraint checker and the same number of checker-guided repair or rejection attempts. Also add a deterministic schema-diff/compiler baseline that performs field/tool rebinding and constraint solving directly from the known source and target schemas. The typed IR survives only if restricted relational editing still improves unseen joint swaps after these controls.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须统一 verifier access。整体重写器应获得完全相同的静态 type/reference/constraint checker，以及相同次数的 checker-guided repair 或 rejection。还要加入确定性的 schema-diff/compiler 基线，直接根据已知 source/target schema 完成字段/工具重绑定与约束求解。只有在这些控制之后，restricted relational editing 在未见 joint swap 上仍明显更好，typed IR 才成立。

closest_work: MemIR: Mitigating Provenance-Role Collapse in Long-Term Agents via Typed Memory Representation — typed memory IR with structural constraints, but aimed at source/provenance correctness rather than model+harness migration. ([arXiv][15])
MASA: Model-Aware Skill Alignment — model-conditioned rewriting of persistent agent skills across backbones. ([arXiv][5])
SPELL: Synthesis of Programmatic Edits using LLMs — converts migration knowledge into structured, testable, repeatable transformation scripts. ([arXiv][17])
Compiler-directed Migrating API Callsite of Client Code — compiler-guided API migration demonstrates the adjacent deterministic program-migration boundary. ([ACM Digital Library][18])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: Joint preservation of agent-specific preconditions, executable tool programs, retrieval topology, and temporal execution constraints across simultaneous model and harness/schema swaps remains more structured than prompt/skill adaptation and broader than ordinary API-call migration.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Capacity-matched monolithic rewriter with identical source/target traces, model calls, tokens, parameters, static checker access, and checker-guided repair budget; additionally, a deterministic schema-diff compiler/constraint solver.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: On held-out target-model families and harness schemas, compare typed restricted editing against checker-equipped monolithic rewriting and deterministic schema migration. Measure joint invariant preservation, first-attempt static legality before any repair, final legal-execution rate under equal checker/repair budget, and task success. The decisive ablation keeps the checker fixed while replacing typed edits with unrestricted serialization rewriting.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if checker-equipped monolithic rewriting is within 5 percentage points on joint invariant preservation and first-attempt legal execution, if deterministic schema migration matches the typed method on relation-changing swaps, or if the typed advantage disappears when checker access is equalized.
unknowns: What fraction of field/tool/retrieval remappings require learned semantic inference rather than deterministic schema matching.
Whether constraint satisfiability can be checked soundly for memories containing open-ended natural-language predicates.

title.zh: 零锚点评价器状态外推器

problem.zh: Actor 与 evaluator 持续共同演化时，新 evaluator 版本可能产生此前未出现的版本配对偏差，而部署时通常无法立即获得该新版本的人工 anchor 标签。
problem.en: As actors and evaluators co-evolve, a new evaluator version can induce previously unseen version-pair biases, while human anchor labels for that new evaluator are often unavailable at deployment.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再依赖未来 evaluator 的少量真实标签进行校准，而是假设 evaluator 在无标签探针上的可观测行为指纹携带其潜在版本状态；该状态的时间动力学可从历史版本学习并外推到完全零 anchor 的未来版本。
changed_assumption.en: Remove reliance on a few ground-truth labels from the future evaluator. Instead assume that observable responses to unlabeled diagnostic probes encode a latent evaluator-version state whose temporal dynamics can be learned from historical versions and extrapolated to a truly zero-anchor future version.

exact_mechanism.zh: 为每个历史 evaluator 在固定无标签 probe bank 上采集 logits、置信度、长度偏好、位置翻转敏感性和自一致性等 fingerprint。编码器将 fingerprint 映射到低维状态 z_t，并用按时间顺序训练的状态转移模型预测 z_{t+1}。历史 actor×evaluator 交叉评分仅用于学习从 actor 描述与 z_t 到偏差残差的条件修正头。测试时新 evaluator 只能运行无标签 probe；禁止读取该版本的任何人工或任务真值标签，生成 z_new 后直接修正其评分。
exact_mechanism.en: For each historical evaluator, collect a fingerprint on a fixed unlabeled probe bank, including logits, confidence, length preference, position-flip sensitivity, and self-consistency. An encoder maps the fingerprint to a low-dimensional state z_t, and a chronologically trained transition model predicts the next-state manifold. Historical actor-by-evaluator crossed scores train a conditional correction head from actor descriptors and z_t to score bias. At test time the new evaluator may only answer unlabeled probes; no human or task labels from that version are allowed, and its inferred z_new directly conditions score correction.

children.update_surface: persistent latent evaluator-version state transition model and frozen bias-correction head

learning_signal.zh: 状态表示由历史无标签 fingerprint 的时间预测和重构损失学习；偏差头使用仅来自历史版本的独立人工/任务真值与 evaluator 分数残差训练。未来版本标签严格不进入任何更新。
learning_signal.en: The state representation is learned from temporal prediction and reconstruction of historical unlabeled fingerprints; the bias head is trained on evaluator residuals against independent human/task ground truth from historical versions only. Labels from the future version are strictly excluded from all updates.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 评价真值由在模型训练完成后才揭示的人工偏好、多评审共识或可程序验证任务结果给出；这些标签仅用于最终评估 held-out evaluator version，而不参与其状态估计。
independent_ground_truth.en: Ground truth consists of human preferences, multi-rater consensus, or programmatically verified task outcomes revealed only after model training; these labels are used solely to evaluate the held-out evaluator version and never to infer its state.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配的静态 pooled calibration head，输入完全相同的 actor descriptor、新 evaluator 无标签 fingerprint、版本元数据和 recency，但把这些量当作普通协变量，不学习显式时间状态转移或跨版本外推算子。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched pooled static calibration head receiving exactly the same actor descriptors, new-evaluator unlabeled fingerprint, version metadata, and recency as ordinary covariates, but with no explicit temporal latent-state transition or cross-version extrapolation operator.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按发布时间排序至少 5 个 evaluator checkpoint，以最后一个版本做完全 zero-anchor 测试。训练阶段仅允许前序版本真值；测试阶段两方法都可访问最后版本同一套无标签 probes。比较其对最后版本 actor×evaluator 配对偏差的 MAE、排序反转率和人类一致性恢复。再逐步删除时间转移，仅保留同维 fingerprint encoder，验证收益来自历史动力学而非更多参数。
decisive_pilot.en: Chronologically order at least five evaluator checkpoints and hold out the final version under a strict zero-anchor protocol. Training may use ground truth only from earlier versions; at test time both methods access the identical unlabeled probe set from the final evaluator. Compare MAE of actor-evaluator pair bias, ranking-flip rate, and recovery of agreement with humans. Ablate the temporal transition while retaining an equal-dimensional fingerprint encoder to test whether gains arise from longitudinal dynamics rather than parameter count.

stop_condition.zh: 若在两个以上 held-out chronological splits 上，显式状态转移模型不能持续优于使用完全相同无标签 fingerprint 的静态校准器，或其优势在去掉版本时间顺序后仍保持，则停止“纵向外推”主张并退化为 fingerprint-based calibration。
stop_condition.en: Stop the longitudinal-extrapolation claim if the explicit state-transition model fails to consistently outperform the static calibrator with identical unlabeled fingerprints on at least two chronological held-out splits, or if its advantage persists after destroying version chronology; then reduce the method to fingerprint-based calibration.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承父方案的 actor-version × evaluator-version 交叉视角、独立真值锚定和对版本配对特异偏差进行修正的目标。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the crossed actor-version by evaluator-version perspective, independent ground-truth anchoring, and the goal of correcting version-pair-specific bias.

material_change.zh: 父方案依赖 anchor 后拟合交互残差；子方案把不可约对象改为可在未来标签出现前估计的 evaluator 潜在版本状态及其时间转移，并用严格 zero-anchor chronological extrapolation 检验其是否提供静态校准无法获得的信息。
material_change.en: The parent fit interaction residuals around anchors; the child makes the irreducible object an evaluator latent version state and temporal transition estimable before any future labels exist, tested by strict zero-anchor chronological extrapolation against a static calibrator with identical observables.

external_reviews.finding: This is a material repair rather than a rename: it removes the parent's dependence on labels from the future evaluator and turns evaluator replacement into a strict zero-anchor chronological generalization problem. Evaluator replacement is a real measurement-validity failure mode: recent work shows that changing the judge can change rankings and bias behavior even with fixed candidate responses. ([arXiv][1]) The held-out ground truth is also independent because future-version human/task labels are revealed only for final evaluation. However, the proposed temporal operator is not yet shown to be irreducible. As written, the new evaluator's current unlabeled fingerprint is encoded into z_new and directly drives the correction head; the transition model mainly supplies a temporal prediction/manifold objective. A capacity-matched direct predictor given the identical current fingerprint, complete ordered historical fingerprints, timestamps/recency, actor descriptors, and historical labels could potentially learn the same future residual without an explicit latent state transition. The proposed static pooled baseline is therefore too weak. This matters because existing work already supplies label-free judge debiasing at inference time, covariate-based human-judge calibration, and external bias-correction modules, although none of the sources found directly implements zero-anchor chronological evaluator-state extrapolation. CalibraEval is label-free but targets selection bias rather than version dynamics; Bridge models systematic human-LLM discrepancies using covariates but is fitted with human judgments; RBD learns an external correction module for known judge biases. ([ACL Anthology][2]) ([arXiv][3]) ([NeurIPS Proceedings][4])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 这是实质性修复而不是改名：它真正去掉了父方案对未来 evaluator 标签的依赖，并把 evaluator 更换问题改成严格的 zero-anchor 时间外推问题。近期研究已经证明 evaluator 更换本身会导致固定候选输出的测量结果、排序和偏差行为发生变化，因此问题是真实的。([arXiv][1]) 独立真值设计也成立，因为未来版本的人类/任务真值只在最终评估时揭示，不参与状态估计。但当前仍不能 PASS，因为“时间状态转移”尚未成为不可约机制。按现有描述，新 evaluator 的当前无标签 fingerprint 被编码为 z_new 后直接输入修正头；状态转移更像训练时的时间预测/流形正则。因此，一个容量匹配、使用完全相同数据的直接预测器——同时输入当前 fingerprint、完整有序历史 fingerprint、时间戳/recency、actor descriptor 和历史标签——可能无需显式 latent transition 就复现收益。当前仅比较 static pooled calibrator 的 baseline 太弱。已有工作已经覆盖无标签 judge 去偏、基于协变量的人类-judge 校准以及外部 bias correction，但本次检索未发现与“未来 evaluator 零标签 + 按版本时间顺序外推 latent state”完全相同的方案：CalibraEval 是无标签但主要修复 selection bias；Bridge 用协变量建模人类与 LLM judge 偏差但依赖历史人类判断；RBD 是针对已知 bias 类型训练的外部修正模块。([ACL Anthology][2]) ([arXiv][3]) ([NeurIPS Proceedings][4])
external_reviews.required_action: Make the chronological operator causally necessary and test it against a genuinely equivalent non-state alternative. Specify an explicit inference equation, for example a state-space filter in which the previous inferred state predicts a prior for z_new and the new fingerprint supplies an observation update; clarify exactly where the transition affects the corrected score. Then replace the weak static-only control with a capacity- and budget-matched direct history-aware predictor that receives the same ordered fingerprint history, current fingerprint, timestamps, actor descriptors, and historical supervision but predicts the future evaluator residual directly with no latent transition. Use rolling-origin held-out evaluator versions and require the transition method to beat both the current-fingerprint static model and this history-aware direct predictor; chronology permutation must destroy the claimed advantage.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须让时间算子在推理路径中具有因果必要性，并与真正等价的非状态模型比较。首先写清楚明确的推理方程，例如使用 state-space filter：上一版本状态先通过 transition 产生 z_new 的先验，新 evaluator fingerprint 再作为 observation 更新状态，并明确 transition 最终在哪一步影响校正分数。其次，把目前过弱的 static-only baseline 替换为容量和预算匹配的 history-aware direct predictor：它可获得完全相同的有序历史 fingerprint、当前 fingerprint、时间戳、actor descriptor 与历史监督，但不建立 latent transition，直接预测未来 evaluator residual。采用 rolling-origin 的多个未来版本测试；只有 transition 方法同时超过当前 fingerprint 的静态模型和 history-aware direct predictor，并且打乱版本顺序后优势消失，才能保留“纵向状态外推”主张。

closest_work: When the Judge Changes, So Does the Measurement: Auditing LLM-as-Judge Reliability (arXiv:2607.08535) — directly establishes evaluator-replacement ambiguity and version-dependent judge reliability, but audits rather than learns a zero-anchor longitudinal correction operator. ([arXiv][1])

Bridging Human and LLM Judgments: Understanding and Narrowing the Gap — models systematic human-LLM judgment discrepancies using covariates and improves human agreement, but does not perform chronological zero-anchor extrapolation to an unseen evaluator version. ([arXiv][3])

CalibraEval: Calibrating Prediction Distribution to Mitigate Selection Bias in LLMs-as-Judges — provides label-free inference-time debiasing, but targets position/selection bias through prediction-distribution calibration rather than evaluator-version dynamics. ([ACL Anthology][2])

Any Large Language Model Can Be a Reliable Judge: Debiasing with a Reasoning-based Bias Detector — learns an external bias detector/corrector applicable across evaluators, but relies on supervised bias construction and does not extrapolate a latent evaluator state over release chronology. ([NeurIPS Proceedings][4])

Validating LLM-as-a-Judge Systems in the Absence of Gold Labels — studies judge validation when per-item gold labels are unavailable, but its object is validation rather than correction of a newly released evaluator from longitudinal fingerprints. ([arXiv][5])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: No directly colliding source found implements the full combination of crossed actor-by-evaluator historical supervision, unlabeled diagnostic fingerprints for a completely unseen evaluator version, an explicitly learned chronological evaluator-state transition, zero future-version anchors, and frozen downstream bias correction. The surviving novelty is therefore the longitudinal zero-anchor transition operator, conditional on proving that chronology adds information unavailable to equally budgeted direct fingerprint/history regression.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched history-aware direct residual predictor using the identical ordered historical fingerprints, current-version unlabeled fingerprint, timestamps/recency, actor descriptors, historical human/task residual labels, probe budget, parameter count, and training compute, but mapping these observables directly to actor-by-evaluator bias without an explicit latent state transition. Include current-fingerprint-only calibration and last-version/recency regression as simpler controls, plus CalibraEval or RBD where their bias assumptions apply.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use substantially more than a single five-checkpoint split if possible: construct at least 8 chronologically ordered evaluator checkpoints/releases, preferably with two independent release sequences or model families, and perform rolling-origin evaluation on at least the final three versions. For each held-out version, prohibit all of its human/task labels during training and state inference; every method receives exactly the same unlabeled probe responses and historical supervision. Compare (A) the explicit transition/filter, (B) current-fingerprint static calibration, (C) the capacity-matched history-aware direct predictor, and (D) time/last-version controls. Measure held-out residual MAE, pairwise ranking flips relative to independent human/task truth, and human-agreement recovery. Add equal-dimensional encoder ablations, shuffled chronology, reversed chronology, and fingerprint-feature ablations. A longitudinal claim is supported only if A consistently beats C as well as B, with paired uncertainty excluding a practically negligible effect, and the A advantage collapses when chronology is destroyed.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the longitudinal-state claim if the explicit transition fails to outperform the capacity-matched history-aware direct predictor on at least two of three rolling future-version holdouts, if the pooled paired advantage is indistinguishable from zero or practically negligible, if chronology permutation/reversal preserves the gain, or if z_new inferred without the transition performs equivalently. In those cases retain only the narrower zero-anchor fingerprint-calibration contribution. Also stop if future-version fingerprint shift is so discontinuous that historical dynamics have no predictive value.
unknowns: Whether real evaluator release trajectories are sufficiently smooth or recurrent for a learned transition to extrapolate rather than merely interpolate; released API models can change discontinuously, and recent evaluator-replacement evidence shows non-monotone adjacent behavior. ([arXiv][1])
Whether logits or comparable confidence signals are available for the intended closed-source evaluators; the fingerprint definition may need an API-agnostic subset based only on observable outputs.
Whether a fixed probe bank remains informative for later evaluator versions rather than becoming stale, contaminated, or easy to overfit.
Whether the latent state is identifiable separately from model-family identity, release metadata, domain shift, prompt changes, and actor-distribution drift.
Whether enough historical actor-by-evaluator crossed human/task labels exist to estimate version-pair residuals without the correction head simply learning actor or evaluator identity.

Whether five evaluator checkpoints, as originally proposed, provide enough independent temporal transitions to distinguish genuine dynamics from ordinary regression; a larger rolling-origin panel is preferable.

Whether human preference disagreement makes residual MAE an appropriate primary target in subjective domains; programmatically verifiable tasks or multi-rater uncertainty-aware targets should be included where possible.

title.zh: 盲锚条件化纵向评价残差

problem.zh: actor 与 evaluator 都不断换版本时，新 evaluator 的评分偏差不仅是单一尺度偏移，还可能取决于它正在评价哪一代 actor，导致静态或逐 evaluator 校准错误排序未来候选策略。
problem.en: When both actors and evaluators change versions, a new evaluator's bias may depend on which actor generation it scores rather than being a single scale shift, causing static or per-evaluator calibration to mis-rank future policies.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设历史 actor×evaluator 交互能够在完全看不到新 evaluator 的情况下外推；每个未来 evaluator 都获得完全相同、极小且外部人工标注的盲 anchor panel，历史 crossed data 的价值仅允许体现在这些 anchor 之外的交互外推。
changed_assumption.en: The method no longer assumes that historical actor-by-evaluator interactions can extrapolate to a completely unobserved evaluator. Every future evaluator receives the same tiny externally labeled blind anchor panel, and crossed history may help only by extrapolating beyond those anchors.

exact_mechanism.zh: 在历史完整或近完整 actor-version×evaluator-version 评分矩阵上拟合分解 s(a,e,x)=b(x)+u_a(x)+v_e(x)+u_a(x)^T M v_e(x)，其中最后一项是必须保留的 actor-evaluator 交互残差。对新 evaluator e*，仅暴露 K 个预注册 anchor：每个 anchor 包含固定候选输出、e* 的评分和外部人工真值。用这些 K 个点估计 v_e* 的低维坐标，但冻结历史的 u、M 和基础评分头；随后用得到的交互项修正 e* 对未见 actor 策略的评分并进行策略选择。
exact_mechanism.en: Fit historical crossed actor-version by evaluator-version data with s(a,e,x)=b(x)+u_a(x)+v_e(x)+u_a(x)^T M v_e(x), where the final term is the required actor-evaluator interaction residual. For a future evaluator e*, expose only K preregistered blind anchors containing fixed candidate outputs, e* scores, and external human labels. Use those K points to infer the low-dimensional coordinate v_e* while freezing historical u, M, and the base scoring head. The resulting interaction term corrects e* scores for unseen actor policies before selection.

children.update_surface: frozen crossed actor-evaluator residual correction head

learning_signal.zh: 历史交叉版本评分、历史独立人工偏好标签，以及每个未来 evaluator 完全相同的 K 个盲 anchor 上的 evaluator-human 残差。
learning_signal.en: Historical crossed-version scores, independent historical human preference labels, and evaluator-human residuals on the identical K blind anchors for each future evaluator.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 由未参与模型拟合且不属于 anchor panel 的人工/专家偏好标签确定 double-held-out actor 候选的真实排序，并以最终所选策略相对人工最优策略的 selection regret 计分。
independent_ground_truth.en: Human or expert preference labels excluded from fitting and from the anchor panel determine the true ranking of double-held-out actor candidates, with policy-selection regret measured against the human-optimal candidate.

simplest_baseline.zh: 仅使用相同 K 个未来 evaluator anchor 拟合逐 evaluator affine 或 isotonic 校准，以及容量匹配的 SAJA/Bridge 风格轻量校准头，然后直接排序候选策略。
simplest_baseline.en: Per-evaluator affine or isotonic calibration and a capacity-matched SAJA/Bridge-style lightweight calibration head, each trained on exactly the same K future-evaluator anchors and then used for direct policy ranking.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造至少 4 个 actor 版本和 4 个 evaluator 版本的历史交叉矩阵，并将一个新 actor 版本和一个新 evaluator 版本同时完全留出。所有方法只能获得新 evaluator 上相同 K 个盲 anchor。随后让它们从 held-out actor 产生的多个候选策略中选择一个，并用未见人工标签计算 regret。逐步扫描 K=2,4,8；若 crossed interaction 在小 K 区间持续降低 double-held-out selection regret，而删除交互项后优势消失，则支持机制。
decisive_pilot.en: Build a crossed history with at least four actor and four evaluator versions, then hold out one new actor and one new evaluator simultaneously. Every method receives only the same K blind anchors from the new evaluator. Methods select among multiple policies produced by the held-out actor, and unseen human labels determine regret. Sweep K=2,4,8; the mechanism is supported only if the crossed interaction consistently reduces double-held-out selection regret in the low-anchor regime and the gain disappears when the interaction term is ablated.

stop_condition.zh: 如果相同 K 个 anchor 下，逐 evaluator affine/isotonic 或 SAJA/Bridge 校准达到相同 selection regret，或者历史交互项在 double-held-out actor×evaluator 上不提供增益，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if per-evaluator affine/isotonic or SAJA/Bridge calibration reaches the same selection regret with the same K anchors, or if historical interaction terms provide no gain on the double-held-out actor-by-evaluator pair.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承 actor 与 evaluator 联合版本漂移会破坏未来策略排序，以及历史 crossed actor-evaluator 数据可能包含可迁移交互结构的假设。
what_is_inherited.en: It inherits the problem that joint actor/evaluator version drift corrupts future policy ranking and the hypothesis that historical crossed actor-evaluator data contains transferable interaction structure.

material_change.zh: 父方案中未明确的新 evaluator 可观测性被固定为 K 个外部盲 anchor；机制被压缩为可消融的 crossed interaction residual，并要求在相同 anchor 预算下直接击败逐版本校准，而不是与未校准 judge 比较。
material_change.en: The parent's undefined future-evaluator observability is fixed to K external blind anchors. The mechanism is narrowed to an ablatable crossed interaction residual that must beat per-version calibration under the identical anchor budget rather than merely outperform an uncalibrated judge.

external_reviews.finding: The repair materially fixes the parent's observability defect: the new evaluator now exposes a fixed K-anchor interface, human truth is separated from calibration anchors, and the decisive endpoint is double-held-out policy-selection regret rather than raw judge agreement. However, the proposed scientific object does not survive simplification. Its core u_a^T M v_e interaction is a low-rank dyadic factorization, and adapting v_e* from a few anchor judgments is essentially cold-start latent-factor estimation. Closely related preference-factorization work already learns low-dimensional reward factors and infers a new individual's coordinates from a small number of preference observations; PReF explicitly reduces this adaptation to matrix-factorization followed by low-dimensional coefficient estimation. ([arXiv][1]) The child therefore needs to beat a matched low-rank dyadic model, not only affine/isotonic or lightweight calibration heads. As currently specified, the claimed crossed residual is reproducible by the simplest equivalent factor model.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该修复确实实质性解决了父方案的可观测性问题：新 evaluator 现在只暴露固定的 K 个 anchor，人工真值与校准 anchor 分离，决定性终点也改成了 double-held-out 的策略选择 regret，而不是普通 judge agreement。但其核心科学对象没有通过简化挑战。u_a^T M v_e 本质上就是低秩二元交互分解，而通过少量 anchor 估计 v_e* 本质上属于 cold-start latent-factor estimation。已有偏好因子化工作已经利用低维 reward factors，并通过少量新用户偏好观测估计其低维坐标；PReF 甚至明确把这一过程归约为矩阵分解和低维系数估计。([arXiv][1]) 因此真正必须击败的不是 affine/isotonic 或轻量 calibration head，而是相同数据和预算下的低秩 dyadic factor model。按当前定义，crossed residual 可被最简单的等价因子模型复现。
external_reviews.required_action: Revive only if the learned object is no longer equivalent to ordinary dyadic factorization. At minimum, compare against a capacity-matched low-rank actor-by-evaluator model that learns the historical interaction matrix and estimates the new evaluator coordinate from exactly the same K anchors. A future version needs a transferable structure that this factor model cannot express, such as identifiable higher-order context-dependent interaction structure, and its gain must survive after matching latent rank, anchor selection, regularization, and human-label budget.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 只有当学习对象不再等价于普通 dyadic factorization 时才值得复活。至少必须加入容量匹配的低秩 actor×evaluator 模型：用同一历史交互矩阵训练，并从完全相同的 K 个 anchor 估计新 evaluator 坐标。未来版本需要提出普通因子模型无法表达的可迁移结构，例如可识别的更高阶、上下文依赖交互，并且在 latent rank、anchor selection、regularization 和人工标签预算全部匹配后仍保持优势。

closest_work: Language Model Personalization via Reward Factorization (PReF): low-dimensional reward factorization with few-observation adaptation to a new preference source. ([arXiv][1])
Calibrating LLM-Based Evaluator: explicit human-aligned calibration of LLM evaluators. ([arXiv][2])
Calibrating the Evaluator: evaluator calibration specifically inside agent-feedback loops. ([arXiv][3])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The child applies low-rank interaction structure specifically to longitudinal actor-version by evaluator-version drift and evaluates double-held-out policy-selection regret, but the proposed bilinear mechanism itself is not distinct enough from generic latent preference factorization.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A low-rank actor-evaluator dyadic preference model trained on exactly the crossed historical matrix, with the held-out evaluator latent vector inferred from the identical K anchors, plus per-evaluator affine/isotonic calibration as simpler controls.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use the proposed double-held-out actor/evaluator protocol, but add the direct low-rank factorization baseline. Match rank, K, anchor identities, human labels, regularization search, and candidate policies. The child survives only if its specifically claimed residual structure improves selection regret beyond that baseline and the improvement disappears under an ablation unique to the proposed mechanism rather than under removal of factorization itself.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if a matched low-rank dyadic factor model reaches statistically indistinguishable double-held-out selection regret at K=2,4,8, or if the alleged interaction advantage disappears after matching latent rank and regularization.
unknowns: Whether actor-evaluator interaction is actually stable enough across both unseen actor and unseen evaluator versions to be identifiable from K as small as 2-8.
Whether anchor choice, rather than historical crossed structure, explains most low-K gains.
Whether evaluator-version embeddings have meaningful transferable structure beyond ordinary latent collaborative filtering.

children.external_finding: The repair materially fixes the parent's observability defect: the new evaluator now exposes a fixed K-anchor interface, human truth is separated from calibration anchors, and the decisive endpoint is double-held-out policy-selection regret rather than raw judge agreement. However, the proposed scientific object does not survive simplification. Its core u_a^T M v_e interaction is a low-rank dyadic factorization, and adapting v_e* from a few anchor judgments is essentially cold-start latent-factor estimation. Closely related preference-factorization work already learns low-dimensional reward factors and infers a new individual's coordinates from a small number of preference observations; PReF explicitly reduces this adaptation to matrix-factorization followed by low-dimensional coefficient estimation. ([arXiv][1]) The child therefore needs to beat a matched low-rank dyadic model, not only affine/isotonic or lightweight calibration heads. As currently specified, the claimed crossed residual is reproducible by the simplest equivalent factor model.
children.external_finding_zh: 该修复确实实质性解决了父方案的可观测性问题：新 evaluator 现在只暴露固定的 K 个 anchor，人工真值与校准 anchor 分离，决定性终点也改成了 double-held-out 的策略选择 regret，而不是普通 judge agreement。但其核心科学对象没有通过简化挑战。u_a^T M v_e 本质上就是低秩二元交互分解，而通过少量 anchor 估计 v_e* 本质上属于 cold-start latent-factor estimation。已有偏好因子化工作已经利用低维 reward factors，并通过少量新用户偏好观测估计其低维坐标；PReF 甚至明确把这一过程归约为矩阵分解和低维系数估计。([arXiv][1]) 因此真正必须击败的不是 affine/isotonic 或轻量 calibration head，而是相同数据和预算下的低秩 dyadic factor model。按当前定义，crossed residual 可被最简单的等价因子模型复现。
children.external_required_action: Revive only if the learned object is no longer equivalent to ordinary dyadic factorization. At minimum, compare against a capacity-matched low-rank actor-by-evaluator model that learns the historical interaction matrix and estimates the new evaluator coordinate from exactly the same K anchors. A future version needs a transferable structure that this factor model cannot express, such as identifiable higher-order context-dependent interaction structure, and its gain must survive after matching latent rank, anchor selection, regularization, and human-label budget.
children.external_required_action_zh: 只有当学习对象不再等价于普通 dyadic factorization 时才值得复活。至少必须加入容量匹配的低秩 actor×evaluator 模型：用同一历史交互矩阵训练，并从完全相同的 K 个 anchor 估计新 evaluator 坐标。未来版本需要提出普通因子模型无法表达的可迁移结构，例如可识别的更高阶、上下文依赖交互，并且在 latent rank、anchor selection、regularization 和人工标签预算全部匹配后仍保持优势。

title.zh: 反事实纠错产生式语法

problem.zh: 按失败轨迹或粗粒度失败标签保存纠错技能时，Agent 在从未联合出现过的复合失败上缺少可靠的重组规则，尤其无法判断某个纠错动作究竟是必要原因修复还是偶然共现步骤。
problem.en: When correction skills are stored by failure trace or coarse failure label, agents lack reliable recombination rules for failure factors never observed together and cannot distinguish necessary corrective actions from merely co-occurring steps.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设从轨迹归纳出的 slot 与技能足以支持组合，而是假设每条可迁移产生式必须由模块替换干预识别出因果 failure slot，并由动作插入/删除反事实确认必要纠错动作及其 typed precondition/effect。
changed_assumption.en: Instead of assuming trace-induced slots and skills are sufficient for composition, require every transferable production to be grounded in a causally identified failure slot from module-replacement interventions and a necessary correction action established through action insertion/deletion counterfactuals with typed preconditions and effects.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对可分模块 Agent 建立 intervention matrix：对感知、规划、工具选择和执行模块分别以 oracle 或已验证替代模块替换，观察失败是否消失，由此将失败归因到最小 causal slot 集。随后对候选纠错动作执行两类反事实：从成功修复轨迹中删除该动作，或将该动作单独插入匹配失败轨迹；只有删除导致修复失效且插入在满足前置条件时恢复目标 effect 的动作才被编译为 necessary production。每个 production 记录 typed precondition、effect、不可共存条件和可交换条件。冻结后，解析器仅依据当前检测到的 causal slots 选择满足 precondition 的 productions，并按 effect dependencies 组合；测试阶段不允许新增 production。
exact_mechanism.en: Build an intervention matrix over modular agents by replacing perception, planning, tool-selection, and execution modules with oracle or verified substitutes and observing which failures disappear, thereby identifying the minimal causal failure-slot set. For candidate correction actions, run two counterfactual tests: delete the action from a successful repair trajectory and insert the action alone into a matched failing trajectory. Compile an action into a necessary production only if deletion destroys the repair and insertion restores the target effect when its precondition holds. Each production stores typed preconditions, effects, incompatibility constraints, and commutativity conditions. After freezing, a parser selects productions only from detected causal slots and composes them according to effect dependencies; no new production may be added at test time.

children.update_surface: frozen library of intervention-identified typed correction productions

learning_signal.zh: 模块替换前后失败状态的变化用于识别 causal slot；候选纠错动作删除与插入后的修复成败用于判定动作必要性；执行状态差用于归纳 typed precondition/effect。
learning_signal.en: Changes in failure status under module replacement identify causal slots; repair outcomes under candidate-action deletion and insertion establish action necessity; execution-state differences induce typed preconditions and effects.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 通过程序化或人工可验证任务生成 factorial failure grid，并完整留出若干从未共同出现的 failure-factor 组合；每个 slot 的真实来源由可控故障注入记录，每个动作 effect 由环境状态转移而非语言模型自评判定。
independent_ground_truth.en: Generate a factorial failure grid using programmable or human-verifiable tasks and hold out combinations of failure factors never jointly observed during training. True slot origins come from controlled fault-injection records, and action effects are determined by environment state transitions rather than model self-judgment.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同诱导 slot 标签，每个 slot 保存一个验证过的纠错技能，再由 NSI/SkillGraph 式 dependency composer 在测试时组合，不做动作必要性的删除/插入反事实，也不学习 causal production precondition/effect。
simplest_baseline.en: Using exactly the same induced slot labels, store one verified correction skill per slot and compose them at test time with an NSI/SkillGraph-style dependency composer, without action-necessity deletion/insertion counterfactuals or causal production precondition/effect induction.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选择一个可控工具 Agent 环境，注入四类 failure factors，每类至少两个取值，形成 factorial grid；训练只观察单因子和部分双因子组合，完整留出至少 25% 的双因子/三因子组合。所有方法使用同样 slot classifier、同样训练轨迹、同样测试调用数。比较因果产生式语法、NSI/SkillGraph composer、slot-conditioned retrieval。主要指标为未见组合上的成功率、错误纠错动作率和因 precondition 冲突造成的失败率。必须出现这样的差异：即使 baseline 拿到完全相同的 slot 标签，因果 production 仍能在未见组合上更正确地选择、排序或抑制动作。
decisive_pilot.en: Use a controllable tool-agent environment with four failure-factor types and at least two values per factor, forming a factorial grid. Training observes only single-factor and selected pairwise combinations, while at least 25% of pairwise/triple combinations are held out entirely. All methods receive the same slot classifier, training traces, and test-time call budget. Compare the causal production grammar against an NSI/SkillGraph composer and slot-conditioned retrieval. Primary outcomes are success on unseen combinations, incorrect-correction rate, and failures caused by precondition conflicts. The required effect is that, despite receiving identical slot labels, the causal productions choose, order, or suppress actions more correctly on unseen compositions.

stop_condition.zh: 若使用相同 slot 标签的现有程序/技能组合器在未见 factorial 组合上达到等价成功率与错误动作率，或去掉动作删除/插入反事实后结果不下降，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if an existing program/skill composer with the same slot labels matches success and incorrect-action rates on unseen factorial combinations, or if removing action deletion/insertion counterfactuals does not degrade results.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案的感知/规划/工具/执行 failure slots、持久纠错表示以及冻结后跨未见失败组合重组的目标。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the parent's perception/planning/tool/execution failure slots, persistent correction representation, and goal of frozen recombination over unseen failure compositions.

material_change.zh: 创新中心从通用 grammar composition 转移到两个可检验的因果识别步骤：模块替换识别 failure slot，以及动作删除/插入识别 necessary correction；语法只作为这些因果产生式的执行载体。
material_change.en: The scientific center moves from generic grammar composition to two testable causal-identification steps: module replacement for failure slots and action deletion/insertion for necessary corrections. The grammar becomes only the execution substrate for those causally grounded productions.

external_reviews.finding: The repair is material relative to a generic trace-induced grammar, but the repaired mechanism is now reducible to a composition of already available primitives. CausalFlow uses interventions over agent traces to identify causally responsible failure steps and constructs validated minimal counterfactual repairs. ([arXiv][9]) NSI already lifts trajectories into explicit predicate-conditioned, logic-grounded modular programs, while SkillGraph represents reusable skills with typed dependency edges and retrieves ordered skill compositions. ([arXiv][10]) Replacing modules to identify a coarse causal slot and deleting/inserting actions to obtain a minimal correction does not create a distinct causal learning object beyond these components. A straightforward CausalFlow-to-NSI/SkillGraph pipeline using the same intervention data can produce causal minimal repairs and dependency-aware composition, so the current production grammar does not survive the simplest-equivalent-method test.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 相对于通用 trace-induced grammar，这次确实是实质性修复；但修复后的机制现在可以被已有原语的直接组合归约。CausalFlow 已经通过对 Agent trace 做 intervention 来识别具有因果责任的失败步骤，并生成经过验证的最小 counterfactual repairs。([arXiv][9]) NSI 已经把轨迹提升为具有显式 predicate 条件的 logic-grounded modular programs，而 SkillGraph 则用 typed dependency edges 表示可复用技能并组合有序技能子图。([arXiv][10]) 再通过 module replacement 找一个较粗的 causal slot，并通过 action deletion/insertion 得到 minimal correction，并没有形成超出这些已有组件的新 causal learning object。一个直接的 CausalFlow→NSI/SkillGraph pipeline 使用完全相同的 intervention data，就能同时得到 causal minimal repairs 与 dependency-aware composition，因此当前 production grammar 没有通过 simplest-equivalent-method 检验。
external_reviews.required_action: A revival needs a learned object that cannot be produced by independently identifying minimal repairs and then composing them with an existing symbolic skill system. One viable scientific target would be causal interaction among corrections themselves: jointly necessary, antagonistic, or order-sensitive productions identified through multi-action interventions, where marginal single-action necessity is insufficient. The pilot would then need to beat CausalFlow-derived repairs composed by NSI/SkillGraph under identical intervention budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 若要复活，需要把学习对象改成无法通过“先独立识别 minimal repair，再交给现有 symbolic skill system 组合”得到的东西。例如可以研究纠错动作之间的因果交互：jointly necessary、antagonistic 或 order-sensitive productions，并通过 multi-action intervention 来识别，使单动作边际必要性不再足够。届时必须在完全相同 intervention 预算下击败 CausalFlow-derived repairs + NSI/SkillGraph composer。

closest_work: CausalFlow: interventional causal attribution and validated minimal counterfactual repair from agent failures. ([arXiv][9])
Neuro-Symbolic Skill Induction: trace-to-logic lifting into predicate-conditioned modular executable skills. ([arXiv][11])
SkillGraph: typed dependency graphs and ordered composition of reusable agent skills. ([arXiv][10])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The child evaluates factorially unseen combinations and grounds coarse failure slots through module substitution, but these differences currently modify the evaluation protocol more than the core learnable mechanism.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: CausalFlow-style minimal counterfactual correction extraction followed by NSI logic compilation and SkillGraph/dependency-based composition, with the same fault injections, trajectories, slot observations, and execution budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: If revived, construct failures where two individually ineffective or individually harmful corrections become necessary jointly, or where correction order changes the outcome. Compare a joint-intervention production learner against independently extracted CausalFlow repairs plus NSI/SkillGraph composition. Ordinary factorial held-out combinations are insufficient unless they require this higher-order causal interaction.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if independently validated atomic corrections composed by NSI/SkillGraph match unseen-combination success and incorrect-action rates, or if multi-action causal interaction terms are unnecessary after typed preconditions and dependencies are supplied.
unknowns: Whether module replacement identifies failure causes more accurately than finer-grained trajectory interventions.
Whether insertion of one correction action into a failing trajectory gives a valid intervention when downstream policy behavior changes.
Whether realistic compound failures contain higher-order correction interactions beyond ordinary precondition and dependency constraints.

title.zh: 反事实后代记忆变换器

problem.zh: 同一经验可能对不同任务子群产生方向相反的未来影响；仅全局保留或删除会失败，而仅学习“何时读取原经验”的门控也无法修复经验内容本身在某些子群中的错误归纳。
problem.en: The same experience can have opposite future effects across task subpopulations. Global keep/delete decisions fail, and merely learning when to retrieve the original memory cannot repair cases where the memory content itself induces the wrong abstraction for a subgroup.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设效应异质性只需要 applicability gating；改为假设一部分符号冲突来自经验内容中混合了可共享核心与子群特定错误归纳，因此需要学习会改变记忆内容的 descendant transformation。
changed_assumption.en: Effect heterogeneity is not assumed to require only applicability gating. Instead, some sign conflicts are assumed to arise because a memory mixes a reusable core with subgroup-specific misleading abstractions, requiring learned descendant transformations that modify memory content.

exact_mechanism.zh: 先对原始记忆 m 在随机化 replay 中估计条件处理效应 tau(x,m)，定位稳定的 effect-sign conflict 区域。仅当预注册异质性检验通过时启动分叉。一个共享 transformer 接收原记忆 m 与由任务可观察特征形成的 effect context c，输出受长度约束的 descendant delta Δm_c；后代记忆为 m_c=T(m,c)，而不是简单复制 m。训练目标要求：在该 context 下使用 m_c 比 withholding memory 提高成功率；在相反 context 下不继承原记忆的负效应；不同 descendants 通过共享-core regularizer 保留可验证共同事实，同时 contrastive effect loss 强迫它们产生不同决策。训练完成后冻结 transformer 与少量 prototype contexts。未来任务依据可观察特征生成或选择 descendant，不能访问 subgroup identity 标签。
exact_mechanism.en: First estimate the conditional treatment effect tau(x,m) of the original memory m from randomized replay and identify regions with stable effect-sign conflict. Bifurcation is activated only after a preregistered heterogeneity test passes. A shared transformer receives the original memory and an effect context c derived from observable task features, then outputs a length-constrained descendant delta Δm_c; the descendant is m_c=T(m,c), not a copy of m. Training requires m_c to outperform withholding the memory in its context, avoid inheriting the original memory's negative effect in opposing contexts, preserve verified shared facts through a shared-core regularizer, and induce distinct decisions across descendants through a contrastive effect loss. Freeze the transformer and a small set of prototype contexts. On future tasks, descendants are generated or selected from observable features without access to subgroup-identity labels.

children.update_surface: frozen context-conditioned descendant memory transformation operator with versioned lineage

learning_signal.zh: 随机化 replay 中原记忆、withhold、以及候选 descendant 三种条件下的任务结果差；子群效应符号；共享事实一致性；以及 descendants 是否真正改变下游动作分布。
learning_signal.en: Outcome differences among original-memory, withhold-memory, and candidate-descendant conditions in randomized replay; subgroup effect signs; shared-fact consistency; and whether descendants actually alter downstream action distributions.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 隐藏评测按未见 subgroup identity 和未见领域切分，只暴露任务本身的可观察特征；最终效果由随机分配 descendant/original/withhold 三臂实验测量，而非由训练期 effect estimator 自己打分。
independent_ground_truth.en: Hidden evaluation is split by unseen subgroup identities and unseen domains, exposing only observable task features. Final effects are measured by randomized assignment among descendant, original-memory, and withhold-memory arms rather than scored by the training-time effect estimator.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配的 effect-conditioned contextual gate：从相同随机 replay 学习 tau(x,m)，始终保留同一份原始记忆，仅在预测效应为正时检索，否则 withholding；存储、推理调用、训练样本和 estimator 容量与 descendant 方法严格匹配。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched effect-conditioned contextual gate learned from the same randomized replay: retain a single unchanged memory and retrieve it only when predicted tau(x,m) is positive, otherwise withhold it, with storage, inference calls, training examples, and estimator capacity strictly matched to the descendant method.

decisive_pilot.zh: 设计一个可控低资源 memory benchmark，使一条经验包含“共享正确核心 + 在训练环境中成立但在另一机制子群中错误的策略归纳”。构造至少四个潜在 subgroup，并完整留出其中一个 subgroup identity 与一个领域；测试时只给可观察任务特征。比较 descendant transformer、effect gate、两份独立手工/聚类记忆和原始 keep/delete。严格匹配总 memory token、训练 replay 次数和推理调用。主要指标是在未见 subgroup/domain 上相对 withhold 的真实 randomized treatment effect、平均成功率以及原始记忆负迁移率。决定性结果要求 descendant 在 effect gate 已经选择“可用原记忆”的样本上仍显著更好，证明收益来自内容变换而不是更好的 retrieval gating。
decisive_pilot.en: Create a controllable low-resource memory benchmark where one experience contains a shared correct core plus a strategy abstraction valid in one training mechanism but wrong in another subgroup. Construct at least four latent subgroups and hold out one subgroup identity and one domain entirely; expose only observable task features at test time. Compare the descendant transformer with the effect gate, two independent hand-written or clustered memories, and global keep/delete. Match total memory tokens, training replays, and inference calls. Primary metrics are true randomized treatment effect relative to withholding, average success, and negative-transfer rate on unseen subgroup/domain splits. The decisive result must show that descendants outperform the effect gate even on examples where that gate already chooses to retrieve the original memory, demonstrating a content-transformation benefit rather than improved retrieval gating.

stop_condition.zh: 若在未见 subgroup identity 和领域上，effect-conditioned gate 在相同预算下达到等价效果，尤其是在 gate 判定应检索原记忆的样本中 descendant 不再有增益；或 descendants 与原记忆的行为差异可由 token 重写噪声解释，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the effect-conditioned gate matches performance under the same budget on unseen subgroup identities and domains, especially if descendants provide no gain on examples where the gate already retrieves the original memory, or if descendant behavioral differences are explainable by generic rewriting noise.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案通过随机化 replay 估计异质处理效应、检测 effect-sign conflict、维护版本化 descendant lineage 并冻结到未来任务的核心框架。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the parent's randomized-replay estimation of heterogeneous treatment effects, detection of effect-sign conflict, versioned descendant lineage, and freezing to future tasks.

material_change.zh: 后代不再只是带不同适用条件的原经验副本，而是由冻结 transformer 学到的子群条件内容变换；决定性实验专门在 applicability gate 已经做出正确读取决策的样本上检验后代是否仍产生额外收益。
material_change.en: Descendants are no longer copies of the original experience with different applicability conditions; they are subgroup-conditioned content transformations produced by a frozen transformer, and the decisive test isolates whether they add value even after the applicability gate has already made the correct retrieval decision.

external_reviews.finding: The child directly follows the parent's simplification vector: descendants now modify memory content and the pilot explicitly conditions on cases where the applicability gate already chooses retrieval. Unfortunately, work available before the audit cutoff now collides with that repaired scientific center. MemHarness, submitted July 30, 2026, explicitly argues that retrieved memories should be contextually reconstructed rather than replayed, trains a policy to preserve transferable content while rewriting or rejecting misleading content, and shows that removing reconstruction eliminates much of the benefit. ([arXiv][12]) Thus 'learn a context-conditioned transformation of memory content because retrieval gating is insufficient' is no longer a distinct mechanism. Randomized treatment-effect estimation, effect-sign-triggered bifurcation, and lineage are meaningful additions, but as currently written they supervise or organize essentially the same context-conditioned memory-rewriting operator rather than establishing a new persistent learning object.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该 child 确实直接沿着父方案的 simplification vector 修复：descendant 现在真正修改 memory content，而且 pilot 专门在 applicability gate 已经决定检索原记忆的样本上检验额外收益。但在审查截止日期之前已经出现了与这一修复后科学中心高度碰撞的工作。MemHarness 于 2026-07-30 提交，明确提出 retrieved memory 不应直接 replay，而应根据当前 context 重构；其策略会保留可迁移内容、重写或拒绝误导内容，并通过 ablation 表明去掉 reconstruction 后收益明显下降。([arXiv][12]) 因此，“因为 retrieval gating 不够，所以学习 context-conditioned memory-content transformation”已经不再是独立的新机制。随机 treatment-effect estimation、effect-sign-triggered bifurcation 和 lineage 都是有价值的附加结构，但按当前写法，它们主要是在监督或组织一个已经存在的 context-conditioned memory rewriting operator，而没有形成新的持久学习对象。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not revive as another contextual memory-reconstruction method. A future child must make the causal bifurcation itself the irreducible persistent object—for example, use randomized replay to commit offline, versioned descendant memories whose contents remain fixed during future inference, and test whether maintaining multiple causally specialized persistent descendants beats a MemHarness-style state-conditioned reconstruction policy given the same memory tokens, replay budget, model capacity, and observable context.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不要以另一种 contextual memory reconstruction 方法复活。未来版本必须让 causal bifurcation 本身成为不可归约的持久对象。例如，用 randomized replay 离线生成并提交 versioned descendant memories，之后这些 descendant 的内容在未来推理中保持固定；再检验“维护多个因果专门化、持久 descendant”是否能在相同 memory token、replay budget、模型容量和 observable context 下击败 MemHarness-style state-conditioned reconstruction policy。

closest_work: MemHarness: Memory Is Reconstructed, Not Replayed, submitted July 30, 2026; it explicitly learns state-conditioned critique and rewriting of retrieved experiences to avoid negative transfer. ([arXiv][12])
MemCon: learned context-dependent control over retrieval, consolidation and forgetting, relevant to the alternative gating/control side of the comparison. ([arXiv][13])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The child adds randomized treatment-effect estimation, explicit sign-conflict tests, prototype descendants, and versioned lineage. Those distinctions could support a future persistent-bifurcation method, but the current transformer still implements the already-collided core operation of context-conditioned memory reconstruction.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: MemHarness-style context-conditioned memory critique/reconstruction trained with matched capacity and the same randomized replay data, plus the original effect-conditioned retrieval gate.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: For a revival, precompute and freeze descendant contents before the held-out task arrives. Compare them against a matched MemHarness-style reconstruction policy that may rewrite the original memory online from the same observable context. Randomize descendant/original/withhold arms for causal outcome measurement, and separately evaluate examples on which both methods elect to use memory. The persistent-descendant method must outperform contextual reconstruction, not merely the retrieval gate.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if a matched contextual reconstruction policy reaches equivalent treatment effect, success, and negative-transfer rates on unseen subgroup/domain splits, or if descendant contents must be regenerated from each test context to obtain the gain.
unknowns: Whether stable effect-sign regions correspond to persistent reusable memory variants rather than ordinary state-conditioned adaptation.
Whether observable features suffice to select a fixed descendant on genuinely unseen subgroup identities.
Whether shared-core regularization contributes beyond the reconstruction behavior already learned by context-conditioned memory policies.
