title.zh: 非加性局部消息效应场

changed_assumption.zh: 零搜索通信图构造的可迁移信息不再被定义为各边独立效用之和；核心可检验对象改为：在相同 task motif 下，一条边的效应会因邻接边是否存在而系统改变，而这种局部非加性残差能够跨任务族迁移。
changed_assumption.en: Transferable information for zero-search graph construction is no longer defined as the sum of independent edge utilities. The testable object becomes a systematic change in an edge's effect caused by the presence of neighboring edges under the same task motif, with this local nonadditive residual transferring across task families.

exact_mechanism.zh: 使用相同 normal/mask/length-matched replacement/joint-mask 数据，先拟合共享 additive 主效应 a_theta(x_e)。随后只从联合干预可识别部分学习局部残差 q_theta(x_e,x_f,c_local)，并强制 q 在没有 joint-mask 证据支持的远距离边对上为零。候选图 G 的冻结预测效用为 U(G)=sum_{e in G} a_theta(x_e)+sum_{(e,f) in N(G)} q_theta(x_e,x_f,c_local)-lambda*token(G)。评测任务上只计算一次该冻结效用并在固定 edge/token 预算下选择图，不使用 target reward。主对照将相同参数预算全部用于 additive regressor，且看到完全相同的 joint-mask executions，但预测形式被限制为 sum_e a'*theta(x_e)。
exact_mechanism.en: Using the same normal, mask, length-matched replacement, and joint-mask executions, first fit a shared additive main effect a_theta(x_e). Learn a local residual q_theta(x_e,x_f,c_local) only from components identifiable by joint interventions, forcing q to zero for distant edge pairs unsupported by joint-mask evidence. The frozen utility of a candidate graph G is U(G)=sum*{e in G} a_theta(x_e)+sum_{(e,f) in N(G)} q_theta(x_e,x_f,c_local)-lambda*token(G). On evaluation tasks, compute this frozen utility once and construct a graph under fixed edge/token budgets without target reward. The primary control allocates the same parameter budget to an additive regressor that sees the identical joint-mask executions but is restricted to sum_e a'*theta(x_e).

children.update_surface: persistent task-family communication graph selected from a frozen edge-interaction effect model

learning_signal.zh: 训练信号为同一执行集合产生的成功率、token 成本和错误传播变化；q 的监督是联合 mask 实测效应减去两个单边主效应所得的非加性残差，不引入额外 rollout。
learning_signal.en: The learning signal is the change in success, token cost, and error propagation from the same execution set. Supervision for q is the measured joint-mask effect minus the two singleton main effects; no additional rollout is introduced.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 完整留出的任务族在图构造完成后才运行真实 agent executions；其任务正确性由独立任务答案/环境状态判定，错误传播由预定义错误注入传播标签判定，均不进入图选择。
independent_ground_truth.en: Entirely held-out task families are executed only after graph construction. Task correctness is judged by independent answers/environment states and error propagation by preregistered injected-error propagation labels; none are available during graph selection.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配 additive task-conditioned edge-effect regressor：获得完全相同的 task motifs、角色、局部描述、normal/mask/replacement/joint-mask executions、token 预算和参数量，但不允许显式 pairwise residual 或邻接交互项。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched additive task-conditioned edge-effect regressor receiving exactly the same task motifs, roles, local descriptors, normal/mask/replacement/joint-mask executions, token budget, and parameter count, but with no explicit pairwise residual or adjacency interaction term.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选取至少三个 held-out task families，并预先定义一组存在正、负和近零真实联合残差的局部 edge motifs。冻结后分别由非加性模型和 additive baseline 在同 edge/token 预算下零搜索构图。主指标是 held-out-family success-minus-cost frontier；机制指标是 q 对真实联合残差的符号和排序预测。只有两者都优于 additive 才支持主张。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least three held-out task families and preregister local edge motifs spanning positive, negative, and near-zero measured joint residuals. After freezing, let the nonadditive model and additive baseline construct graphs with zero search under identical edge/token budgets. The primary metric is the held-out-family success-versus-cost frontier; the mechanism metric is sign/rank prediction of measured joint residuals. Both must improve over the additive model.

stop_condition.zh: 若容量匹配 additive predictor 在 held-out-family 图质量上达到统计等价，或 q 不能预测真实 joint residual，或优势需要目标任务 reward/topology search 才出现，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the capacity-matched additive predictor is statistically equivalent on held-out-family graph quality, if q fails to predict actual joint residuals, or if any advantage requires target-task reward or topology search.

material_change.zh: 将主张缩窄为相同干预数据下“可迁移的非加性局部效应”是否提供 additive 回归无法恢复的信息；所有额外数据优势被移除，pairwise 结构必须直接赢过同数据同容量的加法模型。
material_change.en: The claim is narrowed to whether transferable local nonadditive effects contain information unrecoverable by an additive model under identical intervention data. All extra-data advantages are removed, and the pairwise structure must directly beat a same-data, same-capacity additive predictor.

external_reviews.finding: The second-order repair correctly removes the previous extra-data advantage: both methods now see the same singleton and joint interventions, and the learned operator is frozen before held-out-family graph construction. The remaining simplification gap is decisive, however. The baseline is structurally forced to be additive, while the hypothesis is exactly that the target contains pairwise nonadditivity. A generic same-data pairwise or nonlinear graph-utility predictor can consume the same joint-mask executions and represent those residuals without the proposed additive-plus-q decomposition. Beating an additive model therefore establishes nonadditivity, not the necessity or transfer value of this particular effect-field factorization.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 第二阶修复已经正确消除了额外数据优势：两种方法看到相同的 singleton 与 joint interventions，而且学习算子在 held-out family 构图前冻结。但仍存在决定性的简化缺口。当前 baseline 在结构上被强制为 additive，而核心假设恰好就是目标包含 pairwise nonadditivity。同数据的通用 pairwise/nonlinear graph-utility predictor 可以直接读取相同 joint-mask executions 并表示这些残差，而无需 proposed 的 additive+q 分解。因此，超过 additive 模型只能证明存在非加性，不能证明该 effect-field factorization 的必要性或迁移价值。
external_reviews.required_action: Add a capacity-matched unrestricted second-order utility predictor that receives exactly the same singleton/joint executions, descriptors, task motifs, and budgets and can model arbitrary local pair interactions, but does not use the proposed identifiable residual decomposition or q factorization. The contribution must survive this comparison.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 加入容量匹配的非受限二阶 utility predictor：它获得完全相同的 singleton/joint executions、描述符、task motifs 和预算，可以表示任意局部 pair interaction，但不采用 proposed 的可识别 residual 分解或 q factorization。主张必须在该对照下仍成立。

closest_work: G-Designer already learns task-adaptive communication topology for multi-agent systems, so learned graph construction itself is not novel. ([arXiv][4])

Adaptive Graph Pruning for Multi-Agent Communication learns task-adaptive high-utility communication subgraphs, further narrowing novelty to the intervention-derived interaction object rather than topology optimization. ([arXiv][5])
TCP-MCP explicitly treats prompt utility and communication-edge utility as coupled rather than independent, which is conceptually adjacent to nonadditive communication effects. ([arXiv][6])

Group-MATES models relational influence terms beyond independent contributions in a different data-selection setting, showing that explicit interaction effects are a broader existing modeling pattern. ([arXiv][7])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving difference is intervention-identified local edge-edge residuals learned from matched joint masks and frozen for zero-search graph construction on entirely held-out task families.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A same-data, same-parameter generic pairwise graph-utility model, such as a local second-order MLP/GNN over edge pairs, trained on all identical normal, replacement, singleton-mask, and joint-mask outcomes and permitted to predict graph utility directly without the explicit a+q decomposition.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: On at least three fully held-out task families, compare additive, unrestricted pairwise, and proposed residual-factorized predictors under identical graph and token budgets. Require both accurate sign/rank prediction of unseen measured interaction residuals and a better success-cost frontier than the unrestricted pairwise model.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the factorized effect-field claim if a generic same-data pairwise predictor matches graph quality or residual prediction, if q fails on held-out interaction motifs, or if gains require target-family reward or search.
unknowns: Whether pairwise interactions are sufficient or higher-order graph effects dominate.
Whether local-context definitions are fixed before examining held-out families.
Whether graph optimization under the frozen utility introduces an unaccounted search advantage.

title.zh: 结构等变更新差分失败先验

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把贡献定义成“参数化 policy 比检索更好”，而把唯一假设限定为：跨更新可迁移信息存在于与具体键名、工具名和节点身份无关的 typed relational structure 中；如果这个假设成立，一个显式结构等变且冻结的 failure prior 应在从未出现过的 structural update types 上超过同信息 kNN 和通用 direct diff-conditioned 模型。
changed_assumption.en: The contribution is no longer that a parameterized policy is inherently better than retrieval. The sole hypothesis is that transferable cross-update information lies in typed relational structure invariant to concrete key, tool, and node identities. If true, an explicitly structure-equivariant frozen failure prior should outperform same-information kNN and generic direct diff-conditioned models on structural update types never seen during training.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把 structural diff 图规范化为 typed relation motifs：例如 permission-add→scope-parent、rule-delete→dependent-rule、retrieval-rewrite→consumer 和 termination-change→loop-edge。encoder 对同类型节点重命名强制等变，并通过共享 motif factors 计算 failure-family logits；最终 π(f|G) 是所有局部 motif contribution 与有限 pairwise motif interaction 的归一化和。训练时额外加入 graph-renaming consistency 和 motif-mask contrast：对同一 diff 随机重命名实体后分布必须不变，屏蔽已由独立失败证据定位的关键 motif 时对应 failure-family logit 必须下降。测试前冻结全部参数。比较对象包括：(1) 在同一 canonical graph representation 上做 kNN 并统计邻居 failure-family histogram；(2) 参数量匹配的 generic graph/set encoder，直接从完整 diff 条件化 challenge allocation/generation，但不施加 proposed motif factorization 或 renaming equivariance。三者共享所有历史更新、challenge/verifier calls、replay 容量和 token。
exact_mechanism.en: Canonicalize structural diff graphs into typed relation motifs such as permission-add to scope-parent, rule-delete to dependent-rule, retrieval-rewrite to consumer, and termination-change to loop-edge. The encoder is constrained to be equivariant to renaming nodes of the same type and computes failure-family logits from shared motif factors; π(f|G) is the normalized sum of local motif contributions and a bounded set of pairwise motif interactions. Training additionally uses graph-renaming consistency and motif-mask contrast: arbitrary entity renaming of the same diff must leave the distribution unchanged, while masking a motif independently localized as causal for a failure must reduce the corresponding failure-family logit. All parameters are frozen before testing. Comparators are (1) kNN over the same canonical graph representation with empirical neighbor failure-family histograms and (2) a parameter-matched generic graph/set encoder that directly conditions challenge allocation/generation on the complete diff but has neither the proposed motif factorization nor renaming-equivariance constraint. All three share every historical update, challenge/verifier call, replay slot, and token budget.

children.update_surface: frozen parameterized structural failure-family prior controlling future challenge-budget allocation

learning_signal.zh: 唯一正标签是独立 verifier 确认的历史真实 regression 及其 failure-family；附加监督来自等价 diff 的实体重命名和已确认 failure-supporting motif 的遮蔽对比。当前测试 diff 的 verifier 结果不用于更新 prior。
learning_signal.en: The only positive labels are historical regressions and failure families confirmed by an independent verifier. Additional supervision comes from entity renamings of equivalent diffs and masking contrasts over motifs supporting verified failures. Verifier outcomes from the current test diff never update the prior.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 每个 held-out update 的真实 failure families 由预生成、未向 allocator 暴露的完整 challenge suite 加独立 verifier 确定。该 suite 的覆盖远大于三种方法实际获得的相同 challenge budget，因此 ground truth 不由任一 allocator 自己发现的样本定义。
independent_ground_truth.en: True failure families for each held-out update are determined by a pregenerated exhaustive challenge suite plus an independent verifier hidden from all allocators. This suite is substantially larger than the identical challenge budget available to the three compared methods, so ground truth is not defined by whichever failures an allocator happened to discover.

simplest_baseline.zh: 两个 same-information controls 必须同时通过：(1) Canonical-Diff-kNN，在相同 structural graph 上检索 k 个历史 diff 并直接使用 empirical failure-family histogram 分配预算；(2) Direct-Diff Allocator，一个参数量匹配的通用 graph/set-conditioned allocator/generator，使用相同训练 updates、failure labels 和完整 diff，但没有 proposed structural-equivariant motif prior。另保留 full-state replay baseline。所有方法严格匹配 challenge calls、verifier calls、历史样本、replay capacity 和 tokens。
simplest_baseline.en: Two same-information controls are mandatory: (1) Canonical-Diff-kNN, which retrieves k historical diffs from the same structural graph space and allocates budget according to their empirical failure-family histogram; and (2) Direct-Diff Allocator, a parameter-matched generic graph/set-conditioned allocator/generator trained on the same updates, failure labels, and complete diffs but without the proposed structural-equivariant motif prior. The full-state replay baseline is retained. Challenge calls, verifier calls, historical examples, replay capacity, and tokens are strictly matched across methods.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按 structural update type 而非随机样本划分留出，例如训练只含单一 permission/rule/retrieval motifs 及部分二元组合，测试保留新的 relation topology 和未见 motif compositions，同时随机重命名所有实体标识。冻结 allocator 后，在相同 challenge budget 下测 hidden-suite failure-family recall、first-hit efficiency 和 discovered-regression precision。只有 proposed prior 同时超过 kNN 与 Direct-Diff Allocator，且其优势在取消 renaming-equivariance/motif factorization 后消失，才允许声称存在可迁移 cross-update structure。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out structural update types rather than random examples: training contains individual permission/rule/retrieval motifs and only a subset of pairwise compositions, while test data contains new relation topologies and unseen motif compositions with all entity identifiers randomly renamed. After freezing the allocators, measure hidden-suite failure-family recall, first-hit efficiency, and precision of discovered regressions under identical challenge budgets. Transferable cross-update structure is claimed only if the proposed prior beats both kNN and Direct-Diff Allocator and the gain disappears when renaming equivariance or motif factorization is removed.

stop_condition.zh: 若 kNN 或 capacity-matched direct allocator 在 held-out structural types 上匹配 proposed prior，或 proposed 优势依赖实体名称而在重命名后消失，则停止“参数化跨更新结构先验”主张；只保留当前 diff 条件化测试生成的工程结论。
stop_condition.en: Stop the parameterized cross-update structural-prior claim if either kNN or the capacity-matched direct allocator matches the proposed method on held-out structural types, or if the advantage depends on entity names and disappears under renaming. Only an engineering claim about current-diff-conditioned test generation would remain.

material_change.zh: v5.2 不再依赖一个普通 encoder 与弱 replay 对照，而把可检验差异收窄为结构重命名等变的 motif-factorized prior，并正面对比相同 structural information 的 kNN 和容量匹配 direct model。
material_change.en: v5.2 no longer relies on a generic encoder against a weak replay control. It narrows the testable difference to a renaming-equivariant motif-factorized structural prior and directly compares it with kNN and a capacity-matched direct model receiving the same structural information.

external_reviews.finding: The child materially improves the previous proposal by removing identity dependence, holding out structural update types, freezing the prior, matching challenge budgets, and providing hidden exhaustive-suite truth. The remaining boundary is the direct baseline. A generic graph/set encoder without an explicit renaming constraint is weaker than the standard simplest structural alternative: an identity-free relation-aware permutation-equivariant GNN or graph transformer can ingest the same typed canonical graph, receive the same renaming augmentation and verifier labels, and learn cross-topology structure without the hand-designed motif factorization. Until the proposed motif decomposition beats that control, any gain can be attributed to ordinary graph equivariance rather than the claimed failure-motif prior.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该 child 相比上一版已有实质提升：去除了 identity 依赖，完整留出 structural update types，测试前冻结 prior，严格匹配 challenge budget，并用隐藏 exhaustive suite 建立独立真值。剩余边界在 direct baseline。一个没有显式 renaming constraint 的 generic graph/set encoder 弱于最简单的结构化替代方案：identity-free、relation-aware、天然 permutation-equivariant 的 GNN 或 graph transformer 可以读取同一 typed canonical graph、接受相同 renaming augmentation 和 verifier labels，并在没有手工 motif factorization 的情况下学习跨 topology 结构。若 proposed 不能超过这一对照，优势只能归因于普通 graph equivariance，而不能归因于所声称的 failure-motif prior。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace or augment Direct-Diff Allocator with a parameter-matched identity-free relational GNN/Graph Transformer that is permutation-equivariant by construction and receives the same graph, renaming augmentations, labels, history, calls, and tokens, but no proposed motif factorization. Also include a generic motif-GNN-style control if parameterization permits.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 用容量匹配的 identity-free relational GNN/Graph Transformer 替换或补充 Direct-Diff Allocator。该基线应天然 permutation-equivariant，并获得相同 graph、renaming augmentations、labels、history、calls 和 tokens，但不使用 proposed motif factorization；若预算允许，还应加入通用 motif-GNN 类对照。

closest_work: Motif Graph Neural Network explicitly incorporates graph motifs to model higher-order structural information, so motif-factorized graph learning is not novel in isolation. ([arXiv][14])
StableGNN studies invariant/causal graph representations for out-of-distribution graph generalization, overlapping the goal of transfer across structural distribution shifts. ([arXiv][15])

AgentAssay uses agent-specific mutation operators, regression testing, behavioral fingerprints, and adaptive testing budgets, making update-conditioned regression discovery a close application-level neighbor. ([arXiv][16])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving combination is a frozen diff-conditioned failure-family prior that uses typed structural motifs specifically to allocate a limited future challenge budget on unseen update structures against exhaustive hidden-suite truth.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A parameter-matched identity-free relational GNN or Graph Transformer with permutation equivariance, the same typed graph and renaming augmentation, the same verified failure labels, and identical challenge/verifier/token budgets, but no hand-designed motif factorization or motif-mask objective.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Hold out complete relation topologies and unseen motif compositions, rename all entity identifiers, and compare proposed, equivariant relational direct model, motif-GNN control, and canonical kNN under identical challenge budgets. Require higher hidden-suite failure-family recall and first-hit efficiency than every control, with ablations showing incremental value from motif factorization beyond generic equivariance.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the structural-motif-prior claim if an identity-free equivariant relational baseline matches it on held-out structural types, if gains disappear after fair renaming augmentation, or if the advantage depends on structural leakage from the split.
unknowns: Whether the current generic direct baseline is already permutation-invariant through its implementation.
Whether entity renaming means graph-index permutation, literal identifier replacement, or both.
Whether held-out structural compositions share near-duplicate subgraphs with training updates.
Whether challenge generation itself introduces an additional learned advantage beyond allocation.

The remaining boundary is the direct baseline. A generic graph/set encoder without an explicit renaming constraint is weaker than the standard simplest structural alternative: an identity-free relation-aware permutation-equivariant GNN or graph transformer can ingest the same typed canonical graph, receive the same renaming augmentation and verifier labels, and learn cross-topology structure without the hand-designed motif factorization. Also include a generic motif-GNN-style control if parameterization permits.
children.external_required_action_zh: 用容量匹配的 identity-free relational GNN/Graph Transformer 替换或补充 Direct-Diff Allocator。该基线应天然 permutation-equivariant，并获得相同 graph、renaming augmentations、labels、history、calls 和 tokens，但不使用 proposed motif factorization；若预算允许，还应加入通用 motif-GNN 类对照。

title.zh: 类型条件交互签名商迁移器

changed_assumption.zh: 商类不再由训练期出现过的 memory identity 及其已观测超边决定，而由一个可迁移的、identity-free 类型条件交互算子决定。两个从未见过的记忆只有在冻结算子根据其类型、结构角色、检索位置和上下文类型预测其 pair/triple 干预残差等价时，才允许进入同一压缩类。
changed_assumption.en: Quotient classes are no longer determined by training-seen memory identities and their observed hyperedges. They are determined by a transferable identity-free, type-conditioned interaction operator. Two unseen memories may share a compression class only when the frozen operator predicts equivalent pair/triple intervention residuals from their types, structural roles, retrieval positions, and contextual types.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从训练记忆中完全移除 identity token，定义 phi(m)=[memory type, provenance type, retrieval role, dependency degree, trigger schema, action/read-write signature]。对相同预算下的单项、pair 和 triple add/delete/substitute 干预计算真实交互残差 r_S=Delta(S)-sum_i Delta({i})。训练冻结预测器 F_theta(phi(m_i), phi(context), composition pattern) 输出残差分布及置信区间。对新 identity，先用 F_theta 预测其与候选上下文的交互签名，再仅当边际效应等价且所有高置信预测残差差异低于阈值时合并为 quotient class。压缩完成后冻结 memory store 和 F_theta；未来任务不再进行身份级重拟合或干预搜索。
exact_mechanism.en: Remove memory-identity tokens entirely and define phi(m) from memory type, provenance type, retrieval role, dependency degree, trigger schema, and action/read-write signature. Under a fixed budget, obtain ground-truth interaction residuals from singleton, pair, and triple add/delete/substitute interventions, r_S = Delta(S) - sum_i Delta({i}). Train a frozen predictor F_theta(phi(m_i), phi(context), composition pattern) that outputs residual distributions and uncertainty. For unseen identities, predict their interaction signatures with candidate contexts and form quotient classes only when marginal effects are equivalent and every high-confidence predicted residual difference is below threshold. After compression, freeze both the memory store and F_theta; no identity-specific refitting or intervention search is allowed on future tasks.

children.update_surface: persistent memory quotient classes plus typed interaction-signature hyperedges

learning_signal.zh: 监督仅来自训练身份上的受控 singleton/pair/triple 替换干预残差；identity 标签不进入预测器输入。损失同时拟合残差均值、置信区间覆盖率和“可合并/不可合并”边界。
learning_signal.en: Supervision comes only from controlled singleton/pair/triple substitution residuals on training identities; identity labels are excluded from predictor inputs. The loss fits residual magnitude, uncertainty calibration, and the merge-versus-veto boundary.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 在完全未用于训练或阈值选择的新 memory identities 与新类型组合上重新执行真实 pair/triple 干预，以冻结压缩前后的任务成功、受保护行为和交互残差作为独立真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: On memory identities and type compositions entirely excluded from training and threshold selection, rerun actual pair/triple interventions and use task success, protected behaviors, and measured interaction residuals before versus after frozen compression as independent truth.

simplest_baseline.zh: interaction-aware veto table/classifier：使用完全相同的 singleton/pair/triple 干预、相同特征可见范围、相同存储位数和相同目标压缩率，直接学习“某候选合并是否应 veto”，但不形成类型化交互签名或 quotient algebra。
simplest_baseline.en: An interaction-aware veto table/classifier using exactly the same singleton/pair/triple interventions, feature visibility, storage bits, and target compression rate, directly predicting whether each proposed merge should be vetoed, without typed interaction signatures or quotient algebra.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按 memory identity 和组合同时 disjoint 划分；只在训练身份上拟合。测试包含从未出现的单身份以及训练中从未出现的 type composition。在 3 个固定压缩率下比较冻结 quotient、容量匹配 veto 和仅边际效应压缩器的行为保持率。若 quotient 的优势只发生在 seen identity，而在 unseen identity/composition 上不超过 veto，则失败。
decisive_pilot.en: Use splits disjoint in both memory identity and composition, fitting only on training identities. Test both wholly unseen individual identities and type compositions absent from training. At three fixed compression rates, compare the frozen quotient against the capacity-matched veto and a marginal-only compressor on behavioral preservation. The claim fails if gains occur only for seen identities or disappear relative to the veto on unseen identities/compositions.

stop_condition.zh: 若在任一预注册的中高压缩率上，unseen-identity/composition 的行为保持前沿未显著超过同预算 veto，或允许 identity 特征后才出现优势，或冻结压缩导致受保护行为退化超过预设容忍值，则停止该方向。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the behavioral-preservation frontier on unseen identities/compositions does not exceed the matched veto at any preregistered medium/high compression point, if the advantage requires identity features, or if frozen compression degrades protected behavior beyond the preregistered tolerance.

material_change.zh: 修复点不是再增加超边，而是把决定商类的对象从训练身份上的已记忆交互表改成可冻结迁移的 identity-free 类型条件交互预测算子，并以完全相同干预数据和存储预算的 veto 方法作为主简化检验。
material_change.en: The repair does not add more hyperedges. It changes the quotient-defining object from a memorized interaction table over training identities to a frozen, identity-free type-conditioned interaction predictor, with a same-intervention, same-storage veto method as the primary simplification test.

external_reviews.finding: Removing identity tokens and requiring frozen transfer to unseen identities/compositions is a substantive second-order change, and independent pair/triple interventions give real ground truth. Two material boundaries remain. First, the veto baseline is not information- or supervision-equivalent at the learned-object level: F_theta is trained to predict residual magnitude and uncertainty before thresholding, whereas the stated baseline directly learns a binary merge veto. A same-capacity residual-regression-plus-uncertainty model can use the identical intervention targets and then make direct merge or clustering decisions without quotient algebra. Second, thresholded similarity of pair/triple interaction signatures is not automatically transitive, so the proposed merge relation may fail to define a genuine quotient and may produce order-dependent classes.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 去除 identity token，并要求冻结后迁移到未见 identity/composition，是实质性的第二阶改变；真实 pair/triple interventions 也提供了独立真值。但仍有两个关键边界。第一，veto baseline 在学习对象和监督层面并不等价：F_theta 先学习 residual magnitude 与 uncertainty，再通过阈值决定合并，而当前 baseline 直接学习二元 merge veto。同容量的 residual-regression+uncertainty 方法可以读取完全相同的 intervention targets，然后直接做 merge 或 clustering，而无需 quotient algebra。第二，基于阈值的 pair/triple interaction-signature 相似性并不天然具有传递性，因此该 merge relation 未必真正构成 quotient，并可能产生依赖合并顺序的 classes。
external_reviews.required_action: Add a same-capacity direct residual-to-merge or residual-to-clustering baseline trained with exactly the same residual-magnitude and uncertainty/calibration supervision and storage budget, differing only in the absence of quotient algebra. Separately define and test an equivalence construction that guarantees or explicitly enforces reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity, and merge-order invariance.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 加入同容量 direct residual-to-merge 或 residual-to-clustering baseline：使用完全相同的 residual magnitude、uncertainty/calibration 监督和存储预算，唯一差别是不建立 quotient algebra。同时必须定义并测试一个能够保证或显式约束自反性、对称性、传递性和 merge-order invariance 的等价关系构造。

closest_work: Causal Intervention-Based Memory Selection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents uses controlled interventions to estimate the causal usefulness of memories, overlapping the intervention-based identification side of the proposal although it targets selection rather than quotient compression. ([arXiv][17])

Experience Compression Spectrum organizes agent experience representations as forms of compression and identifies adaptive cross-level compression as a central design problem, making persistent memory compression a neighboring research space. ([arXiv][18])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving distinction is an identity-free typed predictor of pair/triple interaction residuals used to construct persistent compression classes that must transfer to unseen memory identities and unseen type compositions.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched probabilistic residual predictor trained on the exact same singleton/pair/triple residual magnitudes and calibration targets, followed by a direct merge-veto or global clustering rule, with identical feature visibility, compression target, and total storage bits but no quotient algebra.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use splits disjoint in both identities and type compositions at three preregistered compression rates. Compare quotient, direct residual-to-veto/clustering, binary veto, and marginal-only compression. Measure behavioral preservation, protected-behavior violations, residual prediction, storage cost, transitivity violations, and class order dependence. The quotient must beat the direct residual baseline and exhibit near-zero equivalence inconsistencies.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the same-supervision direct residual baseline matches the behavioral-preservation frontier, if class formation is materially order-dependent or non-transitive, if storage accounting removes the advantage, or if gains require identity features.
unknowns: Whether the proposed threshold relation is transitive on unseen memories.
How interaction-signature and hyperedge storage is charged against the stated bit budget.
Whether pair/triple interventions capture important higher-order interactions.
Whether thresholds and uncertainty calibration are selected without leakage from test compositions.

children.external_finding: Removing identity tokens and requiring frozen transfer to unseen identities/compositions is a substantive second-order change, and independent pair/triple interventions give real ground truth. Two material boundaries remain. First, the veto baseline is not information- or supervision-equivalent at the learned-object level: F_theta is trained to predict residual magnitude and uncertainty before thresholding, whereas the stated baseline directly learns a binary merge veto. A same-capacity residual-regression-plus-uncertainty model can use the identical intervention targets and then make direct merge or clustering decisions without quotient algebra. Second, thresholded similarity of pair/triple interaction signatures is not automatically transitive, so the proposed merge relation may fail to define a genuine quotient and may produce order-dependent classes.
children.external_finding_zh: 去除 identity token，并要求冻结后迁移到未见 identity/composition，是实质性的第二阶改变；真实 pair/triple interventions 也提供了独立真值。但仍有两个关键边界。第一，veto baseline 在学习对象和监督层面并不等价：F_theta 先学习 residual magnitude 与 uncertainty，再通过阈值决定合并，而当前 baseline 直接学习二元 merge veto。同容量的 residual-regression+uncertainty 方法可以读取完全相同的 intervention targets，然后直接做 merge 或 clustering，而无需 quotient algebra。第二，基于阈值的 pair/triple interaction-signature 相似性并不天然具有传递性，因此该 merge relation 未必真正构成 quotient，并可能产生依赖合并顺序的 classes。
children.external_required_action: Add a same-capacity direct residual-to-merge or residual-to-clustering baseline trained with exactly the same residual-magnitude and uncertainty/calibration supervision and storage budget, differing only in the absence of quotient algebra. Separately define and test an equivalence construction that guarantees or explicitly enforces reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity, and merge-order invariance.
children.external_required_action_zh: 加入同容量 direct residual-to-merge 或 residual-to-clustering baseline：使用完全相同的 residual magnitude、uncertainty/calibration 监督和存储预算，唯一差别是不建立 quotient algebra。同时必须定义并测试一个能够保证或显式约束自反性、对称性、传递性和 merge-order invariance 的等价关系构造。

title.zh: 预算分账契约路由与转译器

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把“选对 surface”和“在该 surface 上生成好资产”作为一个不可分解的成功事件。假设两种能力必须分别被证伪：router 只负责在固定资产之间选择，transpiler 只负责在已知正确 surface 内生成资产；组合收益只有在两个子问题各自成立后才有意义。
changed_assumption.en: Correct surface selection and good within-surface asset generation are no longer treated as one indivisible success event. The two capabilities must be independently falsified: the router chooses only among fixed assets, while the transpiler generates an asset only after being given the correct surface. Composed-system gains matter only after both components independently succeed.

exact_mechanism.zh: 预先为 prompt、memory 和 tool-constraint 三个 surface 各构建一个容量匹配资产 A_prompt、A_memory、A_tool，并在训练 target 上离线确定它们的 contract profiles。冻结 router r(z_model,C) 后，routing-only 测试中禁止 transpiler 参与，router 仅从三个固定资产标签中选一项。transpiler-only 测试直接提供独立 oracle surface，并要求 transpiler 从同一 contract C 生成与该 surface 的预构建资产容量相同的资产。最后才运行 composed router→transpiler。对每个新 target 明确定义部署 ledger M=6 次目标执行：前 2 次固定 diagnostic probes 产生 z_model，后 4 次只能用于被选 surface 的 contract check；所有 diagnostic、validation、fallback 和 candidate execution 都计入 M。任何额外 target execution 都视为超预算。一个三 surface 穷举器若要用同样的 4-probe contract check 比较三个候选至少需要 12 次 candidate executions，即使不计 diagnostic 也超过 M=6，因此同一 ledger 下不可执行。
exact_mechanism.en: Prebuild one capacity-matched asset for each of the prompt, memory, and tool-constraint surfaces: A_prompt, A_memory, and A_tool, and determine their contract profiles offline on training targets. After freezing router r(z_model,C), the routing-only test forbids use of the transpiler and lets the router choose only among the three fixed asset labels. In the transpiler-only test, an independently determined oracle surface is supplied directly and the transpiler must emit an asset from the same contract C with the same capacity as the prebuilt asset for that surface. Only then is the composed router-to-transpiler system evaluated. For each new target, define a deployment ledger of M=6 target executions: the first two are fixed diagnostic probes producing z_model and the remaining four may only be used for contract checking of the selected surface. Every diagnostic, validation, fallback, and candidate execution counts toward M, and any additional target execution is a budget violation. An exhaustive three-surface procedure using the same four-probe contract check would require at least 12 candidate executions even before diagnostics, so it cannot fit within M=6.

children.update_surface: one persistently selected prompt, memory, or tool-constraint asset emitted from a shared typed contract

learning_signal.zh: router 仅用训练 backbone 上三个固定预构建资产的独立离线排序标签学习；transpiler 仅用 oracle-surface 条件下的 contract-to-asset 配对和该 surface 内的执行结果学习。两者参数、监督和验证日志分离，组合阶段不再学习。
learning_signal.en: The router learns only from independent offline rankings of the three fixed prebuilt assets on training backbones. The transpiler learns only from contract-to-asset pairs and execution outcomes conditioned on oracle surfaces. Their parameters, supervision, and validation logs are separated, and no learning occurs during composed evaluation.

independent_ground_truth.zh: oracle surface 由不向 router 或 transpiler 暴露的独立 adjudication suite 对三个预构建资产做完整评测得到；transpiler 资产质量由另一组隐藏任务比较其与同 surface 预构建资产的 required-effect、forbidden-effect 和 persistence-scope 满足率。部署 M ledger 与 adjudication suite 严格分账，后者只用于研究者计算 ground truth，不能被方法调用。
independent_ground_truth.en: The oracle surface is determined by an independent adjudication suite, hidden from both router and transpiler, that fully evaluates all three prebuilt assets. Transpiler quality is measured on a second hidden task set by comparing its emitted asset with the prebuilt asset on required effects, forbidden effects, and persistence scope. The deployment M ledger is strictly separated from the adjudication suite, which exists only to compute research ground truth and cannot be queried by the method.

simplest_baseline.zh: routing 子实验使用相同 2 个 diagnostics 的容量匹配三分类器以及预注册默认 surface；transpiler 子实验的最强简单基线就是该 oracle surface 上的固定预构建容量匹配资产。组合实验再加入只使用预注册默认 surface+其预构建资产的系统。任何 baseline 与 proposed system 都受相同 M=6 部署 ledger 约束。
simplest_baseline.en: For routing, use a capacity-matched three-way classifier from the same two diagnostics plus a preregistered default-surface rule. For transpilation, the strongest simple baseline is the fixed capacity-matched prebuilt asset on the oracle surface. The composed test additionally includes a system that always uses the preregistered default surface with its prebuilt asset. Every baseline and the proposed system obey the same M=6 deployment ledger.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在完全留出的 backbone swap 上依次做三个锁定实验。A：只替换 routing decision，三个 surface 的资产固定不变，比较 router 的 oracle-surface accuracy 和最终 contract success。B：直接给 oracle surface，比较 transpiler asset 与同 surface 的 prebuilt asset，要求在相同容量下不劣且在跨 backbone contract transfer 上有预注册优势。C：冻结 A/B 后组合，M=6 内完成 2 diagnostics+4 selected-surface checks，比较 oracle-assisted upper bound、默认 surface 和任何可在 M 内实现的搜索策略。若 A 或 B 单独失败，不允许用 C 的结果补救。
decisive_pilot.en: Run three locked experiments on fully held-out backbone swaps. A: vary only the routing decision while keeping all three surface assets fixed, measuring oracle-surface accuracy and downstream contract success. B: provide the oracle surface directly and compare the transpiler asset with the prebuilt within-surface asset, requiring non-inferiority at matched capacity and a preregistered advantage on cross-backbone contract transfer. C: freeze A and B, compose them, and operate within M=6 using two diagnostics plus four checks of the selected surface, comparing against an oracle-assisted upper bound, the default surface, and every search strategy feasible under M. Failure of A or B cannot be rescued by C.

stop_condition.zh: 若固定资产条件下 router 不优于容量匹配分类器/默认规则，或 oracle-surface 条件下 transpiler 不优于或明显劣于预构建 within-surface asset，则停止相应主张并不报告组合系统为机制成功；若任何部署调用未计入 M，预算主张同样作废。
stop_condition.en: Stop the corresponding claim if the router fails to beat the matched classifier/default rule with fixed assets, if the oracle-surface transpiler fails to match or improve on the prebuilt within-surface asset, or if any deployment target call is omitted from M. A composed score cannot be used to rescue a failed component.

material_change.zh: v5.2 把原先混合的 router-transpiler pilot 拆成两个可独立否证的机制实验，并首次给出封闭的 M=6 全调用 ledger，使“少于三 surface 穷举”成为真实预算约束而非文字描述。
material_change.en: v5.2 decomposes the previously confounded router-transpiler pilot into two independently falsifiable mechanism tests and introduces a closed M=6 all-call ledger that makes the impossibility of three-surface exhaustive evaluation an actual budget constraint rather than a verbal claim.

external_reviews.finding: The closed M=6 ledger and routing/transpilation decomposition materially repair the previous experimental confound, but they do not create a non-reducible learned mechanism. The frozen router is still specified only as a three-way mapping from the same diagnostics and contract available to the capacity-matched classifier, so the classifier can implement the same decision rule. The transpiler is then tested mainly against a fixed within-surface asset rather than an equally expressive generic conditional asset generator. Consequently the proposed system reduces to classifier-based surface selection plus conditional generation; the budget accounting makes that decomposition cheaper than exhaustive evaluation but does not make it a distinct persistent learning operator. The broader literature already treats prompts, memory, tools, and control logic as alternative self-improvement surfaces and separately studies cost-sensitive routing, reinforcing that routing itself is not the missing novelty. ([arXiv][1])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 封闭的 M=6 ledger 以及 routing/transpilation 解耦确实实质性修复了此前实验混杂，但仍未产生不可约的学习机制。冻结 router 仍只是从相同 diagnostics 与 contract 到三个 surface 的映射，因此容量匹配三分类器原则上可以实现同一决策规则。transpiler 又主要与固定 within-surface asset 比较，而不是与同等表达能力的通用条件资产生成器比较。因此整个方案仍可还原为“分类器选 surface + 条件生成”；预算记账只证明这种分解比穷举便宜，并没有形成新的 persistent learning operator。现有工作也已经把 prompt、memory、tool、control logic 视作不同自改进 surface，并单独研究 cost-sensitive routing，因此 routing 本身不足以支撑机制新颖性。 ([arXiv][1])
external_reviews.required_action: Do not repair this by adding another module. A revival must change the learned object itself: for example, a single budget-conditioned contract policy whose sequential probe allocation, stopping, surface choice, and emitted repair jointly alter the set of repairs reachable under M. Compare it against a capacity-matched generic policy given the same diagnostics, contract, action space, calls, and supervision. Alternatively, provide a formally restricted contract-routing algebra that yields decisions a generic three-way classifier with identical inputs cannot reproduce.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不要通过继续叠加模块修复。若未来复活，应直接改变 learned object，例如学习一个统一的 budget-conditioned contract policy，使 probe 分配、停止决策、surface 选择与 repair 生成共同改变 M 预算内可达的 repair 集合，并与拥有相同 diagnostics、contract、动作空间、调用预算和监督的容量匹配通用 policy 正面对照。另一条路径是定义真正受约束的 contract-routing algebra，并证明相同输入的通用三分类器无法复现其决策。

closest_work: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey — explicitly organizes persistent self-improvement across model/scaffold targets including prompts, memory, tools, and control logic. ([arXiv][1])

Did You Check the Right Pocket? Cost-Sensitive Store Routing for Memory-Augmented Agents — formulates learned routing under an accuracy/cost trade-off, albeit only among memory stores. ([OpenReview][2])
From Player to Master: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning over Memory — learns a persistent memory-update operator for a frozen agent. ([OpenReview][3])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: No searched official source exactly implements a prompt-versus-memory-versus-tool-constraint contract router followed by contract transpilation under a closed target-execution ledger. The problem combination survives, but the proposed learned operator remains reducible.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A single capacity-matched budget-conditioned conditional policy that receives z_model, C, the same two diagnostic results, and remaining ledger state and directly outputs either a surface-specific asset or abstention, with every call counted inside the same M=6 ledger.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: On held-out backbone swaps, compare the split router→transpiler system against the generic joint conditional policy under identical M=6 calls, training targets, parameter count, contract checks, and asset-capacity limits. The split mechanism is scientifically distinct only if its frozen structure gives a reproducible advantage not recoverable by the generic policy.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep this branch blocked if the generic joint policy matches the proposed system, if the router matches the three-way classifier, or if transpiler gains disappear against an equally trained conditional asset generator.
unknowns: No structural restriction on r(z_model,C) currently distinguishes it from ordinary multiclass prediction.
The current transpiler baseline does not establish whether contract-conditioned generation itself contributes anything beyond generic conditional generation.

title.zh: 留出版本生成算子的边际收益迁移

changed_assumption.zh: 核心问题不再是随机干预是否比观察式 curriculum 更“因果”，而是由一类模型版本生成过程上的随机微分配所学习的 next-unit gain 函数，能否冻结迁移到一种完整未参与拟合的版本生成算子。
changed_assumption.en: The central question is no longer whether randomized interventions are more 'causal' than observational curricula. It is whether a next-unit gain function learned from randomized micro-allocations under one set of model-version-generating processes can be frozen and transported to an entirely held-out version-generating operator.

exact_mechanism.zh: 预先定义多个 version-generating operators O，例如不同但固定的优化器/数据混合更新规则，每个 O 产生自己的 checkpoint stream v_1,...,v_T。训练只使用 O_train 中的随机微分配 tuple (phi(v_t),k,p_t,Delta_t)，其中 epsilon 探索概率和 micro-block 大小固定。学习 g_theta(phi(v),k) 预测下一单位收益及不确定性。评测时冻结 theta，切换到从未用于训练的 O_test；控制器不能利用 O_test 上已实现 micro-allocation 的 outcome 更新 theta，只根据当前版本表示给主要预算排序。Actor-Curator baseline 获得相同 epsilon 探索预算；direct contextual baseline 获得完全相同训练 tuples、phi(v)、k 和历史监督，直接回归/选择 next task，不使用 propensity correction 或显式 gain estimator。所有方法在 O_test 的冻结比较期间不在线更新。
exact_mechanism.en: Preregister multiple version-generating operators O, such as distinct fixed optimizer/data-mixture update rules, each producing a checkpoint stream v_1,...,v_T. Training uses only randomized micro-allocation tuples (phi(v_t),k,p_t,Delta_t) from O_train with fixed epsilon exploration probabilities and micro-block size. Learn g_theta(phi(v),k) to predict next-unit gain and uncertainty. At evaluation, freeze theta and switch to an O_test never used for fitting; outcomes of realized O_test micro-allocations may not update theta, and main-budget ranking uses only the current version representation. An Actor-Curator baseline gets the same epsilon exploration budget. A direct contextual baseline gets exactly the same training tuples, phi(v), k, and historical supervision and directly regresses/selects the next task without propensity correction or an explicit gain estimator. No method updates online during the frozen O_test comparison.

children.update_surface: persistent curriculum allocation policy induced by a frozen version-conditioned next-unit gain predictor

learning_signal.zh: 每个训练 operator 上随机 micro-block 前后的独立 validation delta、回归锚点变化、记录 propensity 和版本表示；所有比较器读取相同 tuple 集，不能从额外在线回报获得监督。
learning_signal.en: The signal consists of independent pre/post-micro-block validation deltas, regression-anchor changes, logged propensities, and version representations from each training operator. All compared methods consume the same tuple set and receive no extra online reward supervision.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 在 O_test 上，对预先抽样的一小部分 evaluation checkpoints 复制模型并对每个候选 task family 分别执行一个真实 micro-block，得到独立 next-unit validation gain oracle；这些 crossed interventions 仅用于事后评估，不反馈控制器。
independent_ground_truth.en: At preregistered evaluation checkpoints under O_test, clone the model and execute one real micro-block separately for each candidate task family to obtain an independent crossed-intervention oracle of next-unit validation gain. These interventions are evaluation-only and never fed back to the controller.

simplest_baseline.zh: 两个主基线：(1) Actor-Curator 式 policy-improvement bandit，具有完全相同的 epsilon 探索率、训练预算和回归锚点；(2) same-data direct contextual bandit/response model，使用完全相同随机微分配 tuples 和版本表示，以匹配容量直接预测收益或任务选择，不使用显式因果估计结构。
simplest_baseline.en: Two primary baselines: (1) an Actor-Curator-style policy-improvement bandit with identical epsilon exploration, training budget, and regression anchors; and (2) a same-data direct contextual bandit/response model with matched capacity, trained on the exact randomized micro-allocation tuples and version representations to predict gain or task choice directly without an explicit causal-estimation structure.

decisive_pilot.zh: 使用至少三个 version-generating operators，执行 leave-one-operator-out。对每个 held-out operator，在多个 rolling checkpoints 上测量预测 gain 与 crossed oracle 的 rank correlation、top-1 regret，以及固定总预算后的最终 validation improvement。方法必须在冻结状态下同时超过 Actor-Curator 和 direct contextual baseline，并且优势不能只来自一个 operator。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least three version-generating operators in leave-one-operator-out experiments. At multiple rolling checkpoints of each held-out operator, measure correlation with the crossed gain oracle, top-1 allocation regret, and final validation improvement under a fixed total budget. The frozen method must outperform both Actor-Curator and the direct contextual baseline, with gains not confined to a single operator.

stop_condition.zh: 若 direct contextual response model 使用同一 tuple 后达到统计等价，若 Actor-Curator 在同探索预算下不劣，或 g 仅能在训练见过的 version-generating operator 内有效而无法冻结迁移，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the direct contextual response model is statistically equivalent on the same tuples, if Actor-Curator is non-inferior under the same exploration budget, or if g works only within version-generating operators seen during training and fails frozen transport.

material_change.zh: 该修复把主要科学对象从一般性的“随机干预 curriculum”改成“跨完整留出版本生成算子的冻结 marginal-gain transport”，并用相同探索预算 bandit 与相同 tuple 的 direct response model 作为真正等价对照。
material_change.en: The repair changes the scientific object from a generic randomized-intervention curriculum to frozen marginal-gain transport across an entirely held-out version-generating operator, tested against both a same-exploration bandit and a same-tuple direct response model.

external_reviews.finding: The held-out version-generating operator and crossed evaluation oracle are substantially stronger evaluation design, but they do not create a scientifically distinct learned object. With randomized micro-allocation and adequate overlap, g_theta(phi(v),k) is a conditional response function for next-unit validation change. A direct contextual response regressor trained on the identical randomized tuples estimates the same prediction target. Propensity correction can change statistical efficiency or robustness, but it does not by itself create a different persistent operator. Holding out O_test tests transportability of that response function; it does not defeat the simplest equivalent direct estimator. The proposed method is therefore reducible under its own strongest baseline.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 完整留出 version-generating operator 和 crossed evaluation oracle 显著增强了实验设计，但并没有产生科学上不同的学习对象。在随机 micro-allocation 且具有足够 overlap 时，g_theta(phi(v),k) 本质上就是下一单位 validation change 的条件响应函数。使用完全相同随机 tuples 的 direct contextual response regressor 估计的是同一个预测对象。propensity correction 可以影响统计效率或稳健性，但本身不会创造不同的持久算子。留出 O_test 只是检验这个响应函数的可迁移性，并没有击败最简单的直接估计器，因此当前 proposed 在自己的最强基线下仍可约化。
external_reviews.required_action: Do not repair this by adding another estimator baseline. A future child would need to change the learned scientific object itself—for example, an identifiable operator-level transformation or counterfactual structure that cannot be represented as the same conditional next-unit response function. Otherwise recast the contribution as an evaluation protocol for curriculum transport rather than a new marginal-gain mechanism.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 不要仅通过再增加一个 estimator baseline 修复。下一版必须改变学习的科学对象本身，例如建立一个不能约化为相同 conditional next-unit response function 的可识别 operator-level transformation 或 counterfactual structure。否则应把贡献降为 curriculum transport 的评测协议，而不是新的 marginal-gain 机制。

closest_work: MATES learns model-aware data influence for data selection as the model evolves, making learned version-conditioned allocation an already occupied neighboring space. ([OpenReview][8])

Group-MATES learns relational data-influence models from training trajectories and uses them for subsequent data selection, again placing learned gain/influence-guided allocation close to the proposed mechanism. ([arXiv][7])
Transfer-Aware Curriculum formulates curriculum selection through bandit-style learning and transfer signals, providing a close policy-allocation baseline family. ([arXiv][9])
Self-Evolving Curriculum uses a nonstationary bandit over problem categories and model-training state, further reducing novelty of version-conditioned curriculum allocation itself. ([arXiv][10])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The unusual part is the leave-one-version-operator-out protocol with evaluation-only crossed micro-block interventions, but that is an evaluation distinction rather than a non-reducible learned mechanism.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: The stated same-data direct contextual response model estimating the conditional next-unit validation delta from exactly the same randomized tuples and version representation; it is already the simplest functional equivalent.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: No outcome-only pilot rescues the present mechanism claim. First demonstrate a formally or experimentally distinguishable target from conditional response regression under identical randomized data and function capacity. Cross-operator superiority alone is insufficient because both methods can learn the same mapping.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Block the current mechanism claim whenever g_theta and the direct contextual response model target the same conditional gain function under the randomized logging scheme; successful O_test transport does not change that equivalence.
unknowns: Whether propensity varies enough for weighting to matter beyond variance.
Whether phi(v) is sufficient for transport across operators.
Whether the proposed uncertainty estimate changes decisions in a way unavailable to a matched direct probabilistic regressor.

children.external_finding: The held-out version-generating operator and crossed evaluation oracle are substantially stronger evaluation design, but they do not create a scientifically distinct learned object. With randomized micro-allocation and adequate overlap, g_theta(phi(v),k) is a conditional response function for next-unit validation change. A direct contextual response regressor trained on the identical randomized tuples estimates the same prediction target. Propensity correction can change statistical efficiency or robustness, but it does not by itself create a different persistent operator. Holding out O_test tests transportability of that response function; it does not defeat the simplest equivalent direct estimator. The proposed method is therefore reducible under its own strongest baseline.
children.external_finding_zh: 完整留出 version-generating operator 和 crossed evaluation oracle 显著增强了实验设计，但并没有产生科学上不同的学习对象。在随机 micro-allocation 且具有足够 overlap 时，g_theta(phi(v),k) 本质上就是下一单位 validation change 的条件响应函数。使用完全相同随机 tuples 的 direct contextual response regressor 估计的是同一个预测对象。propensity correction 可以影响统计效率或稳健性，但本身不会创造不同的持久算子。留出 O_test 只是检验这个响应函数的可迁移性，并没有击败最简单的直接估计器，因此当前 proposed 在自己的最强基线下仍可约化。

Otherwise recast the contribution as an evaluation protocol for curriculum transport rather than a new marginal-gain mechanism.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把 locality、footprint supervision 和 preservation objective 本身视为多轮安全更新的充分条件。新的假设是：即使每一轮局部编辑单独满足这些约束，连续更新仍会因同一依赖闭包中的覆盖、撤销和顺序效应产生路径依赖；因此真正需要学习的是一个在版本化 typed edit 上定义的规范组合律，而不是更强的局部编辑器。
changed_assumption.en: Locality, footprint supervision, and preservation objectives are no longer assumed sufficient for safe multi-round updating. Even when every local edit individually satisfies them, successive edits can create path dependence through overwrite, cancellation, and ordering interactions inside a shared dependency closure. The additional learned object is therefore a canonical composition law over versioned typed edits, not a stronger local editor.

exact_mechanism.zh: 保留原有 typed edit atom、C_keep、footprint label、locality mask 和 residual selector，但把连续 residual 先映射为显式 effect tuple，包括目标键、旧值域、新值域、依赖版本和契约标签，再由一个冻结的 normalizer 学习局部组合表：可交换 edits 被规范排序，覆盖 edits 合并为单一 versioned transition，相互撤销 edits 消去，冲突 edits 根据训练中独立执行得到的组合结果选择合法 normal form。训练额外加入三元 composition supervision：对同一起始 U，比较 R3∘R2∘R1 的真实执行结果与逐步正规化后的单一 residual normal form。最关键的简化基线获得完全相同的 typed edits、C_keep、footprint labels、locality mask、参数量和 preservation loss，并使用同一个 residual predictor，但删除 composition normalizer 与 composition-consistency loss，只把各轮局部 residual 顺序应用。
exact_mechanism.en: Retain the typed edit atoms, C_keep contracts, footprint labels, locality mask, and residual selector, but map successive residuals to explicit effect tuples containing target key, old-value domain, new-value domain, dependency version, and contract tags. A frozen normalizer learns a local composition table: commuting edits are canonically ordered, overwrites collapse into one versioned transition, mutually cancelling edits are eliminated, and conflicting edits are resolved according to independently executed composition outcomes observed during training. Training adds ternary composition supervision by comparing the actual execution of R3 composed with R2 composed with R1 from the same initial U against a single residual normal form produced by iterative normalization. The decisive simplification baseline receives exactly the same typed edits, C_keep, footprint labels, locality mask, parameter count, and preservation loss and uses the same residual predictor, but removes only the composition normalizer and composition-consistency loss and sequentially applies the local residuals.

children.update_surface: frozen versioned typed-edit residual normalizer plus localized persistent residual edits

learning_signal.zh: 训练样本由同一初始更新上真实执行的单轮、双轮和三轮 residual 链产生。监督包括最终任务结果、C_keep 结果、逐原子 footprint、以及两种组合路径是否得到同一可观察行为的 composition-equivalence 标签；不使用测试链反馈更新参数。
learning_signal.en: Training examples come from actually executing one-, two-, and three-step residual chains from the same initial update. Supervision includes final task outcomes, C_keep outcomes, per-atom footprints, and composition-equivalence labels indicating whether alternative composition paths produce the same observable behavior. No feedback from test chains updates the parameters.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 组合正确性由未参与 residual 或 normalizer 训练的独立执行 harness 判定：重新构建每个最终持久资产，在隐藏任务上执行 repair regression、C_keep 和冲突依赖测试，并直接比较规范组合与真实逐轮应用后的最终状态和行为。
independent_ground_truth.en: Composition correctness is determined by an execution harness unused for residual or normalizer training. It rebuilds each final persistent asset, executes hidden repair-regression, C_keep, and conflicting-dependency tests, and directly compares the final state and behavior of the canonical composition with actual sequential application.

simplest_baseline.zh: Residual-Locality-No-Algebra：与提出方法共享 typed edit representation、训练链、C_keep、footprint supervision、locality mask、residual predictor architecture、参数预算和全部单轮损失；唯一删除的因素是 residual composition algebra、normalizer 及 composition-consistency supervision。
simplest_baseline.en: Residual-Locality-No-Algebra shares the typed edit representation, training chains, C_keep, footprint supervision, locality mask, residual-predictor architecture, parameter budget, and every single-round loss. The only removed factor is the residual-composition algebra, its normalizer, and composition-consistency supervision.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按依赖图模式完整留出一组 4–6 轮更新链，其中包含训练中出现过的原子 edit 类型但未出现过的覆盖、撤销、交换和共享依赖组合。冻结两种方法后，在完全相同的起始 U 和 failure sequence 上运行。主指标为最终链 repair success 且全部 C_keep 满足的比例，辅指标为不同等价分组路径得到相同最终行为的 composition invariance。只有 proposed algebra 相对 Residual-Locality-No-Algebra 在 held-out multi-round chains 上显著提高联合成功率，并且优势集中在真实非平凡组合而非单轮 case，才支持主张。
decisive_pilot.en: Completely hold out dependency-graph patterns forming 4–6-round update chains that use familiar atomic edit types but unseen combinations of overwrite, cancellation, commutation, and shared dependencies. Freeze both methods and run them from identical initial U values under identical failure sequences. The primary metric is the fraction of chains achieving the repair while satisfying every C_keep contract; a secondary metric is composition invariance across behaviorally equivalent regroupings. The claim survives only if the proposed algebra materially improves joint success over Residual-Locality-No-Algebra on held-out multi-round chains and the gain is concentrated in genuinely nontrivial compositions rather than single-round cases.

stop_condition.zh: 若 locality+preservation 基线在 held-out 多轮链上的联合 repair/C_keep 成功率与 proposed algebra 等价，或去掉 composition constraint 后性能不下降，则停止“残差代数带来额外价值”的主张；若 normal form 与真实逐轮执行经常不一致，也直接停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop the residual-algebra claim if the locality-plus-preservation baseline matches the proposed method on joint repair/C_keep success over held-out multi-round chains, if removing composition constraints causes no degradation, or if the predicted normal form frequently disagrees with actual sequential execution.

material_change.zh: v5.2 不再把强 locality 和 preservation 作为与普通局部修复器混杂的一揽子贡献，而把唯一待验证差异压缩为版本化 residual 的组合正规形，并构造除该代数外完全相同的强基线。
material_change.en: v5.2 removes locality and preservation as confounded sources of advantage and reduces the unique proposed contribution to a versioned residual-composition normal form, tested against a strong baseline identical in every respect except that algebra.

external_reviews.finding: The repair isolates composition algebra cleanly, but its decisive claim is internally incompatible with its independent truth. The normal form is required to reproduce the final state and observable behavior of actual sequential application, while the proposed pilot simultaneously requires it to materially improve final repair-plus-C_keep success over that same sequential application. If semantic equivalence holds, those final behavioral metrics cannot improve; if they improve by changing the result, the normal form fails its own equivalence criterion. Extra composition supervision also makes the proposed residual learner non-identical to the stated baseline. The current scientific claim is therefore not falsifiable in a coherent way.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该修复确实把 composition algebra 单独隔离出来了，但它的决定性主张与独立真值存在内部矛盾。normal form 被要求复现真实逐轮应用后的最终状态和可观察行为，而 pilot 又要求它相对同一个逐轮应用过程显著提高最终 repair+C_keep 成功率。如果语义等价成立，这些最终行为指标不可能提高；如果通过改变结果获得提高，又违反了自身的 equivalence criterion。此外，额外 composition supervision 也使 proposed residual learner 与声明的 baseline 不再完全相同。因此当前科学主张无法形成逻辑一致的可证伪实验。
external_reviews.required_action: Redefine the object around a property for which canonical composition can add value without being required to equal literal sequential execution—for example atomic conflict resolution, stale-version rebasing, intermediate side-effect avoidance, execution cost, or another independently measured transactional property. Then construct an identical sequential baseline and a ground truth for that new property. Merely adding more composition cases does not repair the current contradiction.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 重新定义一个允许 canonical composition 在不等同于字面逐轮执行时产生价值的科学对象，例如原子冲突解析、stale-version rebase、中间副作用规避、执行成本或其他独立可测的事务属性。随后再构造完全相同的 sequential baseline 与对应独立真值。仅增加更多 composition case 不能修复当前逻辑矛盾。

closest_work: A3E explicitly targets compositional model editing, so composability across edits is already an active neighboring problem rather than a new motivation by itself. ([OpenReview][11])

DeltaEdit addresses interference in sequential model editing, occupying the broader problem of accumulated edit interactions even though its mechanism is parameter-space editing rather than typed persistent assets. ([arXiv][12])
MEMOIR targets long sequences of edits while reducing interference, providing another close neighboring line on persistent sequential modification. ([arXiv][13])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: An executable canonical algebra over versioned typed persistent edits is structurally different from parameter-space sequential model editing, but the present evaluation cannot demonstrate behavioral benefit while simultaneously requiring equivalence to literal sequential execution.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Literal sequential application of the exact same predicted typed residuals from the same starting asset, with every residual predictor input, parameter, single-round objective, and test failure sequence matched.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: The current pilot should not be run as evidence for the stated claim because equivalence and behavioral improvement are mutually incompatible. A repaired pilot must first choose a distinct target such as conflict resolution, atomicity, intermediate safety, rebasing accuracy, or execution cost and independently measure that property.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Block unless the claimed benefit is redefined so that success does not require the normal form both to equal and outperform literal sequential execution on the same final behavioral criterion.
unknowns: Whether sequential edits have intermediate external side effects not represented in final-state equivalence.
Whether stale dependency versions can make canonical rebasing a genuinely different operation.
Whether composition-consistency supervision also changes the residual predictor rather than only the normalizer.

title.zh: 可认证张成空间外交互逆算子

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把 explicit interaction residual supervision 与 out-of-span projection 捆绑为单一机制。最终识别假设改为：在已经由 LP/Farkas certificate 独立证明 stored-delta span 无法同时满足 repair 与 preservation 的样本上，rollback-derived interaction evidence 与强制 span-exit 是两个可独立操纵的因素；只有严格 2×2 交叉实验仍显示不可替代的因素或二者交互，才能获得机制归因。
changed_assumption.en: Explicit interaction-residual supervision and out-of-span projection are no longer bundled into one mechanism. The final identification assumption is that, on cases independently certified by an LP/Farkas witness to be unsatisfiable inside the stored-delta span, rollback-derived interaction evidence and mandatory span exit are separately manipulable factors; mechanistic attribution is allowed only for the factor or interaction that remains necessary in a strict 2x2 crossed test.

exact_mechanism.zh: 冻结 representation 与低秩 linear decision adapter，并对每个 failure composition 使用同一组预注册 repair/preservation probes 求 stored-delta-span 可行性；仅保留带 LP dual/Farkas infeasibility certificate 的 cases。对每个 certified case 固定执行完全相同的 single、pairwise、full rollback，并由这些 execution records 计算唯一 deterministic interaction residual R。随后训练四个容量完全匹配的 generator：Target-OFF/Projection-OFF、Target-ON/Projection-OFF、Target-OFF/Projection-ON、Target-ON/Projection-ON。四个 cell 都获得相同 atom summaries、constraints、rollback records、R 及其所有允许的 deterministic statistics；Target-ON 仅额外启用以 R 为目标的预注册 interaction-direction auxiliary loss，Target-OFF 禁用该 loss，但仍可把 R 作为输入特征；Projection-ON 将生成方向通过 frozen Q_perp=I-P_span 投影到 stored-delta span 的正交补，Projection-OFF 直接输出同维 unconstrained direction。四个 cell 使用相同 adapter rank、generator 参数量、calls、tokens、optimizer、minibatches、optimization steps 和 wall-clock-equivalent update budget。Target-ON/Projection-OFF 同时作为 unrestricted residual-conditioned generator：它可直接消费 rollback-derived residual 并具有完整监督，但不被强制离开 span。2×2 factorial contrasts 与该 unrestricted control 在训练前写入 identification contract。
exact_mechanism.en: Freeze the representation and low-rank linear decision adapter, solve the same preregistered repair/preservation feasibility problem inside the stored-delta span for every failing composition, and retain only cases carrying an LP-dual/Farkas infeasibility certificate. For every certified case, execute exactly the same single, pairwise, and full rollbacks and deterministically compute one interaction residual R from those execution records. Train four capacity-matched generators: Target-OFF/Projection-OFF, Target-ON/Projection-OFF, Target-OFF/Projection-ON, and Target-ON/Projection-ON. Every cell receives identical atom summaries, constraints, rollback records, R, and all permitted deterministic statistics derived from them. Target-ON only activates a preregistered interaction-direction auxiliary loss whose target is R; Target-OFF disables that loss while remaining free to consume R as an input feature. Projection-ON maps the generated direction through the frozen operator Q_perp=I-P_span, while Projection-OFF emits an unconstrained direction of the same dimensionality. All four cells have identical adapter rank, generator parameter count, calls, tokens, optimizer, minibatches, optimization steps, and wall-clock-equivalent update budget. Target-ON/Projection-OFF is also the unrestricted residual-conditioned generator: it may directly consume the rollback residual and receives the full supervision but is not forced outside the span. The 2x2 factorial contrasts and this unrestricted control are part of the preregistered identification contract.

children.update_surface: frozen-representation low-rank linear decision adapter

learning_signal.zh: 所有条件共享完全相同的 certified training cases、rollback executions、interaction residual R、repair/preservation constraints 与 hidden-case sampling。唯一预注册监督操纵是是否对同一个 R 启用 explicit interaction-direction loss；关闭该 loss 不删除 R、rollback trace 或任何可确定计算的 residual statistic，因此不存在信息剥夺式 baseline。
learning_signal.en: All conditions share exactly the same certified training cases, rollback executions, interaction residual R, repair/preservation constraints, and hidden-case sampling. The only preregistered supervision intervention is whether the explicit interaction-direction loss against the same R is activated; disabling that loss does not remove R, rollback traces, or any deterministically computable residual statistic, eliminating information-deprived baselines.

independent_ground_truth.zh: certificate 只由冻结 adapter 参数空间中的线性 repair/preservation inequalities 产生；最终正确性由未用于 certificate、residual target 或训练的隐藏 execution tests 判定，包括目标行为恢复、保持行为不退化以及组合任务真实成功。certificate 与 truth 因而相互独立。
independent_ground_truth.en: The certificate is derived only from linear repair/preservation inequalities in the frozen adapter parameter space. Final correctness is determined by hidden execution tests never used for the certificate, residual target, or training, including target-behavior recovery, preservation of protected behavior, and true compositional task success. Certificate and truth are therefore independent.

simplest_baseline.zh: 最强简化方法是 Target-ON/Projection-OFF 的容量匹配 unrestricted conditional generator：它获得与 proposed cell 完全相同的 certified cases、atom summaries、constraints、single/pair/full rollbacks、interaction residual R、explicit residual-target supervision、adapter rank、参数量、calls、tokens、optimizer 和训练步数，但可以自由产生任意低秩 adapter patch，不执行 orthogonal-complement projection。另两个 crossed cells 分别检验 residual-target-only 与 projection-only 解释。
simplest_baseline.en: The strongest simplification is the capacity-matched Target-ON/Projection-OFF unrestricted conditional generator. It receives exactly the same certified cases, atom summaries, constraints, single/pair/full rollbacks, interaction residual R, explicit residual-target supervision, adapter rank, parameter count, calls, tokens, optimizer, and training steps as the proposed cell, but may emit any low-rank adapter patch without orthogonal-complement projection. The other crossed cells separately test residual-target-only and projection-only explanations.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在模型训练前冻结 certified-case list、2×2 design、hidden execution set 与 factorial contrasts。首先只在 Farkas-certified held-out compositions 上比较四个 cells，并报告 Target 主效应、Projection 主效应及交互；同时直接比较完整 Target-ON/Projection-ON 与 unrestricted Target-ON/Projection-OFF。若只有 projection contrast 在 residual supervision 等价时仍成立，则主张限定为 certified span-exit；若只有 target contrast 成立，则主张限定为 interaction supervision；若只有交互显著且两个单因素均不能复现，则只主张二者交互。所有归因必须同时在独立 hidden execution truth 上成立。
decisive_pilot.en: Before training, freeze the certified-case list, 2x2 design, hidden execution set, and factorial contrasts. Evaluate all four cells only on Farkas-certified held-out compositions, reporting the Target main effect, Projection main effect, and their interaction, while directly comparing full Target-ON/Projection-ON against unrestricted Target-ON/Projection-OFF. If only the projection contrast survives under equal residual supervision, the claim is restricted to certified span exit; if only the target contrast survives, it is restricted to interaction supervision; if only the interaction survives and neither single factor reproduces it, only the interaction is claimed. Every attribution must also hold on independent hidden execution truth.

stop_condition.zh: 若 unrestricted residual-conditioned generator 在 independently certified held-out cases 上复现完整方法，停止 out-of-span 机制主张；若 Target-OFF/Projection-ON 复现完整方法，停止 explicit interaction-target 主张；若 Target-ON/Projection-OFF 复现完整方法，停止 projection 主张；若四个条件均不能在 hidden execution truth 上稳定优于最简单等价方法，则终止该 idea，而不通过重新命名或增加组件继续修补。
stop_condition.en: If the unrestricted residual-conditioned generator reproduces the full method on independently certified held-out cases, stop the out-of-span mechanism claim. If Target-OFF/Projection-ON reproduces the full method, stop the explicit interaction-target claim; if Target-ON/Projection-OFF reproduces it, stop the projection claim. If no factorially isolated component or interaction yields a stable advantage on hidden execution truth over the simplest equivalent method, terminate the idea rather than adding or renaming components.

material_change.zh: v5.3 的实质变化不是增加新模块，而是把先前捆绑且 supervision 不等价的 comparison 改成数据、rollback、residual statistics、capacity 与 budget 全部等价的预注册 2×2 因果识别设计，并加入可直接消费 residual 的 unrestricted generator。因此最终新颖性只能落在被 factorial test 真正证明不可替代的 certified span-exit、interaction supervision 或二者交互上。
material_change.en: The material v5.3 change is not an added component but replacement of the previously bundled and supervision-unequal comparison with a preregistered 2x2 causal identification design equalized for data, rollbacks, residual statistics, capacity, and budget, plus an unrestricted generator that can directly consume the residual. Novelty can therefore be attributed only to certified span exit, interaction supervision, or their interaction if the factorial test shows that element to be indispensable.

external_reviews.finding: v5.3 closes the stated final boundary. The proposed cell and the strongest unrestricted residual-conditioned generator now receive identical certified cases, rollback executions, interaction residual R, deterministic residual statistics, explicit residual-target supervision, adapter capacity, calls, tokens, optimizer, and optimization budget. The preregistered 2×2 Target × Projection experiment separately identifies interaction-target supervision, mandatory span exit, or their interaction, while Target-ON/Projection-OFF is a genuine unrestricted equal-information control. Independent LP/Farkas infeasibility certificates determine where a within-span solution is impossible, while correctness is scored by separate hidden executions. Related orthogonal/null-space editing and model-merging methods establish substantial component-level prior art, but the official-source search did not locate the combined certificate-plus-crossed-identification mechanism. ([OpenReview][1])
