title.zh: 编译器残差式契约编辑器

changed_assumption.zh: 残差编辑器的优势必须在 monolithic rewriter 获得完全相同的 residualized training examples、target traces、残差标注、成功/失败监督、verifier access、计算量与参数预算后仍存在；因此唯一允许保留的机制差异是输出对象被限制为 compiler 后 schema-underdetermined relational residual，而不是训练数据或监督更强。
changed_assumption.en: Any advantage of the residual editor must survive after the monolithic rewriter receives exactly the same residualized training examples, target traces, residual annotations, success/failure supervision, verifier access, compute, and parameter budget. The only permitted mechanistic difference is therefore the output object: post-compiler schema-underdetermined relational residuals versus an unrestricted complete target asset.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对每个 source/target schema pair 先运行共享 deterministic compiler C_schema 得到 M0。训练集固定为同一组 source-target asset pairs；对每一 pair 同时保存 source asset、target asset、M0、target execution traces、checker outcomes、成功/失败 labels，以及由 M0 与 target asset 按固定 canonical differencer 得到的 residual edit annotation delta_R。typed residual editor 只能生成白名单 dependency-edge、semantic-predicate 与 temporal-relation edits，并输出 Apply(M0,delta_R_hat)。容量匹配 monolithic rewriter 在训练时逐例获得完全相同的 source asset、target asset、M0、delta_R annotation、target traces、checker outcomes 和 labels，具有同维 matched auxiliary residual head 以消费同一 residual supervision，但主输出可自由生成完整 target asset；auxiliary head 在推理时丢弃。两者使用完全相同的 train/validation examples、calls、tokens、batch schedule、optimization steps、parameter budget、verifier V 和 checker-guided repair/rejection attempts。任何因完整输出序列更长造成的 token 差额通过预注册 padding/masked decoding budget 对齐，而不允许 residual editor 获得更多有效优化。
exact_mechanism.en: For every source/target schema pair, first run the shared deterministic compiler C_schema to obtain M0. Freeze one common training set of source-target asset pairs. For every pair, store the source asset, target asset, M0, target execution traces, checker outcomes, success/failure labels, and a residual-edit annotation delta_R produced from M0 and the target asset by a fixed canonical differencer. The typed residual editor may emit only whitelisted dependency-edge, semantic-predicate, and temporal-relation edits and returns Apply(M0, delta_R_hat). During training, the capacity-matched monolithic rewriter receives, example by example, the identical source asset, target asset, M0, delta_R annotation, target traces, checker outcomes, and labels, and contains an equally sized auxiliary residual head so that it consumes the same residual supervision while its primary output remains an unrestricted complete target asset; the auxiliary head is discarded at inference. Both methods use exactly the same train/validation examples, calls, tokens, batch schedule, optimization steps, parameter budget, verifier V, and checker-guided repair/rejection attempts. Any output-length token difference is equalized by a preregistered padded/masked decoding budget rather than granting the residual editor more effective optimization.

children.update_surface: persistent migrated memory-contract asset after deterministic schema compilation

learning_signal.zh: 两个模型逐样本共享相同 source-target pair、canonical delta_R、target execution traces、V 的 success/failure outcomes 与 checker feedback；训练次数、有效 token、梯度步数和参数规模严格对齐。delta_R 不再是 residual editor 独占的监督来源。
learning_signal.en: Both models share, example by example, the same source-target pair, canonical delta_R, target execution traces, verifier success/failure outcomes, and checker feedback, with strictly matched effective tokens, gradient steps, calls, and parameter count. Delta_R is no longer supervision available only to the residual editor.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 最终 truth 来自训练与 subset 构造均不可见的 hidden target executions、隐藏 relational assertions、handoff/temporal invariants 以及 joint model-and-harness swap 后的真实任务完成；训练时的 target traces、delta_R 和 verifier V 不包含这些 hidden assertions。
independent_ground_truth.en: Final truth comes from hidden target executions, hidden relational assertions, handoff/temporal invariants, and true task completion under joint model-and-harness swaps that are unavailable during training and subset construction. Training target traces, delta_R annotations, and verifier V do not contain these hidden assertions.

simplest_baseline.zh: checker-equalized、capacity-matched monolithic rewriter：使用与 residual editor 完全相同的 source-target asset pairs、M0、canonical residual annotations、target traces、success/failure labels、schemas、V、repair attempts、calls、tokens、参数量和 optimization steps，但允许直接输出任意完整 target asset，而不受 residual whitelist 或 Apply(M0,·) 分解限制。
simplest_baseline.en: A checker-equalized, capacity-matched monolithic rewriter trained on exactly the same source-target asset pairs, M0 values, canonical residual annotations, target traces, success/failure labels, schemas, verifier V, repair attempts, calls, tokens, parameter count, and optimization steps as the residual editor, while remaining free to emit any complete target asset without the residual whitelist or Apply(M0,·) decomposition.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在查看任何模型比较结果之前，使用 deterministic compiler 与 gold target asset 预注册 residual-required subset：M0 必须已经通过 schema/type/reference checker，但相对于 gold target 的 canonical diff 至少包含一个白名单 relational residual，且该 residual 对预注册 target execution assertion 是必要的；subset membership 完全由 compiler、gold asset 与预定义 assertion procedure 决定，与任一 learned model 输出无关。随后在相同 residual-required held-out cases 上比较 residual editor 与 monolithic rewriter，并额外执行 joint unseen-model × unseen-harness swap。主结论只取 hidden execution success、关系正确率与 preservation failure；完整 held-out set 同时作为防止 subset-only overfitting 的次级报告。
decisive_pilot.en: Before inspecting any model-comparison result, preregister the residual-required subset using only the deterministic compiler and gold target assets: M0 must already pass the schema/type/reference checker, its canonical difference from the gold target must contain at least one whitelisted relational residual, and that residual must be necessary for a preregistered target-execution assertion. Subset membership is therefore determined entirely by the compiler, gold asset, and predefined assertion procedure, never by either learned model's output. Compare the residual editor and monolithic rewriter on the identical held-out residual-required cases and additionally perform a joint unseen-model x unseen-harness swap. Primary outcomes are hidden execution success, relational correctness, and preservation failure; the complete held-out set is reported secondarily to prevent subset-only overfitting.

stop_condition.zh: 若在预注册 residual-required subset 上，获得完全相同数据、delta_R supervision、target traces、verifier、calls、tokens、optimization steps 和参数预算的 monolithic rewriter 匹配 residual editor 的 hidden execution 与 swap transfer，则停止“post-compiler residual object 带来额外迁移优势”的主张。若优势只出现在未预注册或由模型结果选择的 subset，也停止该主张。
stop_condition.en: If the monolithic rewriter, after receiving identical data, delta_R supervision, target traces, verifier access, calls, tokens, optimization steps, and parameter budget, matches the residual editor on hidden execution and swap transfer within the preregistered residual-required subset, stop the claim that the post-compiler residual object adds transfer value. Also stop the claim if the advantage appears only on a subset selected after observing model results.

material_change.zh: v5.3 明确消除了最后的数据/监督不等价：monolithic control 现在逐样本获得 residual editor 的全部 residualized pairs、target traces 和 residual supervision，并在 calls、tokens、优化与参数上完全匹配；同时 residual-required subset 在模型比较前由 deterministic procedure 冻结。因此剩余差异仅是 learned output surface 的 factorization。
material_change.en: v5.3 removes the final data/supervision inequivalence: the monolithic control now receives, example by example, all residualized pairs, target traces, and residual supervision available to the residual editor, with fully matched calls, tokens, optimization, and parameters. The residual-required subset is also frozen by a deterministic procedure before model comparison. The only remaining difference is factorization of the learned output surface.

external_reviews.finding: v5.3 removes the remaining supervision and data asymmetry. The monolithic rewriter now receives, example by example, the same source-target pairs, compiler output M0, canonical residual annotation delta_R, target traces, checker outcomes, success/failure labels, verifier access, repair attempts, effective token budget, parameters, calls, and optimization steps, including a matched residual head that consumes the same residual supervision. The residual-required subset is frozen before model comparison by a deterministic compiler/gold-asset procedure rather than by learned-model outcomes, and final truth is hidden from both training and subset construction. Prior work already supports local/structural program editing instead of wholesale regeneration, so edit-versus-rewrite alone is not novel; the surviving testable difference is the post-compiler schema-underdetermined relational output surface under an equal-information monolithic control. ([NeurIPS Proceedings][4])
external_reviews.finding_zh: v5.3 已消除最后的数据与监督不等价。monolithic rewriter 现在逐样本获得与 residual editor 完全相同的 source-target pairs、compiler 输出 M0、canonical residual annotation delta_R、target traces、checker outcomes、success/failure labels、verifier access、repair attempts、有效 token 预算、参数量、calls 和 optimization steps，并通过 matched residual head 消费完全相同的 residual supervision。residual-required subset 在任何模型比较前由 deterministic compiler/gold-asset procedure 冻结，而不是依据模型结果筛选；最终 truth 同时独立于训练和 subset construction。已有工作已经证明 local/structural program editing 相对整段重生成具有价值，因此简单的 edit-versus-rewrite 并不新；本方案剩余可检验贡献是，在信息完全等价的 monolithic control 下，将 learned output surface 限定为 compiler 后 schema-underdetermined relational residual 是否仍带来迁移优势。 ([NeurIPS Proceedings][4])
external_reviews.required_action: None for the stated final boundary. Keep the canonical differencer, residual-required subset definition, matched auxiliary residual head, verifier/repair budget equality, and output-length budget normalization frozen before observing comparative results. Do not generalize the claim beyond the post-compiler relational-residual factorization if the monolithic control closes the gap.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 针对上一轮最后边界无需继续修补。必须在查看比较结果前冻结 canonical differencer、residual-required subset 定义、matched auxiliary residual head、verifier/repair budget 等价条件以及输出长度预算归一化。若 monolithic control 消除差距，则不得把结论扩展到 post-compiler relational-residual factorization 之外。

SCALPEL: Reinforcement Learning for Surgical Program Edits trains structured, localized program edits and therefore makes generic edit sparsity/locality an insufficient novelty claim. ([OpenReview][6])

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched unrestricted monolithic target-asset rewriter receiving exactly the same source asset, target asset during training, M0, canonical delta_R annotation, target execution traces, checker outcomes, success/failure labels, schemas, verifier V, checker-guided attempts, calls, effective tokens, parameter count, batch schedule, and optimization steps, with an equally sized auxiliary residual head trained on delta_R but discarded at inference.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Before model comparison, construct the residual-required held-out subset solely from C_schema, gold target assets, the canonical differencer, and preregistered execution assertions. Compare the typed residual editor with the equal-information monolithic rewriter on identical cases and under a joint unseen-model × unseen-harness swap. Primary endpoints are hidden execution success, hidden relational correctness, and preservation failures, with the complete held-out set also reported.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the post-compiler residual-object claim if the equal-information monolithic rewriter matches hidden execution and joint swap transfer on the preregistered residual-required subset, or if the apparent advantage exists only on a post hoc/model-selected subset.
unknowns: Whether the canonical differencer yields a sufficiently unique and semantically faithful delta_R rather than one arbitrary representation among many equivalent edits.
Whether the residual whitelist covers enough real migration failures for the claimed scope to be consequential.

title.zh: 滤波式纵向评价器状态外推

changed_assumption.zh: chronological-state 主张不能由仍含 absolute timestamp 的简单顺序 shuffle 来识别。最终假设要求：只有在一个保持 fingerprint 与 interval 各自边际分布、但通过预注册重新配对真正破坏二者时间对应关系且不给出任何可恢复 absolute time/version ID 的 falsifier 下性能下降，并且 inference-time transition-prior ablation 也造成独立下降，才能把优势归因于冻结 transition structure。
changed_assumption.en: The chronological-state claim cannot be identified by a simple sequence shuffle that still exposes absolute timestamps. The final assumption requires performance to degrade under a preregistered falsifier that preserves the marginal fingerprint and interval distributions while truly destroying their temporal correspondence and exposing no recoverable absolute time or version ID, and also requires an independent degradation when the transition prior is ablated at inference without retraining.

exact_mechanism.zh: 主模型保持 z_t^-=T_theta(z_{t-1},Delta t_t)，z_t=z_t^-+K_phi(z_t^-,o_t)(o_t-H_psi(z_t^-))，r_hat(a,t)=C_omega(d_a,z_t)，所有参数仅在历史 evaluator 上训练后冻结。为避免 falsifier 泄漏，主比较与 corruption test 统一不输入 absolute timestamps 或可排序的 version IDs，只输入 ordered fingerprints 与相邻 transition intervals Delta t。对每个 rolling-origin evaluation window，在模型比较前固定一个 seed 与 derangement pi，将历史 fingerprint o_i 与另一 chronological slot 的 Delta t_pi(i) 重新配对，保持 fingerprint multiset 与 interval multiset 完全不变，同时破坏其真实对应关系；当前 unseen evaluator fingerprint 保持不变。state model 与 capacity-matched direct-history predictor 接收完全相同的 clean 或 corrupted sequences。另加无需 retraining 的 transition-prior intervention：在冻结参数下将每一步 z_t^-=T_theta(z_{t-1},Delta t_t) 替换为 z_t^-=z_{t-1}，其余 observation update 与 correction head 完全不变。
exact_mechanism.en: Keep the state model z_t^-=T_theta(z_{t-1},Delta t_t), z_t=z_t^-+K_phi(z_t^-,o_t)(o_t-H_psi(z_t^-)), and r_hat(a,t)=C_omega(d_a,z_t), with all parameters trained only on historical evaluators and then frozen. To prevent falsifier leakage, neither the primary comparison nor the corruption test exposes absolute timestamps or sortable version IDs; models receive only ordered fingerprints and adjacent transition intervals Delta t. For each rolling-origin evaluation window, freeze a seed and derangement pi before model comparison, re-pair each historical fingerprint o_i with the transition interval from another chronological slot Delta t_pi(i), preserving the fingerprint multiset and interval multiset exactly while destroying their true correspondence; the current unseen-evaluator fingerprint remains fixed. The state model and capacity-matched direct-history predictor receive exactly the same clean or corrupted sequences. Add a no-retraining transition-prior intervention by replacing z_t^-=T_theta(z_{t-1},Delta t_t) with z_t^-=z_{t-1} at inference while leaving the observation update and correction head unchanged.

children.update_surface: frozen longitudinal evaluator-state transition, observation filter, and actor-specific correction head

learning_signal.zh: state model 与 direct-history baseline 使用完全相同的历史 actor×evaluator residual supervision、fingerprints、transition intervals、actor descriptors、training windows、calls、tokens 和 optimization budget；future evaluator 不提供任何人工或任务标签。corruption 与 transition-prior ablation 均只发生在冻结模型的 evaluation path 中。
learning_signal.en: The state model and direct-history baseline use exactly the same historical actor-by-evaluator residual supervision, fingerprints, transition intervals, actor descriptors, training windows, calls, tokens, and optimization budget. No human or task label from a future evaluator is available. Both the correspondence corruption and transition-prior ablation operate only on the evaluation path of frozen models.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 每个 future evaluator 的 actor-specific bias truth 由完全留出的 actor×evaluator judgments 与任务结果计算，仅在最终 scoring 时揭示；这些 labels 不参与 fingerprint、T/K/H/C、direct predictor、permutation seed 或 corruption construction。
independent_ground_truth.en: Actor-specific bias truth for each future evaluator is computed from fully held-out actor-by-evaluator judgments and task outcomes revealed only for final scoring. These labels are never used by the fingerprints, T/K/H/C modules, direct predictor, permutation seed, or corruption construction.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量与计算匹配的 history-aware direct residual predictor D，获得与 state model 完全相同的 ordered historical fingerprints、current fingerprint、transition intervals、actor descriptors、historical residual labels、calls 和 inference tokens，并在 falsifier 中接受完全相同的 fingerprint-interval derangement；另保留 current-fingerprint-only 与 last-version predictor 作为弱 controls。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity- and compute-matched history-aware direct residual predictor D receiving exactly the same ordered historical fingerprints, current fingerprint, transition intervals, actor descriptors, historical residual labels, calls, and inference tokens as the state model, and receiving the identical fingerprint-interval derangement in the falsifier. Current-fingerprint-only and last-version predictors remain as weaker controls.

decisive_pilot.zh: 预注册三路 rolling-origin test：Clean、Correspondence-Destroyed、Transition-Prior-Ablated。Correspondence-Destroyed 使用固定 derangement，把 fingerprint 与 Delta t 重新配对且彻底删除 absolute timestamp/version identity；同一个 corrupted input 同时送给 state 与 direct-history baseline。识别要求不是简单看到 corruption 后性能变差，而是 clean state model 在 zero-anchor future evaluators 上优于 direct-history baseline，且 state model 的优势在 correspondence destruction 后显著收缩，同时 inference-only 去掉 T_theta prior 也使其 actor-specific residual correction 恶化。若 direct baseline 对同一 corruption 同幅下降，则不能把该变化单独归因于 latent transition。
decisive_pilot.en: Preregister three rolling-origin tests: Clean, Correspondence-Destroyed, and Transition-Prior-Ablated. Correspondence-Destroyed uses the frozen derangement to re-pair fingerprints and Delta t values while removing all absolute timestamps and version identities; the identical corrupted input is supplied to both the state model and direct-history baseline. Identification requires more than a generic corruption drop: the clean state model must outperform the direct-history baseline on zero-anchor future evaluators, that state-model advantage must contract when temporal correspondence is destroyed, and independently removing the T_theta prior only at inference must worsen actor-specific residual correction. If the direct baseline degrades by the same amount under the identical corruption, that drop alone is not attributed to the latent transition.

stop_condition.zh: 若删除所有可恢复时间标识并真正破坏 fingerprint-interval correspondence 后，state model 仍无变化；或 inference-only transition-prior ablation 不降低性能；或 clean state model 在容量/计算匹配 direct-history predictor 上没有稳定优势，则停止“chronological latent transition 是必要机制”的主张。若 corruption 对两种模型产生相同退化而无 state-specific interaction，也不得用该 falsifier 支持主张。
stop_condition.en: Stop the claim that the chronological latent transition is necessary if the state model is unchanged after all recoverable time identifiers are removed and fingerprint-interval correspondence is genuinely destroyed, if inference-only transition-prior ablation does not reduce performance, or if the clean state model has no stable advantage over the capacity/compute-matched direct-history predictor. A corruption that degrades both models equally without a state-specific interaction also cannot support the mechanism claim.

material_change.zh: v5.3 将原先可从 timestamp 恢复 chronology 的 permutation 替换为无 absolute-time 泄漏、保持双方边际但破坏真实 fingerprint-time correspondence 的预注册 falsifier，并对 state 与 direct baseline 使用完全同一 corruption；同时增加冻结模型上的 inference-only transition-prior ablation。因而 chronology 与 transition prior 现在具有可单独证伪的识别路径。
material_change.en: v5.3 replaces the timestamp-recoverable permutation with a preregistered falsifier that exposes no absolute-time leakage, preserves both marginals, and destroys true fingerprint-time correspondence, using exactly the same corruption for the state and direct baselines. It also adds an inference-only transition-prior ablation on the frozen model. Chronology and the transition prior therefore obtain independently falsifiable identification paths.

external_reviews.finding: v5.3 materially repairs the chronology-identification flaw. Absolute timestamps and sortable version IDs are removed, the falsifier preserves the fingerprint and interval marginals while destroying their original correspondence, and exactly the same corrupted history is supplied to the state model and the capacity-matched direct-history predictor. More importantly, chronology evidence is no longer based on corruption alone: the frozen state model must first beat the strongest direct-history predictor on zero-anchor future evaluators, its relative advantage must contract under the correspondence falsifier, and an independent inference-only removal of T_theta must also hurt. Held-out future actor×evaluator outcomes provide independent truth. The searched evaluator literature studies judge reliability, shortcut/recency bias, and temporal benchmark aging, but did not expose a direct collision with frozen latent evaluator-state extrapolation to unseen evaluator versions. One residual risk is that deranged interval/fingerprint pairs may constitute architecture-sensitive OOD rather than a pure chronology intervention; the independent T_theta ablation makes this a pilot interpretation issue rather than a remaining design boundary. ([ACL Anthology][7])
external_reviews.finding_zh: v5.3 已实质修复 chronology identification 的问题。absolute timestamps 与可排序 version IDs 被删除；falsifier 在保持 fingerprint 和 interval 各自边际分布不变的同时破坏原始对应关系，并将完全相同的 corrupted history 输入 state model 与容量匹配的 direct-history predictor。更关键的是，机制证据不再只依赖 corruption：冻结 state model 必须先在 zero-anchor future evaluators 上稳定优于最强 direct-history predictor，其相对优势在 correspondence falsifier 下必须收缩，同时 inference-only 移除 T_theta 还必须独立造成性能下降。完全留出的 future actor×evaluator outcomes 提供独立 truth。检索到的 evaluator 文献涉及 judge reliability、shortcut/recency bias 与 benchmark temporal aging，但没有发现与“对未见 evaluator version 进行冻结 latent-state 外推”直接重合的方法。剩余风险是 deranged interval/fingerprint pair 可能形成 architecture-sensitive OOD，而非纯粹的 chronology intervention；由于还有独立的 T_theta inference ablation，这更属于 pilot 解释风险，而不是尚未修复的设计边界。 ([ACL Anthology][7])
external_reviews.required_action: None for the final-boundary audit. Keep the no-time-ID interface and frozen derangement preregistered, report the state-versus-direct interaction under the identical corruption rather than raw corruption drops, and require the independent inference-only T_theta ablation to agree before making a transition-structure claim.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 本轮最终边界审计无需继续修补。保持 no-time-ID 输入接口与 frozen derangement 的预注册；必须报告相同 corruption 下 state-versus-direct 的 interaction，而不能仅报告 raw corruption drop；只有独立的 inference-only T_theta ablation 同方向成立时，才可主张 transition structure。

closest_work: Learning to Judge: LLMs Designing and Applying Evaluation Rubrics studies learned LLM evaluation and explicitly frames temporal evaluator drift/adaptation as outside its static treatment rather than providing a longitudinal-state mechanism. ([ACL Anthology][7])

The Silent Judge documents shortcut biases including provenance/recency effects in LLM judges, but does not learn a frozen transition state that extrapolates actor-specific bias to future judge versions. ([arXiv][8])
When Benchmarks Age studies temporal misalignment and benchmark aging, not state-space forecasting of changing evaluator behavior. ([ACL Anthology][9])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The distinctive mechanism is a frozen longitudinal evaluator-state transition/filter used for zero-anchor future-version residual prediction, coupled to a correspondence-destroying falsifier and a separate inference-only transition-prior intervention.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity- and compute-matched history-aware direct residual predictor D receiving the same ordered historical fingerprints, current unseen-evaluator fingerprint, transition intervals, actor descriptors, historical actor×evaluator residual labels, training windows, calls, and inference tokens, and receiving the identical fingerprint-interval derangement during the falsifier.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Preregister rolling-origin Clean, Correspondence-Destroyed, and Transition-Prior-Ablated tests. Require clean state-model superiority over D on zero-anchor future evaluators; require that superiority, not merely absolute performance, to contract under the identical correspondence destruction; and require inference-only replacement of T_theta with identity propagation to independently worsen actor-specific correction. Score only against fully held-out future evaluator judgments and task outcomes.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the chronological-transition claim if the clean frozen state model fails to beat the matched direct-history predictor, if removing recoverable time identifiers and destroying fingerprint-interval correspondence leaves its relative advantage unchanged, if inference-only T_theta ablation does not hurt, or if corruption causes only an equal generic degradation in both architectures.
unknowns: Whether the deranged fingerprint-interval combinations remain sufficiently in-distribution to support a clean causal interpretation.
Whether evaluator fingerprints remain stable and nonleaky across future model/API releases.
Whether enough genuinely zero-anchor evaluator transitions exist for a powered rolling-origin test.

title.zh: 冻结式可组合角色契约子句库

changed_assumption.zh: 关系级 PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM factorization 不能再仅与 whole-task FSM generator 比较。最终假设改为：即使一个最接近的 modular baseline 也从完全相同 traces 中获得可跨任务复用的 executable motif programs，并具有同等 applicability、transition/effect、termination、typed I/O/handoff metadata、router、composer、executor、容量和零 target update，进一步把契约拆成独立 relation clauses 仍能提高 held-out recompositional transfer，才说明 clause factorization 本身有贡献。
changed_assumption.en: Relation-level PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM factorization can no longer be compared only with a whole-task FSM generator. The final assumption is that clause factorization contributes only if it improves held-out recompositional transfer even against the closest modular baseline, which learns reusable executable motif programs from the identical traces and receives equal applicability, transition/effect, termination, typed I/O/handoff metadata, router, composer, executor, capacity, and zero target updates.

exact_mechanism.zh: proposed path 保持原 frozen clause library：只有在至少两个训练任务族以相同 semantic interface 重复出现的 PRE、TRANS、HANDOFF、TERM relation 才获得 versioned clause ID 并进入冻结库；test-time motif router 只能选择训练期 motif，deterministic schema matching 只能组合已冻结 clauses，禁止生成新 clause/state/transition。新增 closest modular control 从完全相同的训练 traces 与 schemas 中学习或抽取 frozen executable motif programs；每个 program 显式携带 applicability/precondition、内部 transition/effect、termination 以及 typed input/output/handoff metadata，并能跨任务复用。它使用与 proposed method 完全相同的 motif router、schema matcher、external executor、training examples、permissions、calls、tokens 与零 target update；一个容量匹配 constrained composer 只能选取和连接这些 frozen programs，不能访问 relation-level clause IDs。两条路径预注册匹配总存储/参数预算、最大 executable states、最大 transitions、composer depth、候选检索数和 inference token budget，因此差异只剩 relation-level factorization versus reusable whole-motif executable programs。
exact_mechanism.en: The proposed path retains the frozen clause library: only PRE, TRANS, HANDOFF, and TERM relations recurring with the same semantic interface in at least two training task families receive versioned clause IDs and enter the frozen library. At test time, the motif router may select only training-time motifs and deterministic schema matching may compose only frozen clauses; generating a new clause, state, or transition is forbidden. Add the closest modular control by learning or extracting frozen executable motif programs from the exact same training traces and schemas. Every program explicitly carries applicability/precondition, internal transition/effect, termination, and typed input/output/handoff metadata and is reusable across tasks. It uses the exact same motif router, schema matcher, external executor, training examples, permissions, calls, tokens, and zero target updates as the proposed method; a capacity-matched constrained composer may only select and connect those frozen programs and cannot access relation-level clause IDs. The two paths preregister matched total storage/parameter budget, maximum executable states, maximum transitions, composer depth, candidate retrieval count, and inference-token budget, leaving relation-level factorization versus reusable whole-motif executable programs as the sole mechanism difference.

children.update_surface: frozen versioned role-contract clause library composed without target-task updates

learning_signal.zh: clause library 与 executable-program library 从完全相同的训练 trajectories、tool schemas、role/handoff observations、success/failure outcomes 与 executor feedback 中抽取；任何 PRE/effect/termination/handoff evidence 都同时允许 program baseline 使用。两者具有相同训练 calls、tokens、优化预算与跨任务复用机会，held-out task 不允许梯度、memory write 或新增 library member。
learning_signal.en: The clause library and executable-program library are extracted from exactly the same training trajectories, tool schemas, role/handoff observations, success/failure outcomes, and executor feedback. Any evidence used to infer PRE, effects, termination, or handoffs is equally available to the program baseline. Both receive the same training calls, tokens, optimization budget, and cross-task reuse opportunities, and held-out tasks permit no gradient, memory write, or new library member.

independent_ground_truth.zh: truth 由训练不可见的 executable assertions 判定：hidden precondition satisfaction、state-transition effects、handoff schema/value assertions、termination correctness、权限约束及端到端任务完成。versioned clause IDs、motif program IDs、router outputs 与训练 executor feedback 均不是 ground truth。
independent_ground_truth.en: Truth is determined by hidden executable assertions unavailable during training: precondition satisfaction, state-transition effects, handoff schema/value assertions, termination correctness, permission constraints, and end-to-end task completion. Versioned clause IDs, motif-program IDs, router outputs, and training executor feedback are not ground truth.

simplest_baseline.zh: 同 traces 学到的 reusable executable-motif/program library：每个 frozen program 都拥有与 proposed clauses 可获得的同等 applicability/precondition、transition/effect、termination 和 typed handoff metadata；相同 motif router、schemas、executor、state/transition limits、composer capacity、calls、tokens、storage budget 与零 target updates 用于 held-out task composition，但 program 内部关系保持整体封装，不拆成独立 PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM clause。
simplest_baseline.en: A reusable executable-motif/program library learned from the same traces, where every frozen program has the same available applicability/precondition, transition/effect, termination, and typed handoff metadata as the proposed clauses. The same motif router, schemas, executor, state/transition limits, composer capacity, calls, tokens, storage budget, and zero target updates are used for held-out task composition, but relations inside each program remain encapsulated rather than factorized into independently reusable PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM clauses.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在模型比较前，仅根据 frozen training libraries 的结构预注册两个 held-out strata。Program-sufficient stratum 中存在可直接组合的完整 frozen motif programs；Relation-recombination stratum 中每个所需 PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM relation 都已在至少两个训练任务族独立出现，但没有单个 frozen motif program 包含目标任务所需的完整 relation conjunction。两种方法在完全相同 tasks、router outputs、schemas、executor、state/transition budget 与 inference budget 下零更新执行。关键 falsifier 是：在 program-sufficient stratum 应接近 parity，而在 relation-recombination stratum，只有 clause method 在 hidden handoff/transition assertions 与 end-to-end success 上稳定超过 modular program composer，才能把 transfer gain 归因于 finer relation factorization；若 program composer 同样重组成功，则 clause novelty 被否证。
decisive_pilot.en: Before model comparison, preregister two held-out strata using only the structure of the frozen training libraries. In the Program-Sufficient stratum, complete frozen motif programs exist that can be directly composed. In the Relation-Recombination stratum, every required PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM relation has independently occurred in at least two training task families, but no single frozen motif program contains the complete relation conjunction required by the target task. Both methods execute with zero updates on the identical tasks, router outputs, schemas, executor, state/transition budget, and inference budget. The key falsifier is that the methods should approach parity on Program-Sufficient tasks, while the clause method may claim finer-factorization transfer only if it reliably exceeds the modular program composer on hidden handoff/transition assertions and end-to-end success in Relation-Recombination tasks. If the program composer recombines successfully as well, the clause novelty is falsified.

stop_condition.zh: 若容量、数据、metadata、跨任务复用机会、composer、executor 与零更新条件全部对齐后，reusable executable-program baseline 在预注册 relation-recombination tasks 上匹配 clause library，则停止“PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM 关系级分解带来额外迁移能力”的主张，并将该方法视为 executable-skill/contract composition 的一种表示形式。若优势仅来自更大 library、更多 states/transitions、额外 handoff labels 或更高 inference budget，同样停止。
stop_condition.en: If, after equalizing capacity, data, metadata, cross-task reuse opportunity, composer, executor, and zero-update conditions, the reusable executable-program baseline matches the clause library on preregistered Relation-Recombination tasks, stop the claim that PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM relation-level decomposition adds transfer capability and treat the method as a representation variant of executable-skill/contract composition. Also stop if any advantage is attributable to a larger library, more states/transitions, extra handoff labels, or a larger inference budget.

material_change.zh: v5.3 增加的不是弱 whole-FSM control，而是文献碰撞后真正最接近的同数据 modular executable-program baseline，并把其 applicability、effects、termination、handoff metadata、router、composer、executor、reuse、capacity 与 zero-update 条件全部对齐。预注册 program-sufficient × relation-recombination 分层进一步直接检验 finer clause factorization 是否在 reusable executable skills 之上提供独立 transfer。
material_change.en: v5.3 adds not another weak whole-FSM control but the genuinely closest same-data modular executable-program baseline exposed by the collision search, equalizing applicability, effects, termination, handoff metadata, router, composer, executor, reuse, capacity, and zero-update conditions. The preregistered Program-Sufficient versus Relation-Recombination stratification then directly tests whether finer clause factorization provides independent transfer beyond reusable executable skills.

external_reviews.finding: v5.3 successfully replaces the weak whole-task FSM comparison with a genuinely modular reusable-program control and equalizes traces, metadata, router, composer, executor, storage/capacity, calls, tokens, state/transition limits, reuse opportunities, and zero target updates. However, the collision search exposes one stronger remaining comparator than the proposed encapsulated whole-motif program library: learned symbolic action/operator libraries already represent reusable typed operators through predicates, applicability/preconditions, effects or causal relations and compose those operators for unseen tasks. UniDomain is particularly close because it learns and fuses reusable predicates, operators, and precondition/effect causal edges into a unified domain for zero-shot compositional planning; BLADE likewise learns reusable structured high-level actions with preconditions/effects. Consequently, comparing independent PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM clauses only with an internally encapsulated whole-motif program can still make the proposed representation artificially more recombinable. The final v5.2-style equality boundary is closed against the nominated program baseline, but the official-source collision search reveals one material strongest-baseline omission, so PASS is premature. ([arXiv][10])
external_reviews.finding_zh: v5.3 已成功把较弱的 whole-task FSM control 替换为真正模块化、可复用的 executable-program baseline，并对齐 traces、metadata、router、composer、executor、storage/capacity、calls、tokens、state/transition limits、跨任务复用机会与 zero target updates。但官方来源碰撞检索显示，还存在一个比“内部保持整体封装的 whole-motif program library”更强、更接近的 baseline：已有 learned symbolic action/operator library 会显式表示可复用的 typed operators、predicates、applicability/preconditions、effects 或 causal relations，并将这些 operator 组合到未见任务。尤其 UniDomain 会从 demonstrations 中学习并融合 predicates、operators 以及 precondition/effect causal edges，形成 unified domain 后进行 zero-shot compositional planning；BLADE 也学习带 preconditions/effects 的 reusable structured high-level actions。因此，如果 proposed method 的 PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM 可以独立重组，而 control 的内部关系仍被人为封装在 whole motif 内，proposed representation 仍可能获得结构性更强的 recombination 权限。当前设计已经关闭对其自选 program baseline 的最终等价性边界，但官方 collision search 暴露了一个新的、实质性的 strongest-baseline 缺口，因此尚不能 PASS。 ([arXiv][10])
external_reviews.required_action: Add a third, capacity/data/budget-matched learned symbolic operator/action-model baseline modeled on the closest collision class: from the identical traces it must learn reusable typed predicates/operators with the same available precondition/applicability, transition/effect, termination, and handoff information, and its planner/composer must be allowed to recombine those frozen operators and shared predicate/causal relations under the identical router, executor, storage, state/transition, retrieval, token, and zero-update budgets. Redefine the preregistered Relation-Recombination stratum so that it does not structurally deny this operator baseline access to reusable substructure. Claim independent relation-clause factorization only if the clause library beats both the whole-motif program baseline and this symbolic operator baseline on the same hidden executable truth.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 增加第三个真正容量、数据和预算匹配的 learned symbolic operator/action-model baseline，对齐当前最接近的 collision class：它必须从完全相同 traces 中学习 reusable typed predicates/operators，并获得与 proposed method 相同可用的 precondition/applicability、transition/effect、termination 与 handoff 信息；其 planner/composer 必须能够在相同 router、executor、storage、state/transition、retrieval、token 与 zero-update 预算下重组冻结 operators 及共享 predicate/causal relations。同时重新定义预注册 Relation-Recombination stratum，避免通过任务构造在结构上剥夺该 operator baseline 对可复用子结构的访问。只有 clause library 在同一 hidden executable truth 上同时击败 whole-motif program baseline 与 symbolic operator baseline，才能主张独立的 relation-clause factorization 增益。

closest_work: UniDomain: Pretraining a Unified PDDL Domain from Real-World Demonstrations for Generalizable Robot Task Planning learns reusable predicates and operators, recovers precondition/effect causal edges, fuses atomic domains, and performs compositional planning on unseen tasks. ([arXiv][10])

BLADE: Learning Compositional Behaviors from Demonstration and Language learns a library of structured high-level actions with preconditions/effects and controllers for compositional generalization. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][11])
Learning compositional models of robot skills for task and motion planning learns skill/action precondition and effect models and composes them for novel long-horizon tasks. ([arXiv][12])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: Independent versioned PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM role-contract clauses, particularly explicit HANDOFF and TERM relations across semantic interfaces, remain finer-grained than the located operator/skill representations. But that difference has not yet been isolated against a same-data symbolic action-model baseline that already exposes reusable predicates, preconditions, effects, and causal structure.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A frozen same-data symbolic operator/action-model library, in addition to the existing reusable whole-motif program library: learn reusable typed predicates and executable operators from exactly the same trajectories and schemas, expose the same applicability/precondition, transition/effect, termination, typed I/O and handoff evidence, and allow a capacity-matched planner/composer to recombine the frozen operator/predicate structure with the same router, executor, permissions, total storage/parameters, maximum states/transitions, composer depth, retrieval count, calls, tokens, inference budget, and zero target-task updates.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Preregister Program-Sufficient and Relation-Recombination tasks before model comparison, but evaluate three matched paths: independent clause library, reusable whole-motif programs, and reusable symbolic operators/predicates. On Program-Sufficient cases all should approach parity. On Relation-Recombination cases the clause method must beat both controls on hidden precondition, transition/effect, handoff, termination, permission, and end-to-end assertions. The stratum must be defined from common semantic requirements rather than from absence of a complete program/operator in one baseline's library.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the relation-level-factorization claim if either the matched whole-motif program composer or the matched symbolic operator/action-model baseline reproduces the clause library on preregistered recomposition tasks, or if the advantage disappears after equalizing reusable predicate/causal structure, handoff/termination evidence, storage, state/transition limits, and inference budget. In that case treat the clause library as a representation variant of executable skill/symbolic contract composition rather than a distinct transfer mechanism.
unknowns: Whether explicit HANDOFF and TERM clauses yield transfer beyond what a sufficiently expressive learned symbolic operator model can encode.
Whether the proposed Relation-Recombination stratum remains nontrivial and unbiased after all three representations receive equal reusable substructure.
Whether relation-level factorization retains an advantage after matching not only nominal storage but effective representational degrees of freedom.

The final v5.2-style equality boundary is closed against the nominated program baseline, but the official-source collision search reveals one material strongest-baseline omission, so PASS is premature. ([arXiv][10])
children.external_finding_zh: v5.3 已成功把较弱的 whole-task FSM control 替换为真正模块化、可复用的 executable-program baseline，并对齐 traces、metadata、router、composer、executor、storage/capacity、calls、tokens、state/transition limits、跨任务复用机会与 zero target updates。但官方来源碰撞检索显示，还存在一个比“内部保持整体封装的 whole-motif program library”更强、更接近的 baseline：已有 learned symbolic action/operator library 会显式表示可复用的 typed operators、predicates、applicability/preconditions、effects 或 causal relations，并将这些 operator 组合到未见任务。尤其 UniDomain 会从 demonstrations 中学习并融合 predicates、operators 以及 precondition/effect causal edges，形成 unified domain 后进行 zero-shot compositional planning；BLADE 也学习带 preconditions/effects 的 reusable structured high-level actions。因此，如果 proposed method 的 PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM 可以独立重组，而 control 的内部关系仍被人为封装在 whole motif 内，proposed representation 仍可能获得结构性更强的 recombination 权限。当前设计已经关闭对其自选 program baseline 的最终等价性边界，但官方 collision search 暴露了一个新的、实质性的 strongest-baseline 缺口，因此尚不能 PASS。 ([arXiv][10])
children.external_required_action: Add a third, capacity/data/budget-matched learned symbolic operator/action-model baseline modeled on the closest collision class: from the identical traces it must learn reusable typed predicates/operators with the same available precondition/applicability, transition/effect, termination, and handoff information, and its planner/composer must be allowed to recombine those frozen operators and shared predicate/causal relations under the identical router, executor, storage, state/transition, retrieval, token, and zero-update budgets. Redefine the preregistered Relation-Recombination stratum so that it does not structurally deny this operator baseline access to reusable substructure. Claim independent relation-clause factorization only if the clause library beats both the whole-motif program baseline and this symbolic operator baseline on the same hidden executable truth.
children.external_required_action_zh: 增加第三个真正容量、数据和预算匹配的 learned symbolic operator/action-model baseline，对齐当前最接近的 collision class：它必须从完全相同 traces 中学习 reusable typed predicates/operators，并获得与 proposed method 相同可用的 precondition/applicability、transition/effect、termination 与 handoff 信息；其 planner/composer 必须能够在相同 router、executor、storage、state/transition、retrieval、token 与 zero-update 预算下重组冻结 operators 及共享 predicate/causal relations。同时重新定义预注册 Relation-Recombination stratum，避免通过任务构造在结构上剥夺该 operator baseline 对可复用子结构的访问。只有 clause library 在同一 hidden executable truth 上同时击败 whole-motif program baseline 与 symbolic operator baseline，才能主张独立的 relation-clause factorization 增益。

analysis_contract.candidate_replication: same candidate must show the same controlled sign in both probe_development and future_eval; require >=2 harm candidates and >=2 benefit candidates
analysis_contract.transport_support: >=12 controlled nonzero effects and >=3 target-family folds with >=2 nonzero each

provenance_deviation.required_postrun_repair: Independently replay every recorded ALFWorld action trace to verify environment success and audit every unit/arm against the frozen plan before granting paper-level authority. Preserve sequencing-deviation.json as separate provenance evidence.

sequencing_deviation.resolution: Continue the unchanged frozen full-stage block; preserve this sequencing deviation in provenance.

provenance_regeneration.early_stop_reason: Frozen recovery requires every original nonzero controlled-effect sign to match. The first sign mismatch makes PASS impossible; remaining units are not run to avoid non-informative GPU spend.

provenance_recovery.next_action: HOLD formal-method and second-backbone escalation. Do not repair by retuning frozen thresholds or mixing partial replica branches. Any future reopening requires a clean source-locked primary collection with an exact runtime snapshot preserved before execution.

support.replication_contract: same candidate must exhibit the same controlled-effect sign in both probe_development and future_eval; require >=2 harm candidates and >=2 benefit candidates

analysis.method_pass_note: No numeric minimum-coverage threshold was frozen for the qualitative method-PASS condition; report evidence without inventing a post-hoc threshold.

analysis.strict_loto_contract: Hold out target family; train only development-candidate probe rows from other target families; evaluate candidate-3 future_eval.
analysis.r_learner_note: A distinct R-learner is not estimated from only 24 development-probe paired-effect units; this is baseline underpower, not method failure.

decision.second_model_rule: Authorization requires both frozen full-table mechanism/support gates; it does not imply #3/#5 method PASS.

decision.scientific_role: CPU-only retrospective VOI falsifier on diagnostic-only 216-table; cannot emit method PASS/FAIL
decision.next_action: Do not launch clean R1 or a second backbone. Stop standalone #3/#5 escalation; retain #5 only as archived secondary transport analysis and preserve all old evidence as diagnostic-only.

applicability_falsifier.scientific_role: retrospective VOI screen; cannot emit method PASS/FAIL

first_divergence.interpretation: Current traces do not support the claim that task-level aggregation alone explains the failure; state-localization rescue is weak on this substrate. Do not revive B-8/B-9 from this diagnostic.

interpretation.pure_stochastic_noise: not supported: branch index reproduces 11/11 and exact branch action pair 10/11 on matched hardware
interpretation.stable_local_state_effect: not supported: state-localization screen is weak and identical local signature can flip sign
interpretation.best_current_explanation: memory reproducibly steers an early trajectory branch; downstream task context determines whether that branch is beneficial or harmful

audit_priority.scientific_role: retrospective experiment-scheduling diagnostic only; cannot emit method PASS/FAIL and cannot exclude candidates from confirmatory evaluation
audit_priority.interpretation: Early branch divergence enriches high-impact memory uses, but the cost advantage collapses when recall approaches confirmatory levels. Use only to prioritize audit order or allocate exploratory budget; never as a hard scientific gate.
audit_priority.recommended_home: research-system pre-experiment/update-governance scheduling heuristic; merge with impact triage rather than a standalone memory paper
audit_priority.next_action: Archive B-8/B-9 standalone escalation. If reused elsewhere, treat branch amplification only as a soft priority score and independently verify outcomes for all confirmatory cases.

mechanism_diagnosis.scientific_role: retrospective failure explanation plus soft experiment-scheduling signal; does not revive B-8/B-9, authorize a new idea, or exclude confirmatory candidates

formal_method.rule: A clean R1 requires applicability-structure screen PASS plus human authorization; the current screen does not authorize execution.

second_model.rule: Remain HOLD through support qualification and the full Qwen support table; second-backbone authorization requires an explicit CPU-only full-support decision and is never implied by the old full table or qualification PASS alone.

system_architecture.model: one temporal lifecycle + six functional responsibility layers

label.zh: 证据、边界与最近邻工作

mandate.en: Build provenance-aware evidence, define the research boundary, and detect collisions before a contribution is claimed.
mandate.zh: 建立可追溯证据、冻结研究边界，并在声称贡献前完成最近邻与撞车审查。

mandate.en: Turn a real gap into a publishable contribution, explicit mechanism, and paper-motivated method before implementation.
mandate.zh: 在实现之前，把真实缺口转成可发表贡献、明确机制和由论文 Novelty 推导的方法。

mandate.en: Compile paper claims into decisive tests and prove the cheapest local experiment is identifiable, economical, and executable.
mandate.zh: 把论文主张编译成决定性实验，并证明最便宜的局部验证在可识别性、资源与执行条件上具备启动资格。

mandate.en: Separate phenomenon support from method evidence, adjudicate negative results by layer, freeze the method, then scale only the frozen design.
mandate.zh: 把现象支持与方法证据分开，按证据层解释负结果，冻结方法后才允许对冻结设计做全量扩展。

mandate.en: Keep code execution, GPU leases, traces, budgets, AI triggers, and scientific authority explicit and recoverable.
mandate.zh: 把代码执行、GPU 租约、Trace、预算、AI 触发与科学权限分离管理，并保证可恢复。

label.en: Scientific memory, system learning, and publication
label.zh: 科研记忆、系统学习与发布

mandate.en: Preserve decisions and dead ends without rewriting history, evaluate the research system itself, and close publishable claims against real artifacts.
mandate.zh: 在不改写科研历史的前提下沉淀决策与死路，评测科研系统本身，并让论文主张逐条回到真实工件。

purpose.en: Detect portfolio collapse toward a small neighborhood of seed literature even when individual ideas appear novel.

invariants: Temporal stages answer WHEN work may advance; functional layers answer WHO owns each responsibility.
A component has one primary responsibility layer even when its evidence is consumed elsewhere.
No advisory component can grant scientific or GPU authority.
The P0 seven-stage state machine is nested inside scientific validation; it is not a second paper lifecycle.
Cross-cutting methodology controls attach to an existing owner component and never create an implicit seventh functional layer.

gate_provenance.rule: The executed frozen contract is historical authority; the later stricter source gate is reported only as a robustness/provenance check.

authority.basis: The paper-first authority preceding these executions explicitly kept local validation locked; no externally supplied human-authorization artifact is active.
authority.rule: Executed traces are preserved as historical diagnostics but cannot create P0 lifecycle, method-admission, principle, or scale-up authority.

detail.stage_scope_note: The seven scientific stages are the experiment-evidence state machine nested inside the 11-stage paper-first lifecycle; they do not replace the paper lifecycle.
